Bruen*, the Supreme Court established a two-step test for Second Amendment challenges: first, whether the plain text covers the conduct; second, whether the government shows its regulation is consistent with historical tradition. Critics, including Justice Breyer and Judge Reeves, argue this test is impractical because judges are lawyers, not historians. The author contends this is the wrong question, as judges decide cases using legal tools, not historical methods. Originalists argue that evidence of law is durable, and judges must decide cases even with uncertainty. At step one, the plain text of the Second Amendment is generally clear. At step two, courts must identify historical traditions, which are often easy to discover due to durable sources. When uncertainty remains, legal tools like burden-shifting resolve cases, unlike historians who can remain silent.

The speaker is thrilled the series is over, praises Buffalo's young team, and reflects on the grueling journey to winning the Stanley Cup, highlighting teammates playing through injuries and the value of experience.

The passage discusses poker strategy, focusing on the "decision mentality" of evaluating decisions based on expected value rather than actual outcomes. It contrasts three levels of reasoning: Level 1 (my hand vs. your specific hand), Level 2 (my hand vs. your range, or exploitative play), and Level 3 (my range vs. your range, or optimal play). Key concepts include pot odds, equity calculation, effective stack size, position, and the importance of blinds and antes. The instructor provides specific hand ranges for opening from different positions and advises against common beginner mistakes like calling instead of raising or being too scared to go all-in with short stacks.

In the UK, most ovarian cancer cases are diagnosed late, with nearly half presenting as emergencies. Public awareness of its four main symptoms—persistent bloating, difficulty eating, frequent urination, and persistent abdominal pain—is low, and there is no screening test. Early detection offers a 95% survival rate, but only one in three cases is found early. Ovarian Cancer Action provides a free online symptom checker and a symptoms diary to help women seek timely medical advice.

DryShips Inc. (DRYS) raised $14.5 million through a continuous offering plan, failing to meet its $30 million request from Kalani Investors. As of April 17th, $173.4 million remained to be issued, with weak market demand and 16.8% dilution from shares issued. The company’s equity market capitalization was $106 million.

On September 20, 2017, Hurricane Maria struck Puerto Rico with 155 mph winds and up to 40 inches of rain, destroying the electricity grid, infrastructure, and 80% of crop value, causing over $82 billion in damages. The passage proposes a semiparametric Poisson regression model to estimate excess deaths from indirect causes post-hurricane, accounting for population displacement, intra-annual variability, and cause-specific mortality duration.

Dylan Drysdale, Tim Loughran, and Garry Cullum won class titles at the 2017 Molecule ProKart Series final. Drysdale won the Wifiplus KZ2 class by four points, Loughran won the Aarque Group KZ2 Masters class, and Cullum won the KZ2 Restricted class by 20 points.
NASA plans to use a nuclear device on the spacecraft HAMMER to destroy the large asteroid Bennu, which has a 1 in 2,700 chance of hitting Earth in 2135.

Hendrik Bessembinder's 2017 study found that between 1926 and 2015, only 43% of equities outperformed one-month Treasury Bills. The median stock performed poorly, while a few select stocks drove overall market returns. The recommended solution for investors is to buy a passive fund or, if investing in individual stocks, to diversify.

In soccer, when play continues after an injury, players may kick the ball out of bounds as an act of sportsmanship. The restart is a throw-in to the team that did not kick it out, who then returns the ball to the other team, typically backward. Neither team should exploit this courtesy; the receiving team must wait for the thrower to reposition before attacking. If the referee stops play for an injury, a dropped ball restarts play, and the team with possession may pass it backward to an opponent.

Predictive maintenance systems, or e-Maintenance, use real-time monitoring to achieve near-zero downtime and integrate with e-business tools. E-Maintenance supports the integration of e-Manufacturing and e-Business, improving asset performance. A reconfigurable maintenance system uses diagnostic knowledge to support intercompany cooperation and improve system reliability. A modular reconfigurable maintenance system uses a distributed architecture and monitoring to enable remote activities and rapid detection of adverse conditions. Companies must integrate reconfigurable maintenance systems to respond to market changes with minimal costs.
The author admits to prematurely abandoning the US equity market but now presents 21 charts suggesting reconsideration of a bearish stance, citing signs of underlying market breadth strength.

Teachers were advised against becoming Facebook friends with students to maintain professional distance, warned about hasty or angry social media comments that could harm careers, and told not to feel obligated to respond to unreasonable employer contact outside work hours.

VentureWire's May 17, 2001 issue covers top stories including Tahoe Networks' $38M launch, Startups.com's restructuring, Hermes' $965M investment plan, and OffRoad Capital's split. It also reports on new money, bad news, new products, M&A, new directors, new people, VC fund news, and VC personnel changes.

The speaker expresses gratitude for being chosen to serve, outlines executive duties (executing laws, managing foreign relations, revenue, and military), and pledges to respect constitutional limits, preserve peace, practice economy, reduce debt, favor agriculture/commerce/manufactures equally, support internal improvements, maintain a subordinate military, strengthen the militia, adopt a just Indian policy, pursue reform against patronage abuses, and select diligent officers.

The passage examines how TRNC Presidents' discourses have shaped education policies, focusing on identity construction, historical narratives, and reforms. Education policies evolved through historical periods (Ottoman, British, post-1974), with Council decisions influencing structural reforms, teacher training, and curriculum. History textbooks have often presented a Turkish identity-centered narrative, though post-2000 reforms aimed for more reconciliatory approaches. Presidential statements varied: Denktaş emphasized national identity, Talat focused on EU harmonization, Eroğlu and Tatar prioritized cooperation with Turkey, and Akıncı highlighted multiculturalism. The study concludes that political discourse directly impacts education, recommending multi-perspective curricula and long-term strategic planning.

Russian Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov stated that India's SCO accession increased the group's political profile and capacity to stabilize Central and South Asia, including Afghanistan. He called India's foreign policy a factor for global security, deemed current bilateral trade unsatisfactory (aiming for $30 billion by 2025), and noted deeper defense cooperation will increase technology transfer. Lavrov criticized the US strategy in Afghanistan, denied Russia supported the Taliban, and said the situation requires involving all relevant parties, including the Taliban and neighbors.

A letter from fired prosecutor Michael Ben’Ary stated a false social media post led to his termination during a terrorism prosecution. The letter accused DOJ leadership of being "more concerned with punishing the president’s perceived enemies than they are with protecting our national security."

The speaker emphasizes the need for their team to be prepared for a strong opponent playing to extend the series, focusing on a good start to avoid a difficult game. They are more concerned with their own team's readiness than any external chatter, noting the opponent's home success.

Malcolm Mitchell, a New England Patriots wide receiver, will receive the Promise Hero Award from America’s Promise Alliance for overcoming his own literacy struggles and founding Read with Malcolm, a youth literacy initiative. Mitchell taught himself to read using children's books after struggling in college. His organization aims to increase book access for low-income children, as 61% of such families lack age-appropriate books. Mitchell graduated in 2015, was drafted in 2016, and has written a book, *The Magician’s Hat*.
Yandex will report its Q2 2018 financial results on July 26, 2018, followed by a conference call and webcast at 8:00 a.m. U.S. Eastern Time.

The passage describes a digital accessibility workshop designed for software professionals and CS educators in India, addressing a lack of accessibility training. The one-day workshop included five instructional modules and hands-on activities. Post-workshop feedback from 73 participants was highly positive, with 100% willing to recommend it. Participants reported increased confidence and a shift in perception, though some found technical sessions challenging. The authors recommend pre-workshop materials, role-based content, and follow-up sessions for future efforts.

The passage discusses the Supreme Court's potential approach to *Humphrey's Executor* in a case about President Trump's firing of FTC commissioner Rebecca Kelly Slaughter. It notes the court seems likely to uphold the firing but may not overturn the 1936 precedent, instead applying a nuanced analysis of the FTC's modern powers, which have shifted from legislative/judicial to primarily executive functions, as signaled in recent opinions like *Seila Law*.

DA leader Mmusi Maimane accused President Zuma and the ANC of using "Radical Economic Transformation" as a cover for elite self-enrichment, calling the ANC the "enemy of the people." He cited the Esidimeni deaths, militarization of Parliament, and corruption allegations against Zuma. Maimane outlined a DA "Rescue Plan" focused on education reform, youth employment, private sector-led growth, anti-corruption measures, and inclusive economic policies.

Using Alexa, you can create a cleaning schedule via the Cleaning Buddy skill, order cleaning supplies from Amazon with voice commands, automate robot vacuums like Neato or Roomba, and manage laundry through Laundrapp or stain-removal skills.

This study investigates topographic defects introduced by electropolishing (EP) on bulk niobium (Nb) samples for superconducting radio frequency (SRF) cavities. Using atomic force microscopy and white light interferometry, the authors characterized intergranular sloped steps with slope angles up to ~50° and step heights up to 70 nm. They calculated that these defects cause magnetic field enhancement and superheating field suppression, which can degrade the achievable peak magnetic field. The study also found that such topography can locally reduce impurity concentration during shallow diffusion treatments, potentially affecting the effectiveness of processes like low-temperature baking. The authors conclude that minimizing these topographic defects is essential for achieving high-field performance in SRF cavities.

MIT researchers developed a refined prime editing system, called vPE, that reduces DNA editing errors to about 1/60th of previous rates, achieving as few as one mistake per 543 edits in certain modes, by identifying specific Cas9 mutations that stabilize new DNA strands.

British police declared a major incident after a man and woman in their 40s were found unconscious in Amesbury from an unknown substance. Counterterrorism officers are assisting, and it is unclear if a crime occurred. The incident is near Salisbury, where the Skripals were poisoned in March.

In a bankruptcy case, the court denied a creditor's complaint to deny the debtor's discharge under four sections of the Bankruptcy Code. The court found the plaintiff did not prove the debtor fraudulently transferred or concealed property, failed to keep financial records, made false oaths, or failed to explain asset losses. Judgment was entered for the debtor.

The passage discusses the history of polo, originating in Persia over 2,000 years ago, spreading to India, and then to England and the U.S. It focuses on the Milwaukee Polo Club in Hartland, Wisconsin, an extension of a 1923 club. Club member Thomas Esser describes it as "blue collar" polo, aiming to be accessible with low ticket prices ($5, kids free). The club has players from multiple states, games last about two hours with six seven-minute chukkers, and safety for horses is a core concern, with horses treated as teammates.

The passage discusses the importance of preparation, focus, and execution over momentum, the devastating nature of not winning in a salary cap league where opportunities are rare, the value of team depth and player development, the need to control game match-ups, the significance of goaltending and team support, the belief that winning together builds lasting bonds, the impact of puck handling on forechecking, and the uncertainty of future opportunities.

After recent ICE arrests in Austin, Austin ISD lawyers directed staff not to share unvetted resources or speak on controversial topics, citing scrutiny from state lawmakers. The memo followed 51 detentions, causing student anxiety. School board Vice President Paul Saldana criticized the memo as contradictory to district commitments. Education Austin distributed immigration resources and held Know Your Rights seminars, arguing the information is non-political and essential for family safety.
A 13-year-old girl was shot in the leg in Guildford, Sydney, on Tuesday night. She is in serious but stable condition in hospital. Police believe the shooting was not random.

Penny stocks are bad because they involve unproven business models, low liquidity, exposure to scams, and high volatility, with most ending up worthless. They are often traded on unregulated OTC markets with less financial disclosure, making them very risky.

Senator Mark Warner believes Republicans are attempting to undermine Robert Mueller's investigation and the FBI's integrity, citing the Nunes memo's partisan release and his blocked access to it. He argues this is unprecedented and threatens national security by preventing a unified response to cyber threats.

The passage discusses two-sided matching, focusing on fairness for both participants and teams. It introduces a new fairness concept, team-justified EF1, and presents an algorithm that guarantees team-justified SD-EF1, participant-justified EF, balancedness, and Pareto optimality, while also being group-strategyproof for participants. The algorithm unifies the round-robin and Gale–Shapley algorithms.

Digital laggards prioritize short-term efforts, risk aversion, and transactional training, while digital leaders foster learning mindsets, transparent data access, and data-driven goals. Leaders use metrics for flexibility and alignment, whereas laggards hoard data, set aspirational goals, and lack strategic connection. Data culture is central to leaders, but transformation challenges persist; organizations fit patterns like data novice or data reliant.

The passage marks the centennial of the U.S. Constitution, reviewing national progress, the Civil War's strengthening of the Union, the emancipation of enslaved people, and the importance of equal suffrage and education. It addresses financial policy, agriculture, manufacturing, transportation, religious freedom, civil service reform, and the administration's commitment to constitutional authority and national unity.

The ATR trailing stop is a technical indicator that helps traders set stop-loss levels based on price volatility, using the average true range (ATR) to calculate dynamic stop levels. It adjusts to market conditions, protects profits, and minimizes losses. The stop value is calculated by multiplying the ATR by a multiplier (typically 3.5) and subtracting from the previous close for long positions. It can signal trend reversals when price breaches stop levels, and is applicable to stocks. Risks include not accounting for past performance.

Drew Faust, Harvard's first female president, announced she will step down on June 30, 2018, after 11 years, coinciding with the end of a major fundraising campaign that has raised $8 billion. A historian, she plans a sabbatical to return to scholarship. Hired in 2007 without prior college presidency experience, she succeeded Lawrence Summers and is credited with restoring trust, fostering collaboration, expanding financial aid, and championing arts and sciences. Her tenure also faced challenges, including backlash over cracking down on all-male clubs, diversity demands, suspending the men's soccer team, and a 2% endowment loss.

Texas A&M has had at least one first-round NFL draft pick every year since 2011. Receiver Christian Kirk is the Aggies' best hope to continue that streak in 2018, though he is projected as a fringe first-round pick. The streak began with linebacker Von Miller in 2011 and includes nine first-round selections through 2017.

Michigan State Superintendent Michael Rice, retiring after a decades-long career, argues that state law gives schools too much flexibility to reduce instructional days, including counting up to seven professional development days as instructional time. He notes that while Michigan has made progress on some educational goals, such as increased preschool enrollment and a record 82% graduation rate, challenges persist, including flat NAEP scores and poor third-grade reading results. Rice points to Mississippi's mandatory literacy training and focus on instructional time as a model. Teacher shortages are improving, with 18,000 now preparing for the profession annually, up from 9,500 in 2017.

Alphabet will pay $24.5 million to settle a lawsuit by Trump over his post-January 6 YouTube ban, with $22 million going to Trump and $2.5 million to co-plaintiffs. Trump directed his portion toward the Trust for the National Mall and a White House ballroom. Alphabet admitted no liability.

Peter Lynch, a retired money manager, led the Fidelity Magellan Fund from 1977 to 1990, achieving 29.2% annual returns and more than doubling the S&P 500's performance. His strategy focused on investing in understandable businesses, undervalued companies, and fundamental analysis, categorizing firms into six types: slow-growing, moderately growing, fast-growing, cyclical, crisis recovery, and those with undervalued assets. He preferred simple companies with clear business models, boring names, minimal analyst interest, and those not in fast-growing industries.

The Vice President of the Ghana Football Association, George Afriyie, was sacked after an Executive Committee meeting, weeks after announcing his intention to contest the 2019 GFA polls. The decision highlighted a rift with GFA boss Kwesi Nyantakyi, who had previously wanted Afriyie removed. Afriyie’s sacking is expected to embolden his campaign, though history shows Nyantakyi sidelines former deputies. The Executive Committee was divided over the leadership, and Nyantakyi may seek re-election to protect his legacy.

Lenders to the Dabhol Power project have hired Stone & Webster to evaluate the cost of suspending the project's second phase. Enron suggested a temporary suspension, contingent on assurance that Phase I power would be lifted. DPC is willing to cut its rate of return to 11%. Lenders formed a committee to negotiate with MSEB. DPC appealed to the Bombay High Court to stay a MERC order. The Godbole committee stated DPC's return on equity should not exceed 16%.

A comprehensive assessment of cheetah populations in southern Africa, supported by the National Geographic Society, reveals the dire state of the species. Scientists urge listing the cheetah as "Endangered" on the IUCN Red List, citing low population estimates and a 91 percent loss of historic range.

Vector-borne diseases transmitted by mosquitoes are a growing global concern, with climate change and human mobility facilitating their spread to temperate zones. In the Basque Country, no autochthonous cases have been recorded, but imported cases and mosquito populations are increasing. This study uses machine learning to model the relationship between mosquito egg counts and environmental factors (temperature, humidity, precipitation) in the Basque Country provinces of Gipuzkoa and Bizkaia. The Random Forest model performed best on training data, while the Generalized Linear Model performed best on test data. The study aims to predict mosquito abundance to inform public health strategies.

The speaker reflects on the playoff series, noting four games were competitive and two were momentum-driven. They express excitement for the opportunity ahead, praise their team's effort and resilience despite injuries, and highlight the privilege of having Red Wings legends like Lindsay and Gordie involved. They discuss comfort at home ice, the importance of execution over the prize, and the Stanley Cup as hockey's greatest prize. They emphasize enjoying the moment, the series' great player battles, and the support of Detroit fans amid economic hardship. They downplay individual scoring, focus on team success, and mention Rafalski's input.
The author reflects on their college experience eight years after graduation, noting they didn't seize enough opportunities or adventure time, and now regrets these missed chances.

The Himachal Pradesh Board of Secondary Education (HPBOSE) declared the Class 12th Result 2018 on April 24 at 14:07 pm on its official website hpbose.org. The Class 12 examination was held from March 6 to March 29, 2018. Students can check results via SMS or on websites like examresults.net and indiaresults.com. The overall pass percentage was 69.67%.

Seven more candidates qualified on Feb. 14 for Georgia's 6th Congressional District seat, increasing the field to 15 with one qualifying day remaining. The special election is April 18, with a potential runoff on June 20.

Liverpool's 2017/18 Premier League season starts away to Watford on August 12. Key fixtures include: home to Everton on December 9 (away April 7), home to Manchester United on October 14 (away March 10), home to Swansea on Boxing Day, and ending at home to Brighton on May 13. They face Chelsea away on May 6. Dates may change for TV.

A study in *Thorax* found that CT lung cancer screening increased smoking cessation rates among high-risk smokers, with 10% quitting after two weeks and 15% after two years, compared to 5% in the unscreened group. The study involved 8,729 high-risk participants aged 50-75 from a sample of nearly 2.5 million British residents.

The Geminid meteor shower peaks Wednesday night, best viewed between midnight and 4 a.m. Thursday, with up to 50 meteors visible. Viewing is improved by a smaller crescent moon, and no telescope is needed. The meteors radiate from the Gemini constellation and occur when Earth passes through debris from asteroid Phaethon.

The U.S. Geological Survey awarded $4.9 million to Caltech and six other institutions for a West Coast earthquake-warning system, and purchased $1 million in sensor equipment for the ShakeAlert system. The funding follows earlier budget concerns, with $10.2 million secured after legislative outcry. Completion is estimated to require $38.3 million in capital and $16.1 million annually.

Northwestern's first NCAA bid is within reach after a win over Wisconsin, but the team must manage increased media attention and avoid complacency, as players emphasize each game's importance and the risk of losing their position. The next test is against Maryland, with Scottie Lindsey out due to mono.

Valmet Oyj’s Board of Directors approved a new long-term share-based incentive plan for key employees, covering 2018-2020, with rewards based on performance criteria. The plan targets about 120 participants, with a maximum reward of 586,000 shares, and includes ownership recommendations and restriction periods.

An email from American Airlines to Theresa Staab promoting Net SAAver Weekend Getaway fares for travel the weekend of November 30 - December 4, 2001, with a purchase deadline of November 23, 2001. It lists domestic and international roundtrip fares from various US cities, along with information on AAdvantage award travel, vacation packages, car rental specials, and rules/restrictions.

A U.S. study of Illinois daycare centers found that sun safety is a low priority for teachers, who focus more on nutrition, exercise, and tooth brushing. Only 20% listed sun protection as a top priority. While half of programs provided sunscreen, 77% did not allow children to apply it themselves. Some used spray sunscreen to avoid touching children, but often applied it incorrectly to faces. The study noted limitations, including its single-state focus.

A federal jury in Denver found that radio host David Mueller assaulted and battered Taylor Swift during a 2013 photo session. The jury awarded Swift $1 in compensation and also decided that Swift’s mother and manager did not interfere with Mueller’s contract.

The author, a lawyer and mother, describes experiencing unwanted belly touching during three pregnancies while working in court, which she labels as assault. She argues this practice, often euphemized as "the Rub," is a workplace culture and public health problem that violates consent and should be addressed through explicit policies and training, such as a simple "Do not touch" rule.

The speaker notes improved puck management and positioning, aiming to keep the puck away from Brodeur. They feel confident after two consecutive wins, focusing on the next game Thursday. The team is in a good mood, with a key player providing a tremendous lift. They acknowledge the challenge of playing after travel but expect a good game, noting both teams are defensively strong and capable of comebacks.
Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth told hundreds of generals and admirals that the military had become "soft" and "woke," arguing for a shake-up.

Setting a number of write blocks to be pre-erased (ACMD23) makes a following Multiple Block Write operation faster. The host uses this command to define how many write blocks will be sent in the next write operation.

On Christmas Eve 2012, Commander Chris Hadfield, aboard the International Space Station 400 km above Earth, hid cards from crew families for the astronauts to find. Due to 16 daily sunrises, timing "morning" was complicated. To avoid crumbs in microgravity, the crew ate a non-crumbly fruitcake from Trappist Monks, velcroed to a table. Hadfield prioritized psychological health for holidays, including a special meal, a 61-cm artificial tree, and stockings. Crews celebrated holidays from their cultures, a perspective Hadfield now shares in his show, *Generator*.

The A100 GPU has a 1.5x larger L1 cache and shared memory per SM than V100. It features 40 GB of HBM2 memory with 1555 GB/sec bandwidth (73% increase over V100) and a 40 MB L2 cache (nearly 7x larger) with 2.3x the read bandwidth. It includes L2 cache residency controls and Compute Data Compression for up to 4x improvement in DRAM bandwidth and L2.

Polling for 69 of 70 Uttarakhand assembly seats began Wednesday with tight security. Karnaprayag seat voting was moved to March 9. Over 74 lakh voters will decide the fate of 628 candidates. Nearly 30,000 security personnel and 60,000 polling officials are deployed across 10,685 booths.

The plaintiff was injured when a splinter from a bowling alley's worn, splintered floor entered his finger while bowling. The court found the evidence warranted a finding of the defendant's negligence and did not require a ruling of contributory negligence. Judgment was entered for the plaintiff.
Samsung announced three new water-resistant Galaxy A smartphones (A3, A5, A7) with varying screen sizes, a 16-megapixel camera, and fingerprint sensor, launching first in Russia.

Only the Secretary of State may issue U.S. passports. Passports are denied to non-citizens and those who have only declared intent to become citizens. Applicants must submit a sworn affidavit with personal details, a physical description, a witness certificate, and an oath of allegiance. Additional requirements apply for native citizens, foreign-born children of citizens, naturalized citizens, women, children of naturalized citizens, and residents of U.S. insular possessions.

Parents of Camp Mystic flood victims pushed for Texas camp safety laws, signed by Gov. Abbott, requiring cabins out of floodplains, alert systems, and emergency training. Despite the legislative success, they remain in grief over the loss of their children.

The passage details memory map regions, TILER extended addressing, and terminal functions for a device, referencing tables and sections for further information on system MMU features, interconnect topology, and pin multiplexing.
China launched a new visa program to attract young professionals and science/technology graduates from top universities, coinciding with US restrictions on H-1B visas.

The passage discusses how AI, particularly LLMs, can transform social science research by synthesizing data, automating analysis, and exploring novel theories, while also highlighting challenges like bias, cost, and ethical concerns. It also addresses the need for regulatory frameworks to balance innovation with risk mitigation, emphasizing top-down and bottom-up governance approaches.

An international study of 747 people with primary ciliary dyskinesia (PCD) found large variation in diagnostic test use between countries. Most participants (92%) reported diagnostic testing, but only one-third of those over age 5 reported all three tests (nasal nitric oxide, biopsy, and genetics). People diagnosed after 2010 reported more tests, while those with situs abnormalities reported fewer.

A federal judge rejected an effort to overturn the Biden-era gainful-employment rule, siding with the Education Department. The rule requires for-profit and nondegree programs to prove graduates can afford loan payments and earn more than high school graduates, with failure risking loss of federal aid.

The Third Circuit vacated the district court's denial of a petition to set aside a settlement and release of a deceased seaman's admiralty claim, remanding for further proceedings. The court held that the district court erred by not applying Indian law to determine the validity of the special power of attorney, and that federal maritime law governed the release's validity, placing the burden on shipowners to prove it was freely executed. The court also found that the district court abused its discretion by denying a new commission to take testimony in India, which deprived the petitioner of a fair trial and due process.

Halliburton reported first-quarter net income of $46 million (5 cents per share), with adjusted earnings of 41 cents per share, meeting analyst expectations. Revenue was $5.74 billion, below the $5.76 billion forecast. Shares have risen over 6% year-to-date and 10% in the last 12 months.

U.S. international student arrivals in August 2025 fell 19% compared to August 2024, according to National Travel and Tourism Office data. Experts say this aligns with expectations due to visa interview freezes, but note the data excludes current students who stayed over summer and those arriving later. This contradicts a 0.8% increase in SEVIS data, which critics call inaccurate. Declines are steepest among students from Africa (32%), Asia (24%), and the Middle East (17%), with Iran down 86% and India down 44.5%. Experts warn total declines may exceed 20%, with potential for larger drops in 2026.

Canada has benefited from NAFTA, which boosted economic growth and manufacturing competitiveness. However, Canada does not export enough outside North America, and simply signing more FTAs has not expanded exports. A plan with five elements is needed: improving domestic business competitiveness, ensuring FTAs address non-tariff barriers, focusing on natural trade partners, leveraging existing supply chains, and supporting small and medium enterprises to grow globally.

A Delhi court deferred the hearing on the ED chargesheet against Karti Chidambaram and two companies in a money laundering case related to the Aircel-Maxis deal to July 6. The ED alleges the FDI was misrepresented as Rs 180 crore when it was actually Rs 3,565.91 crore.

President Roosevelt reported to Congress on the Yalta Conference, stating that the Allies agreed on plans for Germany's unconditional surrender, occupation, and denazification; established a framework for a United Nations organization; and reached compromises on Poland's government and borders. He emphasized continued Allied unity, the need for postwar international cooperation, and that the conference laid groundwork for lasting peace.

The speaker discusses a player's uncertain status for tomorrow's game, mentions no fatigue factor, and notes the team's pride in their players. They reference inconclusive replays, home and road wins, and that overtime games have determined their current position.

Niantic's Pokémon GO Solstice Event offers 3x XP for catches, throws, curveballs, and first throws, with no bonus for evolving, making catching more rewarding and efficient for XP gain, especially for casual and midcore players.

Conservative MP Andrea Jenkyns warned Theresa May that failing to deliver Brexit would be "catastrophic" for the Tories, as Brexiteer Jacob Rees-Mogg suggested Leave-supporting MPs could revolt. Jenkyns, who resigned as a ministerial aide, stated that a "half in and half out" outcome would break party trust. Environment Secretary Michael Gove expressed confidence the cabinet would agree on a united position supporting Brexit.

The U.S. stock market, measured by the S&P 500, has nearly quadrupled from post-crisis lows, but market conditions have been changing. The S&P 500 has not set a new all-time high since January 26, marking the longest streak since 2015-2016. The Federal Reserve is raising interest rates and shrinking its balance sheet, unlike in past periods of volatility. Volatility, as measured by the VIX, has remained elevated in 2018, with 39.24% of trading days seeing moves of 1% or more, compared to 3.19% in 2017. This level of volatility is historically associated with years like 1974, 2000, 2001, 2002, 2008, and 2009. The article suggests that current conditions may foreshadow a bull market top and a challenging market climate.

The passage describes the Bogleheads 3 and 4 Fund Portfolios, which are low-cost, diversified investment strategies using index funds. The 3 Fund Portfolio includes U.S. stocks, international stocks, and U.S. bonds. The 4 Fund Portfolio adds international bonds. A backtest with a 50% U.S. stock, 30% international stock, and 20% bond allocation for the 3 Fund Portfolio showed a 7.6% annual return and 28% max drawdown. A backtest with a 50% U.S. stock, 30% international stock, 10% bond, and 10% international bond allocation for the 4 Fund Portfolio showed a 7.8% annual return and 31% max drawdown.

The Caribbean Water and Wastewater Association’s 26th Annual Conference and Exhibition, approved by Cabinet, will be held October 16-20, 2017, in Guyana. The event will feature technical papers on water, wastewater, and waste management, including the Caribbean’s position on water governance for the 2018 World Water Forum. The ministerial conference will review a regional waste management action plan for the UN. Over 250 delegates and 40 exhibitors are expected.

The broadcast announces a national mobilization to provide security for citizens facing unemployment and privation. It emphasizes voluntary community action, led by Mr. Walter Gifford, to coordinate relief efforts. The Federal Government is expanding public works, stopping immigration, and ensuring credits to stimulate employment. The appeal calls for local funding to prevent hunger and cold, framing this as a test of national conscience and neighborly responsibility.

The LG V35 ThinQ, a successor to the V30S, features a Snapdragon 845, 6GB RAM, 6-inch OLED display, no notch, headphone jack, IP68 rating, dual 16MP rear cameras, 8MP front camera, AI camera features, Google Lens, 3,300 mAh battery, and 64GB/128GB storage with microSD. Pricing and release date are unannounced.

Drug repurposing finds new uses for existing drugs, reducing development time and cost. A knowledge graph (EBKG) built from open access (OA) and controlled access (CA) literature was analyzed. OA and CA contribute roughly equally to the graph's relations. Most relations are supported by a single reference, and this accumulation of uncited observations is increasing exponentially in both OA and CA. Citation rates between OA and CA are similar. The study concludes that additional confidence scores are needed for knowledge graph relations.

The lecture covers upcoming quiz details (closed book, one page of notes, provided statistical tables), reviews control charting as a running hypothesis test, explains alpha (false alarm rate), beta (missed alarm rate), and average run length, and discusses how sample size affects beta. It distinguishes control limits from specification limits, introduces process capability indices CP and CPK, and previews alternative control charts like moving average and cumulative sum charts.

Managed by Q, an on-demand office cleaning and maintenance startup, had raised $15 million and expanded to three cities by July 2015. The company hired and trained its employees, paying above industry standards. Its goal was to provide all office management services. The founders were deciding whether to grow by deepening services in existing markets or by expanding to new cities.

President Trump's first State of the Union address will see Democratic lawmakers wearing black in solidarity with the #MeToo movement, hosting "Dreamer" immigrants as guests, and some boycotting the speech. Bill Nye will attend as a guest of NASA nominee Jim Bridenstine, and Rep. Joe Kennedy will deliver the Democratic response.

Iraq has begun an aerial bombardment of Tal Afar, a town under Islamic State control west of Mosul, and a ground attack will follow the air campaign. Tal Afar is the next target after the recapture of Mosul.

The Sarahah app, which allows anonymous messaging, has recently gained popularity after being a hit in Egypt and Saudi Arabia. It has a near 50-50 split of 5-star and 1-star reviews on Google Play, with concerns about hurtful comments and bullying. Privacy features include removing profiles from search and blocking senders, but the app's long-term success is uncertain compared to similar past apps like Yik Yak.

The PGA848 is a high-voltage, high-bandwidth, programmable gain instrumentation amplifier with eight binary gain settings from 0.5V/V to 100V/V. Its linear input range extends within 3V of either power supply. A typical application drives a 16-bit SAR ADC (ADS8860) using ±15V input and 5.3V output supplies, with three filters for EMI reduction, bandwidth control, and charge kickback. The output voltage is referenced to a 2.5V midscale voltage generated from a REF6250 reference. Power supplies above ±20V can permanently damage the device. Good layout practices include symmetrical input paths, bypass capacitors, and minimizing leakage and parasitic capacitance.

Tungsten oxidation was studied from 400°C to 1050°C, showing a transition from parabolic to linear kinetics. Preferential oxidation at edges increased with perimeter-to-area ratio. The oxide scale consisted of a 30-50 nm WO2 layer, a 10-20 µm WO2.72 layer, and an outer WO2.9/WO3 layer. WO3 sublimation rates were measured. The WO2 layer may explain low detritiation efficiency.

A police officer in Washington, Missouri, was exposed to heroin mixed with fentanyl while giving rescue breaths to an overdose victim. The officer inhaled the drugs, experienced a headache, lightheadedness, and tingling. Both were hospitalized and recovered. Police report increasing danger to first responders from this drug combination.

A mother and father learned in court that Joseph Nicholson, originally sentenced for first-degree murder, will now be eligible for parole earlier after the Ontario Court of Appeal ordered a second-degree murder sentence. Nicholson stabbed 16-year-old Joey Tanner to death and attempted to murder Jeremy Rodgers in 2007. The Crown requested parole eligibility be set at 16 years, citing Nicholson's violent history. Sentencing is scheduled for Aug. 11.

Katie Albert, a psychology and studio art student, describes the second half of her study abroad in Florence, Italy. She details progress in Italian, art classes (completing five paintings and various drawings), cultural activities (cooking class), and school trips to Siena, Pisa, and Lucca. During spring break, she visited seven countries in ten days, including a personal trip to Becherbach, Germany, where her ancestor lived. After returning, she took a trip to Croatia, reaching 20 countries by age 20. With three weeks left, she faces final exams and the bittersweet process of preparing to leave.

From July 2, 489,000 of 1.2 million eligible Australian families risk losing childcare subsidies unless they update their Centrelink details via myGov. The new system combines existing subsidies into a single means- and activity-tested payment, requiring both parents to work, study, volunteer, or seek work at least eight hours a fortnight. Households earning under $186,958 face no annual cap; those earning more see the cap rise from $7,500 to over $10,000 per child. Subsidy rates range from 85% of fees for families earning $66,958 or less to 0% for those earning over $351,248. Activity hours determine subsidised care hours, with exemptions for legitimate cases. The reforms include a $1.2 billion safety net and aim to boost workforce participation.

Jeffing, created by Olympian Jeff Galloway in the 1970s, is a run-walk-run fitness method involving planned walking breaks. It improves aerobic endurance, reduces fatigue, and lowers injury risk. Beginners should start with 1–2 minute intervals, progressing slowly. It benefits long-distance runners but may be unsuitable for athletes needing sustained high-intensity effort. Improper progression can still cause injuries.

Despite two assessments indicating suicide risk, she was not referred for counselling. The trust is improving procedures and staff training to address these issues.

They emphasize confidence in Joe, who is playing well despite not scoring, and note that physical play from themselves and Hatcher can shut down opponents.

Anna Ryder Richardson is leaving Manor House Wildlife Park in Pembrokeshire and moving to France, divorcing her husband Colin MacDougall. She states the stress and expense of running the zoo destroyed their 16-year marriage. The couple bought the rundown park in 2008 for £1 million, and she invested another £1 million in renovations. They lived in a prefab cabin while animals had heated homes. A 2010 tree accident at the park caused serious injuries and over £100,000 in fines. Anna says the marriage ended due to daily drudgery and lack of time, though they remain friends. She has bought a ruin near Bordeaux to live with her daughters.

Tiffany Gholston, born with a heart murmur, received her first pacemaker at age 20. She stays healthy through activity, diet, and daily meditation. An active member of the American Heart Association's Circle of Red, she raises money for research, which she credits with saving her life.

Hackers released more unaired HBO episodes, excluding "Game of Thrones," including "Curb Your Enthusiasm," "Insecure," "Ballers," and "The Deuce." HBO stated it is not communicating with the hacker and will not comment on each release. The hack, which occurred earlier this summer, involves leaked materials and a ransom demand.

A study by Albert Einstein College of Medicine researchers, published in PLOS Biology, found that intense exercise curbs appetite because body temperature increases activate heat-sensitive TRPV1-like receptors on POMC neurons in the hypothalamus's arcuate nucleus, triggering a "stop eating" signal. Experiments on mice showed that capsaicin or heat activated these neurons, reducing food intake, and that treadmill exercise reduced food intake by 50% in normal mice but not in mice lacking the receptors.

The Texas Supreme Court denied Anna Black's application for writ of error in a case involving the Health Spa Act, but clarified it does not approve the lower court's distinction between witness and document identification under Tex.R.Civ.P. 215.5, nor does it relieve parties of the duty to show good cause in the record.

A team of researchers proposes using a global network of mobile phones and small radio receivers to detect fast radio bursts (FRBs) from within the Milky Way. Phones would run an app to monitor frequencies, and a central website would correlate data to identify a real FRB. The researchers calculate Milky Way FRBs may occur once every 30 to 1,500 years, or weekly if repeating.

McLaren has resolved the reliability issues from pre-season testing and heads to the F1 season-opener in Australia with improved confidence. Racing director Eric Boullier confirmed all problems were addressed, while Fernando Alonso noted the car's potential but acknowledged the need for further work. Boullier added that the tight midfield makes it hard to gauge McLaren's current position.

The speaker, after eight years in the league, expresses immense joy and gratitude for winning the Stanley Cup, thanking his teammates, coach Scotty, and family. He reflects on the challenges of transitioning from domestic to international hockey and the motivation to compete despite age. He also suggests bringing the Cup to Moscow could help attract investors and support Russian hockey.

The National Weather Service's early forecast for the partial solar eclipse in Philadelphia is uncertain due to potential clouds. Meteorologist Lance Frank notes unsettled weather to the south may move north, but a certain prediction is not possible this far out. Philadelphia is not in the eclipse's totality path; the nearest state is South Carolina, where a million visitors are expected.

Intel is in early talks with AMD to manufacture chips for it in its foundry business, according to a Semafor report. Intel shares rose 7% and AMD shares rose over 1% on the news. The Stack Offense compacts players into two stack alignments near the free throw line, using three ball handlers to reduce turnovers. It includes options like dribble penetration, basket rolls, and back cuts, with specific actions for when defenders overplay or show help.

A study of 335 NYC pharmacies found that only 40% of pharmacists were aware of Expedited Partner Therapy (EPT), and willingness to dispense nameless EPT prescriptions was low at 30%. National chain pharmacies had higher EPT awareness than independent ones. Higher neighborhood socioeconomic vulnerability was associated with greater EPT awareness but not with willingness to dispense. Adherence to New York State EPT guidelines was suboptimal at 46%.

The principal of Horace Maynard Middle School stated that the bullying incident involving student Keaton Jones, which went viral in a video, was resolved last week and action was taken with the other children involved. He said he was not aware of repeated bullying of Jones. The school plans an assembly to address bullying and had an anti-bullying talk scheduled for January prior to the incident.

The passage describes a Machine Learning Model Swapping (MLMS) system that selects and interchanges ML models (subnets) in an energy and communication efficient way, adapting to real-time changes in system constraints. It uses a similarity-based selection process to find a replacement subnet with the most overlap in pre-trained parameters from the current model, minimizing memory write overhead. The system includes an MLMS engine, a subnet selector, and a performance auditor that monitors model performance and context information (e.g., hardware state, environment) to trigger model swaps.

Globalization is often ill-defined but refers to a communal global lifestyle. It involves increased global interconnectedness, cross-cultural interaction, and international collaboration, supported by organizations like the UN and WTO. Globalization affects education policies, as seen in Switzerland, Japan, and China, and influences power transitions. It impacts school textbooks and policies, with global institutions like the OECD affecting local practices. Education should respond to social change, and university curricula should include global issues to prepare students. English is a key tool for international communication, and English curricula should incorporate global issues like health, climate change, and war. The study involved 372 Taiwanese university students who, after a semester of global topics, showed high agreement that globalization education is important, interesting, and motivates English learning. Students suggested topics like global warming and energy, and pedagogies like travel and films. The study concludes that global cooperation benefits humanity, and English education should prepare students as global citizens.

Skinimalism is a skincare trend focused on streamlining routines to a few high-quality, essential products, as explained by Dr. Hazel Parkinson. It aims to protect the skin barrier, reduce irritation, and is suitable for most people, though those with specific conditions like acne or rosacea may still need targeted actives. Benefits include less waste and cost, but the approach should be tailored to individual skin needs, age, and lifestyle.

A single case study of a man in his late twenties with epilepsy used a smartphone app to record touchscreen interactions over six months. The study found significant behavioural changes in these interactions following anti-seizure medication (ASM) tapering and a convulsive seizure, with tapering associated with faster next-interval dynamics and the convulsion with slower dynamics.

In 2014, Market Basket employees, vendors, and customers protested the firing of CEO Arthur T. Demoulas for six weeks, demanding his reinstatement. The company, a New England supermarket chain, had a successful business model based on low prices, high volume, no debt, and a strong employee culture with low turnover. The protest stemmed from a family feud between Arthur T. and his cousin Arthur S. Demoulas over control of the company. The board fired Arthur T. in June 2014, leading to a walkout that shut down operations. An agreement was reached in August for Arthur T. to buy a 50.5% stake for $1.6 billion, reinstating him. The company then faced significant debt from the buyout.

Microsoft Corporation filed a Form 10-Q for the quarterly period ended September 30, 2018, reporting total revenue of $29.084 billion, net income of $8.824 billion, and diluted earnings per share of $1.14.

The 2022 NFL draft set a record with 6 wide receivers in the first 20 picks. Wide receivers are crucial in pass-heavy offenses, tying together the passing game by running routes and securing passes. They also contribute to run blocking. The position name comes from lining up "wide" and "receiving" passes. Key skills include route-running, speed, and hands; body types vary. Notable receivers include Jerry Rice, Randy Moss, and Steve Largent. Elite wide receivers disrupt defenses by demanding attention, forcing defensive adjustments.

PerovSegNet, a YOLOv8-seg-based segmentation framework for SEM images of perovskite and lead iodide films, introduces ASDCB and SAD modules to enhance multi-scale feature extraction and boundary preservation. It achieves state-of-the-art segmentation accuracy (mAP@0.5 of 87.3%) on the PerovData dataset while reducing computational cost, and enables automated quantification of grain area and count for correlation with device performance.

A University of Connecticut study found that vaping nicotine-based liquid can cause DNA damage similar to smoking unfiltered cigarettes, using a 3D-printed device that detected equivalent damage levels.

The passage describes how to backtest a momentum trading strategy in Python, using sector SPDR ETFs, a 9-month momentum factor, and monthly rebalancing to buy the top 3 performers. The strategy's 9.89% CAGR was nearly identical to the SPY's 9.46% CAGR.

The Evening Star is a bearish reversal pattern in technical analysis, identified by a tall bullish candle, a small candle that gaps above it, and a third bearish candle closing below the first candle's midpoint. The strategy involves spotting this pattern, confirming it with tools like trendlines or oscillators, and using risk management. Benefits include easy identification and high reliability, while risks include false signals and market volatility. The pattern can be backtested with specific rules.

A 92-year-old woman, Anna Mae Blessing, was charged with first-degree murder after allegedly killing her 72-year-old son to avoid being placed in an assisted living facility. She shot him multiple times with two pistols hidden in her robe.

The passage critiques the U.S. education system's historical adoption of business models, which led to bureaucratic structures and practices like standardized testing under the No Child Left Behind Act, and the medical model's focus on diagnosing inherent student deficits, which can cause stigma and fixed mindsets. It argues these approaches have not improved student performance and have increased disparities. The passage proposes reframing education as a universal problem-solving process, rooted in the scientific method and metacognition, to foster self-directed learning. This model would be implemented recursively at student, teacher, and administrative levels, replacing top-down hierarchy with collaborative, goal-oriented support to address individual and systemic educational problems.

In Leitrim, 12 Autism Units are planned for 2018/19 within Sligo/Leitrim and Donegal. Since 2011, ASD special classes in Leitrim increased from two to five, with five new Primary and seven new Post-Primary classes. Minister Bruton, responding to Deputy MacSharry, noted SNA support for over 12,000 extra pupils since 2011, with 13,400 resource teachers currently. A professional report is required for placement; a fair, non-discriminatory selection process may be used if applicants exceed places.

The author disagrees, arguing non-deployment would test NATO's viability and embolden anti-American forces. The author recommends holding firm on the zero-zero option, deploying as scheduled, and only considering a shift if the Soviets seriously restructure their position. The passage also summarizes a meeting where Dobrynin and the Secretary agreed on regular discussions and the desirability of a summit, with Dobrynin advocating for a Foreign Ministers channel to resolve arms control issues.

CZTS crystals are promising for radiation detectors, but surface damage from cutting/polishing must be removed. A 20% rate decrease was observed at low selenium concentration (y~0.02), consistent with a thermodynamic model. Etching rates decreased further with higher selenium content, though differences between compositions narrowed.

Vanuatu's financial regulator may investigate APMA Financial Investment Centre, a savings and loan scheme with 25,000 fully vested and 30,000 partially vested depositors, but no deposits in commercial banks, three of which deny involvement. The Ambae volcano's rating dropped from level 4 to 3, with stable eruptions confined to Lake Voui. The Ambae Port Vila Disaster Committee collected essentials for evacuees. Crystal Palace and Newcastle United face off at Selhurst Park, with both managers dissatisfied with their transfer business. Newcastle may have Islam Slimani available, while Palace have lost Bakary Sako to a long-term injury and may rely on new young signings. Newcastle aim to repeat Sunderland's 4-0 win at the same venue last season.

The second edition of *The New Zealand Land and Food Annual*, edited by Professor Claire Massey, was launched at the National Field Days. The book features 31 experts on New Zealand’s role in the green revolution. Professor Massey notes the environmental impact of food production and the responsibility to address it. The land and food sector is worth $33 billion, with a goal to treble this by 2025 through sustainable practices. Recent OECD and Ministry reports highlight the urgency, and contributor Ralph Sims states current practices are unsustainable, but New Zealand could lead by example.

Small-body reservoirs in planetary systems are remnant populations of objects that form after the gas disc disperses. In the Solar System, these include asteroids, the main belt, Trojans, and trans-Neptunian populations. Planetesimals form in protoplanetary discs through processes like the streaming instability, leading to gravitational collapse. The composition of these bodies is influenced by thermal conditions and snowlines. Debris discs, the likely source of exocomets, are common around stars and deplete over time. The formation and evolution of these reservoirs depend on stellar mass, environment, and planetary architecture.

This document is a statistical analysis plan (SAP) for a clinical trial, detailing the planned analyses for pharmacokinetic, pharmacodynamic, and safety data, including summary statistics, figures, and listings for plasma concentrations, glucose response, adverse events, and other safety parameters.

A March 27, 1899 circular instructed that passports should not be issued to those not intending to return to the U.S., but no fixed return period is required. A March 25, 1902 circular clarified that in a mission head's absence, the first secretary acts as chargé d'affaires ad interim; consulting the Department is needed if a second or third secretary must serve. An April 26, 1902 circular, via Executive order, prohibited diplomatic and consular officers from publicly attacking or criticizing each other, limiting such communications to the Department of State.

Seminary graduation for 16 Miami Valley seniors was held May 20 in Huber Heights. Graduates from multiple cities received certificates for studying the Book of Mormon. Three seniors spoke about their experiences. The program is open to all high school students.

The company lost nearly $80 million over two years, driven by incorrect assumptions about cross-selling its software suite, operational hurdles from rapid acquisitions, and rising interest rates.

Federal Reserve Chairwoman Janet Yellen questioned President Trump's economic policies and defended the Dodd-Frank Act, citing healthy bank lending, strong bank capital, and resilience. She acknowledged community bank regulatory burdens but opposed repealing the Act, suggesting exemptions from the Volcker Rule. Yellen declined to comment on Trump's fiscal plans, urging sustainable fiscal policy and warning that delaying interest rate hikes could require rapid increases.

It compares standard of care (SOC) with SOC plus convalescent plasma, using a 2:1 allocation. Outcomes are based on the WHO master protocol.

Germany's education system, shaped by its history, features a three-tiered secondary structure (Hauptschule, Realschule, Gymnasium) and a separate special education system. Special education schools (Sonderschule) serve about 577,000 students, while only 33.6% of children with disabilities are included in elementary schools and 14.9% in secondary schools. Teacher training involves a two-phase model with a special education certificate. Current issues include inclusion practices, funding, teacher perceptions, and limited job opportunities for students with disabilities, particularly those attending Hauptschule.

A Department of Education spokesperson confirmed that staff will be impacted by a reduction in force (RIF) directed by the Office of Management and Budget, but did not specify numbers or offices. The Office of Federal Student Aid is reportedly excluded. The layoffs are part of broader federal cuts, with fewer than 16,000 total employees expected to be affected.

German Chancellor Angela Merkel and Polish Prime Minister Mateusz Morawiecki met in Warsaw on March 19, 2018, to discuss EU future, security, and bilateral ties. Merkel expressed hope for a resolution to the EU standoff over Poland's judicial changes, while Morawiecki noted progress requires mutual understanding. Both leaders stressed EU unity, economic cooperation, and migrant support, and discussed a firm EU response to the poisoning of a Russian ex-spy in Britain, with Merkel citing significant evidence of Russian responsibility.

Overplay counters involve skip passes and dribble penetration. The offense includes specific strategies for attacking 2-3, 1-2-2, and 1-3-1 zones.

Hawaiʻi is expanding free preschool by converting private programs to charter schools, which receive state funding and are tuition-free. Waikīkī Community Preschool became the first to transition. Charter preschools can attract teachers with state benefits and higher pay, but current funding of $171,000 per classroom is insufficient, requiring fundraising. The state aims to provide preschool access to all 3- and 4-year-olds by 2032, needing about 330 more classrooms.

Ed Silverman, a STAT senior writer and Pharmalot columnist, has covered the pharmaceutical industry for nearly three decades. Shareholders elected nine director nominees, ratified Ernst & Young LLP as independent auditors, and approved executive compensation in an advisory vote. Two shareholder proposals, regarding an independent board chair and vote-counting practices, were not approved.

The Turnaround Tuesday effect is a market tendency for price reversals from Monday's close to Tuesday's close. Backtests show buying on a weak Monday (e.g., close at least 1% lower than Friday) and selling at Tuesday's close has been profitable for about 30 years, but it only works on weakness.

The King appointed Allen and Carter to negotiate a reciprocity agreement, signed January 30, 1875, effective September 9, 1876. Disputes arose with Great Britain and Germany over a "favored nation" clause, resolved by Carter. A British compromise was rejected, leading to a Hawaiian legislative majority favoring British claims, a ministry change, and a pledge to uphold U.S. exclusive privileges. Questions of treaty interpretation were settled diplomatically. A domestic scandal caused ministerial changes and a recalled request for Comly's recall. Using femtosecond noise correlation spectroscopy, the study investigates ultrafast magnetization fluctuations in the canted antiferromagnet Sm0.7Er0.3FeO3. By varying temperature and external magnetic field, the research reveals that thermal fluctuations of the quasi-ferromagnetic magnon mode are enhanced where the free energy potential softens, particularly near the spin reorientation transition. An external magnetic field suppresses these fluctuations and increases the magnon frequency by stiffening the potential. These findings are supported by atomistic spin noise and Monte Carlo simulations.

The molded base has an inner side surface that is slanted (at an acute angle) to facilitate demolding during manufacturing, reduce stray light, and prevent damage. The passage discusses the van der Waals interaction between two neutral atoms. Classically, the expectation value of the dipole operator and its square is zero, resulting in no attraction. In quantum mechanics, zero-point fluctuations give a non-zero expectation value for the square of the dipole operator, leading to a non-vanishing force. The interaction can be derived via second-order perturbation theory, yielding a 1/R^6 potential. The effect is also explained using two coupled LC circuits, where the zero-point energy of the oscillators produces the potential. A third interpretation involves vacuum fluctuations of the electromagnetic field inducing correlated dipole moments, leading to a 1/R^7 potential at long range (Casimir-Polder potential) due to propagation effects. The transition between the 1/R^6 (short-range, instantaneous) and 1/R^7 (long-range, retarded) potentials occurs at distances on the order of the atomic transition wavelength. This is illustrated diagrammatically via fourth-order perturbation theory involving the exchange of virtual photons, where the dominant diagrams differ based on whether the photon frequency or atomic excitation energy is larger.

A study at Kuwait University surveyed 63 faculty members on AI in education. Results showed medium acceptance of AI (mean 3.37/6), with most (58.7%) lacking teaching experience with AI. Key challenges included lack of suitable materials and expertise. No significant differences were found based on gender, academic degree, or department, except for challenges in using AI between males and females.

The lecture introduces the expected utility model as the standard economic framework for analyzing risk preferences, focusing on risk aversion derived from diminishing marginal utility of wealth. It discusses measuring risk aversion through coefficients of absolute and relative risk aversion, using examples like certainty equivalents and insurance choices. A key point is the Rabin critique, showing that expected utility theory cannot reconcile small-scale risk aversion (e.g., rejecting a 50-50 bet to win $11 or lose $10) with plausible large-scale risk aversion, leading to absurd implications. The lecture previews an alternative model of reference-dependent preferences to address these limitations.

Sears borrowed $100 million from ESL Investments, with an additional $100 million possible by December 1. Lampert's hedge fund has lent Sears nearly $2 billion over two years. Sears plans to close over 300 stores in 2017, reducing its count to under 1,140 from 2,073 five years ago. Second-quarter sales fell 11.5%, and total revenue dropped 22% to $4.37 billion.

The Post-9/11 GI Bill covers up to 4 years of education for eligible members, paying full tuition at public schools based on service months and credits. Benefits must be used within 10-15 years after service.

Republicans want to negotiate those credits after a funding resolution is approved. A shutdown deadline is 12:01 a.m. Wednesday.

The company faces stiff competition and a tough market, with sales shrinking in February. Analysts suggest slowing store expansion, as H&M had 4,426 stores, up 11% year-on-year. Materials characterization is essential for understanding structure-property relationships in complex materials. X-ray diffraction (XRD) and X-ray absorption fine structure (XAFS) spectroscopy are complementary bulk techniques, with XRD probing long-range structure and XAFS measuring short-range, element-specific structure. Researchers use synchrotron facilities for these multi-modal measurements due to enhanced resolution and sensitivity. However, conventional mapping approaches are inefficient for inhomogeneous samples, leading to the development of data-driven, machine learning (ML) and artificial intelligence (AI) approaches. This work describes a modular framework for AI-driven, multi-modal synchrotron experiments, using an ensemble of AI agents for data processing, analysis, and interpretation to guide XRD and XAFS measurements on combinatorial libraries. A digital twin was developed to design and optimize agents without consuming beamtime. The framework enables collaborative human-AI experiments, with AI agents passing measurement requests to human-controlled adjudicators.

Higher symptom load at diagnosis correlated with lower NAc-paracingulate gyrus FC. Symptom improvement correlated with lower NAc-anterior insula FC. In patients continuing stimulant medication, higher NAc-posterior insula FC predicted improvement, while the opposite pattern was seen in those who discontinued medication.

The primary comparison is between dasiglucagon and placebo, with 20 patients in the dasiglucagon arm and 10 in placebo. GlucaGen is included as a reference with 10 patients. Meb Faber's Three-Way Momentum/Trend-Following Model Strategy invests equally in stocks, bonds, and gold when the monthly 3-bar moving average is above the 10-bar moving average. From 1971 to 2015, it returned 13% annually. A backtest from 2006 showed an 8.9% annual return, a 57% win rate, a profit factor of 1.6, and a maximum drawdown of 18%. The GA10x GPU architecture moves ROPs to the GPC, increasing their count to 112 in GA102. RTX IO enables GPU-based decompression, offloading CPU work. The A40 data center GPU offers up to 2x FP32 and ray-tracing throughput over prior generation.

Phlogopite (KMg3(AlSi3O10)(OH)2) is a dark mica with a layered structure used in various applications. Its response to radiation was modeled using the XTANT-3 code. Simulations found damage thresholds: hydrogen migration at ~0.17 eV/atom, Mg diffusion at ~0.4 eV/atom, complete disorder at ~0.5 eV/atom, and bandgap collapse at ~0.9 eV/atom. The calculated hydrogen migration threshold agrees with experimental data (~0.2 eV/atom). Nonthermal and nonadiabatic effects were found to compete in phlogopite.

Topological insulator lasers combine topological insulators with lasers to create more efficient and stable lasers. Lasers are sensitive to defects, which reduce efficiency and can cause instability, such as unwanted colors and beam profile changes. Topological insulators have surface states where electrons flow without scattering off defects, protected by spin properties. By applying this concept to light using optical waveguides, researchers created a laser where light is in a protected state, preventing scattering and maintaining a single color and beam profile. Experiments showed these lasers are more efficient, resist defects, and do not produce new colors at higher power, making them promising for applications like 5G networks.

In Phase 1, a few participants had a temporary drop in lymphocyte count 1-3 days after Dose 1 of BNT162b1 or BNT162b2, which returned to normal by 6-8 days. Injection site reactions (most commonly pain) and systemic events (most commonly tiredness and headache) within 7 days after vaccination were well tolerated and mostly mild or moderate. All tested doses (10, 20, 30 µg) for BNT162b1 and BNT162b2 in Phase 1 were well tolerated, except BNT162b1 at 100 µg. In Phase 2/3, BNT162b2 at 30 µg was well tolerated; few participants left due to medical problems (less than 1% in each group). No single medical problem occurred in more than 1% of participants aged 12-15. Serious medical problems were rare; researchers did not believe most were related to the study vaccine. No participant died during Phase 1; in Phase 2/3, 85 of 23,141 who got BNT162b2 at the start died, and researchers did not believe deaths were caused by BNT162b2.

Neutral particle diagnostics measure the core ion distribution function in a tokamak by detecting neutrals that escape the plasma. Neutrals are produced via charge exchange with edge neutrals or a neutral beam. The probability of a neutral escaping depends on attenuation from electron impact ionization, ion impact ionization, and charge exchange, with the mean free path being about 10 cm for a 10 keV, dense plasma. Passive diagnostics use edge neutrals, while active diagnostics use a neutral beam for localization. Techniques include charge exchange recombination spectroscopy (measuring impurity density, ion temperature, and flow velocity) and beam emission spectroscopy (measuring density fluctuations). The motional Stark effect, from the electric field in the particle's frame (V x B), splits energy levels, allowing measurement of the magnetic field and current profile.

In late 2004, Toyota's Walt Bernstein was frustrated with supplier ChassisCo's Athens plant, which produced rear suspension cradles for the Suprima crossover. The plant's production rate was barely 60% of target, parts were frequently nonconforming, and improvement was insufficient, putting the vehicle program at risk. ChassisCo's plant manager cited increased automation, responsibility for 85 parts, and aggressive cost targets as challenges. Radiotheranostics enables personalized cancer treatment via agents for diagnostic imaging and therapy. Current radiopharmaceutical therapy (RPT) regimens are standardized, overlooking interpatient variability. Computational nuclear oncology (CNO) uses theranostic digital twins (TDTs) for model-informed treatment planning, with physiologically based pharmacokinetic (PBPK) models offering advantages. Model verification, validation, and uncertainty quantification (VVUQ) are essential for clinical translation. PBPK models mathematically describe radiotheranostic agent activity over time, integrating computational, anatomical-physiological, and radiopharmaceutical frameworks. Models are built using bottom-up, top-down, or middle-out approaches. VVUQ includes verification of correct implementation, internal and external validation against biokinetic data, and uncertainty quantification of predictions. Extending PBPK to dynamic TDTs introduces challenges due to continuous data integration. Rigorous VVUQ frameworks are needed to support regulatory approval and clinical adoption.

The Turing TU102 GPU is the highest performing GPU of the Turing line, featuring six GPCs, 36 TPCs, and 72 SMs. Each SM contains 64 CUDA Cores, eight Tensor Cores, and one RT Core for ray tracing. The TU102 includes 12 GDDR6 memory controllers (384-bit total), 96 ROP units, and 6144 KB of L2 cache. Turing introduces a new SM design with concurrent FP32 and INT32 execution, a unified L1/shared memory architecture, and GDDR6 memory. The architecture supports hybrid rendering combining rasterization, ray tracing, and AI. RT Cores accelerate BVH traversal and ray-triangle intersection. Tensor Cores support FP16, INT8, and INT4 precision. NVLink provides high-speed multi-GPU connectivity. Variable Rate Shading and Texture Space Shading offer new shading control. The TU104 and TU106 GPUs are scaled-down versions of the TU102 architecture.

The passage describes a variable multiplexer for vehicle communication bus compatibility. Vehicles use a communication bus (e.g., CAN bus) with a data link connector. While the connector hardware is standardized, pinout configurations vary by manufacturer, requiring different cables. A device with a variable multiplexer can be electronically configured to a desired pinout configuration, allowing a single cable to work with various vehicles. The device determines the correct pinout configuration by either providing a vehicle identifier to a remote system with a vehicle data index, or by analyzing data on the bus (e.g., using a listening mode or checksum values) to match known configurations.

The passage discusses distributed system patterns, focusing on single-node patterns (sidecar, ambassador, adapter) and multi-node patterns (replicated load-balanced services, sharded services). It explains how containers can be grouped on a single machine for resource isolation, team ownership, and separation of concerns. The sidecar pattern augments an application container with additional functionality (e.g., adding HTTPS, configuration management, monitoring). The ambassador pattern brokers interactions between the application container and external services (e.g., sharding, service brokering, request splitting). The adapter pattern modifies the application container's interface to conform to a standard (e.g., monitoring, logging, health checks). Multi-node patterns include replicated stateless services for redundancy and scaling, and sharded services for distributing state across multiple machines. The passage also covers caching, session tracking, SSL termination, and sharding functions.

The Blackwell GB20x GPUs double integer operations by unifying INT32 and FP32 cores, though they operate as either type per cycle. The RTX 5090 has 680 texture units, up from 512 in the RTX 4090, and delivers 1636.76 Gigatexels/sec. GDDR7 memory uses PAM3 signaling, with the RTX 5090 offering 1.792 TB/sec bandwidth. Tensor Cores add FP4 and FP6 support. The Fourth-Generation RT Core doubles ray-triangle intersection throughput and introduces Linear Swept Spheres for hair. DLSS 4 includes Multi Frame Generation and transformer-based models. The AI Management Processor offloads GPU context scheduling. Blackwell supports 4:2:2 chroma sampling and DisplayPort 2.1b. The GB202 chip has 92.2 billion transistors and 24,576 CUDA Cores.

The Reverse Action Offense, introduced by Coach Pete Newell in the late 1950s, is a guard-around continuity that is difficult to defend due to precise execution. Its key option is the weakside wing's rub cut off a post screen, but it also includes post-up play, isolation, and counters against overplays. The offense relies on patience and execution of off-ball post screens, with players reading defensive deployment to choose counters. It can be initiated by any pass or dribble, with entries including weakside, strongside, dribble clear, and back door. The guard-around action features counters for various defensive reads, such as drive, pull-up jumper, and slip. Sideline triangle action creates post isolation and options like lob pass, post split, and post isolation. The offense includes specific reads and counters for defensive post deployment (high side, baseline side, front, behind, double team) and back cut counters against overplays. Crunch time specials include weakside screen and roll, double screen, and back screen lob.

Tesla Motors, Inc. filed a Form 8-K on June 8, 2015, reporting that CFO Deepak Ahuja intends to retire after seven years, and will assist in selecting his successor. A defensive wall in soccer is a line of defenders placed shoulder-to-shoulder to block the goal from a nearby free kick, typically 10 yards from the ball. The goalkeeper decides to build a wall based on ball location and their own judgment. The wall is built methodically, with an "Anchor" player positioned on an imaginary line from the near post to the ball. The wall blocks about half the goal, giving the goalkeeper more reaction time. Referees enforce Laws of the Game, allowing quick free kicks or ceremonial free kicks, and may move the wall if requested. The number of defenders in the wall varies from two to eight, depending on the ball's distance and angle from the goal.

The DAT bus line is high when idle. A data block has start bits (1 or 4 LOW), a data stream with payload and optional ECC, and end bits (1 or 4 HIGH). Transmission is synchronous. Read commands are rejected for BLOCK_LEN_ERROR or ADDRESS_ERROR. Block read is block-oriented; maximum block size is 512 bytes. Block length is set by CMD16 up to 512 bytes.
