The U.S. deployment of missile defence systems in Romania and planned systems in Poland violate the Intermediate-Range Nuclear Force Treaty, according to Russia's foreign ministry.

The passage discusses the potential of LLMs to generate novel social theories, the challenges of AI regulation (including misinformation, deepfakes, and bias), and the need for human-AI collaboration and updated governance frameworks involving top-down and bottom-up approaches.

ASTROCO is a conformer-style encoder for astronomical time series that combines global self-attention with local depthwise convolutions and gating. It produces more accurate reconstructions and label-efficient embeddings than previous Astromer baselines, with the smaller model surpassing prior work using fewer resources.

The speaker criticized their team's poor performance, citing turnovers, lack of coverage on the winning goal, and failure to handle Anaheim's physical forechecking. They noted Jason's need to improve, discussed adjusting to the officiating, praised draft picks Getzlaf and Perry, and defended their lineup decisions. They acknowledged Anaheim's strong defense and the need for better puck movement and support in their own end.

Las Vegas Valley residents have until 10 p.m. Tuesday to postmark 2016 tax returns. The Postal Service headquarters will close at 10 p.m., with a drive-up drop-off area available. Tips include using sufficient postage, clear addressing, sealing envelopes, and saving mailing receipts.

The Carlsberg UK Northamptonshire Food and Drink Awards 2017/18 winners were announced on November 15 at Northampton’s Royal & Derngate. The event included a toast to Antonio Carluccio OBE, who died a week before his scheduled appearance. The evening also celebrated the Eat Out Eat Well scheme, with top-scoring gold venues from five councils recognized. The Hopping Hare won Booker Food Pub of the Year, and 23-year-old Arturs Dzerins was runner-up in the Booker Young Chef of the Year category. A full list of winners and runners-up across various categories was provided.

The speaker describes a game where their team had brief lapses, allowing the opponent to score quick goals, despite playing well overall. They note the opponent's strong defense and goalie, but remain confident after a previous comeback. The key is to play a full 60 minutes and work hard for goals.

The passage details defensive strategies against the Triangle Offense, including basic NBA "Show and Recover" methods and more aggressive "SOS Disruptions" and "All Out SOS Disruption" tactics, which involve full-court pressure, trapping, and specific rotations to disrupt offensive flow.

Girlfriends' employee Kenna McNeil said the shop has received close to 100 prom orders, started preparing around March 1, and helps students select flowers, ribbons, and stones for corsages. She noted a steady stream of orders, with a recent rush of 20 to 30 tux and corsage orders in the past few days.

Shared tasks are community-driven challenges that compare methods on specific problems using shared datasets and metrics, advancing research and promoting transparency. The NFDI4DS consortium organizes such tasks to support a FAIR research data infrastructure. The paper overviews twelve tasks: seven completed (SOMD 2025, SciVQA, ClimateCheck, FoRC2025, LLMs4Subjects, LLMs4OL-2024, Scholarly QALD), one ongoing (CheckThat!Lab Task 4), and four under development (Dataset and ML Model Mention Detection, ReadMe2KG, CURED, Algorithm2Domain). These tasks address challenges in scholarly information processing, contributing to sustainable and interoperable research data practices.

Scores of Vietnamese fishermen clashed with police in Nghe An province while attempting to file lawsuits for compensation from Taiwanese firm Formosa, which paid $500 million for a toxic waste dump that killed fish and destroyed livelihoods. Some protesters were beaten and hospitalized, and several were briefly detained. A previous lawsuit in September was dismissed.

The summer movie season begins early with "Avengers: Infinity War," as the year's box office is down nearly 3%. Major franchises like Marvel and Jurassic World aim to boost sales, but oversaturation risks flops. Studios are diversifying slates with varied films, including female-led comedies and original projects, to attract discerning audiences.

Digital leaders use data to set goals and measure progress, with employees tracking performance through metrics and 360-degree reviews. This data-driven culture fosters flexibility, autonomy, and innovation, contrary to the perception of rigidity.

On May 17, the Colchester-Milton Rotary Club, along with volunteers from Dealer.com and Vermont Gas, planted saplings at Pine Island Farm to enhance a 2014 restoration project organized by the Intervale Center. U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service agents assisted. The planting followed instructions from Intervale manager Mike Ingalls. The effort was part of Rotary International president Ian H.S. Riseley’s challenge to plant a tree for each member. The local club had previously planted five trees at Porters Point School in 2018.

The passage promotes the Wells Fargo Active Cash® Card, highlighting unlimited 2% cash rewards, a $200 bonus after $500 spend in 3 months, 0% intro APR for 12 months, and a $0 annual fee. It also mentions other cards and states that Motley Fool Money receives compensation from advertisers but this does not influence product ratings.
On July 19, 2016, Microsoft Corporation filed a Form 8-K reporting its financial results for the quarter and year ended June 30, 2016, via a press release furnished as Exhibit 99.1.

The A100 Tensor Core GPU accelerates HPC with FP64 performance up to 2.5x that of the V100, using new Tensor Cores and a Double Precision Matrix Multiply Add instruction. It supports mixed-precision iterative refinement solvers, with TF32 delivering a 2.0x geomean speedup over FP64. A100 introduces Fine-Grained Structured Sparsity, doubling compute throughput for deep neural networks by skipping zero values. It features a 192 KB combined L1 data cache and shared memory per SM, simultaneous FP32 and INT32 execution, 40 GB of HBM2 memory with 1555 GB/sec bandwidth, and a 40 MB L2 cache. The Multi-Instance GPU (MIG) feature partitions the GPU into up to seven isolated instances. Third-generation NVLink provides 600 GB/sec total bandwidth, and PCIe Gen 4 with SR-IOV is supported.

Wall Street stocks initially rose but then fell on Thursday as bond yields increased and tech stocks declined. The S&P 500 is set for its first weekly drop in five weeks. The Fed held rates steady but flagged inflation concerns. U.S. Treasury yields rose after economic data supported inflation views. The Dow rose 0.14%, the S&P 500 fell 0.06%, and the Nasdaq dropped 0.35%. Banks gained, while eBay rose 13.8% and PayPal fell 8.1%. UPS dropped 6.1%. After-hours trading saw Amazon up over 6%, Alphabet down nearly 3%, and Apple down about 1%.

This study examined the global rankings of top five HEIs in ten Asian countries (2015-2025) using THE WUR data. China and Japan were the most successful; Russian HEIs were stable. Indian HEIs showed a positive trend. HEIs in the Philippines, Indonesia, Thailand, and Pakistan had neutral or decreasing trends. Bangladesh and Vietnamese HEIs were newcomers with neutral or downward trends. The study offers policy recommendations to improve Asian HEI rankings.

Odell Beckham Jr. accepted a six-game suspension for violating the NFL's policy on performance-enhancing drugs, delaying his comeback attempt. He failed a PED test last season while with the Dolphins, stating he did not knowingly take banned substances and was told his testosterone levels were too high. The suspension starts a six-week clock, making him eligible to play in Week 12. Beckham, who will be 33, identified four franchises he is interested in joining.

The passage discusses renormalization in Soft-Collinear Effective Theory (SCET) for the example of b to s gamma, focusing on Sudakov logarithms. It explains the structure of counterterms, the calculation of anomalous dimensions (including cusp and regular terms), and the renormalization group evolution that sums double logarithms. The cusp anomalous dimension arises from a kink in Wilson lines. The discussion extends to deep inelastic scattering (DIS), where operators with colinear fields are used to derive factorization theorems involving parton distribution functions.

The passage discusses the rise of open source software and its role in community-driven development, particularly for distributed systems. It defines patterns for distributed systems as general blueprints for organizing systems without mandating specific technologies. The value of patterns includes learning from others' mistakes, providing a shared vocabulary, and enabling reusable components. The text then focuses on single-node patterns, starting with the sidecar pattern, where a sidecar container augments an application container to add functionality like HTTPS, configuration management, or monitoring. The ambassador pattern is introduced for brokering interactions between an application container and external services, such as sharded storage or service brokering. The adapter pattern is described for modifying an application container's interface to conform to a standard, such as for monitoring or logging. Multi-node patterns are then covered, including replicated load-balanced services for stateless applications, with examples of caching and SSL termination layers. Sharded services are discussed for stateful systems, where each shard handles a subset of requests, with considerations for caching performance and hit rates.

A study of 75 preadolescents found that increasing physical education hours with cognitively engaging activities improved short-term attention speed in experimental groups, with significant gains in 30-second tests for both class 6 (p < 0.001) and class 7 (p < 0.001), and sustained attention only in class 6 (p = 0.012). Control groups showed no significant changes.

The UK's Competition and Markets Authority (CMA) has designated Google Search with Strategic Market Status, allowing it to impose new regulations. Potential measures include offering users a choice of rival search engines, fair ranking principles, increased data portability, and requiring permission to use publishers' content in AI Overviews. Google accounts for over 90% of UK search queries and £10 billion in ad spending. Google argues the measures could inhibit innovation and harm businesses.

A method for configuring hardware to implement a Deep Neural Network (DNN) uses a programmable lookup table in an activation module. Calibration data is provided to a hardware representation, and the input range to the activation module is monitored. Lookup data representing the activation function over that determined range is generated and loaded into the hardware's lookup table.

The Rockwood School District in Missouri keeps students together in their classroom cohorts for whole-class instruction, regardless of ability, and provides flexible, needs-based small groups within their grade level. Their kindergarteners outperformed national proficiency averages in every skill group, and first and second graders outpaced national averages across nearly every domain. The district argues that ability grouping can create larger learning gaps, while their inclusive, grade-level-first instruction builds readers.

A study in *Science* found 75% of global honey samples contained at least one of five neonicotinoid pesticides; 45% had two or more, and 10% had four or five. North America had the highest contamination rate at 86%, followed by Asia (80%) and Europe (79%).

China announced it will shut down its domestic ivory market by the end of 2017. The elephant population in Africa has declined by over half in 25 years, mainly due to ivory poaching. The 1989 international ban failed because it exempted older ivory, allowing illegal ivory to be passed off as legal. Wildlife experts say addressing demand is essential, and China is the largest ivory market. The closure is expected to have a dramatic impact and could be a turning point for elephant conservation. China plans to retrain ivory carvers and educate the public.

This review examines 41 studies on quality in higher education, focusing on online teaching during COVID-19, leadership spirituality, resistance to change, e-learning factors, quality assurance, gender differences, university rankings, and the impact of technology. The conclusion notes dynamic shifts in higher education publications driven by new models and technologies, presenting both challenges and opportunities.

Platinum futures are exchange-traded contracts for physical delivery of 50 troy ounces of platinum, traded on CME Globex. A platinum futures trading strategy uses technical and fundamental analysis for speculation, diversification, or hedging. The passage presents two backtested strategies: one with 473 trades, 64% win rate, and profit factor 1.7; another seasonal strategy with 60 trades, 75% win rate, and profit factor 2.3. Key risks include leverage amplifying losses, and price volatility from supply, demand, and economic factors.

High-dosage tutoring improves academic outcomes and can inspire students to become teachers. Teach For America's Ignite Fellowship trained over 5,500 tutors, with test scores growing up to 2.5 times faster in math and three times faster in reading. Key lessons include the need for structured training, using technology to build relationships, and evidence that tutoring nearly triples the likelihood of applying to teaching programs.

The President vetoes House bill No. 7864, which would add a literacy test for immigrants over 16, with exceptions for certain relatives. He argues it reverses the traditional open immigration policy, which has succeeded through assimilation. He disputes claims that recent immigrants are undesirable, that they overcrowd cities, or that they displace native workers, attributing unemployment to economic depression. He finds the literacy test a misleading measure of good citizenship, as illiterate laborers are not the source of disorder. He criticizes the exceptions as indefinite and inadequate, excluding siblings and creating loopholes. He also objects to sections barring non-citizen declarants from public works and making it a crime for aliens to regularly enter for private employment, calling them illiberal, vague, and harmful to cross-border relations.

This study introduces GeoSQL-Eval, an automated evaluation framework for LLMs generating PostGIS queries, and GeoSQL-Bench, a benchmark of 14,178 tasks across three categories. It evaluates 24 models across six categories on five capability levels, finding that general non-reasoning and reasoning-enhanced models perform best, while table schema retrieval remains a key challenge.

At Dumbarton Oaks on October 7, 1944, the U.S., U.K., and China informally agreed to exchange papers on dissolving the League of Nations, but no papers were received. The League’s Supervisory Committee appointed a Conciliation Committee in December 1944 to confer with a United Nations group. The U.S. took no initiative, recommending the matter be left for the United Nations Conference unless the U.K. or China acted.

Kyle Busch, after winning three consecutive NASCAR Cup races, expressed concern about peaking too early in the season, noting his strong performance at short tracks and the advantage from running Kyle Busch Motorsports. He acknowledged the challenge of a fourth win due to the unpredictability of restrictor-plate racing at Talladega.

New software patches improve biosecurity screening's ability to detect AI-altered toxic proteins. Researchers simulated tests, generating 76,000 blueprints for 72 harmful proteins; original forms were flagged, but many AI-adjusted versions bypassed filters. Patches helped, though models still failed to flag about 3 percent of variants. The work was computer-only, and it is unclear if AI-generated variants retained function.

In New Orleans' Lower Ninth Ward, Hurricane Katrina's devastation left empty lots and abandoned homes, with many poor, black residents unable to return due to costs and gentrification. The city has since adapted to extreme weather through evacuation centers, raised homes, solar panels, and rain gardens. The Greater New Orleans Urban Water Plan, inspired by Amsterdam, aims to manage flooding and subsidence via green infrastructure like the Mirabeau Water Garden. Louisiana's Coastal Master Plan, approved in 2017, requires $50 billion for rebuilding barrier islands, wetlands, and levees, funded partly by local sales taxes. Land subsidence from oil and gas extraction and rising seas pose major threats, with lessons from Louisiana considered valuable globally.

The cup and handle pattern is a bullish continuation formation on a price chart, consisting of a "U"-shaped cup followed by a handle. It marks a consolidation period and completes with a breakout above the handle's trading range. The pattern is used to identify potential upward price movements.

On May 10, 2018, NVIDIA Corporation filed a Form 8-K reporting its financial results for the quarter ended April 29, 2018, via a press release (Exhibit 99.1) and CFO commentary (Exhibit 99.2). These documents are furnished, not filed, and are not incorporated by reference into other SEC filings.
Every graph has a pair of vertex partitions P and Q, with Q refining P, such that P is ε₀-regular, Q is extremely regular, and the energy difference between P and Q is small.

Higher-order Feynman diagrams introduce integrals that diverge logarithmically to infinity. The solution involves introducing a cutoff and renormalizing physical parameters like mass and coupling constants. These parameters are scale-dependent, and their values "run" with energy. While the three fundamental couplings do not converge at a single high-energy scale, introducing new particles could alter this running behavior, potentially allowing for a unified theory.

Boston is the leading biotech hub, but its advantage faces new challenges from federal funding cuts and threats to higher education. The region has the most lab space globally, with billions in venture capital and federal research funding driving its prosperity.

Roma are reportedly interested in signing Manchester United winger Adnan Januzaj, who is out of favour and expected to be sold. Januzaj, 22, returned to United after a disappointing loan at Sunderland, and Roma may see him as a cut-price replacement for Mohamed Salah.
The passage is the copyright and publication information for the book "Designing Distributed Systems" by Brendan Burns, published by O'Reilly Media, Inc.

The passage compares lump sum investing and dollar-cost averaging, concluding that lump sum investing historically offers a higher probability of success over long-term horizons (at least ten years). It details backtesting of a lump sum buy & hold strategy using a diversified portfolio of five asset classes.

The passage is a collection of news articles and headlines from June 4-5, 2001, covering California's energy crisis, Enron's Dabhol project in India, and other business news. Key points include: California's natural gas market faces pipeline shortages and potential price manipulation; FERC implements a new price-mitigation plan for electricity; a PBS documentary examines the crisis; a Senate committee subpoenas power generators; Enron's Indian creditors meet to salvage the Dabhol project; and Marathon replaces Enron in a Saudi gas venture.

NeoWorld is a deep learning framework for interactive world generation from a single image. It uses a hybrid object-centric scene structure, combining 2.5D background layers with full 3D foreground objects, which are progressively unfolded based on user exploration or prompts. This design enables 3D-consistent scene exploration and physics-based object manipulation. In evaluations, NeoWorld outperformed prior 2D and 2.5D methods in 3D consistency and user engagement, achieving the highest CLIP score for temporal coherence among comparable 3D methods and superior text-motion alignment for user interactions.

Senator Sherwin Gatchalian urged the Department of Education (DepEd) to address delays in delivering performance-based bonuses to public school teachers, calling the long delay "unacceptable." Teachers have yet to receive bonuses for school year 2016-2017, the first time the delay has reached the following fiscal year. DepEd cited failed biddings and delayed clearance processing.

Former President Robert Mugabe returned from Singapore to Zimbabwe amid allegations from President Mnangagwa's government that he and his allies (G40) were behind a June 24 bomb blast in Bulawayo that killed two and injured over 40, including the Vice President. Mnangagwa stated in a BBC interview he could not trust Grace Mugabe based on a "hunch without evidence." A family source said the Mugabes were unperturbed and returned home. Mugabe's nephew, Patrick Zhuwao, warned in a letter to UK Prime Minister Theresa May that Mnangagwa might use the blast to target perceived enemies with violence.

The ADS9803 has an input clamp protection circuit for each of its eight analog channels, allowing swings up to ±18V. It features a programmable gain amplifier (PGA) per channel and a wide-common-mode voltage rejection circuit supporting CM voltages up to ±12V. The device outputs 20-bit conversion data. It can operate with a differential or single-ended clock and uses a SMPL_SYNC signal for simultaneous sampling across multiple devices. The ADS9803 has an internal voltage reference and supports 2-lane and 4-lane data interface modes with SDR and DDR. It includes a data output randomizer, two data averaging modes, and test patterns for debugging. The device can be powered down via the RESET or PWDN pin. It supports a speed-boost mode for up to 8MSPS on a selected channel pair. Register access is via SPI with three register banks. Multiple devices can be connected in a daisy-chain topology for SPI configuration.

On February 2, 2015, Apple Inc. entered an underwriting agreement to issue $6.5 billion in Notes: $500 million in Floating Rate Notes due 2020, and $1.25 billion each in 1.55% Notes due 2020 and 2.15% Notes due 2022, $1.5 billion in 2.50% Notes due 2025, and $2 billion in 3.45% Notes due 2045. The Notes are senior unsecured obligations issued under an indenture with The Bank of New York Mellon Trust Company, N.A.

A whole-body PBPK model was developed to study the distribution of four first-line anti-TB drugs (rifampicin, ethambutol, isoniazid, pyrazinamide) at extrapulmonary sites, including the pleura and lymph nodes. The model was calibrated and validated using reported plasma and lung concentration data. Simulations predicted that rifampicin and isoniazid concentrations were above critical concentrations in most sites, while ethambutol and pyrazinamide often were not.
Microsoft Corporation filed a Form 10-Q for the quarterly period ended September 30, 2017, reporting total revenue of $24.5 billion, net income of $6.6 billion, and total assets of $249.1 billion.

The U.S. Federal Reserve raised the federal funds rate by 0.25 points to a 1 to 1.25 percent target range, its second hike in six months. This followed a March increase to 0.75-1 percent and was only the third hike since the end of the post-2007 crisis flatline policy.

The K-T collaborative EVT registry, integrating data from Korean and Taiwanese stroke registries, includes 9,941 patients. Taiwanese patients were older with more vascular risk factors and severe strokes. Age strongly influenced EVT outcomes, particularly between 75-85 years, but symptomatic hemorrhagic transformation risk did not differ by age.

Dr. Maria Pane became a neonatologist after a medical school rotation. She treats the sickest and tiniest patients at GBMC, involving parents in rounds. She values the team and looks forward to the annual Father’s Day 5K fundraiser for the NICU.

Amazon.com, Inc. filed a Form 10-Q for the quarterly period ended June 30, 2022, reporting a net loss of $2.0 billion for Q2 2022 and $5.9 billion for the six months ended June 30, 2022, compared to net income of $7.8 billion and $15.9 billion in the same periods of 2021. Total net sales were $121.2 billion for Q2 2022 and $237.7 billion for the six months, up 7% year-over-year. Operating income decreased to $3.3 billion in Q2 2022 from $7.7 billion in Q2 2021.

The lecture introduces probabilistically checkable proofs (PCPs), which convert a standard NP witness into a larger proof that a verifier can check by reading only a few random bits. The goal is to construct a PCP for any NP language (e.g., 3SAT) using the GKR protocol, achieving completeness 1, soundness 1/2, and polylog n query and randomness complexity. The PCP is built by computing low-degree extensions of all circuit layers and all possible sumcheck transcripts, allowing the verifier to simulate GKR interactively via oracle queries. Soundness relies on the sumcheck protocol’s error bound, requiring the field size F to be polylog n to keep the proof polynomial-sized. The lecture also notes that a low-degree test is needed for the input layer, and transitions to discussing computational soundness (arguments) in the second part.

This study investigated the impact of mydriasis on image gradability and AI model performance for diabetic retinopathy (DR) screening using a portable fundus camera. In the mydriasis group, 82.1% of images were gradable versus 55.6% in the non-mydriasis group (P < 0.001). The AI model achieved higher accuracy (82.91% vs. 79.23%), F1 score (0.83 vs. 0.79), and AUC (0.94 vs. 0.93) in the mydriatic group, with fewer false positives (13.9% vs. 17.8%).

A Stephens County jury convicted Robert Pearl Bryson of multiple sex offenses and failure to register as a sex offender. On appeal, Bryson challenged the sufficiency of evidence, trial court rulings on motions, and effectiveness of counsel. The court affirmed all convictions, finding sufficient evidence for each charge, no error in denying motions to quash, withdraw, sever, or admit evidence, and that Bryson waived his ineffective assistance claim.

Image registration seeks a coordinate transform to align a moving image with a fixed image. Current methods fail on large, high-resolution images due to high memory use. This paper identifies key bottlenecks and proposes fused kernels to reduce memory, enabling problems up to 64× larger on a single GPU. It also introduces a distributed framework (FFDP) to scale to multiple GPUs, demonstrating a multimodal registration with over 11.8B parameters completed in one minute on 8 GPUs. FFDP accelerates existing pipelines by up to 7.48× while reducing memory by up to 59%.

This paper investigates the relationship between Big Data (BD), Advanced Analytics (AA), and Artificial Intelligence (AI) to develop a multidimensional, data-driven AI innovation framework. It creates an AI/BD/AA micro-level value chain and a five-level enterprise maturity framework for AI-based automation, ranging from human-led to machine-controlled. The framework is designed to help organizations evaluate their AI innovation initiatives and identify steps for advancing BD/AA maturity.

The CS5535 may not signal an SSMI if an IRQ occurs simultaneously, causing the I/O to complete without the SSMI. UDMA fails if the bus master is enabled before a PIO command. Wake events from GPIO[27:24] do not work in ACPI S3. RTC reads can return incorrect data after a specific write sequence. Block and demand mode DMA blocks LPC I/O. USB clock gating causes register read failures. An IDE interrupt during bus mastering resets the engine. The AuxOutputFull bit is incorrectly cleared by a Port 60h read. tACK timing is fixed at 30 ns. ATAC can hang with WORD-aligned PRDs. LPC may abort transactions with short SYNC patterns. The NEGACK bit may not set immediately. The retry counter counts all PCI retries. Atomic GPIO writes clear non-selected bits after suspend. SMBus hold time is too short. LOWBAT_FLAG may not set after abnormal standby. SLEEP_X/Y may not deassert if delays are too large.

Ulysses S. Gandy appealed his second manslaughter conviction. The Supreme Court of Mississippi affirmed, finding sufficient evidence supported the jury's verdict that Gandy was intoxicated and in the wrong lane of traffic. The court held the trial court did not err in refusing a proposed jury instruction, admitting sketches of the accident scene, or failing to recess the jury for food during deliberations.

The passage describes a study that developed a model linking Google Community Mobility Reports (GCMR) to SARS-CoV-2 transmission dynamics. The model was applied to regions in Norway, Sweden, and Germany, estimating that 60% of infections in Sweden and 39% in Norway were attributed to settings captured by four GCMR categories (Workplaces, Transit stations, Groceries & Pharmacies, Retail & Recreation). Transit stations and Workplaces were the most important settings in Norway and Sweden, while Retail & Recreation was most important in the German regions analyzed. The model also estimated a ~40% reduction in transmissibility with a 20°C temperature increase and a doubling of transmissibility for the Delta variant.

The passage is a political speech accepting a presidential nomination, contrasting the speaker's party's record of economic recovery, tax cuts, job creation, and military strength with the opposition's past policies of high inflation, taxes, and deficits. It outlines future goals including tax simplification, deficit reduction, nuclear arms reduction, and pledges to uphold individual liberty and traditional values.

EUR/USD rose to 1.1840, supported near 1.1810, extending a four-day gain from 1.1690/85 lows due to a weak US dollar after Friday's inflation data. Focus is on ECB and FOMC minutes for QE tapering and balance sheet reduction. Key levels: resistance at 1.1846, 1.1894, 1.1911; support at 1.1722, 1.1687, 1.1611.

This integrated circuit can be damaged by ESD. Texas Instruments recommends appropriate handling precautions, as failure to do so can cause damage ranging from performance degradation to complete device failure.

California's energy crisis involved a wider range of suppliers than Governor Davis suggested, with some public entities charging higher average prices than the Texas firms he criticized. A Senate committee chair accused Duke Energy of refusing to release key pricing data for a price-gouging probe. Power companies failed to reach a refund agreement with California, and a judge will recommend a plan for refunds. The CEO of Enron's Indian unit, Dabhol Power Company, resigned. Enron's chairman confirmed the resignation and said talks to resolve a payment dispute with an Indian utility were inconclusive.

Grief is a unique emotional reaction to loss, varying per individual. It can stem from death, life changes, or anticipatory loss. The grieving process is complex and non-sequential, involving emotions like numbness, denial, relief, yearning, restlessness, guilt, anger, and sadness. Grief duration varies; intense periods eventually ease, though the deceased is always missed.

The ADS9803 has two data averaging modes (simple and moving average) to improve SNR, and test patterns (fixed, digital ramp, alternating) for debugging. It can be powered down via the RESET or PWDN pin. An initialization sequence is required after power-up or reset. A speed-boost mode allows up to 8MSPS for a selected channel pair. SPI register access uses three banks, with a specific read/write procedure. Daisy-chain topology is supported for multiple devices. The device is an eight-channel, 20-bit, 2MSPS DAQ system for ATE applications, with a TUE of 0.0015% post-calibration. It has three power supplies and layout recommendations are provided.

The Patriots' poor offensive performance kept them in the game until a bizarre, ineffective onside kick by Stephen Gostkowski, which Jon Gruden called the most bizarre he had seen, led to a Dolphins recovery and win.

A team led by Vanderbilt University improved hyperlens resolution by using isotopically purified hexagonal boron nitride (hBN) crystals, enhancing imaging capability about tenfold. This allows potential imaging of objects as small as 30 nanometers, enabling live-cell observation with infrared light.

Beating the offside trap requires attackers to recognize the trap, adjust to avoid offside, and exploit the space behind defenders. Tactics include dribbling, through passes, horizontal runs, checking runs, short passes, deep-lying runs, bending runs, back passes, delaying play, delayed runs, and using a designated non-runner. Success often results in a one-on-one with the goalkeeper.
Scientists found that periwinkle sea snails can adapt to ocean acidification by producing less-dense, less-soluble inner shells, suggesting some calcifying organisms may resist future conditions.
The case of *People v. Roldán* is nearly identical to case No. 2037, differing only in the loan amount. Based on the same evidence and errors, the judgment is reversed and the defendant acquitted.

China blacklisted Canadian firm TechInsights and nine subsidiaries for endangering national security after it published an analysis of Huawei's AI chips, banning it from business with Chinese organizations. The ban restricts collaboration, data supply, and client access, reflecting China's tightening control over tech information and rising semiconductor tensions.

Barron's suggests Netflix stock could lose over half its value due to threats from Disney, Facebook, Amazon, cash-burning, and accounting tactics. However, the article argues these fears are overblown, citing Netflix's pricing flexibility and market dominance as reasons it can continue to succeed.

From 1990 to 2015, nearly 17,000 U.S. children under 6 were treated for window-blind injuries, with entanglement causing most deaths and hospitalizations. Almost all entanglements involved cords, occurred at home, and were unwitnessed. Experts advocate for mandatory cordless or inaccessible cord standards, as voluntary measures have been insufficient.

Ryan Kerr, 26, of Evercreech, was remanded in custody after admitting a series of attacks, including punching a woman and leaving a man unconscious, showing no remorse. Sentencing was adjourned for psychiatric reports.

Peterborough City Council leader Cllr John Holdich reported that 31% of 574 long-term empty homes were brought back into use last year, with 663 homes returned over five years generating over £3 million. Phase Two budget proposals were published, and the council faces an 80% cut in government grants. Two Public Space Protection Orders have shown early success in reducing anti-social behaviour. A new mental health service, CHUMS, launched to support children and young people.
Chef Shannon Bard announced the closure of her Portland restaurant Zapoteca, citing a shift in family priorities. The Bards own two other restaurants, a cooking school, and a catering company.

The study evaluated convalescent plasma plus best supportive care versus best supportive care alone in hospitalized COVID-19 patients, hypothesizing that high-volume, high-titer plasma early in hospitalization would reduce mechanical ventilation need. The study was ethically conducted per Declaration of Helsinki and ICH GCP guidelines, with IEC approval and informed consent.

The NAAIM Exposure Index, compiled by the National Association of Active Investment Managers, measures the average equity exposure of its members. It is used as a contrarian sentiment indicator, where high readings suggest bullishness and low readings suggest bearishness. However, backtests indicate it is not a strong contrarian indicator, with poor performance in tested trading strategies.

Lubrizol Corp. is investing US$80 million to expand its TPU production capacity in North America, Europe, and Asia, citing increased demand. New capacity is expected later in 2018, with further expansions planned for 2019.

Jeff Horn's WBO welterweight title defense against Gary Corcoran could lead to a potential bout with Terence Crawford if he wins, while a loss might return him to obscurity. Horn aims to prove his win over Manny Pacquiao was not a hometown decision. Promoter Bob Arum said a win would lead to major fights in 2018, including Pacquiao's return and Crawford as mandatory. Horn focuses only on Corcoran, who is fighting outside Britain for the first time. The buildup includes accusations of head-butting from Corcoran's camp and biting threats. Both fighters expect an aggressive style.

President Trump announced Pfizer agreed to lower drug prices for Medicaid and patients, with new medicines priced at parity with other countries, in exchange for exemption from certain tariffs. Policy experts are skeptical about the deal's impact on affordability, noting Medicaid already receives low prices.

Manchester City faces Burnley at the Etihad Stadium on Jan. 2, aiming for a win to maintain their title challenge. City must win the midfield battle and defend set pieces, while Burnley seeks points to avoid relegation. Key players include Sergio Aguero, Kevin de Bruyne, and David Silva for City, and Andre Gray and Sam Vokes for Burnley. An early goal is crucial for City to secure victory.

This study used EEG to investigate neural noise in 19 adults with Tourette syndrome (TS) compared to matched controls, operationalizing noise as increased trial-by-trial variability in response to median nerve stimulation. The TS group showed increased trial-by-trial variability and flatter 1/f noise slopes at beta and gamma frequencies, but no differences in the timing or topography of early SEP components. Variability normalized in response to stimulation, and the P100 SEP component was increased in the TS group, correlating with tic severity.

Facebook released a detailed, 8,000-word public rule book for content moderation, covering topics from drug use to hate speech. It now allows appeals for individual content removals and provides specific reasons for takedowns. The standards, updated every two weeks, are based on feedback from over 100 outside organizations. Facebook also blocks content violating local law in specific countries, not globally.
On June 20, 2017, Apple Inc. issued and sold $1,000,000,000 in 3.000% Notes due 2027. The Notes are senior unsecured obligations, with interest paid semi-annually, and mature on June 20, 2027.

A federal jury cleared retired Little Rock police lieutenant David Hudson of excessive force accusations for punching Jon Erwin seven times in October 2011, finding the force reasonable from Hudson's perspective. The video-fueled case involved two days of testimony; Erwin sought damages but settled with the city and restaurant before trial. Hudson testified he acted under police policy, while Erwin maintained he was a victim of excessive force.

Official U.S. statements on the war were largely ignored in Finland. Finnish irritation grew over German troops' perceived inaction, despite Finland's dependence on Germany for supplies. German influence appeared in press censorship and suppression of the Pope's message. War weariness was evident in a trade union petition to the Prime Minister, a widening socialist-conservative schism, and public impatience with conquest aims. A U.S. official warned Finland that press attacks on the U.S. and President, likely German-inspired, risked harming Finnish interests.

An email from Toby Kuehl to multiple Enron colleagues on October 25, 2001, shares a Texas Monthly article titled "How Enron Blew It," which examines Enron's decline from a high-flying energy trading giant to a company with a falling stock price, bearish Wall Street sentiment, and a departed CEO, attributing the downturn to its aggressive culture, market missteps, and internal pressures.

Amazon.com, Inc. filed a Form 10-Q for the quarterly period ended March 31, 2018, reporting net sales of $51.0 billion, operating income of $1.9 billion, and net income of $1.6 billion. The company had $24.6 billion in long-term debt and $31.5 billion in stockholders' equity as of March 31, 2018.

The passage discusses the impact of frequent penalties on game flow, the need for quicker play and defensive positioning, the effectiveness of the opponent's penalty kill, defensive restructuring after a trade, the challenge of coaching in a loud arena, the preference for fewer penalties, the coach's approach to goaltenders, difficulty assessing the series due to penalties, lineup adjustments, the performance of specific players, the coach's philosophy of adapting to his team, and his enjoyment of hockey despite the pressures.

Process modeling is critical in Materials Science and Engineering (MSE) for representing material transformations. This work surveys ontologies and ontology design patterns (ODPs) for process modeling in MSE, defines three core requirements (Process Structure, Data and Resources, Project Goals and Participant Roles), and proposes a baseline method for automatically extracting ODPs using semantic similarity. The method was evaluated on five ontologies (P-PLAN, Metadata4Ing, OPMW, WILD, GPO, PMDcore), with P-PLAN achieving the highest F1-scores for Process (0.59) and Resource (0.53) ODPs, while PMDcore supported all three ODP categories.

Florida State linebacker Ethan Pritchard was released from the hospital Thursday after being shot in the head and moved to a rehabilitation facility in Jacksonville. He is alert and responsive. Four people were arrested in connection with the August 31 shooting, described as a case of mistaken identity.

New executive board members of the Wayne Memorial Hospital Auxiliary were installed. Old Forge High School students raised $3,864 for St. Jude’s Research Hospital through a Math-a-thon. Hannah Perry Burgess presented a program on honey bees at a DAR meeting.

GoDaddy gave The Daily Stormer 24 hours to move its domain after a post mocking Heather Heyer, killed in a Charlottesville attack, violated its terms of service. The site claimed it was hacked, but a contributor said it was a prank. GoDaddy only hosts the domain, not content. The site has faced prior bans from PayPal and an advertiser.

In July 2021, an outbreak of salmonella gastroenteritis in Cardiff, UK was linked to an Eid al-Adha barbecue. A cohort study of 36 attendees identified consumption of a traditional raw liver dish, 'marrara', as the most likely vehicle for infection (aOR: 49.99). Food samples yielded whole genome sequences identical to those from cases. The outbreak highlights the need for culturally sensitive food hygiene advice for communities preparing traditional dishes.

An appeals court ruled the federal government cannot legally stop interstate trade of Burmese pythons and other giant exotic snakes within the continental U.S., but the ban on importing these snakes and state laws like Florida’s pet prohibition remain unaffected. The U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service is reviewing the ruling.

The speaker reflects on their team's performance in a hockey series against New Jersey, noting a shift in pace after Holik's opportunity in the second period. They highlight improved puck possession and confidence, but acknowledge the team has been chasing the series and lacks advantages. Faceoffs are an edge, but more advantages are needed. The team used three centers and four winger sets. The speaker emphasizes emotion and enthusiasm over technical plans, and notes the team is motivated to avoid past mistakes. They stress the need to outplay New Jersey in more areas to win, as the series remains competitive.

When family life is devalued and birth rates fall below death rates, national decline follows. The speaker urges Congress to pass a law developing American shipping, including better steamer lines to South America, and to reform currency laws due to harmful interest rate fluctuations and credit uncertainty during crop seasons. A proposed plan would allow national banks to issue notes backed by capital, taxed to prevent over-issue.

Fad diets are not a healthy or sustainable weight loss method. A non-diet approach, focusing on reconnecting with food and moderation, is more sustainable than restrictive diets that cause deprivation.
Gold Coast Titans signed veteran Michael Gordon to a two-year NRL deal after his release from the Sydney Roosters, filling the fullback vacancy left by Jarryd Hayne.

Morgan McSweeney, a biotech professional and social media influencer with 4 million followers, discusses his approach to science communication. He uses "edutainment" to make public health topics engaging. He targets a middle audience, avoiding direct engagement with vehemently disagreeing viewers to prevent burnout. He emphasizes nuance and personal details to build trust, noting that sharing about his wife helped a viewer trust him. He keeps his content separate from his day job, which involves monoclonal antibody therapeutics. He finds that only about 1 in 30 of his videos performs exceptionally well.

The Coppock Curve Strategy, devised by economist E.S.C. Coppock in 1965, is a long-term momentum indicator using a 10-month weighted moving average of the sum of 11-month and 14-month rate of change. It triggers a long entry when the curve crosses above zero and an exit when it crosses below zero. On a monthly S&P 500 chart, it produced 12 trades over 63 years, all winners, with reduced drawdown and market exposure, and risk-adjusted return exceeding buy & hold.

Nick Foles, a backup quarterback, led the Philadelphia Eagles to Super Bowl LII after replacing injured starter Carson Wentz. If he wins, he will be adored but likely remain a backup, as Wentz is the franchise's future. Foles' contract allows free agency after 2018, and the Eagles may trade him at peak value. Rebuilding teams like the Arizona Cardinals are potential suitors. Foles is not expected to demand a trade, and the Eagles might retain him as a backup.

He notes economic progress: lowest inflation in 25 years, prime rate down to 7.5%, 13 million new jobs, and record employment. He expresses regret for the Iran action, assuming full responsibility. He urges defense budget support, citing Soviet military spending and cuts to U.S. security assistance. He opposes protectionism, supports a balanced budget amendment and line-item veto, and plans welfare and catastrophic illness reforms. He calls for competitiveness, education improvements, and voluntary school prayer. He concludes by emphasizing "We the people" as America's defining principle, asserting the nation's best days lie ahead.

The UND campus senate will discuss a draft resolution from NDSU's Faculty Senate, which declares a "crisis of confidence" in the NDUS due to budget cuts and consolidation, and calls for improved collaboration and a Higher Education Summit. The UND executive committee will decide if the wider body supports it, though changing factors may render it moot. The resolution was only sent to the 11 system campuses.

The introduction of containers and orchestrators enabled reusable components, so the book aims to provide a shared language and standard library for building better systems more quickly. It captures repeatable, generic patterns to make distributed system development more approachable and efficient.

Sustainable real estate finance involves capital flow from end users to investors, with green buildings offering higher cash flow and lower risk due to regulation and tenant preference, shifting the efficient frontier northwest. Mortgages for green properties have lower default risk, enabling higher loan-to-value ratios and lower interest rates, while climate risk increases default risk for brown properties. Private equity incorporates ESG into investment memos and due diligence.

Open interest in Treasury futures plunged over 400,000 contracts on Tuesday. The 10-year yield rose to 2.855% on Wednesday, after falling to 2.759% on Tuesday, its lowest since April 11.

He focuses on his own performance, notes facing strong goalies, and reflects on past injuries and surgery. He expects the series to become heated and physical quickly.

The rally reflects a flight to safety, supported by central bank gold purchases and geopolitical tensions. Analysts caution that hawkish Fed signals could cause corrections, but the breach indicates investor conviction in future easing.

Wikipedia in Italy and Spain blocked all articles on 3 July 2018 to protest an EU copyright directive vote. The directive, approved by the European Committee on Legal Affairs, includes Articles 11 and 13, requiring content filtering and a link tax. Editors warned it threatens internet openness and could endanger Wikipedia. The EU parliamentary vote is scheduled for 5 July 2018. Critics cite vague wording and potential harm to fair use, while proponents argue it corrects copyright imbalance.

The Boy Scouts' Twin Rivers Council is enrolling girls in Cub Scouts immediately, aiming for 125 girls in grades K-3 by March 31st to prepare for summer camp, as part of a national program change to allow families to participate together.

Audi's upcoming Q8, its new flagship SUV, features a prominent hexagonal grille and aggressive front end. It will debut in Shanghai in early June, riding on the Volkswagen Group's MLB platform. The production powertrain is unconfirmed, but a 48-volt mild hybrid system is likely.

Earth Day, observed annually on April 22 since 1970, is now associated with "Big Environment," which the author describes as a powerful political force. The author criticizes groups like Protect South Portland for passing the Clear Skies Ordinance, which bans Canadian oil sands and is costing taxpayers millions in legal fees. The author also argues that wind power is ineffective, ugly, noisy, and harmful to birds, and that Big Environment uses fear to raise money. US electricity demand hit a new all-time high. Short-term technicals look tenuous, but medium/long-term trends remain healthy.

Types include zone, safety, cornerback, zero, and run blitzes, each with specific risks and strategies. Offenses can counter with quick passes, mobile quarterbacks, or max protection schemes.

Residents of Greensboro's Cottage Grove community report declining housing conditions at Avalon Trace Apartments, including boarded windows, trash, sewage leaks, mold, and inadequate heating, linked to asthma cases. A $250,000 BUILD Health Challenge grant funds a collaboration between the Greensboro Housing Coalition, Cone Health, and UNCG to map asthma hot spots and direct residents to services. Cone Health matches the grant with $250,000, and the Guilford County health department provides additional programs.

China's July power generation rose 8.6% year-on-year to 604.7 billion kWh, a monthly record since May 2014, driven by a jump in thermal power. Thermal output was the highest since December. January-July output rose 6.8% to 3.57 trillion kWh.

The passage argues that student newsrooms face threats like defunding or loss of editorial independence, and calls for support to preserve their role in teaching journalism ethics and unbiased reporting, urging readers to help #SaveStudentNewsrooms.

Information design combines Bayesian persuasion with framing effects, where a sender influences a receiver's decisions through both a recommendation scheme and framing. The study identifies three optimization variants: recommendation-only, framing-only, and joint framing and recommendation. Theoretical results show framing-only optimization is challenging (discontinuous utility, NP-hard), while joint optimization is more tractable (continuous utility, QPTAS). Empirical results using LLMs demonstrate the effectiveness of a hill-climbing approach for joint optimization, validated by human studies.

The Imperial Government denies that Belgium upheld its neutrality toward Great Britain, citing Belgian military cooperation with Britain and France. It claims Germany offered to guarantee Belgian territory and compensate damages if allowed passage, referencing a 1887 British precedent, but Belgium refused. Germany rejects accusations of misconduct in Belgium and blames Belgium and its allies for Belgium's fate. It states the four allied powers will continue fighting until they secure a peace ensuring honor, existence, and free development for their peoples.

The passage describes the adapter pattern, a single-node container pattern where an adapter container modifies an application container's interface to conform to a predefined standard. It explains how this pattern addresses heterogeneity in monitoring, logging, and health checks by providing a consistent interface, using examples like Prometheus for monitoring, Fluentd for logging, and a custom health check for MySQL. The text then transitions to multi-node distributed patterns, introducing microservices and detailing the replicated load-balanced service pattern, including stateless services, session tracking, and the addition of caching and SSL termination layers. It further covers sharded services for stateful data, the scatter/gather pattern for parallel processing, and event-driven computing with FaaS, including the decorator pattern and event handling.

Jaguars defensive end Travon Walker underwent left wrist surgery on Monday but is listed as day-to-day and could play against the Chiefs. He was injured in the second quarter of Sunday's win over San Francisco and did not return. Walker has two sacks, 12 tackles, and one pass breakup this season.
Pasteurization completely inactivates H5N1 bird flu virus in milk, though inactive viral proteins remain.

Department of Education officials stated they will not negotiate their proposed definition of professional programs, which currently limits the category to 10 specific degrees. Committee members pushed back and submitted their own definition, which will be discussed. The department aims to curb excessive graduate borrowing but remains open to future rule making.

Organizations submit designs after the theme announcement, and small groups like DAAC fund their own paint. The process involves painting over old squares annually.

Contributions totaled about $52 million for Democrats and $4 million for Republicans. The analysis, by Professor Derek Muller, covered the top 100 firms and 50 larger plaintiffs-side firms.

The lecture covers the second-order wave equation, comparing it to the first-order system. It discusses semidiscrete and fully discrete methods, focusing on stability and dispersion. The key points include the eigenvalues of the system matrix (c and -c), the leapfrog method, and the stability condition (Courant number r < 1). The solution to the wave equation is given as u(x,t) = f1(x-ct) + f2(x+ct).

A 29-year-old Grande Prairie man, Wally Adams, was arrested in Calgary on Aug. 3 for child pornography charges, including possession and making it available, following an Aug. 2 search warrant. He was released and will appear in court Sept. 27.

A high school baseball team in Citrus Heights is warning that someone is posing as team members to solicit sponsorships from local businesses, costing one auto repair shop about $1,400. The soliciting company, "Athletic Sports," has no website and uses a UPS store mailbox. The team filed a police report and posted the flyer on social media, urging businesses to verify directly with schools before donating.

George McPhee discusses the Vegas Golden Knights' expansion draft strategy, team-building philosophy, leadership decisions, community response to tragedy, player assessments, and coaching criteria, emphasizing competitiveness and process over specific goals.

The TSX rose slightly, boosted by gains in CN Rail and Restaurant Brands, while steady gold prices lifted miners. Seven of 10 main sectors were higher, with Mitel Networks as the top gainer and Prairiesky Royal as the top decliner.

High-energy (1 MeV) electron beam irradiation is used to engineer defects in monolayer MoS2 by varying exposure time. Irradiation increases defect density, evidenced by enhanced defect-bound emission and reduced valley polarization. XPS and KPFM reveal Mo-O bonding and p-type doping post-irradiation. First-principles calculations attribute the defect peak to transitions between the conduction band and acceptor levels.

The strategy, backtested using monthly gold prices, shows lower returns but reduced market time (one-third) and lower maximum drawdown (almost half).

More than 4,000 Japanese troops are in Korea, with Japan preparing for movements, while China is also increasing forces. Japan holds Seoul and China is 15 miles south; Japan will not withdraw until China guarantees non-interference in Korea per the 1885 Tientsin convention, which China allegedly violated by not giving prior notice. A secret edict made Viceroy Li Hung-chang plenipotentiary, though war is regretted due to the Empress's birthday. Japan's action is criticized as hasty; conflict seems imminent. Japan's army is 120,000 men, while Li has 50,000 foreign-drilled troops. Foreign representatives in Seoul are trying to avert conflict. China's grand council stated troops must remain as Japan refused withdrawal. Japan has occupied strategic points around Seoul. Japan presented demands for radical Korean government changes, with troops staying until satisfied.

Tencent added Batman to Arena of Valor as an Assassin class character with a batrang and forearm blades, alongside a new Death Match mode for five teams of two on a colosseum map, where points above heroes are earned by rivals. The update also includes Valor TV for live matches and schedules, plus optimizations to menus, friends list, and messaging.

The Wing-T offense uses misdirection, unusual formations, and a diverse run game to exploit aggressive defenders. Developed by Coach Harold “Tubby” Raymond at the University of Delaware, it requires at least two solid running backs and an athletic quarterback, but not a huge offensive line. Its strengths include slowing down aggressive defenses and having experienced coaching adjustments; its main weakness is the lack of a traditional dropback pass game. Common formations include Wing, Wing-Slot, and Unbalanced. Key plays include the Buck Sweep, Down play, Trap, Waggle, Single Receiver Option Route, and Play Action Vertical Pass. The offense is prevalent in high school football and has influenced spread offenses in college.

The device enters ACQ state on power-up, after reset, or after each conversion. A rising edge of CONVST/CS transitions the device from ACQ to CONV state. In CONV state, the device ignores further CONVST/CS transitions until conversion is complete. Data transfer frames begin on the falling edge of CONVST/CS and end on the rising edge. The device supports nine configuration registers and two data transfer types: write and read. Data read output depends on the command issued and DATA_VAL[2:0] bits. The device features a multiSPI interface with legacy SPI-compatible and source-synchronous protocols. Power-saving modes include NAP and power-down (PD). The device uses AVDD and DVDD power supplies.

For the ADS9803, avoid crossing digital lines with the analog signal path and keep analog and reference signals away from noise sources. The Growth and Strategy Council (GSC) at Corning, led by the CEO, COO, and CTO, manages innovation by providing advice, guidance, and resource allocation for high-potential projects across business segments. It aims to maintain a balanced innovation portfolio and prevent groupthink, making decisions on pacing, investment, and strategy. The project has recently increased hiring, with potential employee testing by end of 2019 and consumer release possibly in 2019. The device's boot state is determined by sampling BTMODE[15:0] pins at reset de-assertion. BTMODE[15:11] set GPMC CS0 bus width, wait enable, and address/data multiplexing. BTMODE[4:0] define the boot mode order; the first mode is primary, with subsequent modes attempted upon failure. BTMODE[7:5] are reserved and must be pulled down. For EMAC bootmode, BTMODE[9:8] select the Ethernet PHY mode. For XIP bootmodes, BTMODE[10] selects GPMC pin muxing options.

WhatsApp is building an ecosystem of products and services, following WeChat's model. It has introduced voice/video calls and plans payments next. Chat platforms are key for user engagement, with content consumption rising due to cheap data. WhatsApp failed with 'stories'; professionally produced content may work better. Competitor Hike offers payments but lags. Gaming is another engagement tool, as seen in Gamepind. The Indian internet market is an oligopoly of global giants.

A security appliance can incorporate a local touch screen interface for command and control, bypassing the need for network-based login. During denial of service attacks, commands from this local interface receive priority access to processing resources, enabling mitigating actions like shutting down ports or modifying filter rules without requiring a manual reboot or network disconnection.

Apple Inc. held its Annual Meeting on March 10, 2015. Shareholders elected eight directors, ratified Ernst & Young as auditor, approved executive compensation, and approved an amendment to the Employee Stock Purchase Plan. Two shareholder proposals, "Risk Report" and "Proxy Access for Shareholders," were not approved.

An environmental group says Canada missed a chance to protect citizens from phthalates, as a federal review found none of over a dozen studied pose a human health risk. The group notes the EU has identified risks from at least four phthalates, attributing the difference to Canada's requirement to prove harm before banning a substance. The government is considering recommendations to modernize chemical regulations.

A synthesis of 49 studies found educators change curriculum due to high-stakes testing. In Wisconsin, private school choice program students must take the state-made Wisconsin Forward Exam, which uses Common Core standards. In Oklahoma, state law requires a specific ACT score for scholarships. The College Board has lowered SAT standards, with a 71-point drop in SAT math rigor from 2008 to 2023. The Classic Learning Test (CLT) is a strong alternative, with a 0.89 correlation to SAT scores. States should provide a menu of assessments for school choice programs.

The Supreme Court will hear oral arguments in a case challenging Colorado's ban on conversion therapy for minors. Therapist Kaley Chiles argues the ban violates her free speech rights, while Colorado contends it regulates unsafe and ineffective treatment. The 10th Circuit upheld the ban under rational basis review, but Chiles argues strict scrutiny should apply. The case centers on whether the ban regulates conduct or speech.

A new analysis by the Canadian Society of Palliative Care Physicians concludes that providing palliative care across Canada would reduce costs and improve care. The report cites studies showing hospital-based palliative care saves $7,000-$8,000 per patient, outpatient services save about 30% compared to regular care, and expanding home-based care in Ontario could avoid $191 million to $385 million in costs.

AMP chairman David Murray stated that ASX corporate governance principles have caused a decline in governance standards in the financial sector by hindering innovation, leading to a "trust deficit." He argued the principles have become overly prescriptive "one-size-fits-all" regulations, with firms conforming due to the "path of least resistance."

Gardaí in Louth renewed an appeal for information about the murder of 18-year-old Cameron Reilly, whose body was found with neck injuries in Dunleer. They seek his iPhone with a black and lime green cover, believing it holds crucial messages. Separately, gardaí seized a semi-automatic shotgun in west Dublin, arresting a man and a woman, and seized drugs worth around €1m, including heroin and cocaine.

The seventh Johnston Press South Business Awards, held at Brighton's Grand Hotel and presented by Nick Wallis, recognized local businesses. Guardian Angel Carers won Overall Business of the Year and Large Business of the Year. Olive and Vine won the Place to Eat or Drink Award. Brandon Relph won the Young Achiever award, and Southsea Bathing Hut won Retailer of the Year. Talks at Six won the Outstanding Contribution to the Community award.

The court affirmed a judgment for the defendants in a negligence case involving a collision at a street intersection. The court found no error in the jury instructions regarding the plaintiff's allegations, the right of way, speed reduction, or comparative negligence, as the evidence supported the verdict.

The Central Bank of Nigeria introduced FORM X for SMEs to ease forex access, requiring only basic documentation, an application letter, beneficiary invoice, and bank wire transfer, targeting needs under $10,000.

A patent application describes techniques for enhanced trick-play modes in streaming video. A media guidance application maintains a normal buffer window of continuous video content and a trick-play window buffering only a subset of video frames from portions outside the normal window. During trick-play, the application plays video using only the buffered subset. Frame selection for the trick-play window is based on performance metrics, playback rate, and frame address information from metadata. The application can also request individual frames from a server without requesting intervening frames, and later fill in missing ranges.

Breast cancer is the most common cancer in the UK, with around 56,000 new cases yearly. A breast lump can feel pea-like, hard, irregular, and may occur in the breast or armpit. Self-examination involves looking for changes in size, shape, skin, and nipples, and feeling for lumps in circular motions while lying down and sitting up. Regular checks (every two weeks to monthly) help identify abnormalities. Risk factors include HRT use, family genetics, early periods, late menopause, and age at first childbirth. Men can also develop breast cancer, typically between ages 60-70. Early detection improves survival rates.

On June 16, 2019, NVIDIA's Board appointed Donald F. Robertson Jr. as Vice President, Chief Accounting Officer and Principal Accounting Officer, effective June 17, 2019. He will report to Colette Kress and replace Michael Byron. His compensation includes a $650,000 annual salary, a $600,000 sign-on bonus, and 15,000 RSUs vesting over four years.

Travis Haydon, 20, was jailed for 18 months for stabbing Liam Brown in the abdomen with a flick knife after a dispute over a spilt drink at a Plymouth pub. He pleaded guilty to assault causing actual bodily harm, possessing a knife, and cannabis possession, and was in breach of a suspended sentence.

SPYR, Inc. will issue a 1-for-1 dividend of shares in a new spin-off company to shareholders of record as of May 19, 2017, to divest its restaurant division. A 167-million-year-old fossil lizard named *Breugnathair elgolensis*, discovered on Scotland's Isle of Skye, has snake-like jaws and teeth but a lizard-like short body and limbs. Its mix of features suggests snake-like traits may have evolved independently or that snake ancestors were different than expected.

The A100 GPU has 40 MB of L2 cache, 6.7x larger than the V100, improving HPC and AI workload performance. It is a shared resource divided into two partitions for higher bandwidth and lower latency, delivering a 2.3x L2 bandwidth increase over V100. Each partition has 40 L2 slices, with eight 512 KB slices per memory controller. A100 L2 read bandwidth is 5120 Bytes/clk versus V100's 2048 Bytes/clk. The architecture provides L2 cache residency controls and Compute Data Compression, offering up to 4x improvement in DRAM and L2 read bandwidth.

The RTC_B operates from a 32kHz clock, providing time counters and multiple interrupt options. It includes customizable and interval alarms, calibration for crystal offset and temperature drift (up to ±240 ppm), and a clock output pin. The IWDT is an independent supervisor that generates a POR reset if not reset within a programmed time, with eight selectable periods (2ms to 2hr). The WWDT supervises code execution, generating a reset or interrupt if not reset within a window, and supports sleep mode stopping and interval timer mode. TIMGx (general-purpose) and TIMAx (advanced) timers offer features like 16-/32-bit counters, prescalers, PWM with dead band, quadrature encoder interface, and cross-triggering. The IOMUX manages digital IO function selection, output driver, input path, and wake-up logic. A serial wire debug (SWD) two-wire interface is provided. The boot strap loader (BSL) enables device configuration and memory programming via UART or I2C, protected by a 256-bit password. A memory-mapped FACTORY region provides read-only device data and trim information.

Chicago faces a major security challenge with three large sports events drawing over 1.8 million spectators. The Las Vegas shooting has added concerns about a lone-wolf gunman from high-rises. Police are deploying 1,000 extra officers and more undercover cops, and are coordinating with building security. Officials express confidence in layered security measures, and runners remain undeterred.
AI models Evo 1 and Evo 2 generated multiple bacteriophage genomes from scratch, with some outperforming a well-studied strain in lab tests.

DoorDash unveiled a new autonomous delivery robot called Dot, which is nearly five feet tall, bright red, and equipped with nine cameras and seven sensors. The company aims for a hybrid delivery model using humans, drones, and autonomous vehicles. The robot is designed to operate on sidewalks, roads, and bike lanes. The delivery robot industry has faced challenges, including technical difficulties navigating sidewalks and bike lanes, and some companies like Amazon and FedEx have scaled back their projects.

The speaker welcomes the visiting nation's representatives, affirming friendship and peace. He states the U.S. will not disturb their lands and will protect them from encroachment. The court reversed the denial of unemployment benefits to Genel Altimeaux, finding the appeals referee's determination that he voluntarily quit was not based on competent, substantial evidence, as it relied solely on testimony from a prior hearing where Altimeaux could not cross-examine the witness.

Some parents in Township High School District 113 are concerned about the hiring process for a new Highland Park High School principal, specifically questioning why only two parents are on the 18-member stakeholder committee. They cite a lack of transparency and contradictory explanations for parent selection. Superintendent Christopher Dignam is using a search firm, with semi-finalists to be reviewed by him and the HR director, then narrowed to two or three finalists for the committee to interview by April 25. The passage explains the Pin and Pull run play in football, covering its definition, strengths (creating lead blockers in space and versatility), weaknesses (requiring specific personnel like quality pulling guards and a speed tailback), and differences from the Buck Sweep. GDDR6X memory on GA10x GPUs delivers up to 936 GB/sec peak bandwidth, a 52% improvement over the TU102 GPU. Jane Goodall, who died on October 1 at age 91, assembled a unique collection of chimpanzee skeletons from Gombe National Park. Her team retrieved bodies within days, cleaned the bones, and linked each skeleton to a known individual's life history. This allowed researchers to study how development influences skeletal features, unlike ancient hominid fossil studies. Goodall stated she began collecting skeletons from the start of her research, saying, "When you’re working in the field, you shouldn’t waste anything." Her refusal to waste anything as a young researcher continued to yield scientific benefits.

Trees can remove pollutants from soil, and a probiotic bacteria can enhance this process. Researchers conducted the first large-scale field experiment using poplar trees fortified with a specific microbe to clean up groundwater contaminated with trichloroethylene (TCE) at a Superfund site. After three years, inoculated trees were healthier, had reduced TCE levels, and groundwater downstream showed lower toxin levels. The method offers a cost-effective, sustainable alternative to traditional cleanup.

Russian intelligence officials repeatedly contacted Trump campaign staff, per anonymous U.S. officials. U.S. agencies were concerned but found no proof of collusion. Zircon (ZrSiO4) transforms to reidite at high pressure, with the transition pressure depending on temperature and compression conditions. This paper reports on the behavior of trace elements during shock loading of a natural zircon single crystal to 13.6 and 51.3 GPa. At 13.6 GPa, zircon retained its phase with fracturing. At 51.3 GPa, the sample transformed to textured reidite with relict zircon. Cathodoluminescence revealed bright yellow speckles in reidite, indicating REE³⁺ segregation on planar defects, which occurred without prolonged annealing. The segregation is attributed to the reconstructive phase transition mechanism.

This patent application describes a ladar transmitter system with improved scanning capabilities. Additionally, it presents a compact beam scanner assembly using an ellipsoidal conjugate reflector reimaging mirror positioned between two scannable mirrors to reduce mirror size and improve scan performance.

On average, each patient infected 2.39 others, but transmission was uneven, driven by those who stayed home rather than those in hospitals. Age was a key predictor, as the very young and very old attracted caregivers. Similar superspreading occurred in SARS and MERS outbreaks.

Monte Carlo methods are accurate for neutron transport but computationally expensive due to slow convergence. Variance reduction techniques (VRTs) improve efficiency, but most were designed for steady-state problems. Results show that combining weight windows with weight-based combing, and implicit capture with uniform combing, harms efficiency. Conversely, Cooper-Larsen weight windows with uniform combing significantly improve performance, especially with time-dependent adaptations.
