Internal emails show executive concerns about backlash, with one warning against mentioning AI. Employee protests included a conference room renaming and a letter opposing autonomous weapons. A roundtable discussion failed to ease concerns about violating Google's "Don't be evil" motto.
Eleven Ursuline High students and six adults will travel to Nicaragua from April 2-8 to assist locals with basic needs, including food, housing, and home visits, as described by school officials.
Dr Chukwuma Agubata stated that consuming Ogbono soup can improve the efficacy of Artemether anti-malaria drugs by helping the drug reach its destination in the body.

A survey found first-year pet costs range from £769 for a fish to £12,654 for a horse, with cats at £2,455 and dogs at £4,791. Nationwide Home Insurance noted record £706 million in pet insurance claims in 2016, and 7% of pet-related home insurance claims were for carpet damage.

On 9 December 2017, the Palmerston North Rescue Helicopter responded to three incidents: transferring a 31-year-old with a suspected spinal injury to Christchurch Hospital, airlifting a 57-year-old with a fractured leg from a motorbike crash to Palmerston North Hospital, and transporting an 11-year-old with a back injury from a trampoline fall to Whanganui Hospital.

This study examines the (re)construction of professional identities of language teachers in initial formation, focusing on the tension between personal and professional selves. It argues that teacher identity is complex, transitory, and negotiated through "borderland discourse," where personal ideologies and professional expectations collide. Analyzing narratives from two participants, Laura and Richard, the study finds that both experienced dissatisfaction with the gap between university theory and school practice. Laura developed a flexible, adaptive professional identity, while Richard, despite rejecting a foreign language teacher identity, significantly developed his professional identity. The study concludes that supervised internships and virtual platforms like Moodle are crucial for identity negotiation, with narratives serving as a privileged site for understanding this process.

The Consumer Financial Protection Bureau finalized rules requiring payday and auto title lenders to assess borrowers' ability to repay within 30 days and limit account debits, aiming to curb debt traps. The rules face Republican opposition and could halve industry loan volume, potentially closing many stores. The rule takes effect in 2019 and may be reversed by Congress.

Ariel Miranda pitched seven shutout innings in the Mariners' 6-1 win over the Marlins, yielding four hits, striking out five, and walking none. He was aggressive with his fastball, throwing it 63 times. Robinson Cano and Nelson Cruz hit back-to-back home runs in the first inning.

Oil prices fell as Middle East geopolitical tensions eased, with Brent crude down 1.4% to $65.07 and WTI dropping to $61.55, driven by rising U.S. inventories, slowing demand, and renewed diplomatic activity reducing supply risks.

The passage discusses quantum states of light, focusing on coherent states, their properties, and quasi-probability distributions (Q, P, and W). It covers minimum uncertainty states, photon number fluctuations, the second-order coherence function g²(τ), and comparisons of coherent, thermal, and number (Fock) states. The Hanbury Brown Twiss experiment is introduced for measuring g², and single-photon generation methods (e.g., using atoms in cavities) are briefly described.

Marine heatwaves can disrupt the ocean's biological carbon pump by altering plankton communities, causing carbon to accumulate near the surface instead of sinking to the deep sea. A study of two heatwaves in the Gulf of Alaska found that changes in plankton populations led to carbon being retained and recycled at shallower depths, reducing the ocean's ability to store carbon and potentially accelerating climate change.

Yen Bai province plans to develop hi-tech processing facilities for its agro-forestry-fishery sector, focusing on wood, tea, cinnamon, and cassava processing to improve product quality and increase export capacity.

The court dismissed eight cases because the plaintiff, former County Attorney Bill Vassar, ceased to hold office in January 1939, and his successor, Frank McVey, did not seek to continue the actions within the six-month period required by Rule 25(d) of the Federal Rules of Civil Procedure and 28 U.S.C.A. § 780.

The Austro-Hungarian government, in a note to the U.S. Embassy, stated that the enemy powers rejected its December 12 peace proposal, claiming it lacked sincerity. Austria-Hungary denies responsibility for continuing the war, asserts its aims are purely defensive, and accuses its adversaries of seeking conquest and spoliation. It declares it will fight on until a peace securing its peoples' existence and honor is achieved.

Mario Batali has surrendered daily operations of his restaurant empire after reports of sexual misconduct involving at least four women over 20 years. Batali apologized, saying the complaints match his past behavior. He will also take leave from his ABC show "The Chew."

Starbucks stock has been flat since late-2015 due to struggling comp-store sales, partly caused by its Mobile Order & Pay platform. Management reports comps are rebounding with new solutions. Limited-time drinks like the Unicorn and Frappuccino Happy Hour are expected to drive sales. Past issues with loyalty program changes and different recording methods are resolved. Starbucks has a strong dividend growth history, with a compound annual growth rate over 26%. In China, Starbucks is expanding rapidly, opening 500 stores annually, with 7% comp-store sales growth last quarter, and expects this rate to continue for decades.

The study developed the Grocery Basket Score (GBS), a model to rate shopping baskets based on their link to mortality, using NHANES dietary data and Cox proportional hazard models. The GBS uses separate food and beverage models with signals like fiber, saturated fat, sugar, sodium, and deficiencies in protein, vitamin C, and iron. Validation showed a 0.60 correlation with the Nutri-Score on single items and correlations of -0.62 and -0.60 with the AHEI (without and with moderate alcohol consumption).
Cam Newton apologized for sexist comments made at a press conference, acknowledging his words were degrading and disrespectful to women, and noting he lost sponsors and fans as a result.

The Fifth Circuit reversed the district court's dismissal of the Tates' Chapter 7 case, holding that under the plain language of 11 U.S.C. § 707(b), debtors may claim a vehicle ownership deduction even without a loan or lease payment.

This document describes the Tiered Memory Page Migration (TMPM) engine, which facilitates page migration by copying page content and updating virtual-to-physical mappings. It covers TMPM commands, statuses, parameter blocks, error handling, and firmware reload procedures for EPYC processors.

Liberty Island was evacuated after a person climbed the Statue of Liberty's base on July 4th, following the arrest of several people for hanging an "Abolish I.C.E." banner. The climber sat near the statue's robes, about 100 feet up, as police attempted to persuade them to descend. The banner group said the climber was not connected to its demonstration.

The paper presents FoodSEM, a fine-tuned open-source large language model for food named-entity linking (NEL) that links food entity mentions in text to entities from three food ontologies (FoodOn, SNOMED-CT, and Hansard taxonomy). It achieves high F1 scores, up to 98% for some ontologies, and outperforms 0-shot, 1-shot, and 5-shot prompting baselines. The model was fine-tuned using instruction-response pairs created from two annotated corpora (CafeteriaFCD and CafeteriaSA) and artificial data to balance entity distribution.

Checkr, a background check company founded in 2014, became a leading voice in the fair chance hiring movement by 2024. The company, valued at $5 billion, developed technology to help customers assess risk beyond a binary reject/accept decision for candidates with conviction records. Checkr offered tools like Candidate Stories and Assess to facilitate fair chance hiring, and its own fair chance employees had a 5% attrition rate versus 22% for the rest of the company. CEO Daniel Yanisse believed fair chance hiring was good for business but that the movement's success depended on a company's financial success.

No statistically significant differences were found between treatment groups for any secondary endpoint. The incidence of adverse events, serious adverse events, and fatal adverse events was similar between groups. Laboratory parameters and vital signs showed similar evolution. Neutralizing antibody titres increased but were not influenced by the intervention.

The TLV321x inputs and outputs have internal ESD protection. Input voltages are limited to 0.2V beyond the rails; a current-limiting resistor is recommended for low-impedance sources. The device has a Power-On Reset (POR) circuit that holds the output low for up to 32us after crossing 1.65V. The comparator output reflects the differential input after the POR period. Overdrive voltage influences propagation delay; smaller overdrive increases delay. External hysteresis can be added to prevent output chatter. The document describes inverting and non-inverting comparator configurations with hysteresis, a low-side current sensing application, and design requirements including bypass capacitors and layout considerations.

Three days ago, Iraqis voted in a landmark election. The vote marks the beginning of constitutional democracy in the Middle East and strengthens America's ally in the fight against terror. The war has been difficult, but the removal of Saddam Hussein was right. The U.S. strategy has three elements: offensive operations, building Iraqi security forces; establishing democratic institutions; and reconstruction. Withdrawal before victory would embolden terrorists and dishonor sacrifices. The U.S. is winning the war in Iraq.

Southeast Asian stock markets rebounded on Wednesday, with Indonesian shares closing 1.8% higher after a 1.4% intraday drop to a 15-month low, and Philippine shares closing over 1% higher for a fourth session. Singapore, Vietnam, and Thai stocks also rose.

An Ashford man, Michael Daniels, was jailed for five years and three months for conspiracy to steal motor vehicles worth over £200,000. As a BMW salesman, he gave spare keys and customer addresses to an accomplice, Alex Tingle, who stole nine cars. Tingle was jailed for two years. The thefts affected victims, including one who missed his daughter's birth.

Sony's "Baby Driver" surpassed $100 million domestically after seven weeks, with $67 million overseas and remaining markets including Japan, Russia, China, Italy, and South Korea. Made on a $34 million budget, it grossed $39 million in its first seven days. The film scored 94% on Rotten Tomatoes and its soundtrack reached No. 1 on iTunes. Directed by Edgar Wright, it stars Ansel Elgort, Kevin Spacey, Lily James, Jamie Foxx, Jon Bernthal, and Jon Hamm.

Jury selection is ongoing in the Isaiah Hagan murder trial, with 10 of 14 jurors chosen from a pool of about 200. A mistrial was declared earlier. The court retained a motion to exclude unfair evidence. Hagan faces four counts, including murder and robbery. The remaining jurors will be selected Thursday, with opening statements on Monday.

The passage is a comprehensive guide on ETF trading, covering definitions, history, strategies (e.g., trend following, mean reversion, momentum, sector rotation, arbitrage, high-frequency trading, quantitative trading, options, volatility, statistical arbitrage, pair trading, market-neutral, global macro, equal weight, smart beta, currency hedging, fixed income, commodities), types, pros and cons, risks, taxation, liquidity, expense ratios, and comparisons with mutual funds and stocks. It notes the first U.S. ETF (SPY) launched in 1993, and that ETFs are traded on exchanges like stocks, offering diversification and flexibility. Key strategies include swing trading and day trading, with emphasis on backtesting and diversification.

The passage describes the Tiered Memory Page Migration (TMPM) engine, which facilitates page migration operations for tiered memory systems. It covers commands for migrating pages with concurrent DMA (PM_PAGE_MOVE_IO) and for SNP guest pages (PM_PAGE_MOVE_GUEST), including pre-migration states, multi-page commands (up to 128 pages), performance guidelines, non-migratable data structures, IOMMU mapping requirements, firmware reloading, debugging, restrictions, command formats, statuses, parameter blocks, and error handling.

A girl from Bihar with drug-resistant TB was denied Bedaquiline due to government restrictions limiting its use to select cities and non-residents. Dr. Zarir Udvadia and the girl's father petitioned the Delhi High Court, which ordered the drug's administration, saving her life.

Duncan Keith discusses his focus on his own game, notes that teammate Duncan Keith works hard and competes consistently, and attributes his maturity to experience. He praises goalie Rask but hopes to score against him. Keith describes his coach as fair and even-keeled, not overdoing meetings. He notes his long friendship and on-ice chemistry with a teammate, with conversations now shifting from partying to family as they age. He says a teammate is misunderstood, has matured with a girlfriend, and that the team has grown together after early playoff exits.
Apple Inc. filed a Form 10-Q for the quarterly period ended June 27, 2020, reporting net sales of $59.7 billion and net income of $11.3 billion for the third quarter.

Count Tisza's letter states that enemy peace terms involve mutilation of Germany and dismemberment of Austria-Hungary and Turkey, contradicting President Wilson's views, and that the dual monarchy's system is the best solution for mixed-population regions. Ambassador Bernstorff's telegram conveys Germany's acceptance of President Wilson's offer for a peace conference, but refusal to publish terms due to enemy demands for destruction; it privately outlines terms, agrees to a post-war conference, justifies the submarine blockade as a response to Entente war aims, and expresses hope the U.S. will understand Germany's position.

GDDR6X memory supports speeds up to 19.5 Gbps on the GeForce RTX 3090 and 19 Gbps on the RTX 3080. The RTX A6000 and A40 use 48 GB of GDDR6 memory, scalable to 96 GB via NVLink. GA102 GPUs feature third-generation NVLink with 112.5 GB/sec total bandwidth between two GPUs. GA10x GPUs have a PCIe Gen 4 host interface, providing up to 64 GB/sec peak bandwidth. The full GA102 GPU contains seven GPCs, 42 TPCs, and 84 SMs. Each SM has 128 CUDA Cores, four third-generation Tensor Cores, and one second-generation Ray Tracing Core. The memory subsystem has twelve 32-bit memory controllers (384-bit total) with 6144 KB of L2 cache. GA10x GPUs include second-generation ray tracing technology, doubling ray/triangle intersection testing rate over Turing. Third-generation Tensor Cores support new data types including TF32 and BF16, and a Sparsity feature that doubles matrix multiplication throughput. GDDR6X uses PAM4 signaling, achieving data rates up to 19.5 Gbps. NVIDIA RTX IO enables GPU-based loading and decompression, accelerating I/O performance by up to 100x. The A40 GPU is optimized for data center applications, supporting vGPU software and the EGX Platform. GA10x GPUs support HDMI 2.1, DisplayPort 1.4a, and include a fifth-generation NVDEC for hardware-accelerated video decoding, including AV1. The seventh-generation NVENC provides hardware-accelerated video encoding.

The speaker addresses the nation after President Harrison's death, assuming the presidency under the Constitution. He outlines principles: justice toward foreign nations, military efficiency, separation of public funds from executive control, limiting patronage and removals to prevent corruption, strict economy and avoidance of debt, abolition of sinecures, enforcement of currency laws while seeking reform, and preserving the constitutional balance between federal and state powers.

The speaker reflects on the need to play physically and aggressively, contrasting a passive first game with an improved, more intense second game that felt like a Stanley Cup final. They emphasize the importance of not falling behind 2-0, the urgency of winning, and the need to maintain the same style. They note the crowd's growing support, the team's home performance, and the value of scoring from different players. They stress avoiding emotional highs and lows, preparing for a hard-fought game three, and learning from past home games.

The GBP/USD pair traded in a narrow 30-pip range after losses from hawkish Fed Chair Yellen's testimony, which boosted the dollar. Future movement may be influenced by UK jobs data, US CPI, retail sales, and industrial production. Key resistance levels are 1.2483/96, 1.2528, and 1.2550; support levels are 1.2417, 1.2400, and 1.2379.

For over a decade, the U.S. has sought detente—a relaxation of tensions with potential enemies—which requires positive actions from both sides. Arms control negotiations have been one-sided, and the U.S. must restore its defensive margin of safety. The speaker supports continued negotiation with the Soviet Union but opposes treaties like SALT II that legitimize a one-sided buildup. Soviet strategy aims to divide NATO, expand influence in the Arabian Gulf and South Asia, encircle China, and cause trouble in the Caribbean. The Kremlin seeks military superiority to force an unacceptable choice between submission or conflict. The U.S. must convince the Soviets they cannot win at war, using strength not for aggression but to defend allies and demonstrate American ideals.

Merck halted its late-stage trial of Alzheimer's drug verubecestat after an independent study found it had "virtually no chance" of working. This follows Eli Lilly's similar decision for solanezumab. Experts call the failure a substantial setback. Over 47 million people have dementia, with no new Alzheimer's drug in over a decade. The failure raises concerns about the beta amyloid theory. Merck's trial on early-stage patients continues, with results expected in February 2019.

The Oklahoma Supreme Court reversed a district court's modification of a six-month driver's license revocation to three months, holding that under 47 O.S.1971 § 755 and the precedent in *Kopczynski*, the district court lacked authority to modify the suspension length. The 1975 amendment to § 755, which allows modification in cases of extreme hardship, did not express the intent of the 1967 Legislature that enacted the original law. The suspension was affirmed, and the modification was reversed.

Vermont City Electric (VCE), a municipal utility formed in 1905, provides electricity to about 16,000 residential and 3,629 commercial accounts. Due to the 2008 economic downturn, VCE must cut spending on its demand-side management (DSM) programs from over $1 million to at most $800,000. The case presents data on VCE's power supply sources, load duration curves, and nine DSM programs, and tasks the reader with building a mixed-integer optimization model to determine which DSM programs to retain and the carbon impact of the strategy.

The System MMU remaps C674x DSP accesses to physical addresses, protecting ARM memory and enabling direct buffer allocation. EDMA TC0 and TC1 can optionally use the system MMU. The HDVICP2 is a video codec accelerator supporting MPEG1/2/4, H.264, VC-1, RV9/10, AVS-1.0, and ON2 VP6.2/VP7. The Face Detection module processes QVGA 8-bit luma images, detecting faces of 20-40 pixels. The Spinlock module provides 128 hardware semaphores. The Mailbox module enables communication between ARM, DSP, and Media Controller with four interrupts. A unified memory map is used across bus masters. The TILER provides an additional 4-GB address range for HDVPSS and ISS. Boot mode is determined by BTMODE[15:0] pin states at reset. Pin multiplexing is controlled by PINCNTL registers.

The professor introduces the course on Effective Field Theory (EFT), covering prerequisites, grading (five problem sets and a presentation), and the course structure: the first half on EFT ideas and the second half on soft-collinear effective theory. EFT allows focusing on specific physics scales by expanding a general theory (like quantum field theory) to simplify calculations while retaining precision. Key steps in developing an EFT are identifying relevant degrees of freedom, symmetries, and expansion parameters (power counting). EFTs are used top-down (from a known high-energy theory) or bottom-up (constructing from low-energy symmetries). The standard model is presented as a bottom-up EFT, with higher-dimensional operators representing unknown high-energy physics. Renormalizability in EFT is defined order-by-order in the expansion parameter.

The MHT CET 2018 exam pattern and syllabus circular was released by DTE Maharashtra. The exam, for admission to engineering, pharmacy, and pharma-D courses, will have 20% weightage from Class XI and 80% from Class XII. There is no negative marking, and the difficulty level will be at par with JEE.

The speaker states the team does not rely on fan support for success, focuses on winning over individual minutes, and emphasizes the team's emotional drive and rivalry for the Stanley Cup. They describe the team as "sore losers" who hate losing, with everyone needing to sacrifice for wins. The speaker acknowledges the opponent was sharper and deserved to win, as the team must earn every victory.

This application is a continuation of several earlier U.S. and international patent applications, claiming priority to U.S. provisional applications from 2015. The background describes WLAN infrastructure, including BSS mode with an AP and STAs, and discusses VHT WLANs, channel aggregation, and the IEEE 802.11ac group ID concept for DL MU-MIMO. The summary describes a WTRU configured to receive and decode a frame, determine if it is an NDP MU MAC PPDU based on an NDP condition, and if so, process the NDP SIG field, generate a response based on the MU control information, and transmit the response.

Xenon Pharmaceuticals held an investor webinar on its Nav1.7 and Kv7 pain treatment programs, moderated by President and CEO Ian Mortimer, who provided a corporate overview and introduced speakers including Jim Empfield, JP Gilbert, and Chris Kenney.

Xiaomi will launch the Mi 8, Mi 8 SE, and Mi Band 3 at an event in Shenzhen, China. The Mi 8 is expected to have a Snapdragon 845 SoC, 4/8 GB RAM, 64 GB storage, 6.2-inch display, dual rear cameras, and an under-display fingerprint sensor. The Mi 8 SE will have 6 GB RAM and 64/128/256 GB storage. The Mi Band 3 will have a touchscreen and gesture controls.

A defense attorney for Quinton Tellis, charged with killing Jessica Chambers, filed a motion alleging District Attorney John Champion sought false testimony from an unrelated defendant, Jalen Asir Matthews Caudle, in exchange for leniency. The motion asks that Champion be removed from the case and punished, and that the September retrial be delayed.
James Patterson increased his annual donations for classroom libraries from $1.75 million to $2 million, distributing 4,000 gifts of $500 each to teachers through Scholastic Inc.

The author, on a 10-day road trip with family, confesses several weather-climate related thoughts. Visiting National Parks, they wondered if weather forecasts should convey uncertainty like the National Park Service does for Old Faithful eruptions. They note people often ignore warnings, such as approaching bison or driving through flooded roads, due to poor risk assessment and optimism bias. At Glacier National Park, they felt despair seeing the shrinking Jackson Glacier, and later felt frustrated when a woman dismissed climate change as fake news based on a cold night.

The passage explains the Draw play in football: a run play disguised as a pass to exploit defenses expecting a pass. It details strengths (effective in pass-heavy offenses or obvious passing situations), weaknesses (vulnerable to blitzes), and specific blocking assignments against 3-4 Odd and 4-3 Even fronts. Variations include QB Draw and Lead Draw.

Westman reported that recent Allied reverses strengthened Finnish confidence in German success against Russia, though anxiety remained about German exhaustion by fall. Mannerheim was struggling to decide on military strategy. Finns had miscalculated their war, expecting it to be short, victorious, and ignored by Britain. The Finnish Minister discussed strained US-Finland relations, acknowledging Finland's alliance with Germany made a separate war with Russia untenable. The Finnish press suppressed President Roosevelt's statements, contrasting with coverage of Churchill. Food shortages persisted as icebound Baltic ports delayed grain shipments, forcing Finland to requisition seed reserves.

A study of 130 Moroccan teachers who stopped using technology after the pandemic found that barriers to sustained ICT use, such as lack of devices, connectivity, training, and institutional support, are attributed to leadership factors rather than teacher demographics. The study concludes that education leaders must play a greater role in sustaining technology integration.

A Houston high school heavily damaged by Hurricane Harvey reopened after over six months of repairs, which included replacing flooring, walls, doors, and adding security upgrades, a new gym, theater, and pool. All 2,782 students were temporarily relocated to another school.

Bilayer CrI2 is a platform for stacking-controlled magnetism. The BA′ stacking is the ground state. Intralayer exchange dominates the energy scale, stacking symmetry selects anisotropic couplings, and weak interlayer exchange provides secondary tunability. Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interactions emerge only in inversion-breaking stackings. Stacking controls in-plane polarization (up to ~10 µC/cm²).

Ian Murray, 74, pleaded guilty to driving without due care and attention after colliding with a cyclist on May 14, leaving the cyclist injured and fearing a broken neck. He was fined £185, ordered to pay £85 costs and a £30 surcharge, and received six penalty points.

The passage outlines defensive and offensive strategies to neutralize a star player, including pass denial, influencing the ball away, attacking offensively to force defensive exertion, and using combination defenses.

A Hylian Shield-themed New Nintendo 2DS XL will launch exclusively at GameStop on July 2 for $159.99. It is a streamlined version of the New Nintendo 3DS XL, lacking the autostereoscopic display but including a faster processor and amiibo support. It comes pre-loaded with "A Link Between Worlds" and plays 3DS and DS games. Nintendo has sold 72 million 3DS family units globally, but its future is uncertain alongside the Switch, which sold nearly 18 million units last fiscal year.

Marsha Jackson, new Head of Internal Audit for RiseEngineer, must ensure FCPA compliance and internal controls. An anonymous tipster claimed misconduct in a major Elysium contract win. Fact-finding revealed: RiseEngineer's $1.2 billion bid was accepted; managers shared meals and gifts with Elysium officials; officials toured Boston with families; $100 million was wired monthly, with $90 million transferred to headquarters; $3 million was wired to a local consultant; $5 million was withdrawn in cash with poor documentation; and an email showed discomfort about the process. The Elysium subsidiary prioritizes profitability, has uncapped sales commissions, and weak financial controls, including undocumented cash withdrawals and transfers.

Soccer players specialize in positions within a formation, starting with general terms (Goalkeeper, Defenders, Midfielders, Forwards) and progressing to specific names. The goalkeeper has handling privileges in the penalty area. Defenders stop attacks, midfielders link defense and attack, and forwards create scoring opportunities. Specific names vary by formation, such as center backs, sweepers, attacking midfielders, and strikers. Coaches must choose and consistently use position names.

Monitoring software should automatically discover and monitor all applications, requiring a standardized interface. However, applications use diverse interfaces. Monitoring solutions use plugins to adapt these formats. The adapter pattern separates the application container from the monitoring adapter container, enabling independent updates, reuse, and dedicated resources.

The passage describes a Python-based backtest of a Bollinger Band trading strategy, covering data download, indicator calculation, trading rules, return computation, and result plotting. The strategy compounded at 2.65% annually while invested 10.6% of the time.

The Williams Vix Fix indicator, created by Larry Williams in 2007, is a synthetic VIX calculated as (Highest(Close,22) – Low) / (Highest(Close,22)) * 100. The passage discusses pseudospin models for two organic crystals, APHTZ and MPHTZ, which exhibit ferroelectric (FE) and antiferroelectric (AFE) ordering. APHTZ is a canted ferroelectric with FE ordering along the a-axis and AFE ordering along the b-axis, while MPHTZ is a uniaxial AFE. The models use Ising pseudospins to represent proton positions and associated dipoles, employing mean-field approximation. For APHTZ, the model predicts a second-order phase transition, a tricritical point, and double hysteresis loops for a transverse field. For MPHTZ, the model reproduces classical AFE switching with double hysteresis loops. The authors note a lack of experimental data limits parameter fitting, making predictions for APHTZ mostly qualitative.

Three-dimensional (3D) imaging has transformed biomedical sciences by improving visualization of complex biological systems. Traditional 2D microscopy limits spatial context, while 3D techniques like confocal and light-sheet microscopy offer better structural and functional information. However, scanning methods create a trade-off between imaging speed and signal-to-noise ratio. Light-field imaging captures a complete 3D scene in a single snapshot by recording both spatial positions and directional components of light rays, eliminating the need for scanning. Its theoretical foundations date back over a century to integral photography and the concept of the light field. This review focuses on light-field imaging applications in biomedical sciences, outlining its operating principles, key implementations, contributions, current challenges, and future research directions.

This application is a continuation of U.S. patent application Ser. No. 16/371,056, which claims priority to U.S. Provisional Patent Application No. 62/651,137. The invention relates to a configurable computing architecture for high-performance, energy-efficient computation, featuring a multi-threaded, coarse-grained configurable circuit capable of self-scheduling, dynamic self-configuration, conditional branching, and ordered thread execution. The configurable circuit includes a configurable computation circuit, synchronous network inputs and outputs, and a configuration memory with a first instruction memory for data path instructions and a second instruction and instruction index memory for spoke instructions and instruction indices. The system may include an array of such circuits coupled to synchronous and asynchronous networks.

A Lewisville mother earns money as a mystery shopper. The FDA approved Contrave for obese or overweight individuals with a BMI of 27 or higher and serious conditions. Studies show patients taking Contrave with diet and exercise lost two to four times more weight than those who only dieted and exercised. However, Consumer Reports analysis found the drug's additional weight loss is small (five to nine pounds more over 56 weeks) and poses serious health risks, including anxiety, insomnia, headaches, liver damage, seizures, and heart risks. Consumer Reports advises speaking with a doctor and recommends safer weight loss through diet, exercise, or intensive behavioral programs.

The IOMUX manages digital IO peripheral function selection, output driver, input path, and wake-up logic. A serial wire debug (SWD) two-wire interface is provided. The boot strap loader (BSL) enables device configuration and memory programming via UART or I2C, protected by a 256-bit password. A memory-mapped FACTORY region provides read-only device data and trim information. TI recommends specific decoupling capacitors, a pullup resistor for NRST, a resistor for SYSOSC FCL, a tank capacitor for VCORE, and pullup resistors for 5V-tolerant open drain IOs. Device prefixes indicate development stage (X for experimental, MSP for production).

Penn State and USC meet for the 10th time, with USC leading 5-4. The Pac-12 leads the Rose Bowl all-time 49-43-3 against the Big Ten. The 1923 Rose Bowl was the first at the current stadium, featuring Penn State and USC. Hugo Bezdek coached Penn State in 1923 and two other teams in prior Rose Bowls. Seven quarterbacks have played in both the Rose Bowl and Super Bowl. Penn State has allowed the two highest passing yardage performances in Rose Bowl history. Since 1952, 20 players have rushed for 150 yards in the Rose Bowl, but only seven play-by-play broadcasters have called the game. USC has played in the Rose Bowl under every U.S. president since 1929. Penn State ties Pittsburgh for most Rose Bowl appearances by a Pennsylvania team. Penn State is 14-11 all-time against California schools.

Facebook released its Community Guidelines, detailing content removal rules based on principles of safety, voice, and equity. The document is a manual for moderators, with specific examples like crisis actor allegations and infant shaking, reflecting compromises from past events and internal policy meetings.

Point72 Europe London LLP bought 10,000 Hershey shares worth about $1,074,000 in Q2. Other funds also adjusted HSY positions. Analysts have a consensus "Hold" rating with a $111.55 target. Insiders sold shares, and the company reported Q2 EPS of $1.09, beating estimates.

The passage reports on the synthesis and characterization of YbCu1.14Se2, a triangular lattice magnet with site disorder. The compound shows no magnetic ordering, sub-linear specific heat, and a frequency-dependent freezing transition at 0.1 K in AC susceptibility, behavior similar to the disordered quantum spin liquid candidate YbMgGaO4.

A 92-year-old woman, Anna Mae Blessing, was arrested on suspicion of murder for fatally shooting her 72-year-old son over his plans to place her in an assisted living facility. She is held on US$500,000 bail. She told detectives she hid two handguns in her robe, confronted her son, and shot him multiple times. She also said she intended to kill herself afterward.

The passage announces the Bridgestone Youth Leadership Award winner, Robert 'Knobby' Knudsen, posthumously awarded for his community work with children in Windsor. His son and grandson accept the award. It also announces the three finalists for the Mark Messier Leadership Award: Dustin Brown, Shane Doan, and Ryan Callahan, recognizing their on-ice leadership and community work. Mark Messier then discusses the difficulty of playoff hockey, the importance of depth, and the New York Rangers' progress.

The speaker expresses gratitude for being elected, acknowledges the task's difficulty, and calls for national unity, respect for majority rule and minority rights, and adherence to principles like equal justice, peace, limited government, and civil liberties.

Christian Bushman credits CPR with saving her life after a 2014 accident caused cardiac arrest. Her sister-in-law, a CPR instructor, performed CPR until she revived. 70% of out-of-hospital cardiac arrests occur at home. A study notes women are less likely than men to receive bystander CPR.

Torsten Sløk, chief economist at Apollo, stated the U.S. economy is accelerating, not faltering, and that the economics profession has been repeatedly wrong about an imminent slowdown. He noted the consensus has forecast a slowdown for nine months, but it has not happened. Sløk warned that strong growth combined with Fed rate cuts could rekindle inflation.

The passage introduces a class of bivariate zero-inflated Poisson (BZIP) models using a common inflation factor and comonotonic or counter-monotonic shocks to allow for positive or negative dependence. It details the model's construction, dependence structure, estimation methods (method of moments, maximum likelihood, EM algorithm), and presents simulation results and a real data illustration on Australian environmental disasters.

National Literacy Month highlights the need to address the literacy gap, which is an urgent crisis. Programs like Read Lead Freedom Schools and Partnership for Growth LA show success, with students seeing a 14.5-point increase in English proficiency and chronic absenteeism dropping from 47% to 5%. However, funding cuts threaten these programs. Literacy is foundational for thriving communities, and sustained support for local initiatives is needed.

The President announces the government's relocation to the permanent seat, congratulates Congress, and discusses the District of Columbia's governance. He notes the discharge of the temporary army, recommends judicial system improvements, reports treaties with Prussia and ongoing negotiations with Great Britain and France, and advocates for naval defense and fortifications. He highlights increased revenue and urges preservation of national institutions.

Beatrice Fihn, executive director of ICAN, warned that a "moment of panic" could cause nuclear destruction of cities and millions of deaths, referencing escalating rhetoric between U.S. President Donald Trump and North Korean dictator Kim Jong Un, including personal insults and threats. She noted the risk of nuclear weapons use is greater than during the Cold War due to more nuclear states, terrorists, and cyber warfare.

Sell US$INR in 68.20-68.30 range, target 67.95/67.75, stop loss 68.40. Government bond yields fell 1.25% in 2025. Rupee posted sixth straight annual loss. Dollar-rupee January contract ended at 68.09.

The ADS7828 can use an internal 2.5V or external reference. A +5V supply requires an external +5V reference for full range; a +2.7V supply uses the internal 2.5V reference. Lowering the reference voltage reduces the LSB size (reference voltage divided by 4096), making offset, gain, and noise errors appear larger. With a 2.5V reference, internal noise contributes 0.32LSB error; with a 50mV reference, it contributes 16LSBs.

The Ministry of Health and Child Care estimates 44,586 sex workers aged 15-49 in Zimbabwe, with nearly 7,000 in Bulawayo. Their HIV prevalence is 55%, versus the 13% national average. Estimates for female sex workers were done in Bulawayo, Harare, Shamva, and Mazowe. HIV prevalence varies by site, with small towns highest. Approximately 25,900 people died of AIDS-related causes in 2016, a decrease from 2005. A parliamentarian warned that ignoring key populations may hinder ending HIV by 2030.

Gas prices in Montgomery rose over 4 cents to $2.18 per gallon, while the national average hit $2.40, the highest since 2015. Analysts attribute the increase to declining oil inventories and geopolitical tensions, with predictions of further rises through summer due to increased demand and potential OPEC production cuts.

GoSun launched the Fusion, a solar-electric oven that allows cooking without fuel anytime, anywhere, using solar energy and an electric heating element. It is portable (10 lbs), feeds five people, and is more efficient than a typical oven. A Kickstarter campaign has been launched for the product.

The lecture discusses extending temporal difference (TD) learning from discrete Markov chains to continuous state spaces using linear function approximation. It covers least squares function approximation, where functions are linear in parameters but can represent nonlinear functions via basis sets like radial basis functions or barycentric interpolators. The TD(λ) algorithm is adapted for linear function approximators by replacing eligibility traces on discrete states with traces on parameter vector α, using the gradient of the value estimate. The lecture also introduces Least Squares Temporal Difference (LSTD) learning, which collects data in batch form to solve for α directly, improving data efficiency and eliminating learning rate tuning.

AAA Nevada Insurance Company's motion for summary judgment was granted. The court held that AAA's liability under the insurance policy is fixed at $100,000.00, and its failure to settle within the time limit set by the interveners did not constitute bad faith under Nevada law.

The High Contracting Parties agree to a mutual guarantee of territorial integrity and political independence under republican governments. They covenant to settle boundary disputes amicably or by arbitration, and to submit unresolved questions to an international commission before hostilities. They also agree to prevent hostile military expeditions and arms exports to insurgents, unless belligerency is recognized. The treaty requires ratification, takes effect 60 days after deposit, continues indefinitely, and allows denunciation with one year's notice to the U.S. Government.

The passage discusses essay writing challenges and services, advising students to choose interesting topics, edit their work, and consider using professional writers for high-quality results. It emphasizes the importance of reliable sources, formal tone, and avoiding common mistakes like restating the thesis or introducing new information in conclusions.

Most Southeast Asian stock markets edged lower on Monday ahead of the U.S. Federal Reserve's policy meeting. Thai shares fell the most, led by energy stocks. Singapore and Indonesian shares also declined. Philippine shares recovered from early losses to close marginally lower. Malaysian shares rose slightly, and Vietnam shares gained for a sixth straight session.

The passage defines the Trap play in football, a quick-hitting run scheme that kicks out an interior defensive lineman, and lists its strengths (quick-hitting, forgiving for offensive line personnel) and weaknesses (difficult against defenses squeezing interior gaps). It then details specific blocking assignments for the play against 3-4 Odd and 4-3 Even fronts, and describes two variations: Gun Trey Same-Side Trap RPO and Wing-T Trap.

The speaker addresses Congress and the nation, reviewing foreign policy and requesting emergency military and humanitarian aid for South Vietnam and Cambodia. He calls for lifting the arms embargo on Turkey, amending the Trade Act regarding OPEC nations and Soviet emigration, and supporting defense and intelligence services. He emphasizes maintaining alliances, strategic arms control, and U.S. leadership on global issues like energy and food.
Hillview Middle School hosts an outdoor family movie night on April 27 at 7:30 pm, featuring the PG-rated film "Sing." One adult per eight children is required. Proceeds benefit LLS and JDRF.

The passage describes the AGESA™ software interface for host BIOS environments, covering binary module execution in 32-bit protected mode, bridge and dispatcher call mechanisms, UEFI build phases (SEC, PEI, DXE, RTP), memory initialization procedures, event logging, and platform configuration options. It details entry points (AmdInitReset, AmdInitEarly, AmdInitPost, AmdInitEnv, AmdInitLate, AmdInitRtb) and resume routines (AmdInitResume, AmdInitRecovery, AmdInitS3LateRestore), along with required call-out procedures, stack setup macros, and build environment variables.

A retired criminologist's 1995 study estimating 2.2 million annual defensive gun uses (DGU) was confirmed by three unpublished CDC studies from 1996-1998, which found 2.46 million annual DGU. The CDC never reported these results, likely due to the Clinton administration's gun control agenda. This confirms that guns are used defensively 3.6 times more often than offensively.

A review of a new study by Andrew Masterson highlights that evidence for biodegradable plastic bags being environmentally helpful is lacking. The study, led by Jesse Harrison, found research on biodegradable bags is inconsistent and poorly defined, making it useless for informing policy.

Kinder Morgan rose 15 cents after Canada agreed to buy a pipeline project. Bank of America fell $1.20 as bond prices rose. Petrobras fell 69 cents after Brazil subsidized diesel cuts. ZTO Express rose $1.52 on Alibaba's stake purchase. Booz Allen rose $2.23 on higher profit. American Woodmark rose $13.05 after a strong report. KB Home rose 43 cents on rising home prices. American Water Works rose 93 cents as bond yields dropped.

Mitsui & Co reported a 64% rise in April-December net profit to 376.8 billion yen and raised its full-year forecast to a record 440 billion yen, driven by higher iron ore and coking coal prices. Itochu Corp posted a 19% profit increase to 357.1 billion yen but kept its forecast unchanged at 400 billion yen. Sojitz Corp raised its net profit forecast by 12% to 56 billion yen due to higher coal prices.

On April 9, the author and his wife waited over six hours at Norfolk General Hospital's emergency ward, seeing a doctor at 11:45 p.m. He blames bureaucrats, not doctors or nurses, for long wait times and argues that doctors should have authority to call in extra help. The passage also includes a separate letter criticizing election-time funding for long-term care beds and medication fees for seniors.

This patent application describes systems and methods for dynamically overlaying video. A client device identifies a set-top box and uses a template to present replacement video content alongside information from the set-top box, mimicking the original video's presentation. The replacement video is selected by matching a fingerprint of the original video to a database of known fingerprints.

The speaker believes winning the next game could shift the series' momentum, citing energy from returning veteran players and a rookie's standout performance. They note the team lacked momentum in previous games but finally secured a win, keeping them alive. The speaker praises a veteran's legacy and composure, hopes for more scoring, and acknowledges the opponent's strong penalty kill and pressure. The season depends on ending a losing streak.

KDKA-TV and WPXI-TV falsely reported that Antwon Rose II was seen on video firing a gun and had gunshot residue on his hands. The reports were later corrected by authorities. KDKA retracted and apologized, while WPXI initially defended its reporting before issuing a written apology. WTAE-TV did not report the false information.

Costa, the second largest coffee chain globally, has driven a coffee boom in Britain with sales rising 37% to £3.4 billion in 2016. Its new Basildon roastery quadruples roasting capacity to 45,000 tonnes annually, using robots and sustainable features. The facility includes a lab where beans are tested, and a Master of Coffee with a £10 million insured tongue ensures quality. Costa plans for 30 years of expansion.

The passage discusses multi-stakeholder engagement in supply chains, using palm oil as a case study. It covers the roles of various stakeholders (e.g., growers, mills, corporations, NGOs, governments, farmers, investors) and strategies for sustainability, including certification (RSPO, ISPO), collaboration with NGOs like Greenpeace and the Forest Trust, and challenges like transparency, cost burdens on small farmers, and communication. The class explores different approaches to marketing, certification, and stakeholder engagement, concluding with examples of company-NGO partnerships and industry collaborations.

YouTube announced four new YouTube Red Original series for the YouTube Kids app, debuting in spring 2017. The series feature DanTDM, TheAtlanticCraft, L2M, and Fruit Ninja, marking YouTube Red's first investment in family-oriented original programming. The app will also be available on LG and Samsung Smart TVs.

The Kiss of Death is a sell signal in the S&P 500 that triggers when the index drops from an all-time high, falls below its monthly 21-EMA, bounces back above it, and then drops below its recent low. It has triggered in 1969, 1973, 1978, 2001, and 2008, anticipating major bear markets, but also generated a false signal in September 2022. The trading strategy involves selling on the signal and buying back when the S&P 500 closes above its 10-month EMA. A backtest from 1967 showed improved performance over buy-and-hold, with higher CAGR and reduced maximum drawdown.

Fair Isaac announced a new pricing model allowing mortgage lenders to bypass credit bureaus for FICO scores, causing its stock to surge over 20%. Shares of Experian, TransUnion, and Equifax fell as investors saw the move potentially reducing the role of credit reporting agencies.

The MSPM0C1105/6 MCUs are part of the ultra-low-power 32-bit MSPM0 family, based on an Arm Cortex-M0+ core at up to 32MHz. They operate from -40°C to 125°C and 1.62V to 3.6V, with up to 64KB flash and 8KB SRAM. Features include a high-speed oscillator, 3-channel DMA, CRC-16, a 12-bit 1.6Msps ADC, comparator, temperature sensor, timers, and communication peripherals (UART, SPI, I2C) supporting various protocols. The platform combines the Cortex-M0+ with an ultra-low-power architecture to increase performance while reducing energy consumption.

Pekkala stated that most Finns sympathized with the democracies and believed Finland must make a separate peace with the USSR, a view shared by Mannerheim, the Army, and several political parties except the Agrarian Party. He expressed lack of confidence in President Ryti and never discussed matters with Foreign Minister Witting. Witting, when confronted, noted Finland’s 93% import dependence on Germany and compared Finland’s position to a mouse in a trap, showing little inclination to break German influence. From Sweden, reports indicate Finland’s military situation is deteriorating, and a Russian advance could cause a political crisis in Sweden, potentially empowering pro-German groups. Soviet Minister Kollontay privately expressed concern and advocated for a simple cessation of fighting.
An immaterial error overstated the Supercharger network's net book value in Tesla's 2015 Form 10-K; the correct value as of December 31, 2015, is $166.6 million.

A molecular sensor that releases a thyme-like flavor when detecting influenza has been developed, offering a taste-based alternative to nasal swabs. This low-tech method could enable rapid, accessible flu screening before symptoms appear, addressing shortcomings of current tests that are slow, costly, or miss early infections.

Four candidates for Baltimore County executive spoke at a forum, opposing impact fees, supporting smoother approval processes, and calling for predictable rezoning based on the master plan. Most praised development's role in the economy, while one criticized "pay-to-play politics."

The nomination phase for the Harrogate Advertiser Business Awards is open, with a March 13 deadline. The ceremony will be held at the Royal Hall on April 27, a restored Edwardian theatre. The awards have 10 categories, and businesses may enter multiple categories.

Robert Oscar Lopez, a former tenured professor at California State University, Northridge, now argues that academic freedom is not a virtue or a reality, but a lie stemming from a corrupted tenure system that protects only favored views. He advocates cutting funding to colleges, promoting trade schools, and replacing academic freedom with a principle of teaching truth, as academia has become a political racket producing dysfunctional graduates.

The passage examines the first trading day of the month effect in the S&P 500. The average gain on the first trading day is 0.24%, six times the average daily gain of 0.04%. However, the strategy of simply buying at the close of the last trading day of the month and selling at the close of the first day is considered too unstable and unreliable to be traded. Adding a filter improves the strategy, reducing trades by one third and increasing the average gain per trade to 0.35%.

Bilateral trade involves a seller and a buyer with private valuations. This work studies profit maximization for a broker in repeated bilateral trade via online learning, aiming to minimize regret against the best mechanism in hindsight. In the stochastic i.i.d. setting, a polynomial-time algorithm achieves ˜O(√T) regret, which is optimal up to poly-logarithmic terms. In the adversarial setting, no learning algorithm can achieve sublinear regret with respect to a 2/3 + ε fraction of optimal profit. The results also improve the regret bound for the joint ads problem to ˜O(√T).
The passage describes multiple views of a cooling fan design, noting that broken lines indicate unclaimed portions.

Mediation analysis in psychological research identifies causal pathways between interventions and outcomes. Structural equation modeling (SEM) is standard for latent variables but assumes no unmeasured confounding. Rank-preserving models (RPMs) relax this assumption but lack latent variable extensions. The authors introduce RAPSEM, integrating RPM with factor score regression to enable robust mediation analysis with measurement error and omitted confounders.

The speaker reflects on their team's confidence and performance, highlighting a goalie's resilience, a player's skill and leadership, power play dynamics, and the importance of game plans and handling adversity. They note the team's growth, tradition, and belief they can improve to take over the series.

The speaker reflects on their team's season, attributing their success to hard work and fun. They praise a fearless player who blocks shots and inspires teammates. They note the different feeling of rest and media hype before games. They agree that a defenseman, though not flashy, is smooth and deserving of a top defenseman nomination.

A study in Denan district, Ethiopia, found a 9.63% sero-prevalence of visceral leishmaniasis (VL) among 187 participants. Risk factors included age 19-36, damp floors, outdoor sleeping, and sleeping near animal shelters. Of 823 sand flies collected, 12 species were identified, including the VL vector *P. orientalis*.

Transformer-based LLMs are studied for their ability to learn transitive reasoning from training examples, specifically through graph connectivity tasks on grid graphs and disconnected chain graphs. Transformers perform well on grid graphs, where connectivity can be inferred from low-dimensional node embeddings, but struggle on disconnected chain graphs. Scaling model size improves performance on grid graphs but not on chain graphs, while scaling graph size benefits both, especially for higher-dimensional grids and chain graphs with many components.

Hawkin's Bazaar in Plymouth will close permanently on February 4, with a closing down sale offering at least 50% off, and up to 75% off some items. The store had been on New George Street for four years, and previously in the West End for six years.

Cincinnati beat No. 14 Iowa State 31-7, handing the Cyclones their first loss. The Bearcats scored 17 points in the first quarter and led 31-7 at halftime. Iowa State rallied to within eight points but failed to recover an onside kick.

The North Carolina Supreme Court ordered a new trial for Roy Allen Whisnant, ruling that the trial court erred by forcing him to trial the day after he changed his plea to not guilty and requested time to obtain witnesses, as he was not given adequate time to prepare his defense.

MADSEN Cycles offers a uniquely designed bucket bike that can carry up to four kids plus cargo, along with a wide range of accessories to improve comfort, security, style, and functionality. Accessories include removable bench seats with seat belts, rain covers, front racks, and a middle bucket seat. The company manufactures customized, brightly colored bicycles with large rear buckets.

Jerome Powell, a Republican former investment banker, becomes Fed chair on Monday, succeeding Janet Yellen. He faces potential difficult decisions on interest rate hikes amid strong U.S. economic growth, low unemployment, and synchronized global expansion. Yellen leaves a "normalized" policy environment after gradual rate increases and reducing the Fed's bond holdings. The first 2018 rate hike is expected in March, with debate over the pace of future increases due to inflation and tax cut impacts.

The Supreme Court will hear oral arguments on Oct. 7 in a case concerning whether Section 924(j) creates a separate crime from Section 924(c) under the double jeopardy clause. The case involves a defendant convicted under both sections for a single criminal event. The test from *Blockburger v. United States* determines if multiple punishments are allowed by comparing the elements of each offense. The government and defendant agree separate sentences are not permitted, but an amicus argues Section 924(c)(1)(D)(ii) mandates consecutive sentences, overcoming the *Blockburger* presumption. The court will decide if Congress intended to authorize separate convictions under both sections.

Assessment in vocational education is complex, requiring teacher-student participation and immediate feedback. It involves formative methods like self-assessment and peer reviews, and competence-based education (CBE) linking theory to workplace skills. Authentic assessment balances reliability with real-world context, while a comprehensive program includes written tests, technical skills, and workplace evaluations.

The Second Circuit affirmed the district court's grant of summary judgment to Reisdorf Brothers on the plaintiffs' Clean Water Act and Resource Conservation and Recovery Act claims, and the dismissal of state law claims without prejudice. The court also affirmed the denial of attorney's fees to the defendant.

This study used multi-state modeling on PREVEND cohort data to estimate age- and sex-specific transition rates between KDIGO risk stages and their association with new-onset heart failure (HF). Forward transition rates increased with age and were higher in men. More advanced KDIGO stages were associated with increased HF risk, with relative risk decreasing with age but absolute risk increasing with age.

Phil Kessel scored twice, Evgeni Malkin added two goals and two assists, and the Pittsburgh Penguins defeated the Washington Capitals 7-4. The Penguins won their fourth straight game, pulling within four points of first-place Washington. Alex Ovechkin scored twice for the Capitals.

The passage discusses accessing Australian financial markets via ETFs, ADRs, direct stock trading, and CFDs. It notes that backtesting reveals profitable Australian trading strategies, but mean reversion strategies are less effective due to the market's commodity exposure. Seasonal strategies, like the Santa Claus effect, show strong results. The Australian Securities Exchange (ASX) and Sydney Stock Exchange (SSX) are the main exchanges, with trading hours from 10:00 am to 4:00 pm AEDT (GMT+11:00). Australian pairs can be traded against major currencies.

This study developed a 36-item, two-factor scale ("Necessity and Usefulness" and "Feasibility") to measure prospective teachers' attitudes towards values education through distance education, with a total variance of 63.286% and Cronbach Alpha coefficients of .969 and .961 for the two factors.

The DPC board authorized its management to issue a termination notice to MSEB, with six votes in favor and one against. MSEB made a protest payment of Rs 134 crore. International lenders supported termination, while domestic lenders opposed it. The Centre's liability if terminated would be one year's electricity bill and a $300 million fee. The state government planned to form a committee to renegotiate the PPA.

Las Vegas gunman Stephen Paddock purchased 1,000 tracer rounds from a private buyer at a Phoenix gun show, which can improve firing accuracy in the dark. It is unclear if he fired them during the attack that killed 58 and injured nearly 500. He also booked rooms overlooking other festivals, and investigators are exploring possible additional planned attacks, including a car bombing.

Defending a talented tall post player requires team effort, including active pressure on the passer, backside help, and post traps. Key individual tactics involve beating the post to the block, pushing them off the block, fronting the passing lane, and influencing the ball away from their strong side. Team strategies include full-court pressing, a 2-3 zone with adjustments, and a Diamond & One combination defense.

Amazon.com, Inc. filed a Form 10-Q for the quarterly period ended June 30, 2017, reporting net income of $197 million for the quarter and $921 million for the six-month period, with total net sales of $37.96 billion and $73.67 billion, respectively.

Justice Babatunde Quadri of the Federal High Court, Abuja, admitted evidence from the EFCC against Li Ya Ping, a Chinese national charged with concealing $300,000 while attempting to board a flight to Dubai. The EFCC's fourth witness, Hassan Mohammed Misau, testified that the Nigerian Customs Service arrested the defendant on March 15, 2018, at Nnamdi Azikwe International Airport, and handed over evidence including the cash, a passport, and boarding passes.
The Ryan Raiders host the Aledo Bearcats in a Texas high school football game. Aledo leads 2-0 after a safety. Aledo is ranked in the SN Top 25 and No. 16 in Massey Ratings. Ryan is unranked.

The passage details archival sources for U.S. foreign policy toward the Soviet Union (1983–1985), including Reagan Library files, NSC records, and State Department lot files. It also outlines the evolution of covert action management from the Truman presidency, beginning with NSC 4–A (1947) and superseded by NSC 10/2 (1948), which expanded CIA operations to covert activities with plausible deniability.

Children of obese women have double the obesity risk by age two, and paternal obesity is also strongly linked. Egg and sperm cells carry molecules, like non-coding RNAs, that respond to parental nutrition and shape offspring obesity risk. Maternal BMI at conception is key, and having two obese parents doubles the child's risk again. Egg mitochondria from obese females are defective, increasing offspring's lifelong obesity susceptibility. However, lifestyle changes like diet and exercise can improve egg and sperm quality, potentially stopping obesity transmission.

The VentureWire newsletter from October 19, 2000, reports on venture capital and private company news, including St. Paul Venture Capital closing a $1.3 billion fund, Idealab! postponing its IPO, Constellation Ventures closing a $350 million fund, and New Edge Networks securing $140 million in funding. It also lists numerous other funding rounds, new products, deals, M&A, board appointments, and personnel changes.

The passage provides troubleshooting for an MP3 player (e.g., unplayable songs, firmware updates, CD copying, file formats, and ID3 tags), followed by service and warranty information, a user notice on WM-DRM, and an end user license agreement for the software.

The speaker reflects on a game where the opponent had more scoring chances despite a low shot total, and their team failed to build on an early lead. The opponent gained momentum in the second period, and the speaker notes that the first game of a series against a team from another conference often involves a feeling-out process.
Novo Nordisk will buy Akero Therapeutics, a developer of a MASH drug, for up to $5.2 billion.

Football has become an offense-first game, making cornerbacks crucial for defending passes. Their primary job is to cover wide receivers in man or zone coverage, often at a disadvantage as receivers know their routes. Cornerbacks protect the field's outside thirds, are part of the defensive backs unit, and are called 'DBs' or 'lockdown corners.' They require speed and agility, also contributing as run defenders. Notable greats include Deion Sanders and Charles Woodson. The position is vital because great cornerbacks can neutralize top receivers, forcing quarterback hesitation and enabling defensive schemes.

Defending goal kicks involves strategic positioning and pressing to win possession or deny an easy build-up. Key tactics include positioning defenders to cover receivers, aggressively moving to the ball first, and pressing if the ball is not won. For youth, build-out lines help facilitate play. At higher levels, options include short kicks, deep targets, and using the goalkeeper as the kicker.

CeeDee Lamb, who missed the past two games with a high ankle sprain, was seen doing rehab work outside on Wednesday for the first time since his Week 3 injury. Despite this progress, doubt remains about his return this week. Stephen Jones expects Lamb back within two weeks, and he has not been placed on injured reserve.
David Jones has not renewed Jesinta Franklin's contract after two years, citing a new direction, and has named Victoria Lee as their new ambassador.
A man who showed a beheading video to a child was jailed for six years for disseminating terrorist propaganda, having tried to radicalize primary school-age children.

The passage summarizes a backtest of Larry Connors' 3-day high/low method/strategy from his 2009 book "High Probability ETF Trading." The strategy, which involves buying ETFs after three consecutive days of lower highs and lower lows, performed well in the book and still works "pretty well" 12 years later. Tests on 20 ETFs showed 13 performed worse since the original test. A portfolio test using 25 ETFs with a maximum of five positions allocated 20% equity each showed the worst drawdown in July 2011. The strategy "seems to have deteriorated a little but still shows some promise."

NewMarket's new Singapore facility may help leverage Asian vehicle growth, but the shares appear overvalued. The company faces headwinds from improved vehicle efficiency in North America and the EU, while emerging market vehicle growth offers a tailwind. Despite strong EBITDA margins and cash flow, the author sees limited top-line growth and believes the current share price already anticipates significant cash flow growth, concluding the stock is not undervalued.

Nippon Express Co. falsified inspection stamps on government-stockpiled rice it stored. Mitsubishi Corp., which entrusted the storage, received a business improvement order in May. Some affected rice was shipped for livestock feed with no health damage reported; the rest will be incinerated. The falsification involved 251 container bags of rice, with incidents in June 2014, February 2015, and September 2016.

Expenses from misconduct are charged to the individual. Masters can displace incompetent officers, adjusting their pay. Sick or deceased seamen's representatives get a prorated share. Seamen are liable for lost or damaged vessel property. Shares are paid in San Francisco at set rates for oil and whalebone. Signatories pledge to board as ordered and not bring liquor, with forfeiture for violations.

EON Resources Inc. published a slide deck for an event. The lecture discusses linearized general relativity, where spacetime is nearly flat, allowing the metric to be expressed as the flat metric plus a small perturbation. It covers coordinate transformations, gauge transformations (analogous to those in electromagnetism), and the derivation of the Einstein tensor in linearized form. By choosing a gauge (Lorentz gauge) that makes the trace-reversed metric perturbation divergence-free, the Einstein field equations simplify to a wave equation. The lecture concludes by examining the static, non-relativistic limit, recovering the Newtonian gravitational potential and the Newtonian limit of general relativity.

The TPS7H500x-SP series controllers have three switching frequency modes: internal oscillator, external synchronization, and primary-secondary. In internal oscillator mode, an RT resistor sets the frequency (100 kHz to 2 MHz), and the SYNC pin outputs a clock at twice that frequency. In external synchronization mode, the RT pin is left floating and a clock at twice the desired switching frequency is applied to SYNC. Primary-secondary mode uses one controller's SYNC output as the clock input for a second controller. The soft-start circuit gradually increases output voltage using a capacitor on the SS pin. The controllers have primary switching outputs (OUTA/OUTB) and synchronous rectifier outputs (SRA/SRB). Dead time and leading edge blank time are programmable on some devices. The CS_ILIM pin senses current for PWM generation and overcurrent protection. Hiccup mode activates when the CS_ILIM voltage exceeds 1.05 V. The FAULT pin provides external fault protection. Slope compensation is set via the RSC pin. The controllers use a transconductance error amplifier for frequency compensation. Thermal shutdown occurs at 175°C.

The lecturer discusses the Schwarzschild solution, noting a coordinate singularity at r = 2GM but a physical singularity at r = 0. Light emitted near r = 2GM undergoes infinite redshift, breaking the Einstein synchronization procedure. Using tortoise and Kruskal-Szekeres coordinates, the surface r = 2GM is identified as an event horizon, defining a black hole. The lecturer then introduces other black hole solutions: Reissner-Nordström (mass and charge), Kerr (mass and spin), and Kerr-Newman (mass, spin, and charge). The No-Hair theorem states that stationary black holes are fully described by only mass, spin, and charge.

The NVIDIA A100 Tensor Core GPU, based on the Ampere architecture, is an 8th-generation data center GPU designed for AI, HPC, and data analytics. The A100 features 108 SMs, 432 Tensor Cores, 40 GB of HBM2 memory with 1555 GB/sec bandwidth, and a 40 MB L2 cache. It introduces Multi-Instance GPU (MIG) for secure partitioning into up to seven GPU Instances, third-generation NVLink with 600 GB/sec total bandwidth, and PCIe Gen 4 support. The GPU delivers up to 2.5x the mixed-precision Tensor Core performance of V100 and up to 20x V100's standard FP32 throughput with sparsity.

To reduce SRAM leakage, SRAM blocks can switch from ACTIVE to SHUTDOWN mode, which removes voltage and loses data. SRAM in switchable power domains enters SHUTDOWN when its domain is "OFF" and returns to ACTIVE when the domain is "ON". The device supports dual voltages (1.8 V or 3.3 V) on some I/Os, partitioned into groups with dedicated supply pins. DDR interface I/O voltage is independently selectable between 1.5 V or 1.8 V. For power-down, software must configure PHYs into power-down mode before turning the power domain "OFF". Standby Mode requires all switchable power domains "OFF", the ARM Cortex-A8 in an IDLE loop, and unused functional blocks clock gated. Device power supplies are organized into four Supply Sequencing Groups, and a specific power-up and power-down sequence must be followed. The device has several system-level resets, including Power-on Reset (POR), External Warm Reset, Emulation Warm Reset, Watchdog Reset, and Software Global Cold/Warm Resets, each with specific effects and sequences. Reset isolation is supported for the PCI Express (PCIE) module and the EMAC Switch. The device clocks are generated from reference clocks fed to on-chip PLLs and dividers. The DEV and AUX clocks can be sourced from an external crystal or a 1.8-V LVCMOS-compatible clock input. The device contains 12 top-level PLLs and 4 embedded PLLs. The ARM Cortex-A8 Interrupt Controller handles up to 128 interrupt requests. The C674x DSP interrupt controller combines up to 128 device events into 12 prioritized interrupts. The device provides two DCAN interfaces, an EDMA controller, and supports Advanced Event Triggering (AET) and Trace. The EMAC SW controls packet data flow between the device and two external Ethernet PHYs, supporting MII, GMII, RMII, and RGMII modes. The MDIO module polls MDIO addresses to enumerate PHY devices. The GPIO peripheral provides up to 128 GPIO pins. The GPMC provides an interface to external memory devices. The device includes an HDMI 1.3a-compliant transmitter and an HDVPSS for video input and output.

AutoPrune is a training-free, complexity-adaptive token pruning framework for Vision-Language Models (VLMs) and Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models. This approach outperforms existing training-free methods across various benchmarks and pruning ratios, e.g., retaining 96.7% accuracy on LLaVA-1.5-7B while pruning 89% of visual tokens.

Marine heatwaves, which can last weeks or months, kill kelp and corals and impact ecosystems and fisheries, but had received little research attention. A 2015 working group defined them as a prolonged period of unusually warm water at a location for that time of year. Analysis of over 100 years of data shows marine heatwave days increased by 54% from 1925 to 2016, with frequency up 34% and duration up 17% between 1925-1954 and 1987-2016, linked to ocean warming. Recent events, like the 2011 Western Australia heatwave and "The Blob" (2014-2016), caused ecosystem shifts, fishery disruptions, and harmful algal blooms. Anthropogenic climate change made the 2016 Great Barrier Reef heatwave 53 times more likely and the 2015-16 Tasman Sea event over 300 times more likely.

Kerberos is a cryptographically secure protocol for authenticating computers and applications over a network, designed for a distributed system with many servers and client workstations. It introduces a trusted Kerberos server (KDC) that stores a shared key for every entity. The protocol uses two interfaces: one for initial login (using a password-derived key KC) and a Ticket Granting Service (TGS) for subsequent requests, allowing the client to discard KC after the first step. Kerberos uses tickets (encrypted with the service's key) and authenticators (encrypted with a session key) to establish shared keys between clients and services. The protocol has several weaknesses, including assuming encryption provides authentication, vulnerability to offline password guessing, reliance on a single encryption scheme (DES), and issues like reflection attacks and lack of message integrity. Kerberos 5 addresses many of these issues with explicit authentication, multiple encryption schemes, and separate keys for client-to-server and server-to-client communication.

The passage explains that scaling in means gradually building a position size as the market creates more entry opportunities, offering flexibility and a better average entry price. It requires discipline and is part of a planned strategy, not a reaction to losses. The strategy differs from double-down and Martingale methods, which are desperate attempts to salvage losing trades. A backtest showed scaling in can improve risk-adjusted returns by using capital more efficiently.

This scoping review examines the role of inflammation in depression and the potential of anti-inflammatory treatments. Results show that higher introspection strength promotes cooperation, with the {C, L} strategy set becoming dominant, while weak introspection favors defection or loner strategies. The framework allows strategies and strategy sets to co-evolve, offering insights into the evolution of cooperation in heterogeneous populations.

Gold prices have risen over 50% in the past year, reaching record highs due to recession fears and political uncertainty, with forecasts for continued increases. Jewelry companies are responding by raising prices, exploring alternative materials like gold-plated or 10-karat gold, and adjusting supply chains. Some firms report cautious consumer spending, while analysts expect central banks to continue buying gold for three more years.

A study of Ugandan *P. falciparum* from 2019-2024 found most parasites were sensitive to common antimalarials, but susceptibilities to dihydroartemisinin and lumefantrine decreased over time. The PfK13 C469Y and A675V mutations were associated with decreased susceptibility to both drugs.

Elon Musk tweeted on Oct. 5 that Tesla could rebuild Puerto Rico's power grid, noting the team has done similar work for smaller islands with no scalability limit. Governor Ricardo Rossello responded, "Let's talk," and Musk agreed. As of Oct. 6, only about 10% of the island had power. Tesla had already sent Powerwall battery systems to Puerto Rico.

Renault SA is expected to extend CEO Carlos Ghosn's contract beyond June, pending shareholder approval, to allow him more time to strengthen the Renault-Nissan-Mitsubishi alliance. Fragment-based drug discovery (FBDD) uses fragment-constrained design but is limited by expert heuristics. In silico molecular generation models exist but are poorly aligned with medicinal chemistry workflows. The authors propose InVirtuoGen, a continuous-time discrete flow model operating on fragmented SMILES, which refines all positions simultaneously. It achieves state-of-the-art performance in de novo generation and competitive results on fragment-constrained tasks, and introduces a hybrid optimization framework for target property optimization.

New video features include 4:2:2 chroma sampling encode/decode, a ninth-generation NVENC encoder with AV1 Ultra High Quality mode, and DisplayPort 2.1b support. Power efficiency improvements include advanced power gating, accelerated frequency switching, and low latency sleep. DLSS 4 introduces Multi Frame Generation, generating up to three additional frames per rendered frame, and transitions to transformer-based AI models for Super Resolution, Ray Reconstruction, and DLAA. Neural shaders are introduced, enabling techniques like RTX Neural Materials, Neural Texture Compression, Neural Radiance Cache, RTX Skin, and RTX Neural Faces. The architecture includes GB202, GB203, and GB205 GPUs, with the GeForce RTX 5090 featuring 92.2 billion transistors, 24,576 CUDA cores, and 192 RT cores.

Wald's equality is reviewed, defining a stopping trial for a sequence of random variables. The elementary renewal theorem states that the limit of the expected value of N(t) over t as t approaches infinity equals 1 over the mean inter-renewal time. The concept of a generalized stopping trial is introduced for sequences of paired random variables, applied to a G/G/1 queue to show that arrivals starting a new busy period form a renewal process. Little's theorem is presented, relating the time-average number of customers in a system to the arrival rate and average delay. The Pollaczek-Khinchin formula for the M/G/1 queue gives the expected waiting time in queue as lambda times the second moment of service time divided by 2 times (1 minus rho), where rho is the utilization factor.
