Cleveland Browns quarterback Shedeur Sanders said he sees a "light at the end of the tunnel" after starting as the team's No. 4 QB in training camp, stating he is thankful for whatever his role is. Head coach Kevin Stefanski has not yet named a backup quarterback after the Joe Flacco trade, leaving Sanders and Dillon Gabriel as the only active roster quarterbacks. Offensive coordinator Tommy Rees praised Sanders' preparation and growth.

Coach Dean Smith's "Four Corner" offense spreads players to each corner, creating isolation for a ballhandler to minimize turnovers and reduce opponent possessions. It involves dribble penetration, kick-out passes, back cuts, and role exchanges when passes are denied.

A waveguide display for VR/AR/MR systems includes a source assembly with a light source (e.g., microLEDs) and an optics system, an output waveguide, and a controller. The source assembly emits image light to the output waveguide, which expands and outputs it to a user's eyes. The controller controls scanning components. The light source may include one-dimensional or two-dimensional arrays of source elements, which may be curved or flat, and may include optical isolators.

Air Canada apologized and offered a C$2,500 voucher to a family after a 10-year-old was bumped from an oversold flight, following a similar United Airlines incident. The family drove to another airport after the flight was canceled.

The passage praises U.S. constructive statesmanship in the Philippines and cooperative Filipinos. It emphasizes the need for a small but highly efficient Army, with maneuvers, marksmanship training, and a general staff. A BARG (batch argument) is a tuple of algorithms (generator, prover, verifier) allowing a prover to convince a verifier that all statements in a list (x1 to xk) are in an NP language L, using a single proof π. Succinctness requires the proof size to be smaller than the total witness length. The lecture presents a construction of BARGs from the learning with errors assumption, with proof size poly(λ, log k, |C|) and verification time k·|x| + poly(λ, log k, |C|). The construction uses a PCP, a somewhere statistically binding (SSB) hash from FHE, and a correlation-intractable hash to compile an interactive protocol into a non-interactive one. Soundness is proven by identifying an index i* where xi* is not in L, using the SSB hash to bind the i*-th row of the PCP matrix, and applying correlation-intractability.

In Card Identification Mode, the host remains at fOD frequency. In Data Transfer Mode, the host may use fPP frequency. CMD9 obtains Card Specific Data. CMD4 configures driver stages. The integration of generative AI in education is growing, offering personalized learning and real-time feedback through LLMs and predictive analytics. It addresses four research questions: which LLM applications are studied, methods used, risks identified, and mitigation strategies. The review synthesizes risks across technical (e.g., bias, hallucinations), pedagogical (e.g., reduced critical thinking), and societal (e.g., AI divide) domains. It introduces a taxonomy of applications, a synthesis of evaluation methods, and a conceptual LLM-Risk Adapted Learning Model. The review includes 70 empirical studies from 2015-2025, organized into three application areas: operational effectiveness, personalized applications, and interactive learning tools. Key risks include superficial understanding, bias, cognitive and metacognitive disengagement, and over-reliance. Mitigation strategies involve educators, developers, students, and governments.

A savings bank deposit made in trust for another, with interest drawn by the depositor during his life and part of the principal paid to the beneficiary, constitutes a valid trust, not a gift. The network can be dynamically modified to track entities, handle malfunctions, and provide cascading alerts.

It has infected about 100,000 devices globally but has not launched any DDoS attacks, leaving its purpose unknown. Security experts recommend patching vulnerable IoT devices to stop both malwares.

OpenAI reached a $500 billion valuation after a secondary share sale where employees sold about $6.6 billion in stock to investors including SoftBank and Thrive Capital. The company generated $4.3 billion in revenue in the first half of 2025, surpassing its full-year 2024 revenue by over 15%.

The passage describes the UCLA High Post Rub Offense, a flexible attack based on sound principles and spacing, utilizing a high post player with passing and shooting skills. It details various offensive phases, including the high post rub cut, ball reversal down screens, and automatic counters against defensive overplays, along with specific reads and counters for different defensive tactics. The text also covers teaching methods, game strategies, and the importance of defending against this offense.

The passage discusses market analysis, noting gold's rally and the USD Index's decline, but highlights that mining stocks failed to capitalize on gold's move, which is considered abnormal. It suggests this indicates a potential bigger decline, while the USD Index is poised to rally. The author draws parallels to 2008 and mentions the Peak Chaos theory. The passage also includes headlines about Trump's tariff threats and market declines, along with disclaimers.

The speaker, having taken the same oath as past presidents, assumes office under unprecedented circumstances. He proposes a compact of straight talk, asking for prayers rather than votes, and pledges to be President of all people. He intends to address Congress, emphasizes unity and forward movement, and pledges a sincere search for peace. He states that truth holds government together, promises openness and candor, and declares the national nightmare over. He asks for prayers for former President Nixon and his family, and reaffirms his oath to uphold the Constitution.

The lecture discusses capital budgeting methods, emphasizing that NPV is the preferred approach, but other methods like payback period, IRR, and profitability index are used in practice. Payback period ignores time value and later cash flows, IRR can have multiple or non-real solutions, and profitability index ignores scale. The lecture also covers market efficiency, using the Challenger disaster as an example of how stock prices quickly reflected information.

It recommends Smithsonian funding for preserving vanishing species and cultures. Finally, it urges model social and labor legislation for Washington, D.C., including an employer's-liability act and improved railway safety laws.

They emphasize doing "little things" like cycling and finishing checks, and highlight strong road play as a playoff advantage.

The study analyzed 116 mother-child pairs from the VDAART cohort, finding that the maternal gut microbiome was more predictive of children's first-year neurodevelopment (ASQ-Y1) than the infant (3-6 months) or child (year one) gut microbiome. Predictive power diminished by year two and was absent by year three. Shared microbial taxa between mothers and infants showed opposite associations with neurodevelopment.

Shipping costs $35 with the address, or $60 to track down the source. A "Tiny Hands Special" sends a Trump tweet to the White House for $30.

The speaker describes an opposing goalie as low, quick, and fast, emphasizing the need for more traffic and shots. They reflect on a loss due to a lack of bounces, drawing confidence from past series wins where persistence led to success, and focus on winning the next game.

A player reflects on entering a Stanley Cup final with five minutes left, calling it a learning process. He notes that making saves builds confidence, and he does not feel helpless. He and Jussi prepared for this opportunity. He admits holding the puck too long was a mistake he would not normally make, possibly due to inactivity, but he believes he can help the team by staying prepared and working hard.

Scientists are puzzled by observations of 14 out of 16 dwarf galaxies orbiting Centaurus A in a common plane, contradicting the lambda cold dark matter model's prediction of random orbits. This phenomenon, previously seen in the Milky Way and Andromeda, is the first observed outside the Local Group. Some astrophysicists suggest it may be a statistical fluke or due to larger dark matter filaments, while others argue it questions the standard model, though many disagree with replacing it without stronger evidence.

The passage describes various types of soccer corner kicks, including Far Post, Near Post, Medium, Top-of-the-Arc, Short, Skip Header, and Direct Score corners, each with specific target areas, objectives, and service techniques. It also covers player selection, practice methods, and tactical considerations such as wind, goalkeeper ability, and signals.

This study developed and validated a Fluorescent Immuno-Lectin Assay (FILA) to investigate lubricin glycoforms in osteoarthritis (OA) patients. The FILA was benchmarked against mass spectrometry. Results showed lubricin glycosylation differs between synovial fluid and plasma. In plasma, only SNA-detectable glycoforms were significantly decreased in OA patients compared to controls. Plasma lubricin glycoforms also correlated with BMI and age.

This study of 121 older adults (≥60) from 61 households found a pneumococcal carriage prevalence of 4.8% (52/1088 samples). Carriage was higher among those with contact with children (10.0%) than those without (1.6%). Contact with children under 10 was associated with a threefold increase in acquisition rate. No clear evidence of adult-adult transmission was found.

On June 10, 2015, Tesla Motors, Inc. and its subsidiary entered a $500 million senior secured asset-based revolving credit facility, expandable to $750 million, with several banks. The facility matures on June 10, 2020, and proceeds are for working capital and general corporate purposes.

Yes. The 2017 hurricane season and wildfires will lead more voters to accept climate change as real and serious, shifting voting patterns. Europe will launch Sentinel-3B, the seventh Copernicus satellite, on Wednesday to monitor Earth's oceans for pollution and damage. It will orbit at over 800 km with its twin Sentinel-3A, providing data within three hours, 24/7. The mission tracks sea level, temperature, pollution, ice, coastal vegetation, rivers, lakes, and wildfires. The Copernicus project, funded by the EU and ESA, has a 2008-2020 budget of about 7.5 billion euros, with uncertainty over Brexit's impact on UK involvement.

Crews removed a Confederate statue in Gainesville, Florida, while red paint was splashed around a Confederate memorial park in Tampa. The Gainesville statue, "Old Joe," was returned to the United Daughters of the Confederacy. The Tampa vandalism occurred on private property. Of 1162 randomized subjects, 1160 received study drug. At 24 weeks, 1054 completed; 108 discontinued. At 48 weeks, 1003 completed; 50 discontinued. Stoke City defender Geoff Cameron said the team must end their five-game winless streak by beating Hull City on Saturday, calling it a "must-win game" to avoid being dragged into the relegation battle.

Significant discordance in staging was found, especially for Black patients, with Black patients being 126 times more likely to have an increased stage of CKD using the 2021 equation.

The bill replaces the 2011 act, requiring district court authorization for data requests, but lacks specific protections for journalistic sources and robust monitoring.

After a trial and permanent implant, she no longer needs a walker or wheelchair. Dr. Michael Bottros at Washington University Pain Management Center performed the procedure, which has shown remarkable results in nearly all of his 40 to 50 patients over the past year.

The Strategic National Stockpile, a $7 billion government repository of drugs and supplies for bioterrorism, nuclear attack, or public health emergencies, includes antibiotics, vaccines, and antivirals. No increased relative incidence of hearing loss was observed following any COVID-19 vaccine.

The passage discusses the Higgs mechanism, which gives mass to gauge bosons (W and Z) via spontaneous symmetry breaking. A complex scalar field with a non-zero vacuum expectation value breaks local gauge symmetry, generating mass terms proportional to coupling strength and the vacuum expectation value. In the Standard Model, this process yields massive W and Z bosons, a massless photon, and one real massive scalar Higgs boson, while Goldstone bosons are absorbed as longitudinal polarizations. The Higgs boson was discovered experimentally in 2012.

Outcomes include improved overall education quality, teacher satisfaction and competence, student development, and reduced school-choice pressure. Problems include cultural homogenization, difficulty applying core school philosophies, and lack of core school motivation. Suggestions involve establishing democratic relationships, strengthening team building, and securing government support.

Fire departments in the state are holding education sessions in October for Fire Prevention month. This year's theme is "Every Second counts – know two ways out," emphasizing awareness of multiple exits. People often block exits in colder weather, which is dangerous. Officials reinforce standard safety messages with kids, including actions when alarms sound, staying outside, and not re-entering. Perivascular spaces (PVS) in the basal ganglia were enlarged in all epilepsy subtypes studied (TLE-HS, TLE-NEG, ETLE, IGE) compared to healthy controls, with large effect sizes. No significant differences in PVS volume fraction were found in the white matter after accounting for age and sex. The TLE-HS group showed a contralateral asymmetry in PVS distribution. No association was found between PVS volume fraction and duration of illness.

David M. Shannon, Executive Vice President, Chief Administrative Officer and Secretary of NVIDIA, announced his retirement effective end of 2016. Brian E. Cabrera will lead the legal team, and a new human resources leader will be recruited.

Redundancy management improves reliability in safety-critical systems like avionics and nuclear control. This work presents a correct-by-construction approach for synthesizing a fault-tolerant voter unit for input selection in a synchronous N-modular redundant measurement system. The voter uses a noise-resilient voting algorithm, with requirements for fault identification, isolation of permanently faulty units, and output generation. The court held that the President's and Governor's satisfaction in issuing ordinances is subject to judicial review, and that laying an ordinance before the legislature is mandatory. Re-promulgation subverts democratic legislative processes.

A University of Surrey study finds solar energy is now the cheapest power source globally, with costs as low as £0.02 per unit in sunniest countries. Lithium-ion battery prices have fallen 89% since 2010, making solar-plus-storage systems cost-effective. Challenges include grid congestion and integration, requiring smart grids, AI forecasting, and sustained policy support.

A non-inverting comparator with hysteresis uses a two-resistor network and a voltage reference (VREF). When VIN is less than VREF, the output is low; to switch high, VIN must exceed VIN1 (Equation 4). When VIN is greater than VREF, the output is high; to switch low, VIN must drop below VIN2 (Equation 5). Hysteresis is the difference between VIN1 and VIN2 (Equation 6).
On January 26, 2015, Microsoft Corporation filed a Form 8-K reporting its financial results for the quarter ended December 31, 2014, via a press release furnished as Exhibit 99.1.

Backtested from 1927, it generated 12 signals, with the S&P 500 up 21.84% on average one year after the signal. A delegation from Ibigawa, Japan, visited St. George, Utah, from Oct. 6-9, 2017, continuing a nearly 30-year sister city cultural exchange. Commuters in Delhi-NCR may face taxi shortages on Tuesday as Ola and Uber drivers plan a one-day strike over low fares, despite a Delhi High Court order restraining unions from disrupting services. The Sarvodaya Drivers' Association demands fare increases from Rs 6 to Rs 20 per km and abolition of 25% commissions, threatening an indefinite strike if ignored. Rain Bird's 9V WPX battery-operated controller is designed for situations where mains power is unavailable or impractical. It is IP68 compliant, waterproof, submersible, and suitable for wet conditions. Models cover 1, 2, 4, or 6 zones with LCD programming, Contractor Rapid Programming™, and automatic zone-stacking. Battery life is about one year with one 9V battery or up to two years with two.

Brad May made a line change, the puck was inside their blueline, Matt passed to Teemu, who fed the speaker. The speaker gave it back to Teemu, drove the net, and scored on an open net. It was a set play. The speaker said it was not as emotional as thought; they had a good period, stayed disciplined, played their game, and got the goal to finish.

A study found that birds and mammals adapt to temperature changes 2-3 times faster than reptiles and amphibians, based on 270 million years of data. However, it is unclear if this will help them survive rapid modern climate change, as current extinction rates are up to 10,000 times higher than normal.

The SNP Run VMPL NAE event lets a guest request the hypervisor to run the current vCPU at a different VMPL level, associating a unique VMSA with each VMPL. The SEV-TIO extension allows guests to bind to trusted devices. The SNP TIO Guest Request NAE event is similar to the SNP Guest Request, with differences related to non-optional unencrypted data. The Secure AVIC feature manages guest-owned APIC state for SEV-SNP guests using a private backing page per vCPU. The termination request NAE event allows a guest to request termination. For SMP booting under SEV-ES, a new method is required because the hypervisor cannot set vCPU registers after they are measured. The SEV-SNP AP Creation NAE event allows a guest to create or update vCPU state of an AP. When injecting an NMI, the hypervisor must not intercept IRET but must intercept #DB. Full virtualization of hardware debug registers is supported for SEV-ES guests with "DebugVirtualization." SMM and nested virtualization are not supported. The #HV doorbell page defines a pending event field and an EOI assist field for host notification.

Kuwait will finish cleaning a crude oil spill in its southern Gulf waters this week, according to its oil minister. No new oil patches have been found, and cleanup focuses on shore areas. The spill's cause and magnitude were not given. A joint Saudi-Kuwaiti operator confirmed its facilities were safe and not involved, citing media reports of a tanker spill, and has activated an emergency plan.

A system for image-guided surgery uses a first head-mounted device (HMD) with a tracking device. When both a patient marker and tool are within the first tracking device's line of sight, an augmented reality image is generated on the first HMD using only data from that device. When both are not within the first line of sight, the image is generated at least partially using data from a second tracking device.

Investors, previously focused on strong corporate profits and tax cuts, are now worried that rising wages and inflation may lead central banks to end cheap money policies, causing a stock market drop and Treasury yield surge.

Fewer than one in five market corrections become bear markets. Since 1900, corrections have occurred annually on average, lasting about 54 days with a typical 13.5% decline. Bear markets average a 33% drop and last about a year. From 1980 to 2015, the S&P 500 had positive annual returns in 75% of years despite average intra-year declines of 14.2%.

The TPS7H500x-SP series controllers have primary switching outputs (OUTA/OUTB) with ~150-mA peak current, requiring external gate drive. OUTB is active only with a 50% duty cycle limit (DCL pin to AVSS) for TPS7H5001-SP and TPS7H5004-SP. Synchronous rectifier outputs (SRA/SRB) also have ~150-mA peak current; SRB is only on TPS7H5001-SP with 50% duty cycle. Dead time (TDSP, TDPS) and leading edge blank time (TLEB) are programmable via resistors (PS, SP, LEB) for most devices, with fixed 50-ns for TPS7H5003-SP. Pulse skipping occurs when COMP < 0.3 V and previous duty cycle < 25%. Duty cycle is configurable via DCL (50%, 75%, or 100%). Current sensing uses CS_ILIM; overcurrent at 1.05 V triggers hiccup mode. The FAULT pin provides external protection. Slope compensation is set via RSC. Thermal shutdown occurs at 175°C.

Apple Inc. filed a Form 10-Q for the fiscal quarter ended March 31, 2018, reporting net sales of $61.1 billion and net income of $13.8 billion for the quarter. The company had $45.1 billion in cash and cash equivalents and total assets of $367.5 billion as of March 31, 2018.

Two teens were arrested and a third is at large after a police pursuit in Frankston early this morning. A car with stolen plates was dumped in Bayswater; the 17-year-old girl and 18-year-old man from Mill Park were caught, and the man was hospitalised after a police dog bite.

Saudi Arabia selected international oil companies for three major natural gas projects, marking the reopening of its energy sector to foreign investment. Exxon Mobil, Royal Dutch/Shell, BP, and Phillips Petroleum were chosen for the $15 billion South Ghawar project. Exxon Mobil will lead the Red Sea project, with Occidental and Enron as partners. To use it, open a video in Chrome in desktop mode, enter full-screen, then press the home button. The video shrinks to a movable window. The team measured minute brightness changes to track temperature, cloud cover, and chemistry, finding temperature variations smaller than 5 °C and no variability in cloud coverage.

In an action to void a husband's deed of gift to his wife, the trial court must determine the husband's intent regarding creditors based on all facts. The unrecorded deed for over two years is suspicious but not proof of fraud. The plaintiff must prove fraudulent intent; without such evidence, the court must find no fraud. Excluding testimony about events four years after the deed, concerning personal property, was not reversible error.

Tropical Storm Nate is moving toward Mexico's Yucatan Peninsula and the U.S. Gulf Coast, likely as a hurricane. Louisiana declared a state of emergency and ordered evacuations. Nate has killed 22 people in Latin America. Forecasters expect it to strengthen. Louisiana mobilized 1,300 National Guard troops. The passage tests a pair trading strategy in SPY and TLT, triggered when SPY falls and TLT rises more than 1.25 times the 50-day average of high-minus-low on the same day. This study analyzed factors causing delayed discharge from a subacute Complex Discharge Unit (CDU) during the first year of the COVID-19 pandemic. Of 390 patients, 237 (60.7%) had a length of stay (LOS) >15 days. The most common factors delaying discharge were complications from primary diagnoses or multimorbidity (37.94%) and patient-centred needs (13.07%).

The 10% bond allocation provides a cushion against market volatility. Backtests using SPY and TLT showed performance almost at par with SPY, while SPY with SHY or IEI performed slightly worse.

A Bank of England study suggests a central bank digital currency (CBDC) could strengthen monetary policy transmission, forcing commercial banks to adjust rates faster and improving quantitative easing by bypassing the banking sector. The Bank is not currently planning a CBDC.

The Court of Appeals reversed the circuit court's reinstatement of a child abandonment charge against Lawrence B. Schaub, who sold his ten-month-old daughter to an undercover officer. The court held that while sufficient evidence showed intent to wholly abandon, the prosecution failed to establish the element of exposure, as the child was handed directly to a caregiver and never left without care. The case was remanded.

The President's message to Congress reports that American citizens in Cuba, especially in rural central and eastern areas, are destitute and lacking food and medicine. Consul-General Lee estimates 600-800 Americans need support. The company has surpassed 300,000 drone deliveries and is expanding partnerships, including with Alphabet’s Wing, to scale operations, citing a favorable regulatory environment.

The passage describes the Golden Cross trading strategy, which uses 50-day and 200-day moving averages. A Golden Cross occurs when the short-term average crosses above the long-term average, signaling a buy; the opposite crossover signals a sell. A backtest on the S&P 500 since 1960 resulted in 33 trades, a 79% win rate, an average gain of 15.8%, an annual return of 6.8%, and a maximum drawdown of 33%, compared to buy-and-hold's 56% drawdown and 7.2% annual return. The strategy aims to reduce losses in bear markets by reducing market exposure.

A study at Kibungo Referral Hospital, Rwanda, found a 13% non-adherence rate to antiretroviral therapy (ART) among 424 HIV patients. Significant factors associated with non-adherence included younger age (under 31), lack of tertiary education, stigma, perceived ART ineffectiveness, and failure to integrate ART into daily routines.

In this 1989 federal case, pro se plaintiff Richard A. Milan sued prison officials under 42 U.S.C. § 1983 over a denied visit. The court granted summary judgment for defendants, finding Milan failed to establish a protected liberty interest in visitation privileges under Hewitt v. Helms and Kentucky Department of Corrections v. Thompson, as the prison’s administrative procedure did not use mandatory language limiting discretion. The lack of written notice did not create a constitutional violation.

This paper discusses the importance of e-learning governance for organizations, proposing a framework of structures, processes, communications and relational mechanisms, and pedagogies. It reviews e-learning ecosystems, adopts characteristics of digital ecosystem governance, and details information security governance. The paper concludes with suggestions for further research.

By March 2020, COVID-19 cases were confirmed in most regions, including Ireland, which entered lockdown on March 27, 2020. The study estimated the Burden of Disease (BoD) from COVID-19 in the Republic of Ireland from March 1, 2020, to February 28, 2021, using Disability-Adjusted Life Years (DALYs). DALYs combine Years of Life Lost (YLL) and Years Lived with Disability (YLD). YLL was calculated from mortality data and life expectancy. YLD included five health states: asymptomatic, moderate, severe, critical, and post-acute consequences, with durations and disability weights from established studies. Data were sourced from public Irish databases. Ethical approval was obtained from University College Cork.

A data management application creates snapshots stored on a storage appliance that caches data for cloud storage. The appliance maintains snapshot metadata in key-value stores and snapshot data files. To prevent eviction of stable data blocks from the cache, which would slow restores, the appliance creates synthetic baseline snapshots and refreshes eviction state data for those stable blocks, associating them with the most recent snapshot to reduce their eviction risk.

In normal-form games, optimistic algorithms like OFTRL achieve O(1) regret and converge to Nash equilibrium, but time-delayed feedback worsens performance. This study shows that any time delay causes OFTRL to suffer O(√T) regret and diverge from equilibrium. The proposed Weighted OFTRL (WOFTRL) with optimistic weight n = m + 1 recovers O(1) regret and best-iterate convergence in poly-matrix zero-sum games.

This approach, including net net stocks, can yield profits as price-value gaps close, regardless of a company's future outlook.

Location trackers in many devices raise privacy concerns. Experts advise turning off location services in device settings, managing app permissions, and being cautious with friend requests. Turning devices off is the only way to fully prevent tracking.

Set pieces in soccer are designed for free kicks, governed by Law 13, requiring the ball to be stationary, defenders 10 yards away, and the kicker not to touch the ball twice. Direct kicks can score directly; indirect kicks require another touch. Basic strategy involves defeating the defensive wall, considering proximity to goal (five near and three far locations), whether the kick is direct or indirect, and player skill. Designs include direct shots, simple touches, crosses, stepovers, misdirection, screening, passes, chips, and crashing. Players must understand responsibilities, referee readiness, and the difference between ceremonial and quick free kicks. Practice involves running plays from all locations, adding defenders, and scrimmaging.

Walter Lippmann proposed studying armament reduction for the peace conference, focusing on preventing cheating in mobilization. Secretary Baker agreed, suggesting General Bliss and General Crowder for the study. Subsequent correspondence discussed coordination and outlines for The Inquiry's urgent subjects.

Florida classifies both events as Level 4 (101-1,000 patients). Regular training occurs, and Weaver believes the community can handle such incidents.

In a suit with conflicting theories supported by evidence, the Supreme Court adopts the theory sustaining the lower court's finding. Bales, as Thompson's assignee, sought specific performance of a land sale contract. The court found Thompson had prior equity over Hunter, who had full knowledge of Thompson's title bond. A tender of purchase money in a complaint is sufficient; interest after tender is not chargeable unless the vendor proves the vendee used the money. The lower court's decree was affirmed.

In a speech, Ronald Reagan criticized the Carter Administration's foreign policy, stating that 50 American hostages in Iran resulted from a weak response that encouraged the Soviet invasion of Afghanistan. He argued Carter's negotiation attempts failed and his belief that Iran might seek U.S. protection was foolish, as the U.S. appeared weak. Reagan asserted the U.S. must be strong, reliable, and predictable to maintain peace, blaming Carter for damaging credibility and allowing Soviet military superiority. He called for a coherent strategy to rebuild military strength, including stronger nuclear deterrent forces, naval superiority, and the capacity to project power to protect interests in regions like the Persian Gulf.

The 2018 Jeep Cherokee has a discount for Memorial Day. Tariffs may raise costs for imported vehicles, but determining what is American-made is complex due to global parts sourcing. This study compared a hybridization capture-based metagenomic next-generation sequencing (mNGS) workflow to a PCR panel for detecting respiratory pathogens in 29 nasopharyngeal samples. The mNGS workflow identified 44 microorganisms, including 29 not in the PCR panel, and showed high concordance (98.33% PPA, 100% NPA) for shared targets. Microorganisms were phenotypically classified into three groups based on infectivity potential. The authors conclude the hybridized approach may provide advantages for deciphering respiratory (co)infections and assessing trafficking potential to the lower respiratory tract.

The Florida Department of Transportation presented two plans to connect the Sawgrass Expressway and I-95 along Southwest 10th Street in Deerfield Beach, a project opposed by neighbors since the 1980s. The plans include a split or northern connector, with construction at least three years away. Local residents and the mayor expressed strong opposition, citing congestion, property value concerns, and unwanted highway proximity.

Nigeria faces a health crisis as doctors migrate mainly to the UK and US, with 88% planning to leave. The physician-patient ratio has worsened from 1:4,000 to 1:5,000, far below the WHO's 1:600, causing fatalities and errors. Nigeria needs 303,000 doctors but has only 35,000 practicing. Key migration reasons include high taxes (98%), low satisfaction (92%), and poor pay (91%).

A municipal corporation with power to make a public improvement may increase a contract price if equitably justified, unless prohibited by its charter. The council then authorized additional compensation and a further assessment, which was held lawful as a "further assessment" under the charter. The order for a new trial was affirmed.

Using narratives connected to real life helped students link learning to daily experiences, enhancing retention.

This document describes the Tiered Memory Page Migration (TMPM) engine, which facilitates page migration by copying page content and updating virtual-to-physical mappings. It details commands like PM_PAGE_MOVE_IO and PM_PAGE_MOVE_GUEST, which enable migration of pages concurrent with DMA and migration of SNP-protected guest pages. The document covers command formats, statuses, parameter blocks, error handling, firmware reload procedures, and performance guidelines, noting that all SPAs must be 4k aligned.
Amazon.com, Inc. filed a Form 10-Q for the quarterly period ended September 30, 2016, reporting net sales of $32.7 billion, operating income of $575 million, and net income of $252 million.
The San Francisco 49ers have ruled out quarterback Brock Purdy, wide receivers Ricky Pearsall and Jauan Jennings for Thursday's game against the Rams. Mac Jones will start at quarterback.

A year-long knowledge exchange project in England supported student teachers in educating for trans inclusion, using Citizenship education to create rights-respecting classrooms. The project involved workshops from Diversity Role Models and explored legal duties under the Equality Act 2010 and international frameworks. Student teachers actualized LGBTQ+ identities but noted minimal inclusion of transgender identities due to fear from media debates and proposed government guidance. The project highlighted the use of storytelling and human rights legislation to build empathy and allyship, and emphasized the need for whole-school approaches and effective training to support trans inclusion.

King Salman and Turkish President Erdogan met in Riyadh to discuss bilateral relations, regional and international developments, and cooperation. Crown Prince Muhammad Bin Naif also held separate talks with Erdogan focusing on regional peace, security, and counter-terrorism.

The President urges Congress to grant substantial tariff reductions on Cuban imports, citing moral and national interest, Cuba's constitutional alignment with the U.S., and a plea from President Palms for financial relief. He argues reciprocity will not harm U.S. industries, benefits both nations, and fulfills obligations from the Spanish-American War, contrasting it with other tariff issues.

Table 6 lists common medical problems (≥1% of participants) between Dose 3 and 1 month after a 5 or 10 µg BNT162b2 booster in Phase 3, following two 30 µg doses. Table 7 shows participants with medical problems after a 30 µg booster in Phase 2/3. Table 8 shows participants with medical problems after an additional 30 µg booster (Dose 4 or 5) in Phase 2/3. In Phase 1, 2 participants had serious medical problems within 1 to 6 months after Dose 2: one (4%) in the 20-µg group had inflamed appendix, and one (4%) in the 30-µg group had inflamed nerves; researchers do not believe these were related.

Health authorities in Taiwan warn against consuming raw or undercooked eggs due to rising avian flu risk. Eggs must be cooked to at least 70°C, and hands should be washed after handling eggshells. Residents are advised to maintain hygiene, cook poultry thoroughly, and wear masks if fever develops.

Malaysia's central bank will allow all resident entities to short-sell government securities from May 2, expanding access beyond licensed banks and investment banks, to boost bond market liquidity and provide risk management tools. Non-bank entities can hedge up to 100% of underlying assets and manage an additional 25% of forex exposure. The bank is also considering short-selling shariah-compliant bonds and will issue a concept paper by April 28. Residents can hedge up to 6 million ringgit per bank in pound sterling, euro, and yen without documentation from May 2. A new code of conduct for financial markets will replace the 1994 code.

The court reversed the judgment and ordered a new trial because the plaintiff was improperly allowed to introduce evidence about a hop speculation between the defendant's testator and the plaintiff's son-in-law, which was irrelevant to the issues and likely to prejudice the jury.

Kinlochleven has received three new defibrillators from fundraising by residents and businesses, presented by charity Lucky 2B Here. The equipment includes two defibrillators, three cabinets, and life support training, with a third defibrillator donated by Marcus and Martine Spence. The devices will be located outside the Co-op and GP’s surgery. The first responders group has raised £2,900 of its £3,500 target.

Magda Enriquez chose the Sandinista revolution over her husband, becoming a member of Nicaragua’s Council of State representing the women’s association AMNLAE. A trained soldier and peasant organizer, she joined the Sandinistas secretly in 1976 after founding a school for mentally retarded children and witnessing malnutrition’s effects. A 1978 land sit-in where ten children died from pesticide poisoning led her to seek military training. Her 14-year-old son joined the militia underage, and she works long weeks away from her children, supported by party and neighborhood solidarity. She views the revolution as providing opportunities to solve women’s problems and challenge U.S. government myths about Nicaragua.

Kane led England to a 4-3 penalty shootout win over Colombia after a 1-1 draw, scoring the opener and his penalty. England faces Sweden in the quarter-final on Saturday. Kane tweeted full focus on that match. Kieran Trippier praised the team's spirit. Radamel Falcao accused the American referee of bias towards England, and Diego Maradona called the result a monumental theft.

Between 24 and 48 weeks, AE rates were 33.8% (Primary SOC), 40.8% (Secondary SOC), and 38.6% (Continued Additional Educational Program). Related AEs were 2.5%, 4.5%, and 3.9%; serious AEs were 11.8%, 13.5%, and 14.0%; discontinuation AEs were 2.3%, 3.6%, and 1.0%. Bleeding events were 4.1%, 4.0%, and 3.2%; major bleeding was 0.7%, 0.4%, and 0.3%. Two fatal bleedings occurred. Overall, 24 deaths were reported; no pregnancies or hepatic/renal signals were found. The study showed high adherence up to 48 weeks; the educational program provided no additional benefit.

Hinsdale South High School seniors were named Illinois State Scholars, a program recognizing top 10% of state graduates based on ACT/SAT scores, unweighted GPA, and class size. The passage lists the named scholars.

Retirees and FIRE individuals are very likely to go broke without a large margin of safety due to sequence of returns risk, high withdrawal rates, and poor diversification. The 4% rule, introduced by William Bengen, is a benchmark for withdrawal rates but may be insufficient for FIREs with longer time horizons. Diversification can offset higher withdrawal rates, but correlations change. Edward Thorp recommends a 2% inflation-adjusted spending limit for perpetual payouts. Mitigating sequence risk requires a conservative withdrawal rate, diversification, and living moderately.

An Appleton couple, Andrea and Luke Benrud, are gaining national attention to promote CPR training after Luke used skills from a Red Cross class to keep Andrea alive for seven minutes when she collapsed from a rare heart defect. Their story was featured by People Magazine, and they hope sharing it encourages others to learn CPR.

A Grand Rapids Police officer pressed his rifle muzzle into a suspect's head during an August arrest, a violation caught on video. Despite the prosecutor stating the action is not trained or condoned, the officer will not face criminal charges. The suspect, a drunk man in a mistaken-identity case, was arrested for resisting arrest. The officer resigned after being reported by other officers.

Analysts expect the European Central Bank to temper expectations for a quick exit from its stimulus programme due to threats to economic growth and sluggish inflation, while keeping interest rates at historic lows and maintaining a September expiry date for its bond-buying scheme.

A 33-year-old Lancaster Township man was charged with drug and child endangerment offenses after police found two marijuana plants, controlled substances, and drug paraphernalia in his home. He was released on $20,000 unsecured bail. The passage also reports charges against three other individuals for indecent assault, corruption of minors, and burglary with assault.

Companies use exhibitions to improve brand image and get feedback, requiring experienced hosts. Recruitment agencies are expensive with limited databases. Online agency Professionate provides a global platform for companies and job seekers, offering access to profiles with ratings, allowing direct hiring. It also benefits agencies and candidates seeking temporary event jobs.

This study examined sex differences in the correlation between self-reported (PCL-5) and clinician-administered (CAPS-5) PTSD assessments in 100 participants. Females showed a stronger correlation (Rho=0.907) than males (Rho=0.655). Males had significant deviation from the ideal regression line and a higher proportion of misclassified PTSD cases (26.8%) compared to females (11.4%). Civilian trauma showed stronger correlation than military trauma.

Two years of war in Yemen may deny 4.5 million children an education, as over 73% of teachers (166,000) have gone unpaid since October 2016, increasing risks of child marriage and recruitment as soldiers. The crisis stems from the government moving the central bank from Houthi-controlled Sanaa, with both sides blaming each other for payment disruptions.

A Channel 4 documentary, "The Super Orgasm," features five women who claim to have up to 100 orgasms per session. Experiments measured arousal, brain waves, and brain blood flow, but experts criticize the term "super orgasm" as unscientific and misleading, noting the study lacked controls and that multiple orgasms are variable and not a standard to aspire to.

Suppose S ⊆ ℝ, c ∈ S, and f: S → ℝ. If c is not a cluster point of S, then f is continuous at c. If c is a cluster point of S, then f is continuous at c iff lim_{x→c} f(x) = f(c). Also, f is continuous at c iff for every sequence (x_n) in S with x_n → c, f(x_n) → f(c).

A second generic version of the abortion pill mifepristone was approved by the FDA. Amgen reported that its cholesterol-lowering injection Repatha reduced heart disease death, heart attacks, and strokes in a 12,000-patient trial.

Cover 3 is a zone defense with four underneath and three deep players, balancing deep and underneath coverage. It is common at all levels of football. The defense uses three deep defenders (free safety and two cornerbacks) covering three deep zones, with four underneath defenders (linebackers and strong safety). Its strengths include balanced pass and run defense. Weaknesses include vulnerability in the flats, to four verticals, and on the perimeter against the run. Variations include flipping safeties, Cover 3 Fire Zone, Cover 3 Buzz, and pattern reading coverage like Rip/Liz.

The President transmitted documents and correspondence related to the Treaty of Guadalupe Hidalgo, including instructions to U.S. commissioners, who were sent to Mexico solely to obtain ratification of the treaty as amended by the Senate. The Mexican Congress ratified the treaty without modification before the commissioners held any conferences. The protocol, containing explanations of the amendments, was not regarded as modifying the treaty. The President considered the protocol consistent with the treaty and took no action on it.

In re Beechwood, the district court ruled that John Jacob Beechwood was not a farmer under the Bankruptcy Act on the dates he committed acts of bankruptcy (September 20 and October 10, 1940). On those dates, his principal income came from his job as a lawyer and business manager, not from farming, which was only an avocational interest. The court ordered him adjudicated a bankrupt.

The Times reported that Trump campaign chairman Paul Manafort was among Trump associates picked up on Russian intelligence calls, which Manafort denied. U.S. officials suspect Russia involved in election cyber-attacks to help Trump, which Russia denies. Rep. Cummings found the report alarming. The report followed Michael Flynn's resignation over calls with Russia's ambassador about U.S. sanctions. Press Secretary Spicer said nothing indicated changed circumstances regarding campaign contacts with Russia.

The passage is a memorandum from S. E. Mezes regarding the work of "The Inquiry," outlining tasks for a peace conference, including establishing boundaries, setting up governments, and economic arrangements, with specific regions listed where these tasks will or may be undertaken.

Amazon is planning to cut up to 15% of its human resources staff, with additional layoffs likely in other divisions, according to sources. The PXT division has over 10,000 employees. The cuts are part of cost reduction efforts while investing in AI. Amazon declined to comment.

The passage is an inaugural address emphasizing the enduring strength of the Constitution, the American creed of equality and unalienable rights, and the need for collective action to meet new challenges. It calls for unity to address economic recovery, climate change, healthcare, education, and social justice, asserting that freedom and prosperity require shared responsibility and adherence to founding principles.

A study in the *Journal of Hematology & Thromboembolic Diseases* found that Bt toxins in GM crops caused hematotoxicity in mice, including anemia and abnormal lymphocyte patterns consistent with leukemia. The toxins damaged mammalian red blood cells and suppressed bone marrow proliferation, with effects increasing over 72 hours. The researchers concluded it is premature to deem these toxins safe for mammals.

For December, Kia offers a $5,000 factory discount on the 2017 Optima Hybrid in Western states, or $4,000 elsewhere, with a 0-percent APR option. Kia also leases the Optima Plug-In at $249/month for 36 months with $1,999 down, plus government incentives. The 2017 Hyundai Sonata Plug-In Hybrid leases at $289/month with $1,699 due at signing in California. The 2017 Chevrolet Volt leases at $273/month for 39 months with $500 down. The 2017 Kia Soul EV offers an $18,100 discount or a $159/month lease for 36 months with $1,999 down. The 2018 Chevrolet Bolt EV leases at $303/month for 36 months. The 2018 Chevrolet Equinox Diesel offers $4,000 off nationwide. The 2017 Toyota Yaris iA has $2,000 off, priced at about $15,000, limited to Southern California.

H H Martyn & Co, founded in 1888 in Cheltenham, closed in 1971. The firm excelled in diverse craftsmanship, including aeroplanes, cars, ship fittings, statues, and ironwork. It produced the Marble Arch gates, held a Royal Warrant, and completed global commissions like the Cenotaph and Selfridges frontage. By 1910 it employed over 1,000 people. It fitted out ocean liners including the Titanic, and during WWI began making planes, leading to the Gloster Aircraft Company. It also built parts for Sir Henry Segrave's land speed record car. After being bought by Maples, the company was closed due to the decline of Britain's shipbuilding industry.

The report analyzes the global Meat Starter Culture market, covering historical and projected revenues by sector, segment, and region. It profiles key manufacturers, examines market dynamics (drivers, constraints, risks, opportunities), and includes segmentation by product type (Maturation Starters, Surface Starters) and application (Meat, Poultry, Seafood, Others). Geographically, it covers the US, China, Europe, Japan, Southeast Asia, India, and the Rest of World from 2018 to 2025.

In 1826, Captain Thomas ap Catesby Jones negotiated the first treaty between Hawaii and a foreign power, though unratified by the U.S. Subsequent U.S. naval visits included Captain Finch in 1829, bearing a presidential letter, and Commodore Downs in 1831, who interceded for persecuted Catholic converts. French and British interventions followed: a French treaty in 1839 introduced liquor, and in 1843, Lord George Paulet seized the islands, forcing a deed of cession. Commodore Kearney protested, and Rear-Admiral Thomas restored Hawaiian sovereignty on July 31, 1843.

On September 9, 2020, Amazon.com, Inc. elected General (Ret.) Keith B. Alexander as a director and appointed him to the Audit Committee. He was granted a restricted stock unit award for 288 shares vesting in three annual installments starting November 15, 2021, and entered into an indemnification agreement.

Network data is common in many fields, and community detection, which groups densely connected nodes, is a key task. A popular method is the stochastic block model (SBM), but most methods require pre-specifying the number of communities, which can be inconsistent. This paper proposes a recursive bipartitioning framework using a Bayes factor stopping rule, which is computationally tractable and does not require pre-specifying the number of communities. The framework is demonstrated on three model classes: stochastic block models, edge exchangeable models, and latent space models.

Progress Software held its Q3 2025 earnings call on September 29, 2025, with President and CEO Yogesh Gupta and CFO Anthony Folger. The call included forward-looking statements and used non-GAAP financial measures.

A study suggests the exoplanet WASP-121b has a stratosphere, detected via water molecule signatures from Hubble data. The planet is a hot Jupiter with atmospheric temperatures reaching 4,500°F. This is the strongest evidence yet for an exoplanet stratosphere, showing a common solar system trait exists elsewhere.

Winthrop University will receive $1.1 million from a $20 million NSF grant for research on complex materials, funding 36 summer student research experiences, $330,000 for equipment, faculty research, and summer teacher workshops.

The NHS Constitution, or Patient Charter, outlines patients' legal rights (e.g., free care, equal access, waiting time standards, quality and safety, NICE-recommended treatments, consent, choice, complaints) and NHS pledges, alongside patient responsibilities (e.g., maintaining health, respecting staff, following treatment plans). It aims to ensure fair, transparent, and accountable care, emphasizing partnership and shared responsibility.

The passage discusses the physical and emotional toll of a playoff series, adjustments due to lineup changes, player performance, resilience, and coaching strategies, including managing ice time and player roles.

The passage describes the Average True Range (ATR) as a volatility indicator used for stop-loss placement, position sizing, and identifying breakouts. It explains calculating ATR in Python using the pandas_ta library and backtests a simple strategy on SPY: buying when volatility is high and selling when low. The backtest results show the strategy performs better risk-adjusted but has similar drawdown to buy-and-hold, suggesting pairing ATR with other indicators may improve results.

A University of Bristol study found the chloroplast lineage split from its cyanobacterial ancestor over 2.1 billion years ago in low-salinity environments, with symbiosis occurring 200 million years later. Marine algae diversified around 800–750 million years ago, suggesting complex algae first evolved in freshwater.

The neo-Nazi website Daily Stormer was removed from GoDaddy's domain registration service after posting a mocking article about Heather Heyer, killed in Charlottesville. It then moved to Google, which also terminated its registration for violating terms of service. The site remains active, and its host is obscured by Cloudflare. The site's founder, Andrew Anglin, faces a lawsuit from the Southern Poverty Law Center for harassment, and his current location is unknown.

The next ISS spacewalk is scheduled for August 17, starting at 10.00am EDT, with Russian cosmonauts Fyodor Yurchikhin and Sergey Ryazanskiy. The six-hour mission includes deploying five nanosatellites, scraping residue samples, and attaching handrails. It is the only spacewalk planned during Expedition 52.

A retrospective cohort study at Mulago National Referral Hospital, Uganda, estimated the direct cost of managing a child with measles. The average direct health care cost per patient was 33.13 USD, and the average overhead cost was 81.37 USD. Mortality was 11.3%, with severe pneumonia as the most common complication. Higher costs were associated with male gender, comorbidities, longer hospital stays, and death.

Anne-Marie D'Amico, an Invesco employee, was identified as one of 10 people killed in the Toronto van attack. Nine others died and 15 were injured. Alex Minassian was arrested and is due in court. Police are investigating the motive. The attack occurred on Yonge Street and Finch Avenue at 1.30pm ET. A witness video shows Minassian pointing an object at police before being arrested. Police Chief Mark Saunders said the attack "definitely appeared deliberate."

This application discloses a recommendation model training method and apparatus. The method selects positive samples from a sample set for a training set, calculates sampling probabilities for negative samples using a preset algorithm based on rules involving score differences, vector distances, and indicator variations, selects negative samples based on these probabilities, and trains a recommendation model using the training set.

The A100 GPU supports PCIe Gen 4, doubling bandwidth to 31.5 GB/sec, and SR-IOV for virtualizing a single PCIe connection. It includes improved error/fault detection, isolation, and containment. New asynchronous copy and barrier instructions are introduced. CUDA Task Graphs are accelerated. It has 40 GB of HBM2 memory with 1555 GB/sec bandwidth and a 40 MB L2 cache. The new MIG capability partitions the GPU into up to seven instances. Third-generation NVLink provides 600 GB/sec total bandwidth.

It details guest and hypervisor interactions, error handling, and initialization examples.

NVIDIA Corporation, SoftBank Group Capital Limited, and SVF Holdco (UK) Limited mutually terminated their Share Purchase Agreement for Arm Limited on February 8, 2022, due to significant regulatory challenges. The Sellers will retain the $1.25 billion prepaid by NVIDIA, which will retain its 20-year Arm license. NVIDIA will record a $1.36 billion charge in Q1 of fiscal year 2023.

The "High/Low" zone offense combines an outside three-player passing attack with an inside high/low rotation, initiated from almost any alignment. It creates matchup problems for zone defenses by moving two interior players, leading to open outside shots when the defense collapses. The offense includes a weakside attack and requires sharp passing. The passage details basic continuity, post roll and flash options, various entries (Dribble Clear, 1-4 Slice, Mid Screen, Horns), and specials (Pin Down, Weakside Double, Vegas) for late-clock situations.

Charlie Tillett, a former CFO and MIT Sloan graduate, presented on creating business plan financials. He emphasized that financials are a "scorecard" to understand key business assumptions and cash needs. He discussed venture capital expectations (3-5x returns, 5-7 year horizon), equity dilution through funding rounds, and the importance of aligning investor capital with market opportunity. Tillett provided a framework for building financial projections, including income statements, cost of goods sold, staffing plans, and cash flow proxies. He advised using bottom-up sales projections, avoiding business plan software, and ensuring all founders' equity vests over time.

This paper presents a solution for analyzing instant messaging data in criminal investigations, combining knowledge graphs, speech-to-text transcription, and entity extraction to enable semantic search. The approach was tested in two real-world investigations, with feedback from investigators indicating its usefulness, though limitations in the entity extraction pipeline were noted.

AQTWM, Inc. filed a preliminary prospectus for an IPO of common shares in Canadian provinces (except Québec), led by TD Securities, Canaccord Genuity, and RBC Capital Markets. The number of shares and price are undetermined, and completion is not assured. The offering is not available in the U.S. Aqua Terra provides water disposal services to oil and gas producers in Canada and the U.S.

The professor discusses the final exam logistics and then reviews coding for bandwidth-limited channels, focusing on lattice constellations, shaping gain, and trellis codes. Shaping gain is limited to 1.53 dB, achieved by using an n-sphere region. Lattices like hexagonal, D4, E8, and Barnes-Wall offer coding gains but suffer from high numbers of nearest neighbors, limiting effective gain. Trellis codes, introduced by Ungerboeck, use set partitioning and convolutional codes to achieve coding gains of 3-6 dB with moderate complexity. Multi-level coding and bit-interleaved coded modulation (BICM) are mentioned as higher-performance schemes approaching the Shannon limit. The professor concludes that coding for the additive white Gaussian noise channel is mature, with research shifting to other areas.

A summit hosted by BlinkRx, which has Donald Trump Jr. as a board member, will occur in early December with drugmakers and Trump administration officials. The agreement between Pfizer and the Trump administration to lower drug prices has prompted other companies to seek similar deals, though the effectiveness of these deals remains unknown.

The speaker presents the fourth and final case study, focusing on their thesis research into manufacturing microfluidic devices using polymers via hot embossing. They discuss the process parameters, material choices, and pattern dependencies affecting replication quality. A simplified linear elastic model is used to simulate embossing topography, showing good correspondence with experimental data. The speaker also addresses challenges like de-molding issues and material anisotropy, and suggests that careful temperature control can mitigate defects.
University officials reinstated Professor Dwayne Dixon after a threat assessment found no basis that he posed a threat or violated policy, following allegations that led to his leave.

The gold-silver chart ratio strategy trades precious metals using their price relationship, calculated by dividing gold's price by silver's. Backtests of a simple strategy on GLD and SLV showed poor performance and erratic equity curves. A pair trade strategy (buying GLD and shorting SLV when the 5-day RSI is above 75, exiting below 50) showed flat development. The ratio is used on a contrarian or mean-reversion basis, but the passage notes difficulty finding robust trading strategies with it.

Hetzner now peers directly at NAP Africa in Isando via a 10Gbps circuit, making its content available to network operators at South African IXPs. This peering, along with JINX, routes over 65% of local traffic through exchange points. Hetzner contributes over 4Gbps of traffic and supports settlement-free peering to reduce costs, latency, and increase network resilience.

A development proposal for 7592 119A St. and several 120 St. properties conflicts with the North Delta Area Plan and Cougar Creek ISMP. The Area Plan allows six storeys, but 35 are proposed. The proposal fails on tree preservation, stormwater management, and lacks space for amenities. The parking garage prevents rainwater infiltration, impacting Cougar Creek. The project does not meet the "low environmental impact" requirement for tax exemptions, causing high environmental impact. The author argues against the proposal, suggesting it would encourage upzoning and speculation, and that highrise condos do not solve housing supply. Acceptable changes would require significant environmental mitigation, including 15% permeable open space for trees and infiltration.

For attestation, the OS should request data via interfaces like SPDM or DPE. Update packages must ensure correct firmware versions exist before updating; if any part fails, the package should not apply. Packages are non-persistent across reboots. Issuing SFS commands requires specific memory alignment and a customer-provided deployment agent. The ASP process verifies signatures, loads the patch, and updates patch level information. The GET_SFS_VERSION_INFO command checks firmware versions. Update packages are binary objects aligned to AGESA releases, and the update process runs in parallel with x86 and DMA traffic with minimal performance impact.
Apple Inc. filed a Form 10-Q for the quarterly period ended June 30, 2018, reporting net sales of $53.3 billion and net income of $11.5 billion for the quarter.

The passage discusses CBCT-to-CT image synthesis using a conditional denoising diffusion probabilistic model (DDPM) for head and neck imaging. It compares this approach to traditional methods (deformable image registration), GANs, and CNN-based models, noting limitations such as training instability and lack of interpretability. The proposed EqDiff-CT method uses a group-equivariant, attention-enhanced U-Net denoiser with a non-adversarial hybrid loss (MSE and SSIM). Evaluated on the SynthRAD2025 dataset, it outperformed baseline diffusion and CycleGAN models across SSIM, PSNR, MSE, and MAE, preserving clinically relevant structures.

The speaker acknowledges their team's mistakes but emphasizes Dallas can play better, noting their strong record after a first-game loss. They focus on preparation, not the past, and analyze Dallas's increased aggression from a previous series. They stress the need to pressure Dallas's skilled players (Modano, Hull, Nieuwendyk) by denying them time. The speaker downplays injuries, calls the rivalry built through competition, and notes the long season. They critique Brian's overplaying, deny game dominance, and blame a missed offside call for a goal but not the loss. They remain calm, seeing the series tied 1-1, and express confidence in playing better in Dallas.

A CDC report shows mosquito, tick, and flea-borne illnesses have tripled in the U.S. since 2004. In Venice, still waters like the canals and Ballona Wetlands are breeding sources for mosquitoes carrying West Nile Virus, which is endemic in Los Angeles County. Most infected people show no symptoms, but some develop nausea, rash, or, rarely, neuroinvasive disease. Local vector control manages standing water, and residents are advised to use insect repellent and eliminate yard water sources.

On Monday, Aug. 21, a solar eclipse will cross the U.S. for the first time in nearly 40 years. Connecticut will see 70% coverage. The Weston Public Library will host events: free solar viewers from Aug. 14, a pinhole projector workshop on Aug. 15, and a NASA live stream on Aug. 21 from 1-3 p.m. The next eclipse is in April 2024.
A model was developed to understand potential sources of influenza A H5 RNA in wastewater, enabling interpretation of H5 RNA detections.

The SteelSeries Arctis GameBuds (9/10, WIRED Recommends) are discounted to $128 at Amazon. They offer portability, compatibility with Xbox or PlayStation, Switch, PC, and smartphones, low-latency 2.4GHz audio via a USB-C dongle, Bluetooth, 10-hour bud battery life (40 total with case), a mobile app with game-specific equalizer settings, comfortable fit with physical buttons, and sound isolation.

Two Zn-based metal inorganic-organic complex (MIOC) crystals, MIOC-4 and MIOC-7, were synthesized and melt-quenched into glasses. Their melting points (440 K and 508 K) and glass transition temperatures (282 K and 359 K) were measured. A binary mixed-crystal system with tunable thermal properties was created by varying the ligand ratio. Structural analysis showed that vitrification preserves short-range Zn-ligand correlations but disrupts medium- and long-range order. The approach was extended to other metal nodes and anions. MIOC-7 glass exhibited enhanced photoluminescence with a quantum yield of 3.4%, compared to 1.2% for the crystal.

James Harden scored 60 points, 10 rebounds, and 11 assists, becoming the first NBA player with a 60-point triple-double, leading the short-handed Houston Rockets to a 114-107 win over the Orlando Magic.

This patent application describes an exercise system, specifically a treadmill, with networked capabilities for streaming live or on-demand exercise classes. The treadmill includes a deck with a continuous track and slats, posts, arms with separate rotary controls for different functions (e.g., incline and speed), and a display. The system enables real-time interaction between users and instructors, performance metric tracking, and gamification features. The application details the machine's hardware, including rotary and linear controls, sensors, and a control architecture, as well as user interfaces for class selection and performance display.

The Socket 940 has an allowable outline with dimensions in millimeters. Its cover accommodates the package pin shoulder and fillet, with a seating plane flatness better than 0.25 mm. The socket base and cover are made from Liquid Crystal Polymer (UL 94 V-0). The cover thickness must not exceed 1.17 mm, and flatness must remain under 0.25 mm. Markings include "SOCKET 940," a locked/unlocked directional designator, a triangular orientation symbol, a UL symbol, and a lot traceability number. Contacts are high-strength copper alloy, plated with 1.27-µm nickel and 0.76-µm gold. Solder balls are 63/37 tin/lead, 0.76 mm diameter, with a co-planarity requirement of 0.20 mm. The actuation lever is stainless steel. Insertion/extraction forces with the lever open must not exceed 2 kgf; with the lever closed, minimum extraction force is 0.013 kgf per pin. Actuation force must be less than 3.6 kgf. Pin displacement during actuation must be less than 1.0 mm. The socket must endure 50 actuation cycles. Visual inspections require no missing or damaged parts. Electrical specifications include a 1.5 A current rating, initial and final LLCR not exceeding 25 mΩ, inductance less than 4 nH, capacitance less than 1 pF, differential impedance of 100 Ω ± 10%, propagation delay skew less than 10 ps, dielectric withstanding voltage of 650 Vac, and insulation resistance of 1000 MΩ.

The passage outlines coaching methods for implementing an early offense and press break, emphasizing precise execution, the "Whole-Part-Whole" teaching method, and developing player skills through progressive drills. It stresses practicing against tough defense, scouting opponents, and using disruptive defense to enhance early offense effectiveness.

The speaker highlights a player's calmness and mental resilience after losing a game, noting similarities between two players in faceoff skills and footwork. Both teams are described as strong defensively, physical, and hard to play against, with similar styles. Discipline after the whistle is emphasized, and the team's identity is based on a team-first approach. The need for two good goalies due to schedule and travel is acknowledged.

A Kentucky valedictorian and student council president gave their graduation speeches via bullhorn outside the ceremony after a Catholic diocese rejected them as untimely and political. The valedictorian, who is gay, said the snub gave his speech a national audience. His speech praised Florida students' gun law activism and argued young people must speak candidly.

The Trump administration's goal to hire hundreds of new government lawyers is progressing slowly. Hiring of assistant US attorneys from January through August is down by more than half compared to the same period in the previous four years, based on LinkedIn data. The slowdown is attributed to budget pressures, political turmoil, hiring freezes, and low morale. Some offices are making a hiring push, but the DOJ has not lowered standards.

The GA10x GPU enhances Async Compute by allowing concurrent RT Core and graphics or compute workloads per SM, enabling scenarios like compute-based denoising with RT Core ray tracing. The second-generation RT Core doubles ray/triangle intersection rates and adds an Interpolate Triangle Position unit for hardware-accelerated ray-traced motion blur, achieving up to 8x faster rendering than Turing. The lecture discusses additive energy, defined as the number of quadruples (a1, a2, b1, b2) from sets A and B in an Abelian group satisfying a1 + b1 = a2 + b2. Small doubling implies large additive energy, but the converse fails. The Balog-Szemerédi-Gowers theorem states that if a set has large additive energy, then there exists a large subset with small doubling. The proof uses a graphical version involving a bipartite graph G between A and B, where a restricted sumset is defined. He acknowledges the recent heated presidential contest but notes calm followed the majority's will. He supports popular sovereignty for territories on slavery, deferring to the Supreme Court on timing. He condemns agitation over slavery as harmful and warns against disunion, emphasizing free trade's value. Synaptics announced plans to mass produce an optical in-display fingerprint sensor called "Clear ID," which is embedded under a phone's screen for bezel-less designs. The company claims it is twice as fast as 3D facial recognition and allows unlocking from any angle. Synaptics aims to compete with major companies, noting consumer preference for front fingerprint authentication.

The Lumberjacks (14-6) defeated Thief River Falls 77-45, led by 18 points from Caden Rolfes and 17 from Linaes Whiting. Bemidji took a 45-25 halftime lead. Caleb Carlson scored 14 points with eight rebounds, and Jeremy Beberg added 10 points with seven rebounds.

The passage discusses container patterns for distributed systems, including sidecars, ambassadors, adapters, replicated load-balanced services, sharded services, and scatter/gather patterns. It emphasizes modularity, reusability, and stable APIs for containers, with examples of deploying these patterns using Kubernetes, Redis, Memcache, nginx, and other tools. Florida State University President John Thrasher has appointed a 15-member committee, chaired by Renisha Gibbs, to review the university's policy on campus names and markers, including statues. The panel was formed following a national movement to remove Confederate designations and will seek public input.

The NVIDIA A100 Tensor Core GPU, based on the Ampere architecture, is designed for diverse compute-intensive workloads in cloud data centers, including AI, HPC, and data analytics. It introduces Multi-Instance GPU (MIG) for secure partitioning into up to seven instances, third-generation Tensor Cores with support for new data types (TF32, BF16, FP64) and sparsity for up to 2x throughput doubling, 40 GB of HBM2 memory with 1555 GB/sec bandwidth, a 40 MB L2 cache, and third-generation NVLink with 600 GB/sec total bandwidth. The A100 delivers significant performance improvements over the V100, including up to 2.5x FP16/FP32 mixed-precision Tensor Core performance and up to 20x INT8 inference performance with sparsity. It also features hardware JPEG decode, optical flow accelerator, and enhanced error detection. CUDA 11 supports new features like asynchronous copy, asynchronous barriers, task graph acceleration, and L2 cache residency controls.

Federal employees say air travel remains safe despite the government shutdown, but expect more delays and cancellations. Essential workers like air traffic controllers and TSA agents are working without pay, causing strain, reduced efficiency, and slowed repairs. Some projects have stopped due to furloughed colleagues. Workers feel undervalued and fear mass firings or union decertification. Officials warn that controllers who don't show up could be fired, but safety-critical positions are exempt from reductions in force.

The 23rd BMO Okanagan Marathon in Kelowna expects up to 3,000 participants, featuring marathon, half marathon, 10K, and 5K runs. The flat, Boston-qualifying course runs along Okanagan Lake. New this year are a timed 5K and a beverage garden. Events run Saturday and Sunday from City Park, with walk-up registration at the Sports Expo. The event supports The Sunshine Foundation of Canada.

A method for operating a surgical system to place a screw in a vertebral body. The system includes a manipulator, a screw with a coaxial sleeve, a navigation system with an insertion trajectory, and controllers. The method involves positioning the screw and sleeve on the trajectory, advancing both to penetrate soft tissue, and then advancing the screw relative to the sleeve to secure it to the vertebra and disengage it from the sleeve.

Anjuna police registered two unnatural death cases involving tourists from Tamil Nadu and Kerala. One man collapsed at Vagator and died; the other was brought to a hospital by an unknown person. Drug overdose is possible. Bodies were sent for autopsy, and viscera will be preserved. Police are investigating.

A New York panel unanimously recommended that the state Medicaid program pause coverage of Sarepta Therapeutics' Duchenne muscular dystrophy treatment, Elevidys, due to a safety controversy. The board advised waiting for the FDA to update the product labeling and for the state to evaluate a new regimen to mitigate liver failure risk. The state will still cover some patients under 21 on a case-by-case basis.

The London Lightning delivered a poor, unfocused performance in a crucial game, losing 123-110 to the St. John’s Edge, tying their best-of-seven series 2-2. The Edge played with intensity and adjusted their lineup, while the Lightning struggled defensively, missed free throws, and showed a lack of discipline, including a confrontation between teammates. Coach Keith Vassell took responsibility for the team's lack of preparation.

A video of mothers and their children with Down's syndrome, inspired by Carpool Karaoke, has been viewed over 600,000 times. The video, made for World Down's Syndrome Day, features the song "A Thousand Years" and was created by a Facebook group called "DesignerGenes". James Corden and Christina Perri praised the video.

The passage discusses distance education in Turkey during the pandemic, focusing on Turkish teachers' experiences. A study of 20 teachers found that while 45% saw progress, most found distance education insufficiently efficient due to infrastructure and material shortages. Key problems included lack of student equipment, multiple school-age children per household, and attendance issues. Teachers primarily used phones and WhatsApp for communication. The study concluded that teachers were not fully ready for distance education and recommended resolving infrastructure problems, updating EBA, and using distance education to support face-to-face learning.

Topshop has removed all till display stands from its stores after a 10-year-old boy, Kaden Reddick, died from head injuries caused by one in Reading. The store remains closed, and police are investigating.

In his inaugural address, the speaker calls for unity and peace, emphasizing a moment of historical opportunity. He notes America's material wealth but spiritual crisis, urging a turn from divisive rhetoric to simple values. He advocates for government and people working together, domestic racial equality, open international relations, and peaceful competition. The FDA announced a crackdown on illegal Juul e-cigarette sales to minors, including undercover blitzes, 40 violation warnings, and requests for documents on youth appeal. Juul, popular among teens, contains high nicotine levels. The FDA warned retailers and took action against online listings.

Diana Beresford-Kroeger, a scientist with degrees in botany and medical biochemistry, lives on a 160-acre property in Merrickville, Canada, which she and her husband developed into an arboretum. Orphaned at 11, she was taught Irish laws of nature. Her Bioplan proposes planting one tree per person annually for six years to reduce atmospheric carbon dioxide from 400 to 300 parts per million. Her film "Call of the Forest" addresses deforestation and climate change, has garnered large audiences, and is based on her book "The Global Forest."

Ravita Meghwar, a Hindu girl from a Pakistani village, was allegedly abducted and forcibly converted to Islam, though she claims she eloped willingly. Such cases have increased in Sindh province, alarming the Hindu minority (2% of Pakistan's population). Conversions are often backed by powerful religious groups, and courts typically accept the girl's testimony of free will. A 2016 Sindh bill outlawing forced conversions and underage conversions was not signed into law due to opposition from hardline groups. Activists now use underage marriage laws to challenge cases. Mass conversions of lower-caste Hindu families also occur, with seminaries offering incentives. This has led some Hindus to leave villages or migrate to India, though exact numbers are unclear.

The speaker describes a coach as tough but honest, praises the opponent's defense and depth, reflects on his team's chance and the excitement of playing in Canada, comments on goalies' size and skill, highlights his team's forward depth, discusses age, and explains why a player isn't more famous due to market size.

A student author describes how a first job improved his academic performance and confidence, arguing that youth employment programs reduce crime and benefit communities. He notes high NEET rates, especially among males and African Americans, and calls for government incentives to expand job opportunities for young people.

The speaker reflects on their team's self-inflicted mistakes in the third period, which they describe as "ripping our own hearts out." They emphasize that these errors are correctable and that the team's focus is on winning the next game to bring the series back home. They contrast their situation with past comebacks, noting that unlike those series, the opposing goaltender is not the primary obstacle. For over 50 years, Saturday night has been the key ratings battleground between BBC1 and ITV. Winning this slot, especially for the BBC, demonstrates it takes its entertainment remit seriously. Getting a new show to work in this competitive slot is difficult, so it is mainly filled by old favourites. Only a few entertainment shows have taken off and stayed over the decades, and it is hard to name a successful new show created in the last decade. The financial rewards for creating the next big show are enormous, but a high proportion of new shows fail.
