Nearly 1.7% of opioid patients become long-term users, but risk rises up to 9 times for prior opioid use disorders.

German Chancellor Angela Merkel agreed to a deal creating asylum "transit camps" along three Austrian borders to save her coalition, following a revolt by Bavarian allies led by Interior Minister Horst Seehofer, who faced pressure from the far-right AfD party. The deal allows Germany to send rejected asylum seekers back to their countries or Austria, but Austria and Italy have threatened to reject returned migrants, risking the EU's open-border system.

The passage details the NVIDIA A100 Tensor Core GPU, based on the Ampere architecture, highlighting its performance improvements over the V100 GPU. Key features include third-generation Tensor Cores supporting all DL data types (TF32, FP16, BF16, INT8, INT4, binary, FP64), fine-grained structured sparsity for 2x throughput, Multi-Instance GPU (MIG) for partitioning into up to seven secure instances, third-generation NVLink with 600 GB/s total bandwidth, PCIe Gen 4, and a 40 MB L2 cache. The A100 delivers up to 2.5x FP16 Tensor Core performance, 2.5x FP64 performance, and 20x sparse INT8 performance over V100. It also includes new CUDA 11 features like asynchronous copy, asynchronous barriers, and task graph acceleration.

The speaker reviews binary detection in communication systems, focusing on simplifying the problem to a single bit transmission with Gaussian noise. Detection involves using a known probability model to minimize error via maximum a posteriori (MAP) decoding, which compares likelihood ratios to a threshold. For antipodal signals (plus or minus a), the log likelihood ratio simplifies to a function of the observation, and error probability depends on the signal-to-noise ratio. The speaker extends this to vector signals in white Gaussian noise, where the sufficient statistic is the inner product of the received vector with the signal vector, leading to the same error probability formula.

The NPD Group identified five 2018 trends for Britain's £57 billion foodservice industry: click & collect via smartphones; investing in staff for higher satisfaction and profits; tiered, personalized VIP loyalty schemes; avoiding over-promising and under-delivering; and using recommendations from staff and data to personalize choices.
Three chemists were awarded the Nobel Prize for Chemistry for creating metal-organic frameworks, which can harvest water or store toxic gases and may help solve major challenges.

The plaintiffs sold a horse to the defendant, who took it twice, used it, and returned it before it died. The court found for the plaintiffs, rejecting the defendant's claims of a trial agreement, statute of frauds violation, and breach of warranty. The judgment was affirmed.

Amazon.com, Inc. filed a Form 10-Q for the quarterly period ended September 30, 2020, reporting net income of $6.3 billion for Q3 2020 and $14.1 billion for the first nine months of 2020. Total net sales were $96.1 billion for Q3 2020 and $260.5 billion for the nine-month period. The company had $68.4 billion in cash, cash equivalents, and marketable securities as of September 30, 2020.

The rocket had successfully launched a supply ship to the ISS. Roscosmos attributed the death to difficult meteorological conditions and a strong gust of wind. The two men were debris-clearing employees of NPO Mashinostroyeniya.

The NVIDIA Ampere architecture-based GA102 GPU, fabricated on Samsung's 8nm process, includes 28.3 billion transistors and features programmable shading cores, RT cores, and Tensor cores. It doubles FP32 processing per clock compared to Turing, with 30 TFLOPS for shader processing in the RTX 3080. Second-generation RT cores double ray/triangle intersection throughput, and third-generation Tensor cores support sparsity for up to 2x throughput. The architecture includes GDDR6X memory, PCIe Gen 4, and NVLink support. The RTX 3080 offers up to 2x ray tracing performance over the RTX 2080 Super, while the RTX 3090 delivers over 35 FP32 TFLOPS. The A40 and RTX A6000 are optimized for data center and workstation applications, respectively.

The Princeton offense is an unstructured, motion-based style relying on constant movement and defensive reads, with the back door cut as its signature. It requires unselfish, skilled players and coach commitment. Spacing of 12-15 feet spreads the defense. The offense uses various entries, exchanges, and post actions, emphasizing ball control, patience, and outside shooting. It is adaptable to any defense and provides psychological advantages by creating pressure in low-possession games.

They highlight a shorthanded goal, strong team play with four lines, effective neutral zone defense, and a key player's confidence and big-game performance. A court held that objections to witness competency must be specific; general claims of incompetence are insufficient. An interested witness may testify against a deceased's administrator about property descriptions, reliance on representations, and property condition, but not about personal transactions with the deceased. The court affirmed the dismissal of the plaintiff's petition and the denial of a motion to retax costs against the administrator individually.

Volunteers gather baseline data on the near-threatened platypus through surveys in southern NSW and the ACT, especially in late winter. Four years of data on the Upper Murrumbidgee River show stable numbers. Citizen science is crucial for monitoring, as the species faces decline from habitat change, reduced flows, and waste.

The socket identifier "SOCKET 940" must be molded on the socket cover. A locked/unlocked directional designator and a triangular orientation symbol are also molded on the cover. The supplier's UL symbol and a lot traceability number must be visible after soldering. Contacts are high-strength copper alloy, plated with 1.27-µm nickel and 0.76-µm gold. Solder balls are 63/37 tin-lead, 0.76 mm diameter, with a 0.20 mm co-planarity requirement. The actuation lever is stainless steel. Insertion/extraction force must not exceed 2 kgf; closed-position extraction force is minimum 0.013 kgf per pin. Actuation force must be less than 3.6 kgf. Pin displacement must be less than 1.0 mm. Socket must endure 50 actuations. Visual inspections are at 1X magnification. No missing or damaged contacts, solder balls, or cover/base defects are allowed. Contact current rating is 1.5 A with less than 30°C rise. Initial and final LLCR must not exceed 25 mΩ. Self-inductance is less than 4 nH; loop inductance is 3 nH ± 10%. Capacitance is less than 1 pF. Differential impedance is 100 Ω ± 10%. Propagation delay skew is less than 10 ps. Dielectric withstanding voltage is minimum 650 Vac. Insulation resistance is minimum 1000 MΩ.

Xiaomi moved these to the bottom on the Mi Mix 2s, while Apple added a notch to the iPhone X, which many followed. Vivo's Apex concept uses an under-screen fingerprint sensor and a pop-up camera to eliminate bezels, though it adds cost and bulk. The Clark County School District Board of Trustees voted Dr. Jesus Jara as the new superintendent on May 2, 2018. Jara, previously deputy superintendent for Orange County Public Schools in Orlando since 2012, had clashed with unions in Monroe County over raises and furloughs. The board was split, with some supporting internal candidate Dr. Mike Barton, who was defeated in a 4-3 vote. Jara won after further debate, and the board hopes he will begin in June.

This command moves SNP guest pages within system physical address space, requiring 4K contiguous pages for 2M pages, which must be 2M aligned. DMA is unsupported during migration. Source pages must be Guest-Valid or Guest-Invalid; destination pages must be Pre-Migration. After migration, destinations take source states, sources return to Pre-Migration. Firmware performs 15 steps per entry, including checks and TLB operations. The command marks end of migration strings, with optional interrupt on completion. Errors in command format, list entries, ring buffer, or hardware are reported via status registers or MCA. Commands operate on up to 128 pages; hardware errors may make all pages unrecoverable.

The passage discusses the use of gamification in academic education, presenting four projects at the University of Wrocław. It argues that gamification can increase student motivation and knowledge retention by using game mechanics like points, levels, and competition. The projects included a location-based game on cultural education, a five-day gamified seminar on career management, a location-based game on entrepreneurship, and a LARP game for soft skills. Results showed high student engagement and effective learning, but also highlighted challenges such as high preparation effort for instructors and the need for clear rules and appropriate complexity. The summary concludes that simple, well-designed games are effective for curricula, while complex games are better for subsidized projects.

The passage argues that zero tobacco deaths is the only acceptable goal, blaming the tobacco industry for marketing an addictive, deadly product while noting progress like the Cape Town Declaration, which over 150 organizations have endorsed.

Eddie Woo, a Sydney maths teacher, gained fame through his YouTube channel "Wootube" and awards, including being named Australia's Local Hero for 2018 and a top 10 finalist in the Global Teacher Prize. He became a 'master teacher' with the NSW Department of Education, mentoring students and teachers while retaining his role at Cherrybrook Technology High School. His videos, started in 2012 for a sick student, have over 200,000 subscribers and 12 million views.

The U.S. IRS announced inflation-adjusted 2026 tax brackets and deductions. The standard deduction rises to $32,200 for married couples, $16,100 for single filers, and $24,150 for heads of household. The top 37% rate applies to incomes above $640,600 (individuals) and $768,700 (couples). The estate tax exemption increases to $15 million. A new $6,000 deduction for taxpayers aged 65+ begins in 2025. Analysts view the adjustments as a middle-ground approach offering relief without significantly reducing federal revenues.

The New Jersey Supreme Court affirmed the denial of costs and counsel fees in both cases. In the arbitration case, the suit was not within the scope of the Anti-Injunction Act. In the strike case, the injunction was reversed on procedural grounds, not because the suit was meritless, so the mandatory fee provision did not apply.

The Sansa Fuze is a portable digital audio/video player with a 1.9” color screen, FM tuner, built-in microphone, and microSDHC card slot. It supports MP3, WMA, secure WMA, audiobooks, MPEG4 video, and photos via Sansa Media Converter. The internal rechargeable battery lasts up to 24 hours for audio or 5 hours for video. The device includes a Hold Switch, thumbwheel navigation, and can be connected to a computer via USB for charging, file transfer, and firmware updates. Music can be transferred via drag-and-drop or Windows Media Player. The player supports music playback with repeat, shuffle, and EQ options, audiobook chapter and speed controls, video playback with bookmarks, and photo slideshows with music. The FM radio can store up to 30 presets and includes recording options. Voice recording is available via the built-in microphone. The product is intended for home and personal use only.

Central Huron Council heard a proposal to renovate the Clinton Library to achieve accreditation, which it lacked due to accessibility and space issues. The county handles staff and services, while the municipality manages the building. The project aims to meet Ontario Public Library Guidelines, requiring adequate square footage and accessible design. Next steps include agreeing on components, preparing architect drawings, and seeking provincial funding for a "shovel-ready" project.

The Turing architecture features a new SM design with 64 FP32 and 64 INT32 cores per SM, supporting concurrent execution. It includes eight Tensor Cores and one RT Core per SM. The SM is partitioned into four processing blocks sharing a 96 KB L1 data cache/shared memory. Turing adds a parallel integer execution unit, achieving an effective 36% additional throughput for floating point operations. The unified L1/shared memory architecture increases hit bandwidth by 2x per TPC. Turing Tensor Cores add INT8 and INT4 precision modes. The TU102 GPU contains 576 Tensor Cores. The Tesla T4 GPU delivers up to 130 TOPS of INT8 and 260 TOPS of INT4 inferencing performance, with up to 40x higher inference performance and over 50x higher energy efficiency than CPU-based inferencing. Turing is the first GPU architecture to utilize GDDR6 memory, delivering 14 Gbps signaling rates and 20% power efficiency improvement over GDDR5X. The TU102 GPU has 6 MB of L2 cache. Turing's memory compression improvements contribute to a 50% increase in effective bandwidth. The display engine supports DisplayPort 1.4a, 8K resolution at 60 Hz, and HDR. The NVENC encoder supports H.265 8K encode at 30 fps. Turing GPUs support USB-C and VirtualLink for VR headsets. TU102 and TU104 GPUs use NVLink for SLI, with TU102 having two x8 second-generation NVLink links. Turing introduces RT Cores for hardware-accelerated ray tracing, enabling real-time ray tracing. RT Cores accelerate BVH traversal and ray/triangle intersection testing. Turing's ray tracing performance is 10x faster than Pascal. NGX utilizes Tensor Cores for AI features like DLSS, InPainting, AI Slow-Mo, and AI Super Rez. DLSS allows rendering at lower input sample count, inferring a result similar to TAA quality with roughly half the shading work. Mesh Shading introduces Task and Mesh Shaders for more flexible geometry processing. Variable Rate Shading (VRS) allows dynamic adjustment of shading rate per 16x16 pixel region. Texture Space Shading (TSS) decouples shading from screen-space pixels. Multi-View Rendering (MVR) supports up to four views per pass. The TU104 GPU contains 48 SMs, 3072 CUDA Cores, 368 Tensor Cores, and 48 RT Cores. The TU106 GPU contains 36 SMs, 2304 CUDA Cores, 288 Tensor Cores, and 36 RT Cores. RTX-OPS is a workload-based metric for hybrid rendering.

Charlie Alliston, 18, riding a fixed-wheel track bike without a front brake, struck and killed mother-of-two Kim Briggs while she crossed Old Street in east London on February 12, 2016. The court heard he was traveling at nearly 20 mph, and reconstructions showed a front brake would have allowed him to stop. Alliston posted online blaming the victim, claiming she stepped into his path and ignored warnings. He denies manslaughter and causing bodily harm by wanton or furious driving.

Elijah Brown scored 27 points, including 17 of New Mexico's final 19, leading the Lobos to a 78-73 win over Boise State. New Mexico (16-10, 9-5) used an 11-0 run to take control. Chandler Hutchison had a career-high 31 points for Boise State (16-8, 9-4). The Lobos made 22 free throws to Boise State's 13.

A December 2017 Harvard poll found 65% of millennials favor Democrats, with only 14% believing America is headed in the right direction. President Trump’s approval among millennials is 25%, and 67% see threats from inside the country.

A retrospective cohort study of over 2.2 million hospitalizations found that perinatal mood disorders were associated with higher odds of peripartum cardiomyopathy (aOR 1.36) and composite adverse cardiac events (aOR 1.57), but not maternal death.

Preempt announced new technology integrations for its Behavioral Firewall, adding data sources like Okta, Azure AD, and VPN gateways, and enforcement integrations with SecureAuth, RSA SecurID, Duo, Google Authenticator, and HP Aruba ClearPass. These enhancements provide deeper context for internal threat detection and automated response options to stop threats.

In card identification mode, the host resets cards, validates voltage, identifies them, and assigns RCA via separate CMD lines. CMD0 resets cards to Idle State, except Inactive cards. After power-on or CMD0, cards are in Idle State with default RCA and driver strength. In UHS-II Mode, RCA is not cleared by CMD0. CMD8 verifies operating conditions; if voltage is supported, the card echoes the command argument; if not, it stays idle. CMD8 must precede ACMD41 for SDHC/SDXC initialization.

The speaker acknowledges a teammate's effort, credits the opposing team's performance, notes home-ice advantage, emphasizes playoff preparation and hard work, accepts being booed, praises an opponent as the best since Patrick, outlines a game-by-game approach for next season, and expresses sadness at not winning the Stanley Cup for his ill mother.

A U.S. official says D.C. police will charge 12 Turkish security agents (7 felonies, 5 misdemeanors) for violence during Turkey's president's May 16 visit. Two men, Sinan Narin and Eyup Yildirim, have been arrested on assault charges.

Mary Meeker's 2018 Internet Trends report, with a China section by Hillhouse Capital, shows a 360% increase in time spent on short-form videos (under five minutes) in 2017, though 76% of Chinese consumers use only one short-video app. Major players Douyin and Kuaishou each have about 100 million daily active users, with 52 minutes average daily viewing and high stickiness. Long-form video ad spending surpassed network TV in China last year, and short-form is approaching long-form in time spent.

Siri gains calendar support but lacks individual voice recognition. Messages in iCloud stores all messages and attachments, freeing local storage but using iCloud space. On May 30, 2018, U.S. stocks surged, recovering most of the prior day's losses, as Italy's political situation improved. The S&P 500 rose 1.3%, the Dow gained 1.3%, and the Nasdaq added 0.9%. Smaller companies outperformed, with the Russell 2000 hitting a record high. Energy and bank stocks rallied, while U.S. crude oil rose 2.2%. International markets were mixed, and bond yields increased.

Eleven directors were elected, and advisory votes approved executive compensation, ratified PricewaterhouseCoopers LLP as auditor, and approved both plans.

The court modified the order, finding sufficient evidence for a jury to decide that the defendant negotiated in bad faith by not timely offering policy limits, which may have damaged the plaintiff. Testimony that a lower settlement would have been accepted if offered earlier was deemed direct, not speculative, evidence. A new study found that low doses of alcohol (equivalent to about 2.5 drinks per day) improved the brain's glymphatic system, which flushes waste including proteins linked to Alzheimer's, in mice. The TPS7H500x-SP controllers can operate in external synchronization mode by leaving the RT pin floating and applying a clock to the SYNC pin at twice the desired switching frequency. Sophomore forward Wenyen Gabriel announced he will leave Kentucky to pursue a professional career, forgoing his junior season. He averaged 6.8 points and 5.4 rebounds per game.

The passage discusses the dressed atom picture for understanding light forces, particularly the stimulated force. It explains how dressed states (superpositions of ground and excited states) are used to describe atom-laser interactions, spontaneous emission, and the Mollow triplet. The dipole force is derived from the gradient of dressed energy levels, with opposite forces for the two dressed states. Non-adiabatic effects (time lag in population adjustment) lead to cooling for blue-detuned light, while fluctuations from radiative cascades cause heating. The Sisyphus cooling mechanism is described for atoms in a blue-detuned standing wave. The passage also notes that the lowest temperature achievable is comparable to the lattice depth, preventing localization in optical lattices for two-level atoms.

In North Carolina, at least 11 counties run child care academies to fast-track new teachers at little to no cost. These two-to-six-week programs use classroom-ready or teaching credential models. The lecture discusses trajectory optimization methods for underactuated robotics, focusing on policy search, shooting methods, and direct collocation. Policy search parameterizes control systems with a vector alpha to minimize a cost function J(alpha). Shooting methods simulate the system forward and adjust parameters using gradients, computed via adjoint (backprop through time) or real-time recurrent learning (RTRL). Direct collocation augments the parameter vector with state variables, adding dynamics constraints, allowing efficient gradient computation and constraint handling. Examples demonstrate pendulum and acrobot swing-up tasks using SNOPT for optimization. Local minima are noted but often acceptable.

The lecture introduces the fast Fourier transform (FFT) algorithm for computing the discrete Fourier transform (DFT). A direct DFT computation requires on the order of N² complex multiplications and additions. The FFT algorithm, for N a power of 2, reduces this to N log₂ N operations by decomposing the computation into smaller DFTs. The algorithm is derived by splitting the sequence into even and odd indexed points, computing N/2-point DFTs, and combining them. This process is repeated recursively. The resulting flow graph uses a butterfly structure, which can be simplified to a multiplication by a power of W followed by an addition and subtraction. The input sequence is rearranged in a bit-reversed order.

The passage introduces Szemerédi's graph regularity lemma, stating that any large, dense graph can be partitioned into a bounded number of parts so that the edges between most pairs of parts appear random-like. It defines an epsilon-regular pair and an epsilon-regular partition. The lemma asserts that for any epsilon, there exists a constant M such that every graph has an epsilon-regular partition into at most M parts. The proof uses an energy increment argument, where the energy of a partition increases by at least epsilon^5 at each refinement step, ensuring termination after a bounded number of steps. The passage also discusses equitable partitions and notes that the bound on the number of parts is a tower of exponentials.

Digital piracy, enabled by digitalization and internet connectivity, has significantly impacted industries by allowing consumers to substitute licensed purchases with unlicensed copies. Their subscription models, streaming services, and community features offer a superior consumption experience, creating a competitive advantage. The research uses case studies and a causal loop diagram to illustrate how these strategic responses generate value and reduce piracy's appeal.

The UC1825B-SP oscillator is a sawtooth; the rising edge is set by RT and CT, and the falling edge sets dead time. RT is selected first for maximum duty cycle, then CT for frequency. The device is a dual output controller for push-pull, half-bridge, and full-bridge topologies, supporting voltage and current modes. A 215 kHz switching frequency was chosen as a trade-off between bandwidth and efficiency, with RT=10 kΩ and CT=680 pF. The transformer design uses a turns ratio of 2.2 and an auxiliary winding ratio of 1.5, with a primary inductance of 120 µH and a 2.2-µH output inductor. An RCD clamp, output diode (60 V rating), and MOSFETs with a voltage rating 2.5-3 times the input voltage are used. Output capacitance of 1145 µF and a 500 nH output filter inductor were selected. Type IIB compensation was used with a 5 kHz crossover frequency. The sense resistor uses a 1 V threshold. The device operates from 10 V to 30 V. Layout recommendations include using a ground plane, placing components close to the IC, and separating power and signal grounds.

Hammerson received a non-binding £4.88bn proposal from Klépierre on 8 March, which its directors rejected as undervaluing the company. The offer was 615p per share, a 41% premium to the March 16 closing price, settled 50% cash and 50% shares. Hammerson's shares rose 25% despite the rejection. The directors called the approach opportunistic and remain committed to acquiring Intu Properties.

New Jersey Sen. Cory Booker campaigned in Alabama for Democratic Senate nominee Doug Jones, with the subtext being the 2020 presidential election. Alabama and other Deep South states can be pivotal in Democratic primaries due to African-American voters. Booker's visit made him more familiar to voters, and he stressed his family roots in the state. Unlike other national Democrats, Booker campaigned in person, as the Jones campaign's embargo on outsiders did not apply to Congressional Black Caucus members. The passage notes the importance of African-American voters in past Democratic primaries, citing Clinton's 2016 and Obama's 2008 victories.

The speaker acknowledges an unfortunate event involving Roli but views it as an opportunity for another player. They express confidence in themselves and the team, despite difficult circumstances. They focus on the Stanley Cup Finals as a chance to perform well, noting that confidence and preparation are key. They feel bad for Roli but emphasize moving forward and staying focused on the opportunity.

In Pfeiffer v. Commissioner, the court reversed a Board of Tax Appeals decision, holding that a preferred stock dividend paid on common stock in 1931 was exempt from taxation under Section 115(f) of the Revenue Act of 1928. The court found the statute's language exempting "a stock dividend" unqualified and that the Commissioner's argument regarding the 1928 stock dividend redemption was not properly before the court.

Dan Le Batard, a Miami Herald columnist since 1990, stated on his ESPN radio show that the Heat organization believed LeBron James "checked out" during the 2014 NBA Finals, knowing he was leaving. James declined his Heat option in 2014, and many expect him to opt out of his Cavaliers contract after this season, raising the question of whether he might "check out" again if Cleveland struggles in the 2018 Finals.

Bitcoin rallied to within 1% of its all-time high on Friday, trading at $123,874, as the U.S. government shutdown entered its third day. The cryptocurrency is up 12% this week, with investors viewing it as a safe haven amid political tensions. Standard Chartered expects a new high soon, with a target of $135,000.

The failure to present a claim against an estate within the statutory period does not extinguish the debt but removes the remedy. A court of equity will not compel a creditor to surrender security for an unpaid, subsisting debt. The judgment was reversed and the case remanded.

Google canceled Daily Stormer's website registration for inciting violence, following GoDaddy's termination of hosting services. The site had ridiculed Heather Heyer, killed at a white nationalist rally. GoDaddy cited promotion of violence. YouTube also terminated Daily Stormer's channel for hate speech. Facebook removes links to the site unless captions condemn content. Daily Stormer re-registered with Google, which then canceled it. Tucows denied hosting but provided privacy services. Cloudflare provides services masking the host. The actions follow violent clashes in Charlottesville.

Investigators found red-stained bedding and an empty box of Coricidin Cold & Cough medicine at the home of Matthew James Phelps, who said he killed his wife Lauren while in a medicated stupor. Phelps called 911, stating he took cough medicine, had a dream, and woke to find his wife stabbed. Lauren was alive when police arrived but died at the hospital. Phelps faces first-degree murder charges and is held without bail.

This patent application describes bonded optical devices for wearable electronics, such as AR glasses. It addresses challenges in creating multi-colored microLED displays by directly bonding monochromatic LED elements (e.g., red, green, blue) to a processor carrier without adhesive. The direct bonding enables fine pixel pitches (less than 5 microns). Multiple monochromatic optical elements can be combined via an optical pathway (e.g., a waveguide) to superimpose their light into a polychromatic image for a user.

Transport CS James Macharia attributed the motorbike menace to poor enforcement of regulations, stating NTSA failed to implement existing laws. He said the ministry is working with county transport committees and the traffic department to improve enforcement. Ruiru MP Simon King'ara called for a separate safety authority for motorbikes and suggested a benchmark mission to Rwanda.

The IRS is furloughing about 34,000 workers, nearly half its workforce, due to the government shutdown. Another 39,870 employees (53.6%) will remain on the job. Most IRS operations are closed, and the furlough began on October 8, 2025.

The GA10x SM improves upon Turing and Volta SMs, adding new features. It is partitioned into four processing blocks, each with a 64 KB register file, L0 instruction cache, warp scheduler, dispatch unit, and math units. The four partitions share a 128 KB L1 data cache/shared memory subsystem. The GA10x SM includes one third-generation Tensor Core per partition, each twice as powerful as a Turing Tensor Core. The combined L1 data cache and shared memory capacity is 33% larger than Turing. GA10x includes FP32 processing on both datapaths, doubling the peak FP32 processing rate. The GA10x SM can execute 128 FP32 operations per clock, double the Turing SM's rate. The GA10x SM continues to support double-speed FP16 operations.

This study analyzes public financing for European cleantech start-ups and SMEs, primarily under Horizon 2020. It covers loan, equity, grant, and guarantee instruments managed by bodies like the EIB and EIF. The report benchmarks instruments on metrics like portfolio size, success rate, and TRL, and notes additional support services provided.

The speaker addresses a meeting convened due to the Johnstown disaster, emphasizing the need for charity. He notes a $2,000 donation from Jacksonville, Florida, and suggests three actions: a committee to collect food for immediate shipment to Williamsport; a committee to gather clothing, especially bedding; and a committee of business people to collect money for long-term rebuilding. He mentions his own prior subscription to the relief effort.

The Tennessee National Wildlife Refuge headquarters and Visitor Center will close on August 21st for the solar eclipse. The public is directed to Cross Creeks National Wildlife Refuge in Dover for viewing, where staff will assist. The partial eclipse begins at 11:56 am (CDT), with totality at 1:25 am (CDT) lasting about 55 seconds. Special glasses ($3), t-shirts, and water will be sold as a fundraiser. Visitors can bring picnics. For information, call 731-642-2091.

William Brock was convicted of juvenile molestation and sentenced to ten years at hard labor. The court found sufficient evidence for the conviction and that the sentence was not excessive, affirming both.

Research is systematic effort to solve problems or improve situations. The Research Methods in Education (RME) course aims to teach basic principles, research processes, and ethics. This study used a mixed method to determine teacher candidates' attitudes towards the RME course. The quantitative sample consisted of 190 students from three departments at Bayburt University. An attitude scale was developed, resulting in 21 items under three factors. Results showed attitudes did not differ significantly by department but did differ by grade level, with a significant difference between first and fourth grades. Qualitatively, 90% of participants found the course necessary, 50% reported personal gains, and 60% stated the course duration was insufficient.

Centrica's stock fell 35% in the past year, now yielding 8.6%, nearly three times inflation. Volution reported 11.6% revenue growth and acquired Simx Limited. Centrica trades at a P/E ratio of around 10, with expected 7% earnings growth this year.

President Bush thanked the press corps, discussed not requesting the remaining $350 billion in bail funds unless President-elect Obama asks, expressed hope for a sustainable Gaza cease-fire dependent on Hamas stopping rocket fire, identified an attack on the homeland as the most urgent threat, urged the Republican Party to be more inclusive, defended his record on Iraq and the economy, acknowledged mistakes like the "Mission Accomplished" banner and Social Security push, disagreed that U.S. moral standing is damaged, supported free trade, and hoped for a respectful tone in Washington.

This study explored the culturally sensitive mentorship needs of 133 occupational therapy students, 59 of whom were from historically underrepresented groups. Results indicated current mentorship was insufficient for these students, who desired mentors demonstrating cultural humility, empathy, anti-racism allyship, and support for handling workplace discrimination. The study provides evidence for implementing culturally sensitive mentorship programs to enhance equity, inclusion, and professional resilience.

The Colorado Supreme Court made absolute its rule to show cause, holding that the trial court lacked jurisdiction over defendants because they were not Colorado residents when served in California under Rule 4(f)(1) R.C.P. Colo. The court found the uncontroverted facts—including defendants' registration to vote in California before the action commenced—established their intent to abandon Colorado residence, and the trial court erred in denying the motion to quash service.

European markets hit record highs, led by steel and banking stocks, after the EU proposed cutting steel import quotas and amid Fed easing expectations. Gold surpassed $4,000 per ounce. Auto stocks weakened after BMW cut its profit forecast.

The Sensex fell 12.31 points to 28,339.31, and the Nifty dropped 12.75 points to 8,792. Five stocks hit 52-week highs: AIA Engineering (Rs 1,441), Alkem Laboratories, KEC International (Rs 170), Exide Industries (Rs 218), and Kalpataru Power Transmission (Rs 299.85).

The Royal Rumble 2017 at the Alamodome has confirmed matches including AJ Styles vs. John Cena for the WWE Championship, Kevin Owens vs. Roman Reigns for the WWE Universal Championship with Chris Jericho suspended in a shark cage, and a 30-Man Royal Rumble match featuring Brock Lesnar and Goldberg.

Bath Rugby fans faced travel chaos after their team's 24-20 loss to Toulon, with snow, ice, and wind causing flight cancellations from Marseille, Nice, and Amsterdam. Supporters took creative routes home, including via Munich, Brussels, and Madrid, while some flew to Paris and took trains, which were also delayed. The Bath team returned via a chartered flight. Fans experienced missed connections, cancelled flights, extra days off work, and pet care issues. One group missed a funeral due to delays. Others faced confusion at airports, including a wrongly cancelled flight and double-booking. Some fans made the best of their extended stay, enjoying local sights and French wine.

Shares of U.S. rare earth miners surged after China tightened export controls on rare earths ahead of a meeting between Presidents Xi and Trump. The Trump administration has taken equity stakes in miners to build a domestic supply chain. China's new rules require export licenses for products containing rare earths or using Chinese extraction technology. The U.S. is dependent on Chinese rare earth imports, which are crucial for weapons, robotics, and electronics.

Two Boeing 737 MAX 8 crashes, Lion Air Flight 610 (Oct 2018) and Ethiopian Airlines Flight 302 (Mar 2019), killed 346 people. The crashes were linked to the MCAS system, which automatically pushed the plane's nose down based on a single sensor. Boeing did not inform pilots or regulators about MCAS changes, and the FAA certified the plane without detailed review. The 737 MAX was grounded for 21 months, costing Boeing over $21 billion in direct costs and $67 billion in lost sales.

The speaker recounts his return to hockey after seven months out, including negotiations with the Detroit Red Wings, being selected for the Russian Olympic team, and the team matching an offer from North Carolina. He describes his relief at staying in Detroit, his first game back, and the emotional impact of seeing Vladislav Tretiak in the stands during a Stanley Cup win, which he found inspirational.

Constraint Programming (CP) faces a modeling bottleneck, which Constraint Acquisition (CA) aims to automate. Over-fitting in passive CA leads to overly specific constraints. This study introduces a three-phase hybrid CA framework with a Query-Driven Interactive Refinement phase to identify and refine over-fitted global constraints using oracle interaction, confidence scoring, and subset exploration.

Research expectations for US mathematics education faculty vary by institution type, department type, and research commitment. R1 faculty are expected to publish about 2.25 papers per year, R2 faculty about 1.5, and Other faculty about 1. Research journal articles are the most valued publication type. R1 faculty are more likely to be required to pursue external funding, while Other faculty are more likely to have no such expectation. R2 faculty are most likely to have expected publication numbers in a written document.

The passage studies the orbital Edelstein effect (OEE) in monolayer transition metal dichalcogenides (TMDs) under a perpendicular gate field. A gate field breaks mirror symmetry, creating a chiral spin/orbital texture. The OEE and spin Edelstein effect (SEE) are calculated using a five-orbital tight-binding model. For electron doping, the OEE is significantly larger than the SEE. For hole doping, the OEE and SEE are similar, but both are enhanced by compressive strain, which shifts the Γ valley energy. The computed Edelstein susceptibilities are up to ~10⁻⁷ µB V⁻¹m, larger than previously reported values.

The passage is a list of questions and a detailed article about the Keltner Channel, a technical analysis tool. It explains that the Keltner Channel was created by Chester Keltner in the 1960s, consists of three lines (a middle moving average and upper/lower bands based on ATR), and is used to assess volatility and trends. The article includes a backtest showing a 77% win rate on the S&P 500, discusses differences from Bollinger Bands, and notes that the tool does not repaint. It also covers customization, common pitfalls, and various trading strategies.

On December 12, 2016, NVIDIA Corporation entered an agreement with Goldman, Sachs & Co. to terminate 63,259,180.62 warrants. In exchange, NVIDIA will deliver shares of Common Stock to Goldman, with the amount determined daily by the volume-weighted average price from December 13, 2016 to January 31, 2017. The shares are issued under Section 4(a)(2) of the Securities Act of 1933.

Government shutdowns have historically had little economic impact, but this time could differ due to President Trump's threat to make some federal furloughs permanent, potentially affecting a precarious employment picture. A prolonged shutdown could delay key economic data releases, impacting the Federal Reserve's policy decisions and Social Security cost-of-living adjustments. While most analysts expect a relatively mild overall impact, the labor market faces immediate risks for furloughed employees and contractors.

A Netflix documentary, "Unknown Number: The High School Catfish," follows a townwide mystery in Beal City, Michigan, where junior high student Lauryn Licari receives hateful and graphic text messages from an unknown sender. The messages escalate to threats against her life, and the local sheriff, unable to resolve the case after 18 months, involves the FBI. The documentary highlights the dangers of cellphone use, the toll of technology, and the potential for digital investigations. The author, a criminal defense attorney, supports Oklahoma's new "bell to bell" no cellphone policy for schools, arguing that excessive cellphone access creates problems for students.

The Bank of England allocated £5.085 billion in its six-month indexed long-term repo operation, the highest since March 2020 and more than double the previous week's £2.352 billion. This reflects increased bank demand for central bank liquidity as the BoE shifts from an era of excess reserves and unwinds its quantitative easing programme. The central bank is moving toward a framework where banks actively borrow funds. The record allotment signals growing reliance on these operations, though demand for six-month repos remains modest compared to short-term facilities, with a record £87.149 billion allotted through the seven-day repo programme the previous week.

The Fabian Timing Model is a quantitative long-term trend-following strategy for the S&P 500, developed by Richard Fabian in the 1960s. It uses intermarket signals between the S&P 500, Dow Jones Industrial Average, and utilities sector, based on 39-week moving averages. The strategy emphasizes mechanical trading rules and discipline. Its key selling points are low volatility and low maximum drawdown, though long-term returns are close to buy-and-hold.

A House panel advanced a bill to raise employee pension contributions from 8.66% to 9% and employer contributions from 11.56% to 18.56% by 2023 to address a $24 billion pension gap. A bill allowing out-of-state concealed weapons permits advanced to the House floor. A measure for Coastal Carolina University championship license plates passed the Senate.

Chelsea will face Barcelona in the Champions League last-16. Chelsea finished second in Group C, while Barcelona topped Group D. The first leg is in February, the second in March. They last met in 2012, with Chelsea winning 3-2 on aggregate. Lionel Messi is Barcelona's star player.

The lecture covers modeling osteoporosis using Voronoi honeycombs, comparing bone loss from strut thinning versus removal, and discussing metal foams as bone substitutes and trabecular bone architecture in evolutionary studies.

Tesla, Inc. filed a Form 10-Q for the quarterly period ended September 30, 2021, reporting total revenues of $13.76 billion for the three months and $36.10 billion for the nine months ended September 30, 2021. Net income attributable to common stockholders was $1.62 billion and $3.20 billion for the respective periods. The company had $16.07 billion in cash and cash equivalents as of September 30, 2021.

This study explores how dialogic pedagogy can be concretized in classrooms, using cases from music and mathematics education. It analyzes how epistemological and ontological dialogue, along with concepts like musicking, mathematizing, and Bildung, appear in educational settings. The teachers promoted participation by facilitating both dialogic aspects, showing that these dimensions interact in practice.

The speaker addresses the council to disclose the U.S. government's duty regarding future international peace. The U.S. must participate in guaranteeing peace and justice worldwide, but must state conditions for joining a league for peace. The war's end terms must create a peace worth guaranteeing, not just serving national interests. A universal covenant must include the New World. Peace must be secured by organized major force, not a balance of power. The war must be for a just and secure peace, not a new balance. Assurances imply peace without victory, as victory would impose terms on the vanquished, creating resentment. Only a peace between equals can last.

A 19-year-old woman was sexually assaulted by a man on a train in Weston-super-Mare on April 8 at around 4.45pm. The man, part of a group of four men and a woman, touched her inappropriately after a jolt; she shouted, but he continued until passengers intervened. He left with the group at Bridgewater. British Transport Police are appealing for information, asking witnesses to contact them.

The lecture covers linearized gravity, focusing on gravitational radiation. It explains how the transverse-traceless (TT) gauge isolates the two radiative degrees of freedom (polarizations) of gravitational waves. The effect of a wave on a ring of test particles is described, showing the "plus" and "cross" polarizations. The quadrupole formula is derived: the TT metric perturbation \( h_{ij}^{TT} \) is proportional to the second time derivative of the source's quadrupole moment, projected to be transverse and traceless.

Scientists discovered that activating two receptors, TRPM8 and TRPP3, on brown adipose tissue (BAT) cells can increase BAT production, offering potential treatments for obesity and diabetes. The study used human precursor cells and found that stimulating TRPM8 promoted brown fat formation, while eliminating TRPP3 prevented it.

Winter parking congestion occurs around Kensington Park. Council advises drivers to avoid parking on driveways, grass verges, or footpaths to prevent tickets. After initial warnings, ticketing begins. Solutions include car pooling, leaving earlier, or parking further away.

The JKPSC has kept in abeyance the 2016 Combined Competitive (Preliminary) Examination result and withdrawn the main exam notification due to discrepancies in question papers and answer keys. All question papers and answer keys will be referred to independent experts for evaluation.

A headteacher expressed confidence in a rapid improvement after Ofsted rated Lyminster Primary School as requiring improvement. The report noted positive changes by the leadership but insufficient impact, while acknowledging strong teaching and good pupil conduct. The school has a clear plan to address development targets.
Apple Inc. filed a Form 10-Q for the quarterly period ended April 1, 2023, reporting net sales of $94.8 billion and net income of $24.2 billion for the quarter.

Bluehole launched a community event on Xbox One called Snipe City, challenging players to collectively make 400,000 kills with M24 and Kar98 sniper rifles. Participants who play at least one round and earn 1 BP are eligible for rewards—Bloody Tank Top, Padded Jacket, and two Militia Crates—if the goal is met. The event runs until July 10, with updates on July 6 and 9, and results on July 11.

Zacks Investment Research upgraded State Bank Financial Corporation (STBZ) from "sell" to "buy" with a $30.00 price target, suggesting an 11.69% upside. The stock has an average "Hold" rating and a $25.25 average target price. The company reported Q3 EPS of $0.34, beating estimates of $0.31. It declared a $0.14 quarterly dividend. Insiders sold shares, and several hedge funds increased their stakes.

The court affirmed the divorce and child custody rulings but reversed and remanded the property division for a new trial, finding the trial court erred by not considering the "good will" value of the husband's stock in a professional corporation as part of the marital estate.

NVIDIA Corporation filed a Form 10-Q for the quarterly period ended July 29, 2018, reporting financial statements and management discussion. Revenue was $3.123 billion for the quarter and $6.330 billion for the six months, with net income of $1.101 billion and $2.345 billion, respectively.

Asian shares fell Tuesday due to investor concerns over U.S. tech regulation, a Federal Reserve policy meeting, and potential U.S. trade protectionism. Facebook led losses after reports of improper user data access. The euro rose on ECB policy shift expectations, while the dollar and oil prices were little changed.

A longitudinal Grade of Membership (L-GoM) model for Alzheimer's disease progression, developed using clinic-based, non-Hispanic white patients, was validated on a community-dwelling, multiethnic cohort (Predictors 3). The model accurately predicted survival and need for full-time care for most groups, including those with mild cognitive impairment, but not for Alzheimer's disease reverters, who were likely misdiagnosed.

Surveillance officers and health workers in Lagos and Ogun States are on high alert. Ogun State confirmed one Lassa fever case, a 20-year-old male isolated at Federal Medical Centre, Idi-Aba, responding to treatment; 66 contacts are under surveillance. LUTH confirmed its cases are responding to treatment, with an official update expected. Lagos previously confirmed five cases, two deaths, and 150 under surveillance.

Microsoft Corporation filed a Form 10-Q for the quarterly period ended March 31, 2022, reporting total revenue of $49.4 billion and net income of $16.7 billion for the three months ended March 31, 2022.

The passage discusses the upcoming Moto Z2 Force, noting its predecessor's popularity due to a shatterproof display, larger battery, and comfortable design. It highlights a change in 2017: Verizon's exclusivity on the device will diminish, potentially allowing unlocked purchases or availability on carriers like T-Mobile and Sprint. A release around June 2017 is anticipated.

Students from Cleveland Central High School presented the Purple Christmas Showcase at the Delta Art Alliance on Friday, featuring photos and biographies from their Cleveland Yearbook project. Since September, the students have conducted oral interviews with peers, teachers, and residents. The display includes interviewee biographies, photos from the high school's first homecoming, and a quote wall. The showcase will be up until Wednesday.
Transparency is crucial for Wall Street job candidates. Specializing in an underpenetrated, niche sector valued by the bank is a recommended strategy.

Fibonacci trading uses tools like retracement, expansion, and fan to identify potential support and resistance levels. These tools are considered leading indicators. Common Fibonacci ratios are 23.6%, 38.2%, 50%, 61.8%, and 78.6%. There is no best timeframe; it depends on trading style. The passage states there is no scientific evidence that prices follow Fibonacci numbers, and a backtested study found a passive strategy outperformed an active Fibonacci strategy. The author has not seen consistently successful Fibonacci traders or positive backtests.

The Dallas Stars and Vegas Golden Knights players stood together before the game to honor victims of the Las Vegas mass shooting, which killed 58 people. The Stars also honored a staff member and announcer Dave Strader, with moments of silence and a message of support.

The passage is a glossary and FAQ-style article listing and describing various day trading strategies (e.g., momentum, range, scalping, breakout, pullback, reversal, gap, news, pattern, seasonal, dark pool, statistical arbitrage, pairs, order flow, market making, short squeeze, volatility, regime switching, phase analysis). It covers definitions, risks, required capital, discipline, technical analysis, backtesting, psychology, and common mistakes. It states that most day traders lose money, and that a $10,000 account might earn $200-$300 daily. The 11am rule is described as a guideline for trend continuation.

A Yale-Brookings study finds that AI's impact on the U.S. labor market consists of "lightning strikes" in specific sectors, not a broad "house fire." While entry-level roles in fields like software development and customer service have seen declines, overall labor market disruption remains within historical norms, driven by macroeconomic factors like a slowing economy and aging population rather than AI. Researchers caution against conflating AI exposure with job displacement, noting that organizational adoption of AI takes time.

U.S. wheat futures fell to a nearly three-week low due to weak export demand and rain forecasts. Soybeans declined for a fifth day on expectations of faster Midwest planting. Corn was near unchanged. The USDA reported planting progress behind average, but traders focused on demand concerns.

Newcastle United are reportedly set to pursue Besiktas midfielder Tolgay Arslan again in the summer, with Borussia Dortmund and Bayer Leverkusen also interested. Jose Mourinho stated he sees David de Gea staying at Manchester United and advised Real Madrid to target another player. Shakhtar Donetsk chief executive Sergei Palkin confirmed midfielder Fred will leave in June, joining either Manchester City or Manchester United.

The passage discusses the rise of Education Savings Accounts (ESAs) as universal school vouchers, contrasting their political alignment (red states) with earlier charter school movements (blue states). It outlines ESAs' lack of accountability, low per-pupil funding compared to public schools, and their primary goal of reducing government's role in education. The text details problems including rising private school tuition, ballooning state costs, negative impacts on rural schools, and discrimination against students and staff. It concludes with recommendations for stricter oversight or repeal of ESA programs.

Since 2001, impact VC firms have raised $13 billion, with $10 billion since 2010, for for-profit businesses providing social or environmental benefits. These funds seek market-beating returns and invest in early- to mid-stage private companies. The sector lacks a consistent name, with "GoodBusiness" proposed. The author compiled the first comparison of impact VC funds, excluding those without a primary impact mission. Notable funds include DBL Partners, Capricorn Investment Group, and Generation Investment Management. Sub-sectors focus on environmental protection, emerging markets, Western consumer goods, and underrepresented founders. The author predicts traditional VC will eventually adopt GoodBusiness investing.

A Ukrainian startup, Dropla, uses AI software called Blue Eyes to detect Russian ambush drones and landmines on supply routes. The software analyzes real-time video from quadcopters, identifying over 170 explosive threats, including idling quadcopters. It sends coordinates to Ukraine's battle management system. The system is being tested by frontline units and aims to scale up deployment.

A confidential document obtained by the Los Angeles Times alleges that government-owned utilities, including the Los Angeles Department of Water and Power, Bonneville Power Administration, and BC Hydro, manipulated California's electricity market from May to November 2000, driving up wholesale prices. BC Hydro earned $176 million in alleged excess profits, the highest amount. The document decodes identities from a California Independent System Operator study.

The speaker is seizing opportunities to avoid the emotional state of waiting for an injury to play, denies a claim about a beard, and states everyone feels better today. They view every game as a must-win and a chance to win, with the goal of returning with a split.

The Side Screen Offense is a two-player screen and roll isolation, the most used play in the NBA. It involves a guard or wing driving over an "ON" ball screen set by a post player, with options including driving to the basket, a pull-up jumper, a return pass to the post, or a kick-out pass. Success requires execution and coordination between the ballhandler and screener. The passage details eight basic defensive reads and their counters, entry variations (High Post Rub, Power, Horns), continuity options (Flex, Triangle Game, Motion), and emphasizes teaching, game strategy, and defensive knowledge.

Arun District Council has confirmed the death of Aldwick councillor Jacqui Maconachie, who died at home on Friday after a battle with cancer. Tributes were paid by MP Nick Gibb, who called her a "great public servant," and by council chief executive Nigel Lynn. Maconachie served on Arun for 22 years, including as chairman from 2001 to 2002.

This passage describes a fluid end for hydraulic fracturing, comprising multiple fluid end sections, each with a single horizontal bore housing, a fluid routing plug, and associated valves and seals, designed to reduce stress and improve durability compared to traditional fluid ends.

Admiral Harry Harris, originally nominated as ambassador to Australia, has been reassigned to be ambassador to South Korea instead, with his nomination hearing postponed. This change occurs during critical US-South Korea negotiations regarding North Korea's nuclear weapons and the Korean War.

According to reports, Real Madrid targets Marcus Rashford as a summer transfer, viewing him as a partner for Cristiano Ronaldo, though Rashford is currently happy at United. Additionally, Manchester United is linked with a potential £40m move for Fulham's Ryan Sessegnon, with Tottenham also interested.

A study found that over 99% of people who had first-time heart attacks, strokes, or heart failure had at least one of four risk factors: suboptimal blood pressure, cholesterol, blood glucose, or smoking. Over 93% had more than one risk factor. The study highlights a gap between "optimal" and "clinical" thresholds for these factors, meaning many people have nonoptimal levels that are not treated.

The A100 GPU's MIG feature partitions it into up to seven secure instances, each with isolated memory paths for predictable performance. It increases hardware utilization with QoS and isolation for multi-tenant use, preventing client interference and enhancing security.

A UE receives a power saving signal from a base station, which includes a minimum applicable K (K0min) indicating a minimum scheduling offset restriction between a PDCCH and a PDSCH. The UE determines an application delay based on a predefined value and applies the minimum scheduling offset restriction after the application delay.

The Triangle and Two defense uses three players in a triangle zone and two chasers denying passes to specific opponents. The triangle provides backside support against cuts and dribble penetration. Variations include double-teaming on baseline or middle drives, and a Post/Outside variation against a strong post player. An Inverted Triangle is used against a two-guard front. The defense's key is the chasers' ability to deny the ball to disrupt the opponent's offense.

Ryan Walters' tenure as Oklahoma state superintendent, marked by culture war edicts, Christian prayer, and teacher monitoring, is seen as a preview of the Trump administration's education overhaul. His actions included Bible mandates, immigration enforcement in schools, and social media monitoring, drawing both praise from right-wing groups and criticism. Despite his loyalty to Trump, Walters did not receive a federal position and resigned to lead the anti-union Teacher Freedom Alliance.

Marriage and civil partnership in the UK have changed legally and socially. A party can seek divorce or dissolution when the relationship is beyond repair. Divorce is the legal dissolution of a marriage by court order. Grounds include adultery, unreasonable behaviour, desertion, two years' separation with mutual consent, or five years' separation. The process begins with a petition; if children are involved, a Statement of Arrangements is filed. Proceedings can take six months or less.

Hunter Greene, a 17-year-old drafted second overall by the Cincinnati Reds, is considered a uniquely important baseball prospect due to his rare combination of generational talent, charisma, and marketability. As an African American, he arrives at a time when MLB's efforts to increase black player representation have stalled. He is also a legitimate two-way prospect (pitcher and shortstop), potentially challenging baseball norms. The Reds drafted him primarily as a pitcher but will allow him to continue hitting.
Canada's main stock index rose slightly, led by financial and materials sectors, while U.S. indexes fell. The Canadian dollar and several commodity contracts also increased.
A US startup aims to democratize AI by enabling anyone to run reinforcement learning, as open source Chinese models gain momentum and researchers advocate for globally distributed AI model-making.

The passage discusses market conditions including seasonal weakness, institutional rebalancing, and technical analysis of yields, TLT, and the dollar. It also lists financial headlines about a U.S. government shutdown, gold prices, and warnings from Goldman Sachs and the Bank of England.

Arvell Reese, an Ohio State linebacker, is a potential first-round pick in the 2026 NFL Draft, possibly in the top 10. His strengths include elite athleticism, run defense, burst, speed, and use as a quarterback spy. He is used across the front seven at 6'3" and 243 pounds. Concerns include a smaller sample size in coverage and zone defense, lack of ball production, and occasional over-aggressiveness. He is considered a Pro Bowl-level talent with a high floor.

The longest woolly rhino horn, found in Siberian permafrost, is 30 centimeters longer than the previous record and dates to about 19,600 years old. The horn belonged to a likely female with a proportionally small skull. Growth bands indicate the rhino lived at least 40 years, the oldest known woolly rhino. The flattened horn may have been used to brush away snow for feeding.

The passage describes fusion trees, a static integer data structure for predecessor queries achieving O(log_w n) time. It uses a B-tree with branching factor w^(1/5), requiring constant-time predecessor in a node with k = w^(1/5) keys. This is done via sketching (extracting important bits), parallel comparison of sketches, and finding the most significant set bit. Sketching uses multiplication to compress bits into a small range. Parallel comparison subtracts concatenated sketches to find rank. Most significant set bit is found by splitting words into √w clusters and using similar techniques. The structure requires polynomial preprocessing and linear space.

Digital twins and IoT data create feedback loops for product development. Most HPC users prefer external or cloud-based HPC architectures for scalability and flexibility, with 81% of HPC users planning HPC-based business models.

On October 30, 2001, Enron's stock fell to eight-year lows after Moody's downgraded its debt and the company sought new credit lines. The stock dropped over 18% to around $11.25, continuing a decline from October 16. Moody's lowered Enron's long-term debt to Baa2, two notches above junk, and placed its commercial paper on review. Enron confirmed it was negotiating with banks for additional credit after tapping $3.3 billion in lines. The company lost over $15 billion in market value amid an SEC investigation into partnerships run by former CFO Andrew Fastow, who was ousted. Enron's bond default insurance premiums doubled. Twenty years ago, the Open Source Definition (OSD) was published, building on Richard Stallman's "free software" advocacy. The term "open source" was proposed by Christine Peterson on February 3, 1998, as an alternative to "free software" to avoid confusion about price versus liberty. Both concepts ultimately involve making source code available under a license favoring user freedom. The term "open source" was chosen on February 5, 1998, and the OSD was announced on February 9, 1998. Open source became commercially palatable, and today major tech companies like Apple, Amazon, Facebook, Google, and Microsoft depend on it. Red Hat's Tim Burke noted that open source now leads innovation rather than cloning proprietary software.

The passage contains diplomatic communications regarding Germany's submarine warfare, peace terms, and blockade conditions. Germany's Ambassador Bernstorff stated the blockade would end if a conference on reasonable terms was arranged. German Chancellor Zimmermann urged the President to make peace, claiming submarine warfare could compel England to seek terms. The German Chancellor's reported peace terms included retaining control over Belgium, a French frontier rectification, and indemnities. Austria-Hungary's Foreign Minister requested the U.S. consider their defensive position and urged President Wilson to influence the Entente to accept a "peace without victory" basis.

Storage is hyped as a solution for renewable energy integration, but its economic viability depends on costs and benefits. Lithium-ion batteries cost A$1,000-3,000 per kWh, needing A$1,000/kWh to break even with variable rates, or A$300/kWh with flat rates. Pumped hydro is cheaper at A$100/kWh but limited by geography. Grid benefits are negligible unless demand grows.

Bitcoin futures began trading on Cboe Futures Exchange, with the launch boosting the cryptocurrency's price, which nearly doubled since December but saw sharp daily swings. The cash-settled contracts, based on Gemini Exchange auction prices, offer a regulated alternative to the unregulated spot market. Major banks and brokerages had mixed responses, with some offering access and others restricting trading. Analysts noted potential for reduced long-term volatility but warned of risks including inaccurate pricing, systemic risk to clearing houses, and market manipulation.

The K-diet is based on traditional Korean foods, focusing on whole, unprocessed items like vegetables, whole grains, and lean proteins, while limiting processed foods, sugary drinks, unhealthy fats, and dairy. It includes fermented foods and small portions. Benefits include high fiber, low calories and saturated fats, and probiotics for digestion, but drawbacks are high sodium from fermented foods, low calcium due to no dairy, and potential irritation from spicy ingredients. Portion control is key for carbohydrates.
CoachingAmericanSoccer.com provides general "Rules of the Road" for new soccer players and coaches, covering positioning, ball work, and team tactics, adaptable to personal coaching style.

It also details how to play music, audiobooks, videos, and photos, use FM radio, make voice recordings, delete content, and customize settings. The chapter includes troubleshooting tips, warranty information, and a software license agreement.

They note a strong first period but attribute the opponent's goals to lucky bounces and broken sticks, stating the series have been hard-fought.

The ADS9803 supports a speed-boost mode for up to 8MSPS sampling on a user-selected analog input channel pair, with the same data output interface as normal mode. Register write access is enabled by setting SPI_RD_EN = 0b, and registers are grouped in three banks. Daisy-chain mode is enabled after power-up or reset by setting the DAISY_CHAIN_LEN register. The device is an eight-channel, 20-bit, 2MSPS data acquisition system with a TUE of 0.0015% at 25°C ±5°C post-calibration. It has three separate power supplies with no specific power-up sequence required.

This study aimed to create a predictive model for shunt-dependent hydrocephalus (SDHC) in patients with aneurysmal subarachnoid hemorrhage (aSAH). A retrospective review of 109 patients identified three significant risk factors for SDHC: age ≥65 years, treatment with clipping versus coiling, and Hunt and Hess scale (HHS) ≥3. A nomogram was developed based on these factors to estimate SDHC risk.

Nike reported fiscal first-quarter revenue of $11.72 billion, a 1% increase year-over-year, beating analyst expectations of $11.0 billion. However, net income fell 31% to $727 million, and gross margin dropped 3.2 percentage points to 42.2%. CEO Elliott Hill noted progress in wholesale, running, and North America, but acknowledged other areas are still struggling.

Miami Dolphins wide receiver Tyreek Hill dislocated his knee during Monday night's win over the New York Jets. He is undergoing further tests and will remain hospitalized overnight. Hill was carted off after his left leg was twisted under him on a tackle. He had 67 receiving yards on six catches before the injury.

An international team studied live Kuphus polythalamia, a giant sulfur-feeding worm-like mollusk in a shell, found in a Philippine lagoon. Researchers hope its gill microbes yield new antimicrobials. The species evolved from wood-eating ancestors, but its life cycle and age are unknown.

The passage describes a seasonal trading strategy for the German stock market using the iShares MSCI Germany ETF (EWG), which involves investing only in the last quarter of each year. A backtest shows this strategy has performed better than buy and hold since inception.

In the northern Rockies, earlier springs and warmer, drier conditions are allowing rainbow trout to invade cutthroat trout streams. Hybridization between the species produces less fit offspring, threatening the native cutthroat trout's survival.

A former INEC official, Christian Nwosu, testified in court that EFCC operatives coerced him into admitting he received N30 million from Dieziani Alison-Madueke and forced him to surrender property worth N30 million and N5 million cash.

A nationwide study of over 1.1 million older adults found that long-term exposure to the industrial solvent trichloroethylene (TCE) in outdoor air was associated with a 10% higher risk of Parkinson's disease for those in areas with the highest levels. The study does not prove causation but shows an association.

John Clarke, Michel Devoret and John Martinis won the 2025 Nobel Prize in physics for demonstrating quantum effects in an electric circuit, enabling quantum computers.

A swimming advisory for high bacteria levels was issued for little beach in Port Stanley on Friday and remained in effect Monday. The advisory warns of health risks like gastrointestinal illness but does not close the beach. Some visitors, like Terrie Vergiris, were unaware of the signs and continued swimming.

Sir John Deane’s sixth form college held its fourth annual Evening of Jazz and Soul at the Macdonald Portal Hotel in Tarporley, featuring a 35-member jazz collective performing 60s soul and classic swing. Head of performing arts Alison Richards praised the performers, who had only been together for months, and thanked the large audience. The college’s next event is a classical music evening at Arley Hall on February 9, with tickets at £8 (£6 concessions).

Two top stories from The Evening Sun in 2016: Norwich siblings Evan (10) and Brynn (6) Meek made 220 bagged lunches for homeless people in Manhattan on August 6. NPD officer Thomas Miller, an eight-year veteran, accepted a position with Syracuse Police, effective August 10.

Researchers at Chalmers University of Technology used machine learning and computer simulations to identify the low-temperature structure of formamidinium lead iodide, a promising but unstable halide perovskite material for solar cells. This discovery is key to engineering more durable and efficient solar cells for applications from phones to buildings.

A 36-year-old man was arrested at Coachella for allegedly stealing over 100 cellphones after concertgoers tracked him using "Find my iPhone." He was detained with the phones in his backpack and faces grand theft charges. Police advise securing valuables and using dummy wallets.

The Syrian grandmother at the center of Hawaii's travel ban lawsuit arrived in Honolulu Saturday night. Her visa was approved weeks ago. The lawsuit argues the ban prevented her visit. Legal challenges continue, with a federal appeals court hearing scheduled. Hawaii's attorney general stated the visa approval does not affect the lawsuit.

Cuba held a military parade on Jan 2 to honor Fidel Castro on the 58th anniversary of the revolution. Soldiers marched without equipment, unlike previous years. A law was passed banning monuments or infrastructure named for Castro. The economy shrank 0.9% in 2016, hurt by Venezuela's crisis, and US rapprochement is threatened by President-elect Trump. A student leader stated Cuba will not renounce its principles.

A study in the *Journal of Experimental Psychology* suggests general distraction is the best short-term method to get over a breakup, though it should be used sparingly. Another option is focusing on the negative aspects of the ex.

A pregnant woman, a stomach-sleeper, struggled to sleep due to medical restrictions against lying on her back or right side. After reading a friend's Facebook post, she bought a U-shaped Leachco pregnancy pillow for $65. It provided comfort, allowed easy side-sleeping and flipping, and she used it constantly. Downsides include its large size and scratchy cover, but she highly recommends it for pregnant women and anyone seeking comfort.

Vale SA's stock conversion plan received 84.4% shareholder support, exceeding the 54.09% threshold, potentially accelerating its Novo Mercado listing. Executives noted no cash incentives for non-swapping investors, and the move could occur as early as 2019, aiming to attract Asian and mining investors. Common shares rose 2%, preferred shares 1%, and ADRs 0.9%.

COVID-19, first identified in China on January 13, 2020, was declared a pandemic by the WHO on March 11, 2020, and first appeared in Turkey on the same day. The pandemic caused a global shift to virtual education, suspending in-person learning. In Turkey, remote learning was conducted via the Education Informatics Network (EBA TV). This study examined the problems and solutions, based on primary school teachers' perspectives, regarding the participation of students with disabilities in inclusive virtual education during the pandemic. The study used a phenomenology design with 10 teachers. Findings revealed challenges such as student participation issues, difficulties in following assignments, and problems with teacher-parent cooperation, but also noted that some students with parental support participated successfully.

The paper defines youth using the UN's 15-24 age range and skills as hard and soft. It notes Nigeria's youth unemployment has risen, with rates higher than total unemployment. Co-op education, an integrated work-study model, is presented as a potential solution to improve school-to-work transitions, with evidence of benefits from developed countries. The paper argues for a federally-driven co-op initiative in Nigeria, building on existing programs like SIWES and N-Power, to better align education with labor market demands.

The Omicron variant (BA.1) was first detected in late November 2021. In England, it spread rapidly from Greater London, with early importations from South Africa and later the US. Travel restrictions on southern African countries were largely ineffective. Most infections stemmed from a few early introductions. Human mobility, particularly from London, drove spatial spread. A statistical model estimated that rising case numbers in urban hubs reduced mobility to/from those hubs by 11.97% per unit increase in weekly cases per 100 people.

The TLV321/2x comparator family consumes 40uA per channel with 40ns propagation delay. It has push-pull (TLV321x) and open-drain (TLV322x) output options. The input voltage range extends 200mV beyond the supply rails. The device has 1.8mV internal hysteresis. Unused push-pull outputs must float; unused open-drain outputs can float or connect to V-. A Power-On-Reset circuit holds the output low for up to 32us after crossing 1.65V. External hysteresis can be added via positive feedback. Proper high-speed PCB layout and supply bypassing are recommended.

The GA102 GPU has 168 FP64 units, with an FP64 TFLOP rate 1/64th of FP32. Each GA10x SM contains 128 CUDA Cores, four third-generation Tensor Cores, a 256 KB Register File, four Texture Units, one second-generation Ray Tracing Core, and 128 KB of configurable L1/Shared Memory. The GA102 memory subsystem has twelve 32-bit memory controllers (384-bit total) with 512 KB of L2 cache per controller, totaling 6144 KB. ROPs are now part of the GPC, with the full GA102 having 112 ROPs across seven GPCs. The GA10x SM has four partitions, each with a 64 KB register file, one warp scheduler, and one dispatch unit. It includes one third-generation Tensor Core per partition, with each being twice as powerful as a Turing Tensor Core. The combined L1 data cache and shared memory capacity is 33% larger than Turing. GA10x includes FP32 processing on both datapaths, doubling the peak FP32 rate. The GA10x SM supports double-speed FP16 operations. The L1 data cache capacity is 128 KB per SM. The full GA102 GPU contains 10752 KB of L1 cache. Ampere architecture GPUs are up to 1.9x more power efficient than Turing. GA10x features second-generation RT Cores that double the ray/triangle intersection testing rate. The GA10x RT Core includes a new Interpolate Triangle Position unit for motion blur. The third-generation Tensor Core architecture includes a Sparsity feature for up to 2x speedup. GA10x supports TF32 and BFloat16 data types. GDDR6X memory uses PAM4 signaling, achieving up to 19.5 Gbps data rates and 936 GB/sec peak memory bandwidth. NVIDIA RTX IO enables GPU-based loading and decompression. The A40 GPU delivers up to 2X FP32 throughput and 2X ray-tracing throughput over the Quadro RTX 6000. Ampere architecture GPUs support HDMI 2.1 and DisplayPort 1.4a. GA10x includes a fifth-generation NVDEC supporting AV1 hardware decode and a seventh-generation NVENC encoder.

The passage discusses Justice Barrett's defense of originalism in constitutional interpretation, focusing on the *Shaw v. Reno* line of cases challenging race-based districting. It argues that these cases cannot be justified under the original public meaning of the 14th or 15th Amendments, as the 14th Amendment's Equal Protection Clause was not understood to constrain election districting, and the 15th Amendment addresses vote denial or abridgment, not districting without vote dilution. The passage then examines how a good originalist, adhering to *stare decisis*, should resolve the tension between *Shaw* precedents and Voting Rights Act Section 2 jurisprudence, concluding that the *Shaw* doctrine should be reconsidered and jettisoned, not used to curtail congressional power under the 15th Amendment.

The United States advanced to the Davis Cup quarterfinals by beating Serbia 3-0 after a four-set doubles win. Switzerland lost 3-0 to Kazakhstan. France led the Netherlands 2-1. Croatia led Canada 2-1. Spain led Britain 2-1. Germany led Australia 2-1. Italy led Japan.
