The Investors Intelligence Sentiment Index, also known as Advisor Sentiment, is a contrarian indicator based on a weekly poll of over a hundred independent market newsletters, assessing authors as bullish, bearish, or expecting a correction. Created by AW Cohen in 1963, it was initially intended to show when to be long based on advisor bullishness, but the investment community now uses it as a contrarian indicator at extreme values. Bullish readings over 55% indicate too much optimism (negative for market), while readings below 35% reflect too much pessimism (positive). Weekly figures above 70% suggest overbought conditions, below 30% oversold. The AAII Sentiment Survey differs by focusing on individual investors' six-month outlook. The index is published by Chartcraft on its website.

Euclid, Ohio police are reviewing a cellphone video of a white officer repeatedly punching a 25-year-old black man during a traffic stop. The officer is on paid leave, and the NAACP is calling for a federal investigation. The man was released after posting bond for driving under suspension and resisting arrest.

Four people were injured in a New York City explosion Monday morning, including the suspect who attempted to detonate a homemade device at the Port Authority near Times Square. The suspect is in custody, and all injuries are non-life-threatening.

Macmillan has released a new season of early years books, including a 35th-anniversary gift edition of Rod Campbell's "Dear Zoo" (£12.99), Catherine Rayner's "Solomon and Mortimer" (£6.99), a republished "Ten Terrible Dinosaurs" by Paul Stickland (£6.99), Julia Donaldson and Rebecca Cobb's "The Everywhere Bear" (£11.99), Morag Hood's "When Grandad Was a Penguin" (£11.99), and Lane Smith's "A Perfect Day" (£11.99).

The Rotary Club of Lakewood and Rocky River held its annual Speech, Music, and Visual Arts Contest awards ceremony on April 9 at Beck Center for the Arts. Speech winners were Nicholas Cleary (first), Taylor Heckel (second), and Gabby Murray (third), all from Lakewood High School. Music winners included Angeliki Cintron (first, flute), Hannah Cogar (second, voice), and Emily Erhardt (third, flute). During the US government shutdown, Department of Education employees found their neutral out-of-office email replies were changed without consent to blame Senate Democrats for the shutdown. Some employees who reverted to neutral language had it changed again. The Department of Education's press line used the same partisan message in response to a comment request.

This policy brief argues that the "out-of-school children" (OOSC) indicator is inadequate because it only measures formal school enrollment, overlooking alternative educational pathways like madrasas and community-based programs. Using Afghanistan as a case study, it advocates replacing OOSC with an "out-of-education children" (OOEC) indicator that captures formal, informal, and non-formal learning. The OOEC indicator broadens perspectives on educational exclusion, fosters culturally relevant solutions, and reimagines education as an interconnected ecosystem.

SFS is an AMD firmware feature for developing and distributing fixes for high priority system issues without rebooting. It uses three version numbers: SFSPL (overall patch level, monotonically increasing), individual firmware SPL versions, and SYSPL (for run-once code, also monotonically increasing). AMD cryptographically signs SFS packages, and customers can opt to co-sign. The ASP verifies AMD's signature before applying updates. SFS packages are non-persistent across reboots and must be reapplied. Application requires specific memory alignment and sequential processing. The ASP checks DRAM protection, verifies signatures, loads the patch, updates patch levels, and returns status.

The defendant appealed a 2004 judgment convicting him of criminal possession of a weapon in the third degree. The court affirmed the judgment, finding no nonfrivolous issues for appeal and granting counsel's withdrawal. The defendant's pro se issues were precluded by his valid waiver of the right to appeal.

The passage outlines U.S. passport application rules, including required personal descriptions, supporting witness certificates, and specific additional documentation for native citizens, naturalized citizens, women, children, insular residents, and servants. Archaeologists in Mexico will excavate a sealed tunnel beneath a Maya pyramid at Chichen Itza to reach a hidden cenote, an underwater cavern central to Mayan spirituality. The Maya used cenotes for human sacrifice to appease their rain god. The team believes the cenote under El Castillo may represent a fifth direction, or "axis mundi," and could reveal more about Maya beliefs, including the role of child sacrifice.
Lab tests show that jostling microbubbles of air and methane can create tiny lightning zaps, potentially igniting swamp will-o'-the-wisps, whose ignition source was previously mysterious.

The EU pledged €545 million ($636 million) for renewable energy and electrification projects in Africa through its Global Gateway plan, aiming to expand electricity access and compete with China's Belt and Road Initiative. Nearly 600 million Africans lack electricity. The EU estimates the program could create 38 million green jobs by 2030. China invested $39 billion in African energy contracts in early 2025 and exported 15GW of solar panels to Africa by June 2025. The US and G7 also launched infrastructure initiatives in Africa, including the Lobito Corridor railway.

Patriarch Theophilos III of Jerusalem announced his Church will appeal an Israeli court decision approving the sale of church property to companies representing Israeli settlers in East Jerusalem. The Church has fought the deal for a decade, arguing it was conducted illegally by the deposed Patriarch Irenaios. The Jerusalem District Court upheld the sale, allowing three properties near Jaffa Gate to be leased for 99 years to Ateret Cohanim. Theophilos called the ruling "politically motivated" and will appeal to Israel's Supreme Court, urging world leaders to intervene.

The passage describes a study on kindergarten teachers' views of distance education in Epirus, Greece, during the COVID-19 pandemic. Most teachers were unfamiliar with distance education before its mandatory implementation, and a majority had not used it previously. Synchronous education (e.g., Webex) was preferred. Teachers generally held negative views, citing reduced psychomotor activities, the need for adult supervision, and lower effectiveness in developing social skills. Key obstacles included inadequate digital infrastructure, limited internet access, and young students' difficulty using technology independently. The study found a statistically significant link between ICT certification and familiarity with distance education, but no significant relationship between years of service and ICT literacy.

A "Take A Knee Chart" is a downloadable PDF and Google Sheets tool for football coaches to determine when to use a risk-free play that runs out the clock at the end of a game when the offense is ahead. The chart shows player positions and movement order. The passage also discusses the importance of clock management, noting that high school and college football use a 40-second play clock without a two-minute warning, and that incomplete passes stop the clock.

S&P Global Ratings downgraded Bridgeview, Illinois' credit rating to BB-minus (junk) due to debt pressures from $135 million in GO bonds issued for Toyota Park. The rating is on watch for a possible further downgrade due to concerns over market access and liquidity. Bridgeview is considering restructuring $24.5 million of variable-rate bonds, and S&P expects continued restructurings that may extend maturities beyond the stadium's useful life. The stadium is "underperforming," contributing to an "extremely high" GO debt of about $256 million and "very weak" liquidity.

It reveals a 15–45% performance drop on non-English tasks, with English consistently yielding better results and low-resource languages showing higher failure rates.

Amazon.com, Inc. filed its 2018 Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2018. The company operates in three segments: North America, International, and Amazon Web Services (AWS). Net sales were $232.9 billion in 2018, up from $177.9 billion in 2017. Operating income was $12.4 billion in 2018, compared to $4.1 billion in 2017. The company employed approximately 647,500 people as of December 31, 2018.

The 9 EMA trading strategy uses the 9-period exponential moving average to generate buy signals when price moves above it and sell signals when price moves below it. Backtesting shows it works well in trending assets like Bitcoin but fails in mean-reverting markets like stocks. Adding a 200-day moving average filter improves performance but does not make the strategy tradable for stocks.
A class action lawsuit was filed against electricity generators, alleging they manipulated California's wholesale electricity market, causing inflated prices.

GOLDWOOD is a premium plywood brand known for uncompromising quality, built on mutual trust, transparency, and a commitment to sustainable development. MU held an annual Veterans Day wreath laying ceremony. Keynote speaker Col. Roderik Cox defined a veteran as anyone who swore an oath to defend the nation. The event included remarks from several university leaders and aimed to honor veterans and look toward future peace. Speakers addressed Hollywood stereotypes, noting veterans are "regular folks."

The Konektadong Pinoy Act, signed into law on August 24, 2025, aims to remove barriers to competition in the Philippine telco market. It may allow Virtual Network Operators to compete with PLDT, potentially worsening PLDT's declining profitability and slowing growth. The law could also lead to excess capital investment in a mature, highly penetrated industry, depressing profitability. Despite PLDT's attractive valuation, the threat of new entrants is a reason to avoid investing.

A passport expires two years after issuance. A new one requires a new application; for naturalized citizens, the old passport may substitute for a naturalization certificate if the original application had sufficient naturalization details. A single passport can cover an applicant's wife, minor children, and servant if they are entitled, but separate passports are needed for others. Professional titles are not included. A one-dollar fee must accompany each application via currency or postal money order. The Department of State does not procure passport visés. Blank application forms are provided to applicants but not to passport procurement businesses. Communications should be addressed to the Department of State, Passport Bureau. The Secretary of State may reject applications for unlawful purposes or non-compliance. For insular possessions, applications go to the chief executive; for those abroad, to diplomatic or consular officers. Passports are only for U.S. allegiance holders; declarant citizens cannot receive one. Applications must be written affidavits with specific personal details and a declaration of temporary travel and intent to return.

The International Nurses Association has welcomed Joy Williams, BSN, RN, for her upcoming publication in Worldwide Leaders In Healthcare. Williams, a registered nurse in Louisiana with over seven years of experience, began her career in 2009 after earning a Diploma of Practical Nursing from Nunez Community College. She later obtained a Bachelor of Science in Nursing from Dillard University in 2016. She holds memberships in the National Black Nurses Association and the National Student Nurses Association, and credits her daughter Londen as her inspiration.

Small group differentiation is a promising strategy for enhancing learning outcomes and inclusivity in diverse educational settings. U.S. public school demographics have shifted, with White enrollment decreasing and Hispanic enrollment increasing from 2009 to 2018. Language diversity also impacts learning, with the percentage speaking only English at home declining from 89.1% in 1980 to 79.7% in 2010. Differentiation tailors teaching to student needs, guided by Constructivism and Sociocultural Theory. It involves adjusting content, process, products, and learning environment. Challenges include time investment, large class sizes, and student diversity, including disabilities—7.3 million students received special education services in 2021–22. The study lacks comparative data on differentiated instruction across settings and empirical evidence linking it to test scores.

This paper presents the Atlas of Human-AI Interaction, a framework using LLMs to extract empirical findings from over 1,000 HCI papers as structured cause-effect triplets, constructing a knowledge graph with three visualization modes. Analysis identified 24 topic clusters and structural gaps, with LLMs, generative AI, and trust as key cross-community integration opportunities. A user study with 20 experts found the tool effective for landscape exploration and gap identification but noted limitations in depth and domain applicability.

The 4-3 defense, popularized by Tom Landry and modernized by Jimmy Johnson and the Tampa Bay Buccaneers, consists of four defensive linemen, three linebackers, and four defensive backs. It uses smaller, athletic players in the front seven, with the 3-technique defensive tackle as a key position. Strengths include run defense and gap soundness, while weaknesses involve struggles against spread offenses and specific personnel needs. Common blitzes include the Will edge blitz and zone blitz, with coverages like Tampa 2 and Cover 3. Notable teams include the 2000s Buccaneers and 2006 Bears, with high school success at Montini Catholic.

Google has launched Gemini Enterprise, an AI platform for business customers, offering access to advanced models and enterprise-grade tools for data governance, security, and compliance. It allows firms to deploy and customize AI on Google Cloud, focusing on transparency and accountability to compete with Microsoft, Amazon, and OpenAI.

Ray Dalio's All Weather Portfolio is a diversified strategy designed to perform well in various economic conditions, including inflation, deflation, and stagflation, using stocks, bonds, and commodities. It prioritizes defense and risk mitigation, resulting in lower drawdowns than stocks during events like the 2008/09 financial crisis, Covid-19, and the 2022 bear market, though it may underperform in bull markets.

The Oregon Court of Appeals modified a dissolution judgment, increasing father's child support from $31 to $65 per month per child, finding the original amount insufficient for the children's welfare.

In Melbourne, a real courtroom trial of Hamlet for murdering Polonius features real lawyers and a judge, with actors as Hamlet, Ophelia, and Gertrude. The show, by Yan Duyvendak and Roger Bernat, has been performed in 12 countries since 2011, adapting to each nation's legal system. A jury of 12 audience members decides the verdict. The work originated from the creators' shock at Guantanamo trial transcripts, aiming to demonstrate how justice systems function. Each performance uses a real 2010 case of a young man accused of killing his girlfriend's father, integrated with Shakespeare's scenario. The creators had differing opinions on the real case's guilt, leading to a show that highlights the complexity of justice.

The passage discusses the metaverse in education, defining it as a 3D virtual reality merging real and virtual worlds for interactive learning. It reviews literature, noting increased research since 2020, with South Korea, China, and the US as leading countries. Using the Scopus database and PRISMA method, 270 articles were analyzed via VOSviewer. Key findings include top journals (e.g., *IEEE Transactions on Learning Technologies*, *Sustainability*) and articles, with prominent topics like virtual reality, augmented reality, and artificial intelligence. The study identifies gaps, such as a lack of longitudinal and cross-cultural research, and suggests future exploration of extended reality, blockchain, and gamification.
The appellate division affirmed the order with costs, with one justice dissenting on procedural grounds.

Michigan State Police and Emergency Management urge voluntary participation in a statewide tornado drill at 1 p.m. Wednesday, with nearly all state facilities joining. Tornadoes can develop rapidly, especially in late spring and early summer, with an average lead time of 10-15 minutes. Residents are advised to identify shelter, conduct drills, monitor weather broadcasts, and prepare 72-hour emergency kits. The drill will be rescheduled to 1 p.m. Thursday if severe weather occurs on April 19.

This passage provides a comprehensive guide to defensive transition in basketball, emphasizing that good offense (ball care, shot selection, rebounding, defensive balance) is the foundation. It details specific techniques for defending outnumbered situations, preventing outlet passes, recovering from turnovers and blocked shots, and maintaining ball vision. The text stresses sprinting back, forcing extra passes, and treating defensive stops after mistakes as "Really Big Plays." It concludes with coaching objectives and teaching methods for instilling these habits.

It specifies the minimum state information required in the GHCB, the use of the VALID_BITMAP field, and the calculation of bit positions. The Navy's Pier Pressure app, part of Alcohol Awareness Month, helps Sailors make responsible drinking choices. It offers interactive gaming, a calorie counter, and integration with Uber and Lyft. The app has been played over 30,000 times and is available on iTunes and Google Play.

The Dow Jones fell over 400 points on Tuesday due to interest rate fears and Caterpillar's economic slowdown hint. The S&P 500 and Nasdaq also dropped. Caterpillar and 3M stocks fell after earnings news, while the 10-year Treasury yield rose above 3% for the first time in four years.

The court reversed a $30,890 judgment for the plaintiffs due to reversible errors in jury instructions. The trial court improperly instructed the jury on life expectancy, assumed a fixed 34.5-year period for the widow's damages, and directed consideration of "loss of love and care" for a minor child, which is not recoverable. The court also erred in failing to exclude sorrow and grief from consideration and in overruling an objection to improper attorney argument.

Hundreds of HP laptop and tablet models were found with a keylogger in Synaptics touchpad drivers, disabled by default and fixed via HP patches. Security researcher Michael Myng discovered it and HP confirmed the issue. The keylogger could allow malicious monitoring after a registry change. Over 450 devices were affected, including HP Notebook, EliteBook, and ProBook models. This was the second keylogger issue for HP in 2017, following a similar problem in Conexant audio drivers.

Police in China's Xinjiang region shot dead three knife-wielding assailants who killed five and injured ten. The incident occurred Tuesday in Pishan County. Authorities called the assailants "thugs" and said social order was restored.

The passage covers two MLS matches. Philadelphia's Borek Dockal, with two assists and a penalty, is highlighted as a key player, and the team is unbeaten in four games. Ilsinho scored a notable goal for Philadelphia against Chicago's Bastian Schweinsteiger. A defensive error by New England's Antonio Delamea Milnar allowed Atlanta's Josef Martinez to score, though a late Teal Bunbury penalty gave New England a 1-1 draw.

Johnny Juzang, on a non-guaranteed contract, scored 20 points in 14 minutes during a preseason game, making a case for a roster spot with the Timberwolves after they lost Nickeil Alexander-Walker. Juzang has made over 38% of his 3-point shots over the last two seasons and fits the team's playing style.

Researchers at Johns Hopkins and the Mayo Clinic published a guideline in *JAMA Internal Medicine* to stop using the CK-MB blood test for suspected heart attacks, citing evidence it is ineffective. The report, part of a series by the High Value Practice Academic Alliance, provides a four-step plan to eliminate CK-MB testing, which remains in use by 77% of U.S. labs despite recommendations favoring troponin.

The passage describes a study using hydrodynamical simulations, chemical modeling, and radiative transfer to produce synthetic line observations of a model prestellar core. The authors find that infall velocities measured using the Myers et al. (1996) method from self-absorbed line profiles underestimate the true mass-weighted infall velocity, often by a significant margin, due to the method's assumption of a constant infall velocity.

An Indian-origin UK surgeon, Dr Sachiendra Amaragiri, was banned from practising medicine after a tribunal found him guilty of writing a love letter to a female patient, Patient A. The patient reported distress, and the doctor, who apologized, intends to appeal.
On March 11, 2021, Jerome Guillen transitioned from President, Automotive to President, Tesla Heavy Trucking to lead the Tesla Semi program, including charging and servicing networks.

Sony launched a U.S. rebate and trade-in scheme offering up to $500 for trading in an interchangeable lens camera, plus instant savings of up to $300 on select cameras, up to $200 on A7 cameras, and up to $100 on select lenses and accessories, with free shipping, valid through September 30, 2017.

Compass Minerals International is rated a "Buy" due to attractive valuation and operational improvement, with rising revenue and volumes in salt and plant nutrition, improved cash flow and EBITDA from cost-cutting, and lower multiples offering upside despite higher net debt and leverage. Management projects 2025 top-line growth, but leverage risk limits the rating to "Buy."

Backtests show the CANSLIM method has beaten the S&P 500 since 2003, but with higher volatility and larger drawdowns. Its outperformance may be due to a small-cap bias. The method is difficult to implement and has underperformed in recent years.

The speaker felt great after a win, credited Rucchin and Jiggy, and noted the team played well. They contributed offensively, felt the game was under control, and emphasized consistency and preparation. They lead by example, avoid pre-game talk, and described a hit as surprising but part of Scott's game. The first two games in New Jersey were an aberration; the team regained legs in Anaheim. They need to change home-court hold. Matchups matter, but they must return to earlier success. Winning the Stanley Cup is meaningful, but focus is on the next game. They sleep fine, need defensive tightening, and had no reaction to a hit. A doctor checked them after a stick hit; they were eager to return. The arena was loud, but teammates were focused. Animosity in a long series is expected. They recalled a comeback win with Rucchin's goal.

Peter Crouch made a humorous comment about the Royal baby's hospital appearance, which was widely retweeted. His wife Abbey Clancy then responded with a blunt reply. Crystal Palace's Twitter account also joked about the baby's name announcement.

The passage discusses the Golden State Warriors' tendency to fall behind early and rely on strong second-half comebacks, a pattern that concerns analysts Mark Jackson and Jeff Van Gundy. Despite the team's success, including leading the NBA in third-quarter scoring and overcoming large deficits in the Western Conference finals, both analysts warn that this habit of digging holes is risky and may eventually backfire.

Savvy investors are buying closed-end equity mutual fund schemes on stock exchanges at discounts to their net asset values (NAVs) due to poor liquidity. Buyers profit from the discount when the scheme matures and redeems at NAV. Examples include Reliance Close Ended Mutual Fund Series A Growth (NAV Rs 21.52, trading at Rs 19.50) and HDFC Equity Opportunities Fund (NAV Rs 9.79, trading at Rs 9.2). The discount depends on time to maturity and tax considerations; schemes with less than a year to maturity may have higher discounts. Experts recommend focusing on schemes with assets over Rs 250 crore for better trading chances.

Airbus plans to test a prototype for an autonomous flying car, called Project Vahana, aiming to offer airborne taxi services by 2021 with a prototype ready by 2017. Other companies, including Uber, Urban Aeronautics, and AeroMobil, along with tech investors, are also developing flying car technology.

A letter from fired prosecutor Michael Ben’Ary stated his termination was due to a false social media post during a terrorism prosecution, and that DOJ leadership is more focused on punishing the president’s perceived enemies than on national security.

A light emitting diode device includes a thin film transistor substrate, first and second diode electrodes, a first passivation pattern between them, micro light emitting diodes on the pattern, a first bridge pattern connecting the first electrode to the diodes, and a second bridge pattern connecting the second electrode to the diodes. Sidewalls of the micro light emitting diodes and the first passivation pattern form a same plane. A manufacturing method involves forming the passivation pattern, micro light emitting diode, and a second passivation pattern via a single mask process with two etching steps.

The US town of Aspen is replacing its Fourth of July fireworks with a 50-drone show due to wildfire risk in the drought-hit area. The 15-minute show, organized by the Aspen Chamber Resort Association, will start at 21:15 local time.

The U.S. national debt surpassed $21 trillion for the first time, growing $73 billion in one day and $215 billion in February. Over six months, it increased by over $1 trillion despite no major economic crisis. Debt growth (6% last year) outpaced GDP growth (4.4% including inflation), and over ten years, debt rose 123% while the economy grew 36%. The passage notes three common attitudes toward the debt: ignoring it, dismissing it, or preparing for potential consequences.

Jio announced offers on Samsung Galaxy J2 2018 and J7 Duo, including instant cashback of Rs 2,750 via 55 vouchers of Rs 50 each, and extra data benefits on Rs 198 or Rs 299 plans, valid until September 30.

The CFPB finalized rules requiring payday lenders to assess borrowers' ability to repay within 30 days and limit debit attempts, potentially halving loan volume and closing many stores. The rules face Republican opposition and could be rolled back by Congress, with 70% of surveyed adults supporting more regulation.

Sarcomas are diverse mesenchymal tumors with varied genetic causes and poor response to first-line chemotherapy (≈20%). Immune checkpoint inhibition (ICI) shows variable activity in sarcomas, with predictive biomarkers like MSI and TMB being rare. This study analyzed pre-treatment biopsies from 67 sarcoma patients across 3 ICI trials, identifying two immune clusters ("hot" and "cold") via RNA-seq. Immune-hot tumors had higher response rates (30% vs. 8.1%) and longer progression-free survival (3.65 vs. 1.7 months). Expression of transposable elements (TEs) and the epigenetic regulator IKZF1 predicted immune type, correlated with immune pathway activation, and were associated with improved outcomes. Findings were validated in a separate TCGA cohort of 190 sarcomas.

A writing program at Seattle Children's helps parents of terminally ill children, like Meagan Holt whose daughter has Zellweger Syndrome, express trapped emotions through journaling. The Pediatric Advanced Care Team (PACT) offers this as an empowerment tool, providing a sense of calm, relief, and acceptance. The program relies on donations.

Happy Home Furnishers is closing its Neath store after 33 years, citing issues including a lack of free parking, increased business rates, and anti-social behaviour. The managing director detailed problems with disruptive behaviour near the store, which staff had to manage, and criticized the council's street improvements and bench placement. Other traders reported mixed experiences with anti-social behaviour. The council defended its improvements, noted the removal of benches, and highlighted a new car park and free parking after 3pm. The Welsh Government mentioned business rate relief schemes. The company is seeking another site in Neath.

This study explores physics teachers' perspectives on science education research, finding that while some teachers value it, many are sceptical about its practical value, feasibility, and the cooperation between researchers and schools. A survey of 174 teachers identified four profiles: "The Sceptical Ones" (14%), "The Uncertain Ones" (27%), "The Undersupplied Ones" (41%), and "The Research Advocates" (18%). Only the frequency of reading instructional journals significantly predicted profile membership, not other professional variables like teaching experience or teacher education.

The Baltimore Ravens traded pass rusher Odafe Oweh and a 2026 fifth-round pick to the Los Angeles Chargers for safety Alohi Gilman, freeing up about $8 million in cap space. Oweh had no sacks in five games this season after a career-high 10 sacks last year. The Ravens, who have allowed the most points per game (35.4) and rank 31st in pass defense, also added safety Gardner-Johnson. Gilman was a key part of the Chargers' top-ranked defense last season.

African countries were urged to use modern technology to address tax non-compliance. Secretary to the Treasury Ben Botolo stated that electronic fiscal devices are critical for optimizing tax revenue, noting that many African countries are still cash economies. He said Malawi has made progress in electronic tax monitoring and that a Tax Administration Act is forthcoming. VADA Chairperson Henry Saka stressed formalizing regulatory strategies and designing African solutions to tax evasion. The VADA Forum includes 10 member countries and provides technical support to 12 non-member countries.

The passage discusses the properties of propagators in free scalar field theory, including their interpretations as transition amplitudes and correlation functions. It then introduces interacting field theories, specifically the phi^4 theory, and explains that such theories cannot be solved exactly. The concept of the S-matrix is introduced as a key observable for scattering experiments, defined as the transition amplitude from an initial state of free particles at t = -∞ to a final state at t = +∞. The S-matrix is unitary and respects symmetries of the Hamiltonian. The LSZ theorem is mentioned, stating that scattering amplitudes can be obtained from time-ordered correlation functions in the full interacting theory.

The author clarifies that his earlier message did not deny Congress's constitutional power to legislate the custody and disposition of public money and property. He admits the Legislature's authority to regulate deposits and custody, and disclaims any Executive right to possession or interference except as granted by law. He requests this clarification be entered with the original message in the Senate journal.

The speaker discusses the team's focus and preparation for upcoming games, noting that home ice is not an automatic advantage and that winning away games is necessary. They mention the team's experience in previous playoffs, the importance of staying focused despite distractions, and the performance of goalie Mike. They also comment on specific plays, player adjustments, and the team's defensive pairings, emphasizing the need to play a complete game and avoid penalties.

This application provides a sidelink positioning method and apparatus. A first terminal device receives a first sidelink positioning configuration from a network device and sends a first sidelink positioning reference signal to a second terminal device. A first measurement value is determined from this signal, and the position of the first terminal device is determined based on this measurement value and the position of the second terminal device.

A retired lawyer purged his 50-year-old law school books, including texts on contracts, property, and torts, after deciding they were no longer useful. He kept one thick volume as a reading stand.

In June 2014, a Wall Street Journal article reported that Hertz Global Holdings had to restate results from the past three years due to widespread accounting problems. Analyst Abby Devins considered whether these issues related to Hertz's rental fleet. The U.S. car rental industry had $36 billion in revenue in 2013, dominated by three companies. Hertz, founded in 1918, had over 30,000 employees and nearly 12,000 locations by 2013. The company's 2013 revenue was $10.8 billion, with depreciation averaging 25% of expenses from 2011-2013. Depreciation of rental fleet is calculated using estimated holding periods and residual values, with rates reviewed quarterly. Devins collected data on Hertz's revenue earning equipment and depreciation from 2006-2013 for analysis.

AI can augment human cognition, learning, and creativity but risks over-reliance and limited skill internalization. Mitigations include selective task delegation and personalized AI-enhanced education. AI may blur job boundaries, promote a gig economy, and enable dynamic global collaboration, requiring policy reforms. In social science, LLMs can synthesize data, automate analysis, and explore theories, but face bias and validity challenges. AI governance needs top-down regulation and bottom-up reporting to balance innovation with risk mitigation.

Unused comparator inputs must not be tied together; they require a minimum 50mV differential voltage within the input range. The TLV32xx family has 1.8mV internal hysteresis. The TLV321x has push-pull output; unused outputs must float. The TLV322x has open-drain output; unused outputs can float or connect to V-. Inputs and outputs have ESD protection to the rails. The TLV321x has a Power-On-Reset circuit that holds the output low for up to 32µs after crossing 1.65V. External hysteresis can be added via positive feedback. Proper high-speed PCB layout and supply bypassing are recommended.

Governor Nyesom Wike of Rivers State called for a US Visa Office in Port Harcourt to serve the South-South and South-East. He also called for the Ogoni clean-up and expressed interest in US partnerships in agriculture, oil, and gas.

The speaker discusses pathways to nuclear war, focusing on fear as a key factor, and compares the risks of climate change and nuclear war. They cover the history of nuclear weapons, the Non-Proliferation Treaty (NPT), the dangers of accidental launch between the US and Russia, and escalation from conventional war in India and Pakistan. The speaker criticizes the lack of progress on disarmament, Obama's mixed record, and the risks of current nuclear postures, arguing for risk minimization over abolition.

It urges a reciprocity treaty with Cuba, citing political and economic ties, and a convention with Newfoundland. It praises The Hague Court, citing the U.S.-Mexico case as a precedent, and recommends building the Panama Canal.

An environment watchdog criticized a council's claim of needing up to 55,000 new homes over 20 years, as a Freedom of Information request showed 60% would be for people moving into the area. The council stated it is required by the government to plan for homes based on migration trends and a standard formula.

President Johnson transmits to the House of Representatives a letter to General Grant and accompanying Cabinet members' statements regarding a conversation on January 14, 1868. Johnson accuses Grant of insubordination and of secretly planning to circumvent the President's intent regarding the War Department. Grant's reply denies insubordination and explains his interpretation of the President's orders.

Grief specialists advise those mourning during the holidays to plan their tolerance, limit events, have an exit plan, feel emotions, create new traditions, and keep old ones. The Surviving Suicide Grief Support Group meets twice monthly in Woodstock, and other grief programs are available in the area.
On October 20, 2016, Microsoft Corporation filed a Form 8-K reporting its financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2016, via a press release furnished as Exhibit 99.1.

This study explored medical students' perceptions of a curriculum-based resilience skills building course in Dubai. The course, grounded in constructivism and experiential learning, aimed to raise awareness of stress and provide tools for developing resilience. Qualitative analysis of student reflective essays generated three themes: Awareness, Application, and Appraisal. Students reported that the course increased their understanding of resilience, its relevance, and the need for conscious practice. They applied concepts through various exercises, though some faced challenges like skepticism and time constraints. Students positively appraised the course, noting benefits for their well-being, academic performance, and future clinical practice. The study supports integrating such courses into medical curricula.

Bill Belichick plans no structural changes after North Carolina's 38-10 loss to Clemson, citing a need to "keep doing what we're doing but do them better." UNC is 0-3 against Power 4 teams, outscored 120-33. Belichick acknowledged a "building" approach, while players rejected the "rebuild" label.

The passage describes an undergraduate special education course designed to integrate advocacy as a consistent theme rather than a standalone lesson. The course includes scaffolded assignments, such as TED Talk presentations, debates, and policy analysis, to build pre-service teachers' advocacy skills. It emphasizes that advocacy is essential for special education teachers to challenge inequities and influence policy, and that coursework should provide practice-based learning opportunities to prepare them for this role.

Community-based organizations like summer camps, mentoring, and after-school clubs can expand youth mental health support by leveraging trusted relationships. With proper training and investment, these spaces can help recognize, respond to, and refer youth in need, complementing school efforts without becoming clinics.

The lecture discusses challenges in regulating digital platforms, focusing on too little cooperation and issues of contestability and fairness. It contrasts the Chicago School argument (that platforms benefit from a rich ecosystem) with three counterpoints: zero lower bounds on consumer prices, contestability of the core segment, and zero lower bounds for apps/merchants. The Digital Market Act (DMA) aims to promote entry and fairness, but regulating global, fast-changing platforms differs from traditional public utilities. The analysis of access pricing shows that optimal access charges depend on ancillary benefits (b), and that platforms may foreclose rivals when access charges are too low.

Avoyelles Parish will spend about $8,123 per student in state and local revenues for 2017-18, the second lowest among 69 districts. The state average is $9,015. Local funding in Avoyelles is $2,102 per student, also second lowest. The Minimum Foundation Program allocates state funds using a formula that considers local tax contributions, with a target of 35% local and 65% state funding. Avoyelles' split is 25.85% local and 74.15% state. The Senate has requested a task force to determine the actual cost of education in Louisiana.

President Ford's EO 11905 (1976) replaced the 40 Committee with the Operations Advisory Group (OAG), banned U.S. involvement in political assassinations, and prohibited domestic intelligence activities. President Carter replaced the OAG with the NSC's Special Coordination Committee (SCC), later formalized in EO 11985 and reaffirmed in EO 12036. The SCC established the Special Activities Working Group (SAWG), which gradually fell out of use by late 1979, replaced by an interagency group chaired by David Aaron. The Carter administration also used "world-wide" presidential findings and "Perspectives" documents for lower-risk covert operations.

An adjournment of the term does not automatically dismiss an application or deprive the court of jurisdiction. In the absence of a contrary showing, cause for continuing the hearing is presumed.

Tesla, Inc. filed its Annual Report on Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2018, detailing its business as a vertically integrated sustainable energy company designing, manufacturing, and selling electric vehicles and energy generation and storage systems.

Coach DeBoer discusses the team's situation, lineup considerations, confidence from past experiences, travel adjustments, officiating, and the need for more goals, crediting the opponent's goaltender while expressing frustration with missed scoring chances.

Temple Grandin will present on livestock handling and animal behavior at a Feb. 23 breakfast event in Red Bluff, sponsored by Shasta College and UC Cooperative Extension. Grandin, a professor and author, is known for her animal behavior research and publications. Breakfast costs $15.

Israel and Canada signed a modernized free trade agreement, replacing the 1997 version, which will eliminate duties on thousands of additional products. The agreement includes new chapters on labor, environment, trade and gender, and aims to double bilateral trade.

Older mothers worry less, are more positive, and have greater psychological maturity, but face higher health risks like miscarriage and premature birth.

They recall a past series win in Montreal and analyze ice time imbalances, forechecking problems, and the importance of puck placement.
Scientists created functional human egg cells from skin cells by inducing meiosis, a process that could potentially aid infertile individuals in having children.

Niu Technologies' stock has risen significantly in 2025 due to strong recent growth, but sustaining this growth is uncertain. Factors could disrupt expected growth, and the rally may not be justified by future performance, leading to a neutral hold rating.

The passage describes compositions and methods for increasing the therapeutic efficacy of chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) T cells by reducing or eliminating the expression and/or function of methylcytosine dioxygenase genes (Tet1, Tet2, Tet3), particularly Tet2. It details cells engineered to express a CAR with reduced Tet function, various inhibitors (e.g., gene editing systems, shRNA, small molecules), methods of treatment, and manufacturing processes. The disclosure is based on findings from a patient where CAR19 insertion into the Tet2 gene led to clonal expansion and reduced 5-hydroxymethylcytosine levels.

The passage discusses the rise of "Russian math" after-school programs in the U.S., driven by the Russian School of Mathematics, which emphasizes reasoning and deeper understanding. Parents enroll children due to dissatisfaction with school curricula or to gain an advantage, creating a competitive "arms race." The trend originated from Soviet math traditions and immigration. It poses challenges for schools, such as widening performance gaps, but also increases honors class participation.

This Mendelian randomization study found that genetically determined pericardial adipose tissue (PAT) was causally associated with increased risks of cardiovascular disease, heart failure, hypertension, coronary heart disease, ischemic heart disease, ischemic stroke, and venous thromboembolism. Hypertension mediated these associations. No significant causal links were found for other cardiovascular diseases.

Enron Corp. disclosed that the SEC requested information on its dealings with partnerships run by CFO Andrew Fastow, leading to a 21% stock drop to $20.65. The company reported a $1.2 billion reduction in shareholder equity from unwinding these partnerships, contributing to a $618 million third-quarter loss. Analysts raised concerns about potential dilution from other financing vehicles like Marlin Water Trust II and Whitewing. A class-action lawsuit was filed, and Enron planned a conference call to address investor concerns.

Three youth were killed by Indian troops in Shopian district during a siege and search operation. A mosque and four houses were blasted. Protests and injuries followed. Two Indian soldiers were killed earlier. Train services were suspended. A joint resistance leadership opposed any attempt to change Jammu and Kashmir's disputed status. A civilian injured in an explosion died.

The case highlighted widespread sexual harassment in Nigerian universities and workplaces. Professor Richard Akindele was dismissed by OAU for soliciting sex from a student. The passage commends OAU's swift action, urges other institutions to follow suit, and calls for measures to protect female students and deter lecturers, while also advising female students to avoid luring lecturers.

Alfie Evans' father said his son's life support was turned off, but the toddler has been breathing unassisted for nine hours. Doctors initially refused oxygen but later provided it after the father intervened. The mother reported Alfie was given oxygen and water.

Karl Rove, a top Bush adviser, owned stock in companies like Enron that could be affected by administration policies, and was awaiting approval to sell his holdings. Saudi Arabia signed $25 billion deals with nine oil firms, including Enron, to develop natural gas fields. Enron faced criticism from Nigeria's president for poor performance on a power project and was involved in a dispute with Indian lenders over the Dabhol project.

The speaker discusses maintaining mindset and preparation for a road playoff game, noting the opponent's desperation and the advantage of rest and practice. They emphasize awareness of the building's energy, the value of a versatile teammate, the need to win faceoffs and execute plays, the reality of injuries, the benefit of past experience, the importance of playing aggressively, and the influence of a passionate former player as a coach.

A workflow using HostEL (human background depletion) and AmpRE (single-tube DNA/RNA library preparation) was developed for unbiased metagenomic next-generation sequencing (mNGS). Analytical validation with spiked plasma showed 96% sensitivity and 96% specificity with HostEL treatment. Clinical validation on 42 plasma samples achieved 93% agreement with qPCR results for samples with Ct<33. The workflow was tested on iSeq 100 and MiniSeq platforms, enabling detection of bacteria, fungi, DNA viruses, and RNA viruses with a potential turnaround time of 27 hours.

In its first year, Mission Hope Cancer Center's transport van, funded by Cruzin’ for Life, served over 2,600 patients and logged 34,000 miles. The free service, born from a board member's relative's cancer diagnosis, was supported by a $36,000 donation from Santa Maria Energy. The van is used based on patient need, and a second van is considered if funding allows.

A woman declared dead by paramedics after a car crash in South Africa was later found alive in a mortuary refrigerator. The incident occurred on June 24 near Carletonville. Mortuary technicians discovered her alive hours after the crash. The ambulance service confirmed all standard checks were performed and has launched an investigation.

The 2025–26 season is Jim Montgomery's first full season as Blues head coach after leading them to the playoffs mid-season. The schedule opens Oct. 9 at home, with seven of the first 11 games in October. Key rivalry games include Oct. 18 and Dec. 12 at home, and Jan. 7 in Chicago. The NHL pauses Feb. 5–25 for the Winter Olympics. The season ends April 16 in Utah. Montgomery faces challenges with defensive consistency, young forward development, and 26 division games.

San Juan mayor Carmen Yulin Cruz called new Harvard death toll estimates for Hurricane Maria, which found 4,645 excess deaths, a "day of collective mourning," criticizing the government's official count of 64 as untrue. The estimate has a margin of error from 793 to 8,498, with a likely figure of about 5,000. Cruz expressed frustration with the Trump administration and stated Puerto Rico is not prepared for the upcoming hurricane season.

The passage backtests the end of month effect in NIFTY 50, finding a positive and robust effect. The optimal turn of the month strategy is to enter at the close of the fifth last trading day and exit at the close of the second trading day of the new month. A backtest investing 100,000 shows a CAGR of 10.5% with 30% market exposure and a 26% max drawdown, outperforming buy and hold.

Celtic are set to create the largest points gap over Rangers in 91 years, currently leading by 19 points with a game in hand. The previous record was in 1925-26, when Celtic finished 20 points ahead of sixth-placed Rangers.

This study reviews literature on drama in education and STEAM, presenting a pilot case study with 19 female university students. Two drama activities (butterfly life cycle and Indian caste system) were observed. Findings showed drama increased creativity, collaboration, problem-solving, and motivation. The study concludes drama is a valuable tool in STEAM education, though limitations include a small, homogenous sample.

This application is a continuation of U.S. patent application Ser. No. 17/682,133 (filed Feb. 28, 2022), which is a continuation of U.S. patent application Ser. No. 16/031,188 (filed Jul. 10, 2018) and U.S. patent application Ser. No. 15/279,165 (filed Sep. 28, 2016), both claiming priority to Provisional U.S. Patent Application No. 62/233,930 (filed Sep. 28, 2015). The application describes an autonomous vehicle with multiple independent control systems, including an autonomous control system and a bypass control unit, to provide redundancy for specific safety situations.

TrackR announced three new Bluetooth tracking devices: the TrackR pixel ($24.99), an updated TrackR wallet 2.0 ($29.99), and the TrackR atlas smart plug ($39.99). The pixel and wallet offer close-range tracking via a smartphone app and long-range crowd-sourced discovery, with replaceable batteries. The atlas maps a home to locate items by room and supports Amazon Alexa. Pre-orders begin today, with the atlas currently available; all launch in spring.

Lightning is not attracted to metal; height, shape, and isolation determine strikes. A car's metal roof, not its tires, provides protection. Lightning can strike up to 10 miles from a storm in clear sky. It often strikes the same place repeatedly. Trees are dangerous shelter as they attract lightning.

On May 2, 2016, NVIDIA Corporation announced a settlement with Samsung to end all pending intellectual property litigation between them, resulting in the dismissal of all related cases in U.S. courts, the ITC, and the Patent Office. The settlement includes a limited patent license exchange with no broad cross-licensing or other compensation.

Thinking Machines Lab, co-founded by former OpenAI researchers including Mira Murati, launched its first product, Tinker, a tool that automates fine-tuning of frontier AI models. Tinker allows users to fine-tune open-source models like Meta’s Llama and Alibaba’s Qwen via supervised learning or reinforcement learning. The startup raised $2 billion in seed funding, valuing it at $12 billion. Beta testers report Tinker is more powerful and user-friendly than similar tools. The company plans to eventually charge for its API and will introduce automated misuse safeguards.

The passage is a Form 10-K annual report filed by Amazon.com, Inc. with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2021. It includes business descriptions, risk factors, financial data, and management discussion.

This study developed and externally validated deep learning models to identify extra-prostatic extension (EPE) and seminal vesicle invasion (SVI) on prostate MRI. The models demonstrated good discriminatory ability across three test sets and showed prognostic significance for biochemical recurrence. Integrating these imaging biomarkers into existing NCCN risk groups reclassified 26.4% of patients and improved prognostic discrimination.

Microsoft Corporation's Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended June 30, 2015, details its business strategy, operating segments, products, and risk factors. The company focuses on a mobile-first, cloud-first world, operating through six segments: Devices and Consumer (D&C) Licensing, Computing and Gaming Hardware, Phone Hardware, D&C Other, Commercial Licensing, and Commercial Other. Key risks include intense competition, challenges in cloud services execution, investment uncertainties, and potential intellectual property issues.

A Software Global Warm Reset is initiated by software, with effects similar to an External Warm Reset except RSTOUT_WD_OUT is actively driven based on the latched BTMODE[11] value. The device supports reset isolation for PCI Express and EMAC Switch modules. Reset priorities are defined, with the highest-priority reset processed when multiple sources occur simultaneously. The device uses multiple clock sources, including DEV and AUX clocks, with PLLs generating system clocks. The EMAC SW supports MII, GMII, RMII, and RGMII interfaces. The device includes GPIO, GPMC, HDMI, HDVPSS, I2C, and ISS peripherals with specified timing requirements. DDR2/DDR3 memory controller supports 16/32-bit data paths and multiple memory capacities.

Michael Flynn's resignation may lead to President Trump's impeachment, as investigations could reveal Trump's knowledge of Flynn's discussions about U.S. sanctions with Russia's ambassador before Trump's inauguration. Flynn was vulnerable to blackmail, and Trump was officially aware weeks before Vice President Pence defended Flynn. Trump has not addressed the issue, instead criticizing leaks. Pundits believe Flynn acted with high-level backing, and if investigations implicate Trump, he could be complicit in inappropriate communication.

The "Power" set offense, used by almost every NBA team, frees up shooters using baseline and down screens. It attacks both sides of the defense simultaneously. The basic option involves wings crossing under the basket and continuing off down screens. The offense includes phases for baseline crossing, down screens with various defensive reads and counters, and offensive rebounding. It provides automatic counters for defensive overplays and continuities like Motion, Side Screen, Drive & Kick, and Triangle Post. A "Single/Double" variation is also described. The passage emphasizes execution, coordination, and defensive recognition, and includes sections on teaching, game strategies, and defending against the offense.

The U.S. government proposed arbitration to settle the boundary dispute between Great Britain and Venezuela, but Britain declined. The U.S. asserts the Monroe doctrine applies, as European territorial expansion in the Americas threatens U.S. peace and safety. The U.S. will now investigate the true boundary and, if necessary, resist British claims by force. Congress is asked to fund a commission for this investigation.
On June 3, 2015, Apple Inc. entered an underwriting agreement to issue ¥250,000,000,000 in 0.350% Notes due 2020, maturing June 10, 2020, with semi-annual interest payments.

Amazon.com, Inc. filed a Form 10-Q for the quarterly period ended June 30, 2015, reporting net income of $92 million for Q2 2015 and $35 million for the first six months of 2015. Total net sales were $23.2 billion for Q2 2015 and $45.9 billion for the first six months of 2015. The company had $10.3 billion in cash and cash equivalents as of June 30, 2015.

Ruston (La.) faces Stephenville (Texas) in a midseason interstate high school football matchup. Ruston is 4-0, ranked No. 2 in Louisiana and No. 25 in Texas. Stephenville is 5-0. Last year, Ruston won 63-17. Live updates are provided by a correspondent.

The October 2025 Supreme Court term begins Oct. 6, featuring major cases on presidential power, including tariffs and the president's authority to fire agency heads, and challenges to Trump's executive order on birthright citizenship. The court will also rehear a Louisiana voting rights case, consider laws on conversion therapy and transgender athletes, and a Fourth Amendment case on emergency entry. The term is expected to produce blockbuster rulings.

Last week in Northeast Mississippi, Karmel Davis was named Tupelo Public School District’s 2017 Parent of the Year; Corey Crayton received a new home from Habitat for Humanity; and Noah Barbieri became a Truman Scholar.

The Department of Homeland Security proposed a rule to replace the "duration of status" policy, capping international student stays at four years with possible extensions, and preventing major or institution changes. Commenters, including hospitals, universities, and private sector leaders, argued the rule would harm students, healthcare, and research, citing overstay rate overestimates, degree completion challenges, costs, and reduced U.S. attractiveness. Supporters claimed it protects American jobs and college spots. The comment period closed with over 15,700 responses.

Playing two hard games and losing one in the finals is difficult, but the team must regroup. They have faced similar situations before and need to bounce back. The long scoreless overtime was a different feeling. Both goalies played well, and the team must adjust their approach to find success.

This study examined the perspectives of 16 early childhood teachers (8 bilingual, 8 monolingual) in Ankara on bilingualism and bilingual education. All teachers agreed bilingualism is an advantage and that bilingual schools should be more widespread in Türkiye. Teachers identified benefits like career advantages and self-confidence. Most viewed bilingual children attending monolingual schools as a disadvantage due to potential language loss. Teachers had limited knowledge of bilingual education programs but emphasized staff should be proficient in both languages. Key issues included ineffective language use by teachers and resource shortcomings. Views on bilingualism's impact on development varied, with monolingual teachers focusing on language proficiency.

The passage discusses how AI is changing intellectual property law, particularly regarding drug patents, including questions about AI as an inventor and what constitutes obviousness for a "person skilled in the art."

Lung cancer has a poor prognosis due to late diagnosis and high mortality. This review analyzed 32 articles on screening methods, finding that circulating tumor DNA (80% sensitivity, 96% specificity) and Ga-Alfatide II scans (86% sensitivity, 85% specificity) are the most promising biomarkers for early detection.

This study compared three surveys on physician EHR use and interoperability: the 2021 NEHRS (18.2% response rate), the 2022 ABFM CCQ (100% response rate), and the 2022 UCSF Physician Health IT Survey (3.6% response rate). All surveys found low physician satisfaction with EHRs and significant interoperability challenges. However, responses differed significantly across surveys, likely due to differences in respondent demographics and response bias. The authors suggest that data from certifying boards like the ABFM could supplement NEHRS to improve reliability.

A 12-month intensive dementia-specific exercise and rehabilitation programme (PrAISED) had no effect on activities of daily living, physical activity, quality of life, falls, cognition, or other health status outcomes in a randomised controlled trial, despite being well-received by participants and therapists.

On August 17, Russian cosmonauts Fyodor Yurchikhin and Sergey Ryazanskiy will perform a spacewalk from the ISS. Activities include deploying five nanosatellites, collecting residue samples, and installing handrails. The spacewalk is the 202nd for station assembly and the seventh this year.

Stenabolic (SR9009) is a synthetic Rev-ErbA ligand developed by Scripps Research Institute. It activates the Rev-Erb protein, increasing mitochondria in muscles and metabolism, leading to improved endurance and fat loss. Studies show mice ran 50% more after administration. It increases resting energy expenditure by 5% and reduces plasma triglycerides by 12%, total cholesterol by 47%, non-esterified fatty acids by 23%, glucose by 19%, insulin by 35%, and proinflammatory cytokine IL-6 by 72%.

The court granted the defendant's motion for summary judgment and dismissed the plaintiff's disability discrimination complaint with prejudice due to the plaintiff's failure to prosecute, failure to obey court orders, and failure to establish a genuine issue of material fact, as the plaintiff did not respond to the motion or demonstrate a disability under the ADA.

Justice must be lawful and swift, not mob-driven. Denying education to any class harms society; public schools are foundational. Educated and property-owning individuals are less likely to commit brutal crimes. Industrial schools like Hampton and Tuskegee benefit both races, reducing criminality and improving race relations. Inflammatory speeches incite mobs and increase crime; only orderly legal punishment suppresses it. Preaching class hatred against the rich harms reform, provokes reaction, and undoes progress. Success requires a resolute, sane advance, rejecting demagogues who exploit class divisions and those who exploit others for profit.

The Pocatello-Chubbuck School District will finalize high school boundary changes using three new focus groups for input, after trustees delayed a decision for more public feedback. The policy allowing school choice for 20 years ended due to enrollment and socioeconomic disparities.

The court granted in part and denied in part the Chapter 13 Trustee's objection, confirming the debtors' amended plan as modified. Modifications included reducing Chrysler's interest to 3.9%, requiring debtors to provide paycheck stubs to the Trustee semi-annually, increasing monthly plan payments by $75.00, and requiring cessation of voluntary retirement contributions during the plan term.

Linux Foundation News: Jim Zemlin's keynote highlighted Linux's dominance (99.4% of HPC, 90% of stock exchanges, 64% of mobile devices) and $14.5 billion in project value. Hart joined as a Gold Member for open-source health data development. The Linux Foundation released a free open-source basics publication. The Cloud Native Computing Foundation announced 11 new members.

The passage contains a formal oath of allegiance and passport application form, followed by a diplomatic message from the U.S. Legation in Buenos Aires (1902) reporting on the Argentine President's address to Congress. The message notes disappointment over vague references to Argentina-Chile armament limitation negotiations, details how both countries' costly naval expansions are straining credit, causing deficits, and harming industry, and states that both governments recognize the need to stop such expenditures.

The author sees no short-term value in owning Snap stock due to competition from larger apps, a 22% drop in downloads, low marketer usage (7%), an upcoming lock-up expiration adding 1.2 billion shares (84% dilution), and weak fundamentals (revenue and DAUs missed estimates, a larger-than-expected loss).

Safety endpoints at 24 and 48 weeks were similar between study groups. AE rates before Week 24 were 51.2% (Primary SOC) and 52.0% (Additional Educational Program); serious AE rates were 12.4% and 14.7%. Between 24 and 48 weeks, AE rates were 33.8%, 40.8%, and 38.6% across groups. Bleeding events before Week 24 were 6.5% and 9.0%; after Week 24, 4.1%, 4.0%, and 3.2%. Fatal bleeding occurred in 1 subject before Week 24 and 2 after Week 24. Overall, 24 deaths were reported. No pregnancies occurred. No clinically concerning laboratory signals were observed.

The passage describes the "Single/Double" offense as an effective method to attack the Triangle & Two defense. It involves shooters using single and double screens to get open, with specific entries (left/right) and options (double screen, single screen, pop out, base screen, side screen). Success requires execution, coordination, defensive recognition, and scouting.

This study surveyed 114 Greek primary teachers on their views of STEM education. Teachers considered scientific thinking development important for everyday life (38%) and critical thinking (26%). While 70-75% valued STEM practices like problem-solving, only 7-19% reported students frequently cultivating them. Teachers cited lack of training (58%), infrastructure (42%), and time (31%) as weaknesses. Most (71%) requested more training. Teachers viewed STEM as reducing educational inequalities.
Newly analyzed microstructures help explain why it can be difficult to dislodge a dandelion’s fluffy seeds by puffing from any one direction.

A report found South Korea's birthrate began falling in the mid-1980s as more married women attained higher education. The fertility rate dropped to 1.6 in 1987 from 2.1 in 1984, coinciding with high school graduates outnumbering middle school graduates among married women. The report linked marriage and birth patterns to education levels.

Concomitant medications and diabetes treatments will be coded using WHODrug Global (March 2018) and summarized by ATC class and preferred name. The primary efficacy analysis is time to plasma glucose recovery, analyzed using a stratified log-rank test on the Full Analysis Set, with sensitivity analyses. Secondary endpoints include recovery rates and glucose changes at specific time points. Safety analyses will be based on the safety set and include summaries of adverse events, local tolerability, laboratory parameters, vital signs, ECGs, and immunogenicity. No interim analyses are planned.

During construction of a new Amsterdam subway line, archaeologists excavated 700,000 discarded objects from the Amstel riverbed, dating from Neolithic stone axes to modern cellphones. The finds, part of the "Below the Surface" project, provide a rich source of urban history. A selection of 10,000 objects will be displayed at the Rokin station, and an interactive online database features about 30,000 objects, attracting 40,000–60,000 daily visitors. The project also produced a book-catalog called "Stuff" and cost 6 million Euros.

The speaker describes a breakaway save, noting initial pressure, a backhand shot, and a second save after a battle. He reflects on playoff ups and downs, his inconsistent performance, and the importance of confidence as a goalie. He contrasts two plays, regrets the first goal, and values the second save. He expresses deep connection to Nashville, praising the crowd and city growth. He states timely saves boost confidence, making the game feel slower and improving anticipation.

A set A of constant proportion alpha in F2^n has 2A-2A containing a subspace of codimension less than 1/alpha^2 (Bogolyubov's lemma). In Z/nZ, a set A of proportion alpha has 2A-2A containing a Bohr set of dimension less than 1/alpha^2 and width 1/4. Every Bohr set of dimension d and width epsilon in Z/nZ contains a proper generalized arithmetic progression of dimension at most d and size at least (epsilon/d)^d * n.

Prior to the COVID-19 pandemic, Japanese universities lagged in ICT use for education due to perceptions and structural factors. The pandemic forced a shift to full-time online classes. This study investigates digitalization in Japanese university education, focusing on MEXT policy, academic staff, students, and lifelong learning. MEXT's pre-pandemic digitalization plans were accelerated by COVID-19, leading to policy changes on remote learning credits and subsidized projects, though the credit limit was not eliminated. The Cabinet also promoted digitalization, including using "My Number," raising personal information protection concerns. Faculty ICT use was low pre-pandemic but increased rapidly during it, though challenges like ineffective communication and lack of computer literacy remained. The pandemic highlighted issues with the "substantiation of the credit system," as students' study time increased with online assignments. Digitalization of lifelong learning, both degree and non-degree programs, was limited pre-pandemic but has progressed, though challenges remain. The pandemic expedited digitalization, but cultural and structural issues must be addressed to maximize its benefits while protecting student data.

A £95,220 donation from the ScottishPower Foundation will allow the Sussex Wildlife Trust to provide 1,300 more people with event access, deliver ten wildlife courses, train 250 wildlife champions, and establish a young naturalists club. The funding also supports habitat improvements and a kestrel nest box camera.

The NVIDIA Ampere architecture A100 GPU features third-generation Tensor Cores that share data across 32 threads, reducing register file bandwidth and redundant data loads. It uses a new asynchronous copy instruction to load data directly from global memory into shared memory, bypassing the register file. A100 has a 40 MB L2 cache (7x larger than V100), 1555 GB/sec HBM2 memory bandwidth, and 2.3x the L2 cache read bandwidth of V100. It supports Compute Data Compression, saving up to 4x DRAM bandwidth. The Multi-Instance GPU (MIG) feature partitions each A100 into up to seven GPU Instances with isolated memory paths for quality of service. Third-generation NVLink provides 600 GB/sec total bandwidth. A100 supports PCIe Gen 4 and includes a hardware JPEG decode engine, an optical flow accelerator, and improved atomic operations. CUDA 11 supports asynchronous copy, asynchronous barriers, L2 cache residency controls, and task graph acceleration.

This study developed and tested an online version of the SInQUE social inclusion assessment tool for use in mental health supported accommodation. The tool was generally perceived as acceptable and useful by staff and service users, particularly in supported housing. Implementation support was essential for uptake, as the tool was not used in areas without it.
Steven Kean forwarded an email to Jeffrey McMahon with a story attached, congratulating him on shaking things up in typical Enron fashion.

The speaker thanks staff and Cabinet, praising their dedication and noting no one profited personally. He contrasts the White House's size and art with its "great heart" from servants. He urges continued service, emphasizes sacrifice over money, and recounts personal stories of his father and mother. Citing Theodore Roosevelt's resilience after loss, he concludes that greatness comes through hardship, and leaves with gratitude and hope.

Prof. Nancy McLean's research on P.E.I. blueberry fields found over half of the bees are native, which are seven times more efficient pollinators than honey bees and better adapted to the climate. She is working to convince farmers to support native bees instead of relying on expensive, risky imported honey bees.

Michael Dell states the AI-driven data center boom is ongoing due to high demand for computing power, with customers deploying infrastructure as fast as they can, limited mainly by power grid constraints. Dell Technologies' server business grew 58% last year, and the company forecasts higher annual revenue and EPS growth. Despite market frothiness warnings, Dell sees no signs of overbuilding.

This document standardizes the GHCB memory area for guest OS interoperability with hypervisors supporting SEV-ES or SEV-SNP. It defines the GHCB as a 4 KB decrypted page, outlines required Non-Automatic Exits and guest state, and specifies actions like NMI handling and SMP booting. Version 2 introduces hypervisor feature advertisement and SEV-SNP support, with subsequent revisions adding features such as APIC ID lists, VMPL levels, page state changes, SEV-TIO, and Secure AVIC. The document details GHCB MSR protocol functions, NAE event handling, guest identification of SEV-ES support, SMP booting methods, NMI handling, and the #HV doorbell page for restricted injection.

Siddharth Agrawal runs the family-managed garment and home textile export business Silkasia from Jaipur, with plants across India and main operations in Mumbai, Noida, and Panipat. His passion is researching Indian cow breeds and developing satellite farms for native breed milk products. He invests in urban rooftop farming and start-ups, and mentors new ventures. His wife Vrinda manages family assets and started a retail store in Jaipur; together they created the women's clothing brand Mayori, set to go nationwide in 2018-19. Siddharth is a member of EO Jaipur, YPO Rajasthan, and RAIN, and President of TIE, Rajasthan.

Russian President Vladimir Putin won a fourth term with over three-quarters of the vote in a pre-determined election, timed to coincide with Crimea's annexation anniversary. Critics cite staged voting, harassment of monitors, and pressure on government employees. Putin framed Russia as a besieged fortress against Western sanctions and anti-Russian campaigns. Opposition figures Alexei Navalny and Ksenia Sobchak failed to unite. Putin stated no plans yet to change the constitution.

An email from Ann M. Schmidt lists news headlines from November 17-18, 2001, including articles about Enron's decline, its proposed sale to Dynegy, and related topics such as executive compensation, stock market performance, and the potential sale of Wessex Water.

The Dark Cloud Cover is a bearish reversal candlestick pattern that occurs after an uptrend, formed when a bearish candle opens above the previous bullish candle's close but closes below its midpoint. It signals a potential shift to a bearish trend and can be used for short selling or closing long positions, but is not a guarantee of reversal. Traders should confirm with other indicators and use risk management. The strategy is best suited for bearish markets and can be traded on various timeframes. Common mistakes include ignoring confirmation and risk management.
Apple Inc. filed a Form 10-Q for the fiscal quarter ended December 31, 2016, reporting net sales of $78.4 billion, net income of $17.9 billion, and total assets of $331.1 billion.

Tesla Motors, Inc. filed a Form 10-Q for the quarter ended September 30, 2015, reporting total revenues of $936.8 million, a net loss of $229.9 million, and cash and cash equivalents of $1.43 billion.

The passage discusses the variability of the active galactic nucleus (AGN) Fairall 9, focusing on the connection between its UV-emitting disc and X-ray corona. Analysis of spectral energy distributions (SEDs) and Fourier-resolved timing signatures from a ~1000-day monitoring campaign reveals a complex and evolving system. The SED shows a significant increase in the optical/UV disc component, likely due to a change in mass-accretion rate, while the coronal X-ray emission remains constant except for a spectral softening. Timing analysis shows disparate lags and a systematic drop in coherence between light-curve segments. The authors propose that the UV and X-ray are linked by disc reverberation and seed photons, but a rising phase in the light curve suggests an additional slow, inwards-moving component, possibly due to a change in the inner accretion structure. The findings challenge standard disc theory and suggest that AGN inner structures can evolve on observable timescales.

Democrat Doug Jones and Republican Roy Moore, accused of sexual misconduct with teenage girls, face off in Alabama's special Senate election on Tuesday. Moore, who denies the allegations, leads in polls despite a controversial career. Jones campaigns actively, criticizing Moore's absence from the trail.

Thousands of Armenian-Americans in Los Angeles commemorated the estimated 1.5 million Armenian deaths under the Ottoman Empire a century ago, demanding Turkey recognize the events as genocide. The protests followed Armenian Prime Minister Serzh Sargsyan's resignation after anti-government demonstrations. Turkey contends the deaths resulted from civil war and unrest.

The speaker discusses the emotional impact and boost of Manny potentially returning from injury, highlighting his leadership and contribution to the team's success. They also address the ease of distinguishing between themselves and a teammate, noting that those close to them have no trouble, while coaches may find it harder.

A speaker discusses using jokes to keep teammates loose, noting missed shots without a goalie as part of the fun. They state the team must win one game at a time, with the next game in Detroit, and that players are relaxed despite elimination risk.

This paper applies Bacchi’s WPR framework to South Australia’s “World Class” education policy, analyzing how the Department for Education, influenced by McKinsey and the Global Education Reform Movement, represented the problem of school improvement. The analysis reveals that the policy centralized control, used standardized testing (NAPLAN) as a high-stakes measure, and ranked schools, increasing bureaucratic surveillance over disadvantaged schools. The authors argue this approach eroded professional trust, ignored equity, and narrowed educational purposes, proposing a more socially just “Beyond World Class” framework.

Non-centrosymmetric crystals exhibit properties like piezoelectricity, ferroelectricity, and pyroelectricity. Polar metals combine a polar crystal structure with electrical conductivity. The study analyzes domain boundaries in the metallic distortive polar metal (DPM) Mn5Al8, which undergoes a centrosymmetry-reducing transition from cubic to rhombohedral. Head-to-head (H-H) and tail-to-tail (T-T) domain boundaries were observed, showing variable surface reactivity with electron enrichment at H-H and depletion at T-T boundaries, evidenced by copper deposition and surface oxidation. A chemical sorting of the ICSD identified at least 134 unique metallic polar metals, with approximately 20% being DPMs.

The Jonathan Hunt Chapter of the Daughters of the American Revolution held a tea at Parkwood Assisted Living in Elkin to honor good citizens selected from eight high schools. The Good Citizens program rewards qualities like dependability, service, scholarship, and patriotism. Students submitted an application and an essay on "Our American Heritage and Our Responsibility for Preserving it." Five of the eight attended with family, read their essays, and received a wallet card and lapel pin. The overall winner received a monetary award, and all will receive a certificate at their Spring Awards Day.

John Wilkerson, a Washington correspondent for STAT, writes about health care politics and authors the twice-weekly newsletter D.C. Diagnosis, which covers health and medicine politics and policy. The passage includes headlines on various health policy and biotech topics, and promotes a subscription to STAT+.

Jane Goodall, pioneering primatologist and conservationist, died at 91 in her sleep of natural causes while on tour in California.
