The lecture covers entanglement entropy (EE) in quantum systems, its properties (subadditivity, strong subadditivity), and its application in many-body systems and quantum field theory (QFT). In local Hamiltonians, EE typically follows an area law, with the leading term proportional to the boundary area of region A divided by a short-distance cutoff. Subleading terms can characterize topological order or central charge in CFTs. The Ryu-Takayanagi proposal for holographic EE states that EE for a region A in a CFT with a gravity dual equals the area of a minimal surface in the bulk ending on the boundary of A, divided by 4G_N. This proposal satisfies strong subadditivity and reproduces known EE results, such as the CFT formula in 1+1 dimensions.

AMD testing shows that adhering to certain guidelines improves TMPM performance. Commands with 16+ pages have higher bandwidth, with maximum performance at 128 pages. The command input queue works best when commands arrive quickly. Interrupts should be requested at the end of a command sequence, not on every command. TMPM can interrupt on a ring buffer low-water mark. Certain data structures do not support migration. The HV/OS must not issue page migration commands for these structures. For PM_PAGE_MOVE_IO, source pages must be DMA-mapped using one IOMMU host page table. A host page table must be constructed to map the memory containing IOMMU host page tables for migratable memory. The TMPM engine may modify IOMMU host page table entries non-atomically. TMPM firmware can be reloaded only when no operations are in flight. The reload firmware must be the same or greater version. EPYC Family 19h is represented by FW_VER_Major value 71. The ring buffer allows sending large numbers of commands. Software can send single commands by not advancing the Tail pointer more than one entry from the Head pointer. TMPM hardware only moves data between 4k aligned pages. TMPM commands are sent to a page migration ring buffer. The ring buffer must use DEFAULT or HV_FIXED pages. Each command contains a parameter page with 1-128 Migration Entries. The ring buffer is set up by client software. A single page can hold 256 commands. The TMPM engine has registers for communication. The driver must enable PAGEMIGRATION_EN in all IOMMUs. The TMPM function uses a ring buffer interface. The Read pointer is controlled by firmware, the Write pointer by software. Changing ring buffer configuration during operation is not allowed. Driver initialization involves checking ENGINE_READY, setting the ring buffer SPA, configuring queue behavior, and setting DRIVER_INITIALIZED. Driver shutdown requires waiting for pointers to equal, setting DRIVER_INITIALIZED to 0, and cleanup. Ring buffer processing can be paused/resumed. There are six TMPM interrupt sources. SPA encoding includes encryption information. Commands include PM_GET_CAPABILITIES, PM_PAGE_MOVE_IO, PM_PAGE_MOVE_GUEST, and PM_NOP. Errors are reported in command status and PM_STATUS register.

A computational DFT study examined the reaction 2 CH₂ → C₂H₄ on one-layer and three-layer gold surfaces. The lecture covers modern portfolio theory, focusing on the risk-return trade-off. Diversification reduces risk, and in diversified portfolios, covariances are more important than individual variances. Investors should hold portfolios on the efficient frontier (the upper branch of a bullet-shaped curve). When a riskless asset is introduced, all investors will want to be on the tangency line from the risk-free rate to the tangency portfolio. This tangency portfolio, in equilibrium, must be the market portfolio of all assets weighted by market capitalization. The expected return of an efficient portfolio is the risk-free rate plus its standard deviation relative to the market's, multiplied by the market's excess return. For any asset, the expected return is determined by its beta, which is the covariance of the asset's return with the market's return divided by the market's variance.

The article presents four overnight trading strategies for the S&P 500, buying at the close and selling at the next day's open. The first strategy buys on a new n-day low with the close above the 200-day moving average, yielding 8.43% profit and a 29% win rate. The second strategy also buys on a new n-day low, yielding 12.69% profit, a 14% win rate, and a profit factor of 2.6. The third strategy uses three variables, with a profit factor of about 3.8. The fourth strategy, a variation of the third, benefits from a short-term oversold market bounce. Holding until the close instead of the open increases total P/L to 80% but makes the equity curve more erratic. A twist—holding until the close if SPY opens lower than -0.1%—boosts the strategy. Overnight strategies minimize drawdowns due to short holding periods, crucial for risk management.

This approach, alongside students willing to pay more for ideologically aligned campuses, risks colleges prioritizing the White House’s agenda over a genuine marketplace of ideas.

A Sarasota couple was arrested after accepting a package containing carfentanil, a drug 10,000 times more potent than morphine. Detectives observed them take the package inside, and a search later found over 7 grams of fentanyl and other drugs. Both face multiple charges.

Alexander Zverev won a five-set match at the French Open, moving into the third round. He has yet to reach a grand slam quarterfinal or defeat a top-50 foe at a major. Other players, including Grigor Dimitrov and Kei Nishikori, also overcame 2-1 set deficits. Simona Halep recovered from a slow start to win her first-round match.

On November 15, 2019, Amazon.com, Inc. notified participants in its 401(k) Plan that Fidelity Investments was selected as the new recordkeeper. A Blackout Period from January 2, 2020, to the week of January 12, 2020, will restrict plan account activity. The company also notified its Section 16 officers and directors of trading restrictions during this period.

The Foreign Relations series editors have full access to State Department records, including central files, decentralized lot files, Executive Secretariat files, and overseas post files. Central files for 1981–1989 will transfer to the National Archives for declassification and access. Research for this subseries uses special access to restricted documents at the Reagan Library and other agencies. Printed material is declassified, though some is from still-classified documents. Presidential papers at the Reagan Library include foreign affairs documentation from various federal agencies. Some research used Reagan Library records scanned for the Remote Archive Capture project, which coordinates declassification across presidential libraries. Due to scanning methods, editors could not always verify document attachments, noting ambiguity as “Not found attached.” Documents are presented chronologically by Washington time. Editorial methodology reproduces original documents exactly, with corrections in bracketed insertions, and omitted classified text noted.

This patent application describes systems and methods for a user equipment (UE) to decode wireless channel frames after a beam failure recovery procedure. The UE receives a frame on a channel associated with a beam identified during recovery and decodes it by assuming a quasi-co-located (QCL) relationship exists between the channel and that beam, using a spatial domain receive filter from the beam. The UE may later receive an updated QCL relationship and decode subsequent frames accordingly.

The passage discusses the challenge of getting children to give more than one-word answers and offers five strategies for parents and caregivers: ask specific, open-ended questions; engage with children's questions; model curiosity by asking questions aloud; admit when you don't know and show how to find answers; and practice active listening.

This cross-sectional study of 225 10th and 11th graders at a science high school in Istanbul found a positive correlation between physical activity (MET scores) and self-esteem (ROSE scores). Males had higher self-esteem and MET scores than females. Regular exercise, greater height, and higher self-reported school success were also associated with higher self-esteem. No association was found between BMI and self-esteem.

The ADS868xW has user-programmable input alarm thresholds and hysteresis for temperature sensing with an NTC thermistor. Hysteresis prevents false alarms from noise. The device uses AVDD and DVDD power supplies, requiring decoupling capacitors. It offers NAP and power-down (PD) low-power modes. PCB layout should separate analog and digital sections, and decouple supply and reference pins.

A Canadian study of nearly 3,000 blood samples found celiac disease occurs in about 1% of the population, with 90% of cases undiagnosed. The research, published in BMJ Open, confirmed findings from other countries. Experts note that diagnosis is difficult due to common symptoms and that blood tests and biopsies should be done while the patient consumes gluten to avoid false negatives.

The Federal Reserve raised the fed-funds rate to 1%-1.25% and indicated it would begin gradually reducing its $4.5 trillion balance sheet this year. U.S. stock indexes were mixed, with the S&P 500 down 0.4%, the Dow slightly lower, and the Nasdaq down 0.9%. Treasury yields fell, the dollar dropped 0.2%, and oil prices declined 3.7%.

A device and method are disclosed that determine a total amount of insulin delivered to a user over a time period, calculate the proportion of that total delivered as basal dosages, and compare it to a threshold. If the threshold is exceeded, an average basal dosage for a subsequent time period is determined, and an instruction is generated to deliver a modified basal dosage that maintains that average.

In Hirsch v. Cummings, the court affirmed dismissal of a bill by alien enemies seeking to recover property seized during World War I, holding that Public Resolution No. 53 of 1934 barred recovery, as Congress had suspended the right of alien enemies to recover seized property, consistent with the Supreme Court's ruling in *Cummings v. Deutsche Bank*.

Schneider Electric's Edge Module is a turnkey, self-contained solution with pre-integrated power, cooling, software, and IT components for flexible, scalable, and autonomous edge deployments. It is designed for the telco industry to manage distributed edge endpoints, supporting single or three-phase power, N+1 standard cooling, and configurable racks. The module can be remotely monitored via EcoStruxture software and includes security features.

The passage defines pin states (IPD, IPU, DIS) for internal pulls during and after reset, and specifies boot configuration terminal functions for GPMC, Ethernet PHY, and ARM Cortex-A8 boot mode pins, including their multiplexing and sampling at reset.

At OpenAI’s Developer Day, CEO Sam Altman announced a new SDK for embedding third-party apps into ChatGPT, with demos featuring Spotify, Canva, and Zillow. OpenAI plans to introduce monetization methods, including an agentic commerce protocol. The company also unveiled tools for building AI agents and coding tools, including Codex. OpenAI faces competition from Google, Anthropic, and Amazon, and released its first open source model in years.

On Friday, concerns over a tightening job market, inflation, and rising bond yields caused a major stock sell-off. The Dow fell 666 points (2.54%), its largest daily percentage loss in 20 months and biggest point drop since December 2008. Wall Street's three major indexes recorded their worst weekly losses in two years. A strong jobs report with the largest wage gain in 8.5 years fueled inflation expectations, potentially prompting more aggressive Fed rate hikes. The 10-year Treasury yield surged to 2.845%, its highest since January 2014. All 11 S&P 500 sectors closed down, with technology the heaviest weight. The CBOE Volatility Index rose to 17.86, its highest since November 2016.

Tail risk refers to "fat tails" in probability distributions, indicating a higher chance of rare, extreme events than a normal distribution suggests. Hedging strategies aim to protect against these left-tail losses and include put options, foreign assets, cash, Cambria's Tail Risk ETF, Ray Dalio's All Weather Portfolio, and trend-following. Investors hedge to avoid losses, survive long-term, and prevent behavioral mistakes. These strategies often come at a cost of lower returns, acting as insurance.

This thesis analyzes Web services for digitized event management, including a mobile app for event immersion. It distinguishes e-business from e-commerce, discusses security (firewalls, encryption), and technologies like cloud computing, Web 2.0, IoT, and mobile. Research on 200 event management websites (17 Croatian, 183 foreign) evaluated 103 attributes across five categories. Results show Croatian sites lag in user experience, social media presence, and mobile adaptation, with the best Croatian site ranking 40th.

A primer on artificial intelligence explains AI as simulating human intelligence, with generative AI creating content and agentic AI focusing on decision-making. AI is useful for document review, legal research, and client communication, but not all tasks require it. Several AI tools like Vincent AI, Microsoft Copilot, and ChatGPT can enhance legal practice.

Real Madrid, aiming for a first European Cup treble in 40 years, will face Paris Saint-Germain in the Champions League last 16. Other draws include Barcelona vs. Chelsea, Manchester City vs. Basel, Bayern Munich vs. Besiktas, Juventus vs. Tottenham, Manchester United vs. Sevilla, Liverpool vs. Porto, and Shakhtar Donetsk vs. Roma.

Kirill Kaprizov signed an eight-year, $136 million contract extension with the Minnesota Wild, the richest in NHL history by total money and average annual value ($17 million). The deal begins next season; he will play this season on his current contract. Kaprizov, 28, had 25 goals and 31 assists in 41 games last season.

Photographer Mark Bickerdike spent several years documenting young musicians at Ricky’s School of Rock in Linthwaite, capturing over 50 RockJam gigs where pupils learned metal and performed for family.

This study used focus groups with 18 pre-service physical education teachers from Quebec to identify their anticipated challenges and needs. Participants identified classroom management and students' lack of motivation as general challenges. Regarding student motivation, five specific challenges were found: student heterogeneity, proposing motivating activities, student engagement, managing disengaged students, and gender differences. Participants expressed needs for more support in planning motivational strategies, learning implementation methods, and having more practice opportunities.

In the semiclassical gravity regime, the generating functional for correlation functions of a boundary operator O is equal to the gravity partition function with a non-normalizable boundary condition for the dual field φ. In the large N limit, this gravity partition function can be evaluated using the saddle-point approximation, giving the classical action of the solution satisfying the boundary condition.

A Tom Thomson painting, "Sketch for Lake in Algonquin Park," given as a gag gift, sold for $481,250 at a Heffel auction. The auction of 118 works raised $14.1 million, with top sales including Paul-Emile Borduas' "Figures schematiques" ($3.6 million) and Lawren Harris' "Morning, Lake Superior" ($1.1 million).

A Southwest Airlines employee asked a white mother to prove her biracial son was hers, despite his passport. The airline apologized, citing policy to verify lap children under two, but did not specify if race was a factor. Model Chrissy Teigen defended the practice as an anti-trafficking measure.

The VIX measures implied volatility of S&P 500 index options and is a mean reversion indicator: when VIX rises, it may be wise to buy stocks, and when it drops, to sell. Many VIX trading strategies are complex due to the indicator's intricate nature.

OPEC and non-OPEC oil producers plan to announce an exit strategy from global supply cuts in June, but the pact may not end then. The strategy's form is premature to discuss before the meeting. Russia has pushed for a clear, gradual exit to avoid market deficit, price rally, or increased U.S. shale output.

Nigeria's inflation fell to 16.25% in May from 17.28% in April, though month-on-month the headline index rose 1.88%, higher than April's 1.60%. Food inflation was 19.27% year-on-year, slightly down from 19.30% in April, driven by price increases in meat, bread, cereals, fish, and other items.

Nash equilibrium is central to game theory. Two-player zero-sum games can be solved in polynomial time via linear programming. For two-player non-zero-sum games, exact algorithms exist. Multiplayer imperfect-information games are PPAD-hard, and iterative self-play algorithms lack convergence guarantees. The paper presents a new approach using a nonlinear complementarity problem modeled as a quadratically-constrained feasibility program. On reduced three-player Kuhn poker, this approach solved the game in 2.47 seconds with an exploitability of less than 1.4 × 10⁻¹⁷, while the only applicable Gambit method (logit QRE) took over 40 seconds and achieved an exploitability of 1.67 × 10⁻⁵. The new approach could not solve the full game within 24 hours.

Box Inc reported a Q1 adjusted loss of 7 cents per share on revenue of $140.5 million, both beating Wall Street estimates. Billings rose to $116.7 million, and the company added 3,000 paying customers. For Q2, it forecasts an adjusted loss of 5-6 cents per share and revenue of $146-$147 million. Despite strong results, shares fell 4.6% after hours.

A transfer of a land certificate over 40 years old, from proper custody and with no suspicion of forgery, is admissible without proof of execution. A transfer identifying a certificate as "for one-third of a league" sufficiently identifies it. A power of attorney is conclusively presumed for a conveyance over 30 years old from proper custody. A certified copy of an affidavit by a third party claiming ownership of a headright certificate is inadmissible to disparage another's title. A party cannot introduce evidence of their own character for truth unless impeached beyond conflicting evidence.

Thomas Scullun agreed to master the bark *Cape Horn Pigeon* for a whaling voyage, with compensation of a 1/12 lay in net proceeds. The vessel cleared San Francisco on December 7, 1891. In 1892, the *Cape Horn Pigeon* was seized in the Sea of Okhotsk by Lieutenant von Cube, who suspected illegal sealing in Russian waters. An investigation found no cause for confiscation, and the vessel was returned to her owners.

This document describes a digital assistant for media exploration, including methods, systems, and devices for receiving speech inputs to request, refine, and provide media items, and for generating merged preference profiles for multiple users.

Dusty Baker believes Jeff Kent deserves Hall of Fame induction. Kent, eligible since 2013, has received about 15 percent of votes, far below the 75 percent needed. Kent expressed confusion about his low vote total, citing unfamiliarity with WAR statistics. Over 17 seasons, he hit 377 home runs, had eight 100-RBI seasons, a .290 average, and won the 2002 NL MVP. Kent acknowledged a possible frictional relationship with media due to his reluctance to talk. Baker praised Kent as genuine and hard-playing.

Carol Moore, former Burlington College president, criticized a 2010 land deal championed by Jane Sanders, which involved a $10 million purchase of 33 acres despite the college's small enrollment and budget, leading to the college's closure. Federal authorities are investigating the deal's collateral representation. Moore also criticized a separate agreement between the college and Carina Driscoll's woodworking school, calling it a "sweetheart deal."

The A100 GPU provides hardware-accelerated barriers in shared memory, available via CUDA 11 as ISO C++-conforming barrier objects. Asynchronous barriers separate arrive and wait operations, enabling overlap of asynchronous copies from global memory into shared memory with SM computations. They support producer-consumer models and synchronize CUDA threads at various granularities.

QuantifiedStrategies.com offers a range of trading strategies for TradingView (Pinescript), developed by full-time traders since 2001. Users can browse and request specific strategies via email. A disclaimer notes trading risks and that past performance does not guarantee future results.
Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth told hundreds of generals and admirals that the military had become "soft" and "woke," arguing for a shake-up.

Amazon.com, Inc. filed a Form 10-Q for the quarterly period ended March 31, 2019, reporting net income of $3.561 billion on total net sales of $59.7 billion, compared to net income of $1.629 billion on net sales of $51.042 billion in the same period of 2018.

The design requires a logic high output when the amplifier exceeds 1.1V. Bypass capacitors (0.1µF low ESR ceramic) are critical on the supply pin to prevent ringing, false triggers, and oscillations. The device can use split or single supplies. Outputs have nanosecond rise/fall times and must be treated as high-speed logic. Minimize coupling between outputs and inputs; avoid parallel traces without a supply or ground trace between them.

Qualcomm accidentally published a blog post about an "Asus Zenfone AR," the second consumer Google Tango-enabled smartphone, dated January 4 and since taken down. It will be the first Tango phone supporting Google's Daydream View headset, using a Snapdragon 821 processor. Evan Blass posted renders of the device. Pricing and availability are unannounced, with more details expected at CES.

The IMF's mission chief to Ukraine stated the pension system is unsustainable, supporting 30% of the population and operating at a loss, and must limit retirees. He noted Ukrainians retire earlier than regional averages and suggested reducing early retirements and targeting tax avoidance, without explicitly requiring a pension age increase.

The passage discusses the 20-day exponential moving average (EMA) trading strategy, which generates buy signals when price rises above the 20 EMA and sell signals when it falls below. A backtest on SPY showed low CAGR and significant drawdown. Adding another indicator (behind a paywall) improved performance. The same strategy backtested on Bitcoin from 2014 showed better results due to momentum.

Iron Sulfate Heptahydrate, also known as ferrous sulfate heptahydrate or copperas, is a water-soluble salt produced during titanium dioxide manufacture. It has 18-20% iron content and up to 3% free acid. It is used medically for iron deficiency, industrially for water purification, phosphate removal, cement additive, and agriculture, and historically in textiles and ink.

The passage discusses the Asymptotic Equipartition Property (AEP) for discrete memoryless sources, defining typical sequences and their properties, such as the number of typical sequences being approximately 2 to the n times entropy. It then introduces Markov sources as models for sources with memory, explaining ergodic Markov chains and conditional entropy. Finally, it describes the Lempel Ziv universal compression algorithm (LZ77), which encodes source sequences by finding the longest match in a sliding window and encoding the match length and position, achieving asymptotic compression equal to the conditional entropy.

The speaker, a Navy person and outgoing President, addresses West Point, discussing leadership, the role of the U.S. as the sole superpower, and principles for using military force. He emphasizes engagement over isolationism, the need for a strong military, and the value of service, duty, honor, and country. He concludes by granting amnesty to the Corps of Cadets.

Coach Quenneville discussed player performances, line combinations, and team dynamics. He praised Johnny's all-zone play and defensive responsibility despite lower offensive numbers, and noted Duncan's exceptional conditioning and increased playoff minutes. He highlighted Bolland's defensive reliability and offensive skill, and expressed satisfaction with the team's consistency and goaltending. He also addressed specific issues like too-many-men penalties and the team's resilience after facing adversity against Detroit.

The Paris tribunal of arbitration, referencing the 1824 and 1825 treaties, ruled that Russia's jurisdiction in the Bering Sea was restricted to cannon-shot range from shore, and that the Bering Sea, like the Okhotsk Sea, is a branch of the Pacific Ocean. The decision implies that exclusive jurisdiction over large gulfs like the Okhotsk Sea is not accepted under international law, which recognizes the liberty of the ocean and that seas connected to the ocean are free to all, with sovereignty limited to safeguarding security.

Damian Lillard scored 32 points, becoming the fastest Trail Blazer to reach 10,000 career points, but Portland lost 130-105 to Toronto, ending a four-game win streak. DeMar DeRozan led the Raptors with 35 points, including a career-high-tying six 3-pointers, as Toronto improved to an NBA-best 20-4 at home.

PAM4 signaling in GDDR6X transmits two bits per clock edge using four voltage levels, improving over NRZ. MTA encoding limits signal transitions to improve SNR. GDDR6X achieves up to 19.5 Gbps and 936 GB/sec bandwidth, a 52% improvement over TU102. NVIDIA RTX IO enables GPU-based decompression, offloading CPU work and improving I/O performance up to 100x. The NVIDIA A40 GPU delivers up to 2X FP32 and ray-tracing throughput over Quadro RTX 6000, with 48GB memory scalable to 96GB via NVLink. Ampere GPUs support HDMI 2.1, AV1 hardware decode, and seventh-generation NVENC. The GeForce RTX 3090 has 24GB GDDR6X and is 1.5x faster than TITAN RTX. Error Detection and Replay (EDR) allows safe GDDR6X overclocking.

Harvey Weinstein has been indicted on charges of rape and criminal sexual act, announced by Manhattan District Attorney Cyrus Vance Jr., who stated the indictment brings him "another step closer to accountability."

The passage presents a theoretical framework establishing a hierarchy of quantum replica advantage for estimating nonlinear functions of quantum states. It proves that estimating tr(ρ^(k+1)O) requires Ω(√d) samples using k-replica protocols but only O(k/ε²) samples using (k+1)-replica protocols, creating an exponential separation. The work develops an indistinguishability principle for Haar-assembled ensembles and applies it to lower bounds for nonlinear property estimation, spectrum testing, and rank testing.

An email chain forwards a Texas Monthly article titled "How Enron Blew It," which details Enron's rise and fall, focusing on its aggressive culture, risky strategies, and the role of CEO Jeff Skilling.
Vertex Resource Group Ltd. acquired a private hydro-vac company for $4.3 million, adding 11 units and expanding into the Edmonton region. The deal is expected to add $5 million in annual revenue.

The speaker addresses the Foreign Service Institute, praising those preparing for overseas service. They contrast past diplomacy with the current goal of building a peaceful world order through reason and moderation. The speech focuses on NATO, describing it as a living institution that has deterred war through collective security and political unity. The speaker argues against dismantling NATO, advocating for adaptation through consultation, and emphasizes that collective action prevents conflict. They conclude by urging continued commitment to human solidarity and the alliance's principles.
The passage describes flash memory characteristics, including erase endurance limits, write operation limits per word line, and definitions of program and sector program times.

Microsoft Corporation filed its Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended June 30, 2019, with the SEC. The report details the company's business segments (Productivity and Business Processes, Intelligent Cloud, and More Personal Computing), risk factors, financial data, and executive officers.

A penalty-kick tiebreaker, or "shoot-out," is used after a tied soccer game when a winner is required, typically in single-elimination tournaments. The procedure is governed by IFAB Laws 10 and 14. Each team selects five players to take alternating penalty kicks from 12 yards. If tied after five kicks, sudden death continues until one team scores and the other misses. Only players on the field at the end of play are eligible. The referee conducts coin tosses for goal and first kick. Coaches should prepare teams in advance, including practicing the process, identifying and ranking kickers, and analyzing opponents. Post-shoot-out, coaches should maintain morale and review performance.

The passage is a review of the Wells Fargo Reflect® Card, highlighting its 0% intro APR for 21 months on purchases and balance transfers, no annual fee, and cell phone protection, but noting it lacks ongoing rewards and has a 5% balance transfer fee and 3% foreign transaction fee.

On June 24, 2020, Tesla entered a 90-day Indemnification Agreement with CEO Elon Musk, who will provide up to $100 million in personal indemnity coverage. Tesla will pay a one-time fee of $972,361 and may pay an additional amount based on a market quote.

The Sony Xperia XZ Premium will receive improved camera features and a 3D scanning app via its Android Oreo update later this year. The update includes a 3D Creator app for scanning objects and a smarter predictive capture mode for smiles. An improved burst mode tracks moving objects at 10 fps. The exact update date is unconfirmed, but expected before year's end.

The Appellate Division affirmed the dismissal of petitioner's CPLR article 78 proceeding challenging the Board of Parole's denial of his parole release, finding the Board properly relied on the presentence investigation report and considered statutory factors.

AGNC Investment is a mortgage REIT benefiting from Fed rate cuts, which should lower financing costs and boost book value. It posted its third consecutive quarter of positive net interest income in Q2'25 and trades at a premium to book value. The author maintains a bullish rating, citing strong NII trends and an attractive monthly dividend.

The speaker addresses a joint session of Congress, stating that 1970 marks a time for reforming U.S. programs and institutions. The first priority is peace, with the goal of ending the Vietnam War and achieving a just peace. Foreign policy is shifting from U.S. dominance to shared responsibility with allies, including new relationships with the Soviet Union and China. Domestically, the focus is on reforming welfare, government institutions (New Federalism), and expanding opportunities. Urgent actions include balancing the budget to fight inflation, increasing law enforcement funding, and launching a $10 billion clean waters program. The speech emphasizes environmental protection, a national growth policy, and spiritual leadership to inspire Americans.

A swimming robot, the "mini manbo," will investigate damage in Fukushima's Unit 3 reactor in July. It is equipped with lights, tail propellers, two cameras, and a dosimeter. Previous snake and scorpion robots failed inside other reactors due to high radiation and structural issues. The robot was co-developed by Toshiba and the government's International Research Institute for Nuclear Decommissioning.
Andrea Conti's agent stated the player only wants Milan, his time with Atalanta is over, and Coach Gasperini must be realistic about the transfer.

Nassim Nicholas Taleb is a statistician, mathematician, philosopher, trader, and investor known for his work on randomness, uncertainty, and probabilities. He is famous for the *Incerto* book series, which includes *Fooled by Randomness* (2001), *The Black Swan* (2007), *Antifragile* (2012), and *Skin in the Game* (2018). Taleb grew up in Lebanon, studied in France, and later worked as a proprietary trader in the US, becoming financially independent after the 1987 crash. He co-founded the hedge fund Empirica Capital with Mark Spitznagel, which closed in 2005, and later advised Universa Investments. Taleb’s barbell strategy involves splitting assets between low-risk and high-risk investments to benefit from tail events. He argues that markets are driven by randomness and extreme events, and emphasizes the importance of having "skin in the game."

The speaker expressed disappointment in the outcome but pride in the team's effort, noting all three games went to overtime. They highlighted strong goaltending and a hard-fought game. They declined to discuss specifics, focusing on reflecting and improving, particularly on puck possession and the power play.

The Malawi Health Equity Network (MHEN) urged the government to deploy internal auditors to all 28 district councils to improve public finance management. Research in Ntcheu found a lack of auditors threatens fund management, and councils fail to involve rural people in budget planning. The government acknowledged the issue, with plans to deploy auditors at an advanced stage, and noted auditors need support, not suspicion. The research also found a coordination gap between councils and NGOs/CSOs.

Gary Gensler discusses initial coin offerings (ICOs) as a new form of crowdfunding where startups sell crypto tokens to raise money, often before the network is functional. He notes that ICOs raised about $25 billion in 12 months (mid-2017 to mid-2018), roughly 20-30% of global venture capital. Key characteristics include proceeds for network building, pre-functional offerings, centralized development, and token scarcity via monetary policy. Evaluation criteria include assessing the token use case, reading the white paper, examining the team, venture capital involvement, community size, monetary policy, and token distribution. Statistics show 84% of ICOs are on Ethereum, 76% are based on just an idea, and most have failed or raised little.

U.S. President Trump says the trade relationship with Canada will only be "tweaked," but 76% of Canada's foreign trade goes to the U.S. versus 18% of America's to Canada. Real problems exist behind friendly language, including grievances over beef imports, supply management, and softwood lumber. Trudeau's diplomatic performance was masterful, keeping dignified distance without disrespect. Both leaders emphasized the special relationship, with Trump calling Canada "our great friend, neighbour and ally." A joint communique expressed mutual support on trade, energy, border security, and alliances.

The speaker emphasizes the importance of home-ice advantage, focus, and limiting distractions in the playoffs. They acknowledge the opponent's speed and depth, particularly Crosby, Kessel, and Malkin, as matchup problems. They stress the need to improve puck possession, attack more, and adapt to the series' momentum, noting that the team must avoid frustration and take care of business at home.

President Roosevelt transmits a preliminary report on unsanitary conditions in Chicago stockyards, urging Congress to pass legislation for federal inspection of meat products in interstate commerce, citing inadequate existing laws and the need for a fee-based inspection system.

Carlos Palacios, 55, will replace retiring Santa Cruz County Administrative Officer Susan Mauriello, becoming the county's first Latino in the top administrative role with a base salary of $263,057. Palacios, currently assistant county administrative officer since 2015 and former Watsonville city manager for 19 years, will oversee 2,400 staff and a $720 million budget. Mauriello, 62, retires July 7 after 27 years.

A 26-year-old man was arrested by armed police at Shackleton Court in Newton Heath after allegedly threatening two people with a firearm. The incident began around 4:30pm, involved negotiators, and lasted several hours before the man was taken into custody.

The passage discusses the L-separability problem for logics L and L+, focusing on ML-separability of µML-formulae over various model classes. It presents complexity results for ML-definability and ML-separability over all models, words, binary trees, and d-ary trees (d≥3), with complexities ranging from PSpace to 2-ExpTime. The paper also addresses separator construction, Craig interpolation, and applications to graded modal logic.

The DAWN-plasma trial was a randomized, open-label phase 2 study evaluating convalescent plasma plus standard of care versus standard of care alone in hospitalized COVID-19 patients. The primary endpoint was the proportion of patients alive and free of mechanical ventilation at Day 15. No significant difference was found between groups (83.7% vs 84.1%, OR 0.99). No differences were observed for secondary endpoints or safety outcomes.

BigLaw associate Ashley Hollis won the reality TV show "Big Brother" by hiding her profession as a social media marketing manager and channeling the movie character Elle Woods. She used her attorney skills to predict and counter arguments in her final speech, which she worked on for days. Hollis plans to give most of her $750,000 prize to her parents and consider buying a home.

A bibliometric analysis of 34 English-language documents from Scopus (2017-2023) examined STEAM education with gamification. Key findings include: publication trends rose from 2017 to 2023; the most cited article had 30 citations; top authors published three papers each; leading countries were Thailand, Bulgaria, Italy, and Malaysia; 37.7% of papers were in computer science; and predominant keywords were gamification, steam, steam education, and computational thinking.

Tharisa plc is presenting a phased transition from open cast to underground mining, a move studied for years, to redefine resources and innovate. The company has remained profitable for 11 years through volatile markets.

Arthur Santiago and Cristiano Mattos, researchers at the University of São Paulo, developed a dialogic educational activity using the Discord platform during the COVID-19 pandemic. The activity, based on Freire's critical pedagogy and analyzed through Cultural Historical Activity Theory (CHAT), aimed to foster dialogue and student autonomy in a remote physics teacher education course. Students used Discord to discuss the contradiction of reopening schools, research information, and collaboratively produce an infographic. The platform enabled self-organized, autonomous student communities, enhancing agency and dialogue.
Libyan forces in Benghazi lost four men and had 10 wounded in December, five months after declaring victory, due to snipers and a landmine in the Khreibish district.

A gaming system and method for a stop-based bonus game is described. The bonus game uses a construct (e.g., a wheel) with stop positions associated with either a first award (e.g., a jackpot) or a second award (e.g., a credit prize). When a stop position associated with a second award is selected, that award is given to the player, and the stop position is then re-associated with a first award for future play. This increases the chance of winning a first award over time. The associations can persist between player sessions and reset after a first award is won.

Under Fran Horowitz, Abercrombie & Fitch Co. achieved a record revenue of nearly $5 billion. Horowitz shifted the company from chasing trends to aspiring to be a long-lasting lifestyle brand. Sales nearly doubled to $2.6 billion between 2019 and 2024, with combined sales of A&F and Hollister topping $5 billion in 2025. New partnerships include Abercrombie Kids at Macy's and an NFL deal for customer acquisition and brand awareness.

A study at a large US university compared three lab approaches for teaching electric potential: physical equipment, a pre-built simulation, and an AI-engaged simulation where students prompted, validated, and refined a simulation. Students using either simulation method scored significantly higher on immediate conceptual questions than those using physical equipment, with no significant difference between the two simulation groups. It uses a fabless manufacturing strategy and relies on third-party suppliers. As of January 28, 2018, NVIDIA had 11,528 employees and reported $7.11 billion in cash and marketable securities.

In soccer, being "goal side" means defenders position themselves between the goal and the opponent. Teaching youth involves saying "get in their way" or keep opponents "in front of them." Defenders behind opponents must sprint past and turn. Instruction includes three basic locations (right, center, left), using field markings, and practicing with forwards moving at half-speed. Analogies include basketball guards and football cornerbacks, but defenders cannot block or extend arms.

The Alabama Court of Civil Appeals denied James F. Robertson III's petition for a writ of mandamus to compel a default judgment in his divorce case, because he failed to establish that the required proof-of-publication affidavit under Rule 4.3(d)(5) was filed with the trial court.

The United States appealed the appraiser's values on imported fishing equipment. The importer conceded that packing charges deducted as nondutiable were actually dutiable. The government questioned a 26.557 yen deduction, but no evidence showed it was improper. The court found the values to be the appraised values less specified charges, including the 26.557 yen deduction.

The BSE Sensex rose 270 points to 29,683.87, and the Nifty gained 74.85 points to 9,214.15. Metal, energy, and FMCG shares saw gains, while TCS traded flat. Banking indices rose over 1%. Asian markets recovered after U.S. Treasury comments, but gains were limited by North Korea tensions. The rupee traded at 64.40 to the dollar.

The Washington Supreme Court reversed the Court of Appeals, holding that Colorado law applies to a promissory note executed in Colorado by a Colorado-domiciled husband, allowing the creditor to reach the husband's wages and acquisitions in Washington, even though those assets are characterized as community property under Washington law.

The WMCC vocational class built cabinets and countertops for Kidder UMC's kitchen, which will become a disaster relief center. The project, suggested by instructor Dean Sedokna, provided real-world experience for offenders, who received certificates. The church paid for materials, and the prison provided labor.

The passage summarizes a class session on financing sources for entrepreneurs. It includes introductions from three panelists (Axel Bichara, Julianne Zimmerman, and Amir Nashat) who discuss their backgrounds and various funding types: venture capital, angel investing, accelerators, crowdfunding, grants (e.g., SBIR), and convertible notes. Key themes include aligning investor and entrepreneur interests, the importance of team and investor selection, and matching funding sources to company stage and goals. The panel also addresses common pitfalls like strategic investor conflicts and the need to retire major risks early.
The court affirmed the judgment, following the precedent set in Century Realty Company v. Frankfort Marine, Accident and Plate Glass Insurance Company.

The passage introduces a method called Flow Matching for Corrected Posterior Estimation (FMCPE) to address model misspecification in Simulation-Based Inference (SBI). It uses a small set of high-fidelity calibration data to correct posterior distributions trained on abundant but imperfect simulations, employing two flow matching steps: one to map real observations to simulated data and another to refine the posterior. Experiments on synthetic and real-world tasks show FMCPE outperforms standard SBI baselines in accuracy and robustness, especially with limited calibration data.

The passage details the Physical Layer Simplified Specification Version 6.00 for SD Memory Cards, covering card types (SDSC, SDHC, SDXC), voltage ranges, bus speed modes (e.g., Default, High, UHS-I, UHS-II), card capacities, speed classes, and communication protocols. It describes card initialization, identification, data transfer operations (read, write, erase), write protection, password protection, and Card Ownership Protection (COP). The specification also includes form factors, register definitions, and command sequences for UHS-I and UHS-II interfaces.

The passage contains multiple unrelated news snippets about South Carolina politics, a congressman's collection, state archives funding, a port authority sale, Medicare cardiac care testing, a mayor's reflections, and new state laws.

Apple announced a battery replacement program for the 13-inch MacBook Pro without Touch Bar, covering units built between October 2016 and October 2017 due to potential battery swelling, which is not a safety issue. Eligible batteries will be replaced free of charge. Owners can check eligibility using their serial number on Apple's support page.

Adding half a litre of water to breakfast promoted weight loss in women who usually drank less than a litre daily, with other studies showing it burns an extra 23 calories, translating to 2kg of fat over a year.

The passage argues that a durable peace requires three conditions: removing causes of international unrest, discrediting the Central powers' aggressive methods among their own peoples, and devising international sanctions behind law and treaties. It asserts that only Allied success can achieve these, as a Central powers victory would validate terrorism and make treaties futile.

DS-STAR is a novel data science agent that uses an iterative process of planning and verification to generate solution code. It first analyzes all data files in a directory to create a textual summary, then enters a core loop of planning, implementation, and verification using an LLM-based judge. Evaluated on DABStep, KramaBench, and DA-Code benchmarks, DS-STAR outperformed existing state-of-the-art methods, improving accuracy from 41.0% to 45.2% on DABStep, 39.8% to 44.7% on KramaBench, and 37.0% to 38.5% on DA-Code.

The passage provides the schedule and viewing details for the 2025 AL Wild Card playoff series between the Yankees and Red Sox, noting the teams' seeds, key players, and that Boston leads their postseason matchups 3-2.

"Sell the rip" is a trading strategy to sell an asset when its price is considered overvalued, based on the principle of "buy low, sell high." It is used by short-term traders who believe an overvalued market is due for a correction. The strategy is not suitable for long-term investing or stocks with strong fundamentals. A backtest of a simple RSI-based strategy on the S&P 500 showed promise but had large drawdowns; an improved version with different exit criteria yielded better results. The strategy works best in certain markets, like the S&P 500, and less so in trend-following markets like commodities.

For 15 years, Rev. Brian Sietsema served as backup pronouncer for Jacques Bailly at the Scripps National Spelling Bee. This year, due to a doubled field from a new wild-card program, Bailly took breaks, and Sietsema pronounced for about 180 spellers. Sietsema, a Greek Orthodox priest and former linguistics professor, enjoys the role. Over two days, more than 500 spellers competed, with 41 semifinalists determined by a written test. The passage also profiles spellers Rebekah Zeigler, Reagan Remmers (reinstated after a homonym issue), and Daniel Doudna.

The passage argues that the prescribed curriculum is the central barrier to increasing student autonomy in education, which is necessary in the AI age. It proposes a "balanced curriculum" where part is system-controlled and part is student-controlled. Using panarchy theory, it suggests transformation can start with small, autonomous subsystems within schools, gradually influencing the larger system, and provides examples of such programs.

The passage lists major public statements of American foreign policy from 1945, including addresses by Presidents Roosevelt and Truman, and Secretaries of State Grew, Stettinius, and Byrnes, with citations to the Department of State Bulletin and other official publications.

The speaker praises their team's defense, especially Yannick Weber and Matt Irwin, for handling top centermen. They discuss learning from Shea Weber and others, and evolving coaching strategies like team meetings on off-days. They emphasize the team earned its success through hard work, balancing fun with business, and being hungry and prepared for the Cup final.

The host controller uses four legacy SPI-compatible protocols (SPI-00-S, SPI-01-S, SPI-10-S, or SPI-11-S) to write data to the device. On power-up, the device supports SPI-00-S. A different protocol is selected by programming the SDI_MODE[1:0] bits. For reading, protocols are classified into legacy SPI-compatible with single or dual SDO-x, and source-synchronous (SRC) protocols. The device has nine configuration registers. It features two low-power modes: NAP and power-down (PD). The device uses AVDD and DVDD power supplies, requiring decoupling capacitors.

On August 28, 2017, Amazon.com, Inc. completed its acquisition of Whole Foods Market, Inc. for approximately $13.55 billion, financed with debt proceeds. Each Whole Foods Market share was converted into $42.00 cash, and outstanding equity awards were cashed out or canceled.

The Martingale trading strategy involves adding a larger trade size to a losing trade, hoping for a market reversal to achieve a net profit equal to the initial bet. Originally for gambling, it is based on 50% probability events. The strategy doubles the position after each loss until a win recovers all losses plus the initial stake. It is a risk-seeking method, contrasting with the anti-Martingale system. The strategy requires an infinite money supply to work; without it, a long losing streak can result in total loss. It is considered dangerous in the stock market, as stocks can fall to zero, but may work long-only with broad market index ETFs. A backtest on SPY using a simple Martingale method showed undesirable results.

A New York Times survey of 65 federal judges found that most expressed dissatisfaction with the U.S. Supreme Court's emergency docket decisions regarding President Trump's second term. Only 12 judges agreed the Court made appropriate use of the docket, 12 said lower courts received sufficient guidance, and 2 said it improved public perception. Many judges criticized the orders anonymously, and the survey noted that at least seven of about 20 emergency orders lacked reasoning, with nearly all benefiting Trump.

The article examines the integration of dance education and social studies in US schools. A survey of 91 dance educators found that many social studies concepts (e.g., people, places, environments; individual development) are taught, but interpretations vary from literal to implied. The study concludes that formal school assessments drive curriculum focus away from such integration, and policy changes are needed to support interdisciplinary education.

A Colorado panel voted to limit what health plans pay for an Amgen arthritis drug, Enbrel, setting a $600 per unit payment ceiling for government and commercial plans, equating to about $30,350 annually per person versus the 2023 average of $53,000.

Turkey's state of emergency will be extended by three months from April 19, with parliament's approval, due to terror threats, primarily from FETO, blamed for the July 15, 2016 coup attempt that killed over 270 people.

The Miami Dolphins won their first game of the season against the New York Jets, but star wide receiver Tyreek Hill suffered a dislocated left knee and is expected to miss the remainder of the season. Tight end Darren Waller caught two touchdown passes in his return. The Jets committed three turnovers and 12 penalties, and running back Breece Hall was lost to injury.

A new paper proposes searching for alien civilizations by detecting their geosynchronous satellites, which would cause a slight dimming of starlight during a planet's transit. This method avoids the synchronicity problem of traditional signal searches, requires no new telescopes, and could find evidence of long-gone societies.

China reduced the US dollar's share in its trade-weighted foreign-exchange basket from 26.4% to 22.4% and expanded the basket from 13 to 24 currencies, adding 11 new ones, effective January 2017. This is the first adjustment since the basket's December 2015 launch, aimed at reducing focus on the yuan-dollar rate. The yuan lost about 7% against the dollar in 2016, its worst performance since 1994.

Eighteen analysts rate IMI plc a consensus "Hold" (two sell, twelve hold, four buy), with an average 12-month target of GBX 1,027.29. Recent ratings include BNP Paribas (outperform, target GBX 1,400), Goldman Sachs (neutral, GBX 1,000), Barclays (overweight, GBX 1,190), Credit Suisse (neutral, GBX 1,020), and JPMorgan (neutral, GBX 990). The stock opened at 1216.00, with a market cap of GBX 3.29 billion.
On July 28, 2022, Apple Inc. issued a press release regarding its financial results for the third fiscal quarter ended June 25, 2022, which is attached as Exhibit 99.1 to this Form 8-K.

The passage discusses the conjugate gradient method for solving linear systems with symmetric positive definite matrices. It explains that the method produces orthogonal residuals and conjugate (A-orthogonal) search directions, requiring one matrix-vector multiplication and a few inner products per iteration. The convergence rate depends on the condition number of the matrix. The passage also contrasts conjugate gradients with steepest descent and mentions the minimum residual method for non-symmetric problems.

Police warn of festive season fraud, as Crimestoppers seeks information on counterfeit banknotes. Over 237,000 fake notes worth £4.88 million were removed from UK streets in early 2017. Crimestoppers and the Bank of England launched the Banknote Checking Scheme for businesses. Contact Crimestoppers anonymously with information.
GSK announced Luke Miels will become CEO on Jan. 1, replacing Emma Walmsley. AstraZeneca plans to list shares on the New York Stock Exchange while maintaining its London listing.

The Department of Livestock and Veterinary Services faces challenges vaccinating cattle for FMD due to vaccine shortages, leading to unchecked virus spread in several provinces. Active infections exist in Chipinge South, Mwenezi, Chivi, and Chiredzi. Zimbabwe is an FMD-infected country without FMD-free zones. The department has under 30 percent veterinary doctor strength, weak logistical and financial support, and issues including abuse of police clearance, vandalism, and non-cooperation by wildlife operators. FMD control is compromised due to loss of boundary fences and uncontrolled livestock movement.

The VentureWire newsletter from September 19, 2000, reports on private company business news, including top stories about Pseudo.com shutting down and laying off all 175 employees, Broadbase acquiring Servicesoft for $645 million, and several companies raising significant funding rounds.

Cheltenham Town face a second summer of trying to keep Harry Pell, as a League Two club seeks to sign the 26-year-old midfielder. He nearly joined Blackpool for £200,000 last August but failed to agree personal terms. Pell signed a contract extension in January 2017, keeping him until end of next season.

The University of Nebraska-Lincoln is investing in agricultural and environmental programs, with a strategic plan emphasizing interdisciplinary research. UNL's ag programs account for 48.5% of $295 million in research spending, and undergraduate enrollment grew 78% from 2006-16. New facilities include the Massengale Residential Center, East Campus Recreation and Wellness Center, and Veterinary Diagnostic Center. A $20 million NSF grant supports root and soil microbe research involving 14 UNL faculty. The INFEWS initiative promotes cross-disciplinary discussions.
Stone tools dated between 385,000 and 172,000 years ago were found in India, suggesting human migration from Africa may have occurred earlier than the previously believed 140,000 to 90,000 years ago.

A cross-sectional study at a Chennai tertiary care hospital (Nov 2023-May 2024, n=346) found 76.3% of cultures positive, with 75.4% being Gram-negative. E. coli (28.8%) and Klebsiella spp. (26.9%) were most common. High resistance was observed for Cefoperazone/sulbactam (97.4%), Cefotaxime (92.1%), and Polymyxin B (98.7%). Amikacin (71.1%) and Gentamycin (63.2%) showed higher sensitivity.

A system and method for a cloud-based industrial data services platform that registers an industrial asset's identity, asset model, and available data service applications. The asset model uses hierarchical elements referencing data tags on industrial devices. A client device selects a data service application, and a gateway interface collects industrial data from a gateway device based on the asset model's data tags. An analytic component then processes the collected data according to the selected application.

A study used computer models of thoracic aortic aneurysms (TAAs) from combined tissue damage and cellular dysfunction to train neural networks. Predictions using both TAA shape (dilatation) and mechanics (distensibility) were significantly better than using dilatation alone, the current clinical standard. The UNet architecture performed best.

The passage covers legal issues for startups, including intellectual property (IP) types like trademarks, copyrights, trade secrets, and patents; university licensing via MIT's TLO; legal business forms (Delaware corporation, S corporation); Section 83 tax issues; founder equity splits; employee equity compensation; vesting; securities laws; and financing terms like convertible notes and liquidation preferences.

The President approves the act to regulate the counting of electoral votes due to the first-ever dispute over a presidential election result, which threatens national institutions. The law provides a constitutional, orderly method for deciding the outcome, as both Houses of Congress will handle disputes, with a tribunal for double returns. The President signs it to ensure peace, end economic paralysis, and secure acceptance of the election result.

The Sansa Fuze is a portable digital audio/video player with a 1.9" color screen, FM tuner, microphone, and microSDHC slot. It supports MP3, WMA, secure WMA, and audiobooks, and video via MPEG4. It has a non-replaceable rechargeable battery lasting up to 24 hours of audio or 5 hours of video playback. The device includes a hold switch, thumbwheel navigation, and can be connected to a computer via USB for charging and file transfer. Music, photos, and videos can be transferred using drag-and-drop, Windows Media Player, or Sansa Media Converter. The player includes FM radio with preset programming, voice recording, and settings for wallpaper, backlight, language, and date/time. Firmware updates are available from SanDisk's website. The product is intended for home and personal use only.

The passage examines the impact of digitalization on sustainable development (economy, society, environment) using the Digital Economy and Society Index (DESI) for 28 EU countries. It finds significant positive correlations between DESI and economic/social measures (e.g., Global Competitiveness Index, GDP) but a negative correlation with environmental wellbeing. Cultural dimensions (e.g., power distance, individualism) also correlate with digitalization levels. The research confirms that digitalization affects sustainable development and is influenced by cultural characteristics.

The passage compares the Trump administration's approach to autism, linking it to vaccines and acetaminophen, to a 1963 U.S. delegation's trip to the USSR, where Soviet political ideology forced researchers to reject genetic and socioeconomic causes of intellectual disability, leading to lower prevalence rates through diagnostic manipulation. The author argues that rising autism rates are due to diagnostic substitution, broader criteria, and improved access, not an epidemic, and criticizes the administration for ignoring evidence while proposing cuts to disability services.
The appellate court affirmed the trial court's judgment, finding no error in jury instructions regarding an inconsistent interrogatory and that substantial evidence supported the verdict.
The Houston Astros defeated the Chicago White Sox 7-1 on April 22, 2018, completing a three-game sweep and extending their winning streak to six games, outscoring Chicago 27-2 in the series.

If COP Unlock is accepted, the card enters CMD42 ver.2.0 mode. When FEP=0, the only supported COP function is set FEP. Before COP Unlock, the card is in CMD42 Ver.1.0 Compatible mode. For cards not supporting COP, the LOCK_UNLOCK_FAILED error bit is set.

A Toronto couple sold their renovated home for over $1 million after values tripled, moving mortgage-free to Ottawa. The market appears to be cooling, with buyers delaying purchases and sellers receiving lower bids. Some sellers are moving to more affordable areas, while others, like in Vancouver, cashed out before a foreign buyers' tax.

Over 50 patients and attendants narrowly escaped a fire at a private hospital in Lucknow. The fire, caused by a bursting UPS, took over three hours to douse; no injuries were reported. ICU patients were relocated to other hospitals, and a probe into fire safety compliance has been ordered.

Defending champions India face Bangladesh in the Champions Trophy semi-final on Thursday at Edgbaston. Bangladesh beat New Zealand in Group A, while India's batting and balanced bowling attack aim to dominate. The match will be broadcast live on Star Sports Network from 3 PM IST and streamed on Hotstar.

LeBron James, a billionaire and four-time NBA champion, hinted at retirement after the 2023 Western Conference Finals but played the 2023-2024 season. He has earned $479.5 million in NBA salary, with a $97 million extension, and $90 million annually from endorsements including Nike, AT&T, and Pepsi. His investments include Blaze Pizza, Liverpool FC, and SpringHill Company. He owns multiple homes and luxury cars, spends heavily on body care, and funds the "I Promise School" in Akron.

Two recent international documents, the Baku Declaration from the 2018 NAM meeting and the 2018 CHOGM Communiqué, are relevant for Indian foreign policy. Both express concern over protectionism and support for the Doha Development Round. The Baku Declaration reiterates support for ending Israeli occupation of Palestinian territories and condemns Israeli policies. The CHOGM Communiqué calls for solutions for small states' vulnerabilities and expresses solidarity with Bangladesh over Rohingya refugees, calling for their sustainable return to Myanmar. The documents contain welcome statements but do not address fundamental existential issues for the Global South.

The Federal Circuit reversed the district court's denial of judgment as a matter of law, holding that the asserted patent claims were invalid. The court found that claim 22 of the '017 patent was anticipated by the Danckert prior art, as Melchior's expert conceded all limitations except a "direct transfer in a closed line" feature not required by the claims. The remaining claims of the '506 and '254 patents were invalid as obvious over Danckert in view of Shirai, as Melchior's only argument against obviousness was based on the same non-existent limitation.

In Norwegian schools, digital technology use is limited to basic ICT, despite high infrastructure. Digital competence in PE aims to help students explore and solve practical challenges. Many pre-service teachers feel unprepared to integrate technology. Research shows digital technology in PE can promote learning and motivation. Teacher educators have limited competence beyond basic ICT. Flipped learning (FL) involves students watching videos before class for active, student-centred activities. FL in teacher education shows positive outcomes for motivation, learning, and engagement. Few studies examine FL in PETE, and none in Norwegian PETE. This study investigates 22 PETE students' perceptions of FL in two units (dance and motor learning) over two semesters. Data from group interviews were analysed using constructivist grounded theory, resulting in five themes: expectations, simple input, deep learning, supportive learning environment, and challenges. Students reported positive effects on motivation and learning, with FL seen as useful for their future teaching. Challenges included lack of real-time questions and technical issues. The study concludes FL positively promotes student learning and motivation in PETE.

St. Jude researchers identified kinases Mst1 and Mst2 as hidden drivers regulating dendritic cell subsets, which control T cell production for cancer and infection response. Using the NetBID algorithm, they found Mst1/2 and the Hippo pathway regulate dendritic cell function, metabolism, and cytokine signaling via an unconventional NF-κB pathway to prime CD8 T cells. The study suggests new treatment strategies for cancer or immune disorders.
On January 27, 2021, Apple Inc. filed a Form 8-K reporting its financial results for the first fiscal quarter ended December 26, 2020, via a press release attached as Exhibit 99.1.

A Roman pottery fragment found on Chapel St Leonards beach, the third Roman artefact discovered there in months, may indicate a lost Roman settlement, possibly a tower or fort, previously thought to be near Skegness.

The Alabama Supreme Court answered a certified question from the Eleventh Circuit, holding that an insurance policy provision limiting an "insured" to an employee acting "within the scope of duties" does not conflict with a separate provision providing coverage for "violations of constitutional/civil rights," and therefore does not create an ambiguity.

COVID-19 is a respiratory infection caused by SARS-CoV-2, with clinical responses ranging from asymptomatic to death. Meteorological factors may influence the incidence of infectious diseases, and the effect of weather on COVID-19 dynamics is expected to increase as the virus becomes endemic. The study hypothesizes that a 'compromised airway epithelium' in infected individuals can be disrupted by external triggers like temperature drops, worsening disease. Analyzing data from Tomsk, Russia, from January to March 2022, the study found that temperature drops over 3°C were associated with increased hospitalizations 1-2 days later, with 14 of 17 hospitalization surges linked to temperature changes. The findings suggest that short-term temperature drops can worsen COVID-19 symptoms and could be used to predict hospitalization surges.

Peter Joseph Saville, a dentist who served Worthing for over 40 years, died peacefully at home on June 27 aged 90. His family remembered him as a kind, selfless man who loved life. He was a devoted Catholic, sportsman, and community figure, survived by his wife, six children, and eight grandchildren.

Minor league baseball completed its first full week. The article outlines a new weekly coverage schedule for minor league baseball, highlights top performer Mike Soroka (2-0, 0.77 ERA, 0.43 WHIP), and lists other big moments including Kyle Tucker's seven RBI, Jose Medina's three home runs, and standout pitching performances. It also notes league leaders in home runs, stolen bases, and strikeouts, and manager Phillip Wellman's 1,000th win.

History suggests stock markets show less volatility during wars, with US stocks performing reasonably well, though wars on home soil change the picture. The Dow Jones rose over 60% during WW2 after an initial fall. Government spending during conflicts is linked to lower volatility. Gold and commodities often rise during uncertainty, but commodities have poor long-term returns.

Nobel-winning biochemist Peter Agre will give a free public talk on May 9 at the University of Louisville about science, human rights, and diplomacy. Agre, who discovered aquaporins and won the 2003 Nobel Prize in Chemistry, has led U.S. scientist visits to several countries to foster peaceful science collaborations.

Gold prices firmed on Tuesday as investors awaited U.S. Federal Reserve Chair Janet Yellen's testimony for interest rate hints. Spot gold was mostly unchanged at $1,225.06 per ounce, and U.S. gold futures inched up 0.04 percent to $1,226.3. The dollar index was nearly flat at 100.94. SPDR Gold Trust holdings rose 0.49 percent to 840.87 tonnes.

The passage reports the experimental demonstration of a chirality-selective thermal switch in ferromagnetic [Co/Pt] multilayer and chiral α-SiO2 heterostructures. By reversing magnetization, a 7% difference in α-SiO2 thermal conductivity was observed at room temperature, attributed to angular momentum transfer from demagnetization-induced chiral phonons. The thermal on/off ratio was 1.07 at 300 K and enhanced to 1.2 at 50 K due to reduced phonon-phonon scattering. Molecular dynamics simulations confirmed the chiral phonon diode effect, where heat transfer efficiency depends on matching phonon angular momentum with material chirality.

Molly Noon was inducted into Pi Theta Epsilon at Misericordia. Abigail Kauffman received a senior leadership award from Immaculata University. Geisinger Commonwealth School of Medicine students matched into residencies. Hayley Hammer was inducted into Psi Chi at King's College. Lyle Luckenbill was elected treasurer of King's College SGA. Molly McMullen completed an internship at King's College. Gregory Schuettler was inducted into Alpha Epsilon Lambda at Kutztown. Ashley Machamer presented research at the EPA meeting. Kelsey Miller was selected as Kappa Delta president at Susquehanna. Shelby Weikel was recognized at an OT pinning ceremony. Rachael Krell and Shana Noon participated in alternative spring break trips from Wilkes University.

Digital media brand The Debrief announced it is facing closure, stating it cannot "see a viable future" despite recent success at the British Media Awards. Launched in 2014, it targeted young women and conducted investigations like Mad About The Pill and the Make Renting Fair campaign. Many readers reacted with heartbreak on social media.

Successful school-based mental health programs share key elements: strong family-school-community collaboration, central roles for existing school staff, and teacher involvement in referrals. Minnesota is a national leader, with programs funded by insurance and state money. Baltimore's model integrates community providers into schools to improve access. Both states emphasize embedding clinicians in the school culture to normalize care and reduce stigma.

The Steelers are in first place in the AFC North after Week 4, the only division team to win that week. The rest of the division is struggling: the Browns are poor, the Ravens are injured, and the Bengals may be without their quarterback due to injury. The Steelers have a bye in Week 5.

A federal lawsuit alleges the U.S. Army issued less-than-honorable discharges to potentially thousands of service members without adequately considering PTSD or other mental health conditions. Two Army veterans from Connecticut claim they were wrongly denied honorable discharges. The lawsuit, seeking class-action status, targets review boards for inconsistently applying a liberal standard to PTSD-related claims.

The passage describes The Economist's "Carrie Bradshaw index," which ranks major US cities by how affordable they are to live alone, based on studio rent costs and required salary. Coastal cities are least affordable, while Sun Belt and Midwestern cities are more livable. New York is the most unaffordable for the third year, and nearly two-thirds of cities scored above one on the "Bradshaw score."

This week’s “The Readout LOUD” podcast discusses Peter Marks’ new role at Eli Lilly, a biotech’s attempt to revive a rare disease drug shelved by AstraZeneca due to a math error, and new funds for Expedition Therapeutics.

A new book by college adviser Jaime Smith offers practical guidance for students transferring between colleges, focusing on vertical transfers from community colleges to four-year institutions. It includes tips on keeping syllabi, choosing withdrawals over failing grades, prioritizing fit over prestige, and noting housing and major admission challenges. The reviewer adds caveats about consulting local transfer advisers for nuances in articulation agreements and transfer scholarships, and criticizes the book’s vague response on completing an associate degree, arguing it overlooks benefits like credit protection and degree insurance.

The team felt they had been playing well but without results, so they chose to continue their same approach, which led to a win. They credited key performances, particularly from Martin Brodeur, and noted they were happy to win one game but faced a difficult road ahead. Brodeur discussed specific plays, including a breakaway save and fortunate bounces, and emphasized focusing on the next shot. He praised a young player's growth and skills, and noted the team aimed to make the opponent's travel difficult. Brodeur stated winning is his priority, not affecting the opponent mentally, and described staying calm after a disputed penalty. He concluded that hockey is about living in the moment.

The banking sector drove weekly index movements, initially rising on US rate hike expectations, then falling due to China bank trading, and recovering with short-covering. The Straits Times Index gained 72 points (2.2%) to 3,291.29, with banks and Jardine stocks contributing 15 points of yesterday's 29.45-point rise. Turnover neared $1 billion, with yesterday's volume at 2.2 billion units worth $1.3 billion. The real estate sector showed a turnaround, with Q3 2017 private residential property prices rebounding for the first time in four years. Maybank Kim Eng expects full-year GDP growth to exceed 2-3% estimates, with Q3 GDP near 4%.

Voluntary medical male circumcision (VMMC) reduces HIV risk by 50-60%. In Uganda, men are advised to abstain from sex for 42 days post-VMMC, but 25-50% resume sex early. This study estimated early sex resumption (ESR) prevalence and risk factors among men in Rakai, Uganda from 2013-2020. ESR declined from 45.1% in 2013/2015 to 14.9% in 2018/2020. ESR was higher among married men, men with multiple partners, and those with lower education.

CVS Health's stock declined due to industry-wide healthcare reform uncertainty and two specific events: Walgreens' deal with Prime Therapeutics and CVS leaving the Tricare Network. However, the author argues these events will not significantly affect CVS's revenues, citing CVS Caremark's larger market share and the non-material impact of the Tricare loss. The author highlights CVS's 2015 acquisitions of Omnicare and Target pharmacies as drivers of future growth, and a DCF valuation estimates an intrinsic value of $116.32 per share, a 45.3% upside from the $80.07 closing price.

This study translated a preclinical model of mifepristone's effect on yohimbine stress-induced alcohol-seeking into a human laboratory trial with 32 individuals with AUD. Mifepristone (600mg/day/7-day) was safe when co-administered with yohimbine and alcohol. It reduced yohimbine/cue-induced alcohol craving, an effect independent of cortisol increases and significant only in those with low family history of AUD.

Seagate has released new 12TB drives (Barracuda Pro, IronWolf, IronWolf Pro) with smaller capacity variants, offering up to 250MBps speeds, 256MB cache, and 5-year warranties, priced from $390 to $440, now shipping worldwide.

Ronald E. Gabler was convicted of aggravated assault for beating Thomas R. Duff. He appealed the denial of his motion for new trial, claiming ineffective assistance of counsel. The court found trial counsel’s performance was not deficient and that Gabler failed to show prejudice, affirming the conviction.
Apple Inc. filed its Annual Report on Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended September 25, 2021, with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission.
Apple Inc. filed its Form 10-Q for the fiscal quarter ended June 25, 2022, reporting total net sales of $82.96 billion and net income of $19.44 billion for the quarter.

A man is in custody after a possible pipe bomb explosion in a subway passage near Times Square during Monday morning's rush hour. The lecture discusses moving beyond tree-level diagrams in QED to include loop diagrams, which represent quantum fluctuations. These loops introduce free internal momenta requiring integration, leading to divergences from high-energy extrapolations. The renormalization program, developed by Feynman, Schwinger, and Tomonaga, provides a method to remove these divergences and obtain physically sensible results. Loop corrections cause the physical mass, charge, and fields to differ from the parameters in the Lagrangian (bare parameters). The lecture also derives the Dirac equation's prediction of g=2 for the electron's magnetic moment and notes that loop corrections, such as the vertex correction, produce an anomalous magnetic moment, first calculated by Schwinger as α/(2π).

TMPM commands allow moving up to 128 pages via a Page Migration List, with no adjacency or order-dependence requirements. The lecture covers two main approaches to optimal control: Pontryagin's minimum principle and dynamic programming (Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman equation). Niobium thin films are key components in various technologies, and their superconducting properties depend on dimensional parameters. Laser-induced periodic surface structures (LIPSS) can be generated on Nb films using femtosecond pulsed-laser irradiation, creating anisotropic surface topographies that affect magnetic flux behavior. This study investigates the formation of LIPSS on Nb thin films, examining the resulting microstructural changes and their impact on superconducting properties such as critical temperature, upper critical field, and critical current density. The research combines experimental characterization with time-dependent Ginzburg-Landau simulations to understand the underlying physics. Results show that laser irradiation causes a reduction in the lattice parameter and critical temperature, while also inducing anisotropic critical current densities, with higher values observed for currents flowing parallel to the LIPSS. The findings demonstrate control over superconducting properties through laser processing parameters.

This study examined behavioural changes in frontotemporal dementia (FTD), comparing behavioural-variant FTD (bvFTD) and semantic dementia (SD). Behavioural changes were common in both subtypes, but quantitative differences (bvFTD > SD) were found, with no qualitative distinctions. Apathy was a major behavioural dimension, associated with executive dysfunction and anterior cingulate cortex atrophy. Neuropsychological measures of semantic memory and executive function discriminated bvFTD from SD better than behavioural measures. No association was found between behavioural changes and semantic knowledge or anterior temporal lobe atrophy.
