Madhav Godbole resigned as chairman of the Maharashtra government's Enron renegotiation panel after NCP chief Sharad Pawar criticized the panel's "negative approach." The chief minister refused to accept the resignation. A scheduled renegotiation meeting was cancelled. Enron warned it would seek $3.5-5 billion in damages if the dispute over unpaid bills is not settled. The Maharashtra government considered terminating DPC's services. Indian financial institutions faced potential losses of over Rs 5,000 crore. The Centre adopted a wait-and-watch policy. Enron also appointed consultants to value its India business, suggesting a possible exit.

Coach Bylsma brought new confidence after a poor start. A five-game road trip and trades for Billy and Adams were the turning point. The speaker wants a ring, not mementos. Sid's leadership is shown by playing the system and being defensively responsible. Jordan is a skilled, two-way forward. The team's top players have talent and will, sometimes turning it on suddenly. The organization's sustained success after losing key pieces is remarkable.

The North of Tyne devolution deal, including an elected mayor and £600m over 30 years, was approved by North Tyneside Council's cabinet. Mayor Norma Redfearn stated the door remains open for councils south of the Tyne to join later, though it is too late at this stage. The deal, expected to bring 10,000 jobs, was criticized by some for creating an "under-powered" authority, but Newcastle Council leader Nick Forbes defended it, citing per-head investment and unique health and housing elements.

DLSS 4 introduces Multi Frame Generation (MFG) and transformer-based AI models for Super Resolution, Ray Reconstruction, and DLAA, powered by GeForce RTX 50 Series GPUs. The Blackwell architecture enables neural shaders, including RTX Neural Materials, Neural Texture Compression, Neural Radiance Cache, RTX Skin, and RTX Neural Faces. The GB202 and GB203 GPUs are detailed with specifications for the GeForce RTX 5090, 5080, 5070 Ti, and 5070.

Plymouth Studio School is to close due to being half full with 155 students, making it financially unsustainable. The closure, expected after summer 2018, follows an Ofsted inspection rating the school as "inadequate."

Assembly Republican Leader Chad Mayes does not regret supporting California's cap-and-trade program, only that he missed the signing ceremony due to a scheduling conflict. His vote has sparked intense internal party conflict, with conservative critics accusing him of betrayal and calling for his removal from leadership. Mayes faces a potential caucus vote on his position, and the dispute has also affected fundraising negotiations and drawn criticism toward other Republican supporters of the legislation.

An email from David I. Levine lists mandatory and optional readings for a class. Mandatory reading is Mankiw, chapter 10, with homework on IS/LM curves. Optional readings include articles on France's 35-hour workweek, Latin American market rallies, and Japan's economic crisis.

The 2017 Nobel Peace Prize was awarded to the International Campaign to Abolish Nuclear Weapons (ICAN) for its work highlighting nuclear weapons' humanitarian consequences and efforts toward a treaty-based prohibition. The Nobel committee noted ongoing nuclear threats from North Korea and modernizing arsenals. ICAN, a coalition in 100 countries, helped drive the UN Treaty on the Prohibition of Nuclear Weapons, adopted by 122 nations, though the five permanent UN Security Council members did not participate. ICAN's CEO called the award "hugely important" for raising awareness.

The passage details design parameters for a GaN-based push-pull converter using TPS7H500x-SP controllers. Dead time was set to ~25 ns with 20.5 kΩ resistors. Leading edge blank time was ~50 ns with a 49.9 kΩ resistor. Soft-start time is ~7.5 ms with a 33 nF capacitor. Transformer turns ratio is 2.5, primary inductance is 40 μH. Primary GaN FETs are 170 V rated; synchronous rectifier FETs are 80 V rated. Output inductor is 0.47 μH. Output capacitance is ~2.3 mF. Overcurrent protection triggers at ~35 A with a 7.5 Ω sense resistor. Hiccup capacitor is 3.3 nF. Frequency compensation uses Type 2A with a 10 kHz crossover. Slope compensation resistor is 102 kΩ. Layout guidelines emphasize separating analog and power grounds, minimizing switching loop areas, and placing bypass capacitors close to the controller.

Pragyan '18, held from March 1, 2018, featured guest lectures, workshops, and infotainment shows over three days. Events included a human library, exhibits like Hyperloop India and KalamSat, and a valediction ceremony with performances by Suhani Shah and Azeem Banatwalla.

The 2025 Nobel Prize in physiology or medicine was awarded to Shimon Sakaguchi, Mary Brunkow, and Fred Ramsdell for discovering regulatory T cells (T-regs), which prevent the immune system from attacking the body. Sakaguchi identified T-regs in 1995. Brunkow and Ramsdell found a mutation causing a fatal autoimmune disease in mice, linked to T-reg deficiency, and revealed similar mutations in humans in 2001.

The defendant's motion to dismiss a bigamy indictment is granted. The court found that the defendant's second marriage, performed by a Justice of the Peace when he was 19, was void under subdivision 5 of section 11 of the Domestic Relations Law, following the reasoning in *Caplan v. Caplan* and *De Martino v. De Martino*.

The passage examines the Santa Claus rally, an end-of-year stock market phenomenon. Backtests on the S&P 500 from 1960 show a 0.7% average gain per trade with a 66% win ratio. Extended holding periods improved results to 1.6% per trade and a 72% win ratio. The rally also appears in the German DAX (2.1% average gain, 81% win ratio), Euro Stoxx 50 (1.5% average gain, 81% win ratio), Emerging Markets (2.7% average gain, 73% win ratio), and India's NIFTY (1.2% average gain, 71% win ratio). The passage concludes the rally is not a myth, though recent returns have weakened.

The University of Maine cancelled its annual floating offshore wind summit due to changing federal policies and priorities, following the suspension of a $12.5 million grant by the Trump administration. The university has no plans to revive the summit but will hold private meetings with relevant parties.

Darfon America Corp. is showcasing upgraded energy storage products at Intersolar North America 2018, including the H200 and H300 hybrid systems and H5001 inverter. Improvements include new battery options, redesigned wiring and panels, lockable components, laser-cut knockouts, upgraded fans, and better overload handling. The products are available through authorized distributors.

The passage discusses a hockey team's perspective on a playoff series, acknowledging they faced adversity against top conference teams, are not discouraged despite losing two games, need to adjust to the opponent's system, create scoring chances through rebounds, avoid distractions like family and the Stanley Cup's presence, and value the partnership between Drew Doughty and Rob.

The Federal Reserve raised short-term interest rates by a quarter point to a range of 1% to 1.25%, its third hike since December, citing a solid U.S. economy. The Fed upgraded its growth and unemployment forecasts, plans to gradually sell $4.5 trillion in assets starting later this year, and expects at least one more rate hike in 2017.

The speaker is excited to be playing in a hostile environment, treating it like any other game while staying focused. They feel confident in net, credit their team, and emphasize the need to match Edmonton's readiness, as no game can be let slide. They also note it's not baseball and enjoy good relationships with teammates.

The ARM Cortex-A8 Subsystem integrates the ARM Cortex-A8 processor, which supports the ARM debug architecture and includes a NEON SIMD engine and VFPv3 coprocessor. It contains an interrupt controller (AINTC) that prioritizes service requests and generates IRQ or FIQ to the processor. The subsystem also includes an embedded PLL Controller (PLL_ARM) for clock generation. The C674x DSP CPU features eight functional units, two register files, and supports various data types and multiply operations. The system MMU remaps C674x accesses to protect ARM memory regions. The device includes a Mailbox module for inter-processor communication, a Spinlock module with 128 hardware semaphores, and an HDVICP2 video encoder/decoder accelerator. The Face Detection module supports QVGA resolution inputs. Memory maps are provided for L3 and L4 interconnects, and terminal functions tables detail pin multiplexing, pullup/pulldown resistors, and supply voltages.
Amazon.com, Inc. filed a Form 10-Q for the quarterly period ended June 30, 2019, reporting net sales of $63.4 billion and net income of $2.6 billion for the quarter.

Volkswagen's U.S. unit requested a delay in court trials over excess emissions, citing fears that a lawyer's "inflammatory" comments in a Netflix documentary—comparing the company's monkey fume tests to Nazi gassing—would prejudice a jury. The first trial, set for Feb. 26, involves a North Carolina Jetta owner. VW argued the comments are irrelevant to consumer fraud claims, while the lawyer called the motion "hogwash."

President Madison vetoed a bill for internal improvements (roads, canals, and navigation), stating it was unconstitutional because the power to construct them is not among Congress's enumerated powers, cannot be derived from the commerce clause or the general welfare clause without improper interpretation, and cannot be conferred by state consent. He argued the Constitution requires a definite partition of powers.

NATO's 2017 annual report shows positive trends, including increased deterrence against Russia, burden-sharing, and defense spending. Actions included deploying battle groups to Eastern Europe, enhancing cyber defenses, and expanding missions in Afghanistan and Iraq. Russia's activities, including a nerve agent attack, were condemned. NATO also welcomed Montenegro as a new member.

Scalping is a trading style that profits from small price changes within a very short time frame, but it is argued to be a waste of time because most scalpers lose money. It involves competing with better-equipped traders and institutions, dealing with market randomness, and facing challenges like slippage and commissions that erode profits. Backtesting scalping strategies is difficult and unlikely to reflect reality, and automation is necessary but comes with its own risks. The article recommends finding edges and strategies on longer time frames instead.

This study uses DFT to investigate three novel o-MAX phases, Mo2A2AlC3 (A = Zr, Nb, Ta), predicting their structural, electronic, mechanical, thermodynamic, and optical properties. The compounds are dynamically, chemically, and mechanically stable, exhibit metallic behavior, and are brittle. Their properties suggest potential for thermal barrier coatings and solar heat-shielding layers.

Becton, Dickinson and Company has paid dividends since 1962, with double-digit growth in 12 of the past 13 years and an average increase of 16.3% since 2004. The 2017 dividend is estimated at $2.98, a 10% increase. GAAP EPS guidance for fiscal 2017 is $7.90–$8.00, up to 78% over 2016. The dividend payout ratio fell to 59% in 2016 and is projected at 37% for 2017. Net profit margins are recovering after CareFusion merger costs, with 2017 expected to approach record profits. Risks include manufacturing issues, higher interest rates, and competing products.

QuantifiedStrategies.com offers free, data-driven trading resources including over a thousand articles and hundreds of videos on backtested strategies, indicators, and trading psychology, with a focus on numbers, facts, and statistics.

Celtic's victory at Ibrox highlighted their superiority and the financial gap between the clubs, with the author arguing Rangers chairman Dave King has failed to provide manager Mark Warburton the promised financial backing. The passage states Celtic has Champions League funds and potential player sale income, while Rangers' key players are aging. It suggests Celtic should use its financial advantage to strengthen further, aiming to permanently outdistance Rangers domestically and improve in Europe.

This paper argues that generative AI's integration into education requires a philosophical framework to ensure ethical, humanizing use. Drawing on Anders, Foucault, Freire, Bloom, and Arendt, it proposes a spectrum-based framework for assessing AI use, ranging from consumptive labor to humanizing action, and provides applied examples for classroom contexts.

A method and apparatus handle reduced processing time in systems using configurable or short transmission time intervals (TTIs/sTTIs). A WTRU determines processing capabilities, sends a processing capability (PC) indication to an eNB, receives a PC configuration, and limits timing advance or Rx-Tx time difference based on the PC configuration or determined capabilities for a specific TTI length. The WTRU may also measure a processing value (PV), determine headroom (difference between PV and PC), and report the headroom based on a condition. The WTRU may receive a TTI configuration, determine its PC based on the TTI configuration and a processing criteria, and transmit a report of the determined PC. The WTRU may also receive downlink control information (DCI) including an uplink grant, determine available processing time based on the end of a time unit at the end of the DCI and the start of a time unit at the start of a scheduled transmission, and transmit the scheduled transmission if the available processing time is at or above a threshold.

The report analyzes the global Silyl Modified Polymer market, covering historical and projected revenues by sector, segment, and region. It profiles key manufacturers and examines market dynamics, segmentation by product type and application, and regional data for 2018-2025. The report aims to provide market insights, strategies, and forecasts.

India's trucking industry will undergo significant change over the next decade, with trucks becoming faster, more powerful, and more efficient. Key changes include the rollout of Bharat VI emissions standards by 2021, the implementation of the Goods and Services Tax, and the Automotive Mission Plan II aiming to make India a top-three automotive industry by 2026. However, self-driving electric trucks remain many decades away.

This document describes a device and method for performing fundamental computational primitives (e.g., convolution, matrix multiplication, FFT) using a matrix multiplication accelerator (MMA) coupled to a processor. The device configures a streaming engine to stream data from memory and configures the MMA to format and execute the primitive. The MMA includes buffers for multiplier and multiplicand matrices, performs a single Load, Store, and Execute instruction per cycle, and includes configurable formatting, row offset, and nonlinearity components. The processor provides input data to the MMA and receives output data, applying formatting as needed.
Jerome Guillen, President of Tesla Heavy Trucking, departed Tesla as of June 3, 2021.

Cowen Group Inc's shares rose 19% after CEFC China agreed to buy a 20% stake for $100 million, with rights to appoint three directors and provide $175 million in debt financing. The deal, at $18 per share (29.5% premium), is expected to close by Q3 2017, pending approvals.

Apple surpassed Samsung in Q4 2016 smartphone sales (77M vs 76.8M units), but Samsung is expected to regain the lead with a new flagship in March, while Apple's next iPhone launch is in September. Over the full year, Samsung led with 20.5% market share to Apple's 14.4%. Chinese firms Huawei (9.5%), Oppo (6.2%), and BBK (5.6%) hold the next three spots, with BBK now top in China and expanding globally.

The NVIDIA A100 Tensor Core GPU, based on the Ampere architecture, is designed for AI, HPC, and data analytics workloads. It includes third-generation Tensor Cores supporting TF32, FP64, BF16, INT8, INT4, and binary data types, and a new Sparsity feature that doubles throughput. The A100 features Multi-Instance GPU (MIG) for secure partitioning into up to seven instances, 40 GB of HBM2 memory with 1555 GB/sec bandwidth, a 40 MB L2 cache, third-generation NVLink, PCIe Gen 4, and new asynchronous copy and barrier instructions.

An 80-year-old man was treated on the floor at Gujranwala DHQ Hospital due to a bed shortage. The family stated the hospital refused a bed, claiming all were occupied. Separately, Yaum-e-Takbeer was celebrated by PML-N in Gujranwala.

Unidentified gunmen attacked a U.N. peacekeeping base in Timbuktu, Mali, killing seven and injuring seven. Earlier, attacks on two U.N. camps in Douentza killed a Malian soldier and a U.N. peacekeeper. The U.N. mission chief called both "terrorist" attacks. U.N. peacekeepers killed six assailants in Timbuktu and two in Douentza. The U.N. is investigating a possible connection between the attacks.

The Treasury Department recommended rolling back Obama-era Wall Street regulations, including CEO pay gap disclosure, to ease companies going public and streamline financial market rules. The report calls for repealing parts of Dodd-Frank, easing IPO burdens, and recalibrating derivatives rules. Critics argue it is uniformly deregulatory, while supporters say it will spur growth.

An Arizona man, Douglas Haig, was charged with manufacturing armor-piercing bullets after his fingerprints were found on unfired rounds in the Las Vegas shooter's hotel room. Haig sold 720 rounds of ammunition to Stephen Paddock before the attack that killed 58 people, but said he noticed nothing suspicious.

The passage discusses the use of Large Language Models (LLMs) as synthetic agents in social science research. It argues that LLMs are not Bayesian inference engines; they generate text via pattern matching from training data, not probabilistic sampling from a population. This leads to issues like order dependence and "introspective hallucination," where predictions drift. While LLMs can mimic human responses, their outputs often show low variance and systematic biases. The paper recommends treating LLMs as high-capacity predictors, not calibrated belief sources, and advocates for rigorous validation, stress-testing, and transparency in their use.

The National Institute of Standards and Technology revised its password guidelines, now recommending simple, long, and memorable passwords using phrases and lowercase letters, without special characters or regular expiration. This approach aims to create harder-to-break passwords and has been positively received by the security industry.

The passage is a newsletter discussing California's electricity crisis in December 2000, including public concern over rising bills, criticism of political figures and regulators, credit issues for power producers, and updates on FERC actions and industry meetings.

A study of 71 Anganwadi centers (AWCs) in Mewat, India, found most lacked basic infrastructure, safety, and learning resources. Most Anganwadi workers (AWWs) had low educational qualifications and were unaware of child development domains, using repetition-based teaching. The study concludes that rural ECE faces challenges in infrastructure, trained educators, and parental engagement, recommending standardized facilities and AWW training.

Raja Jackson, son of MMA legend Quinton "Rampage" Jackson, faces one count of felony battery causing serious bodily injury and one count of misdemeanor battery for an assault during a professional wrestling event in Los Angeles in August. He allegedly slammed wrestler Stuart Smith and continued striking him after he appeared unconscious. Smith suffered jaw, head, and lip injuries and lost teeth. In two consolidated cases (No. 12,391 and No. 12,392), the court reviewed a dispute over property at 820 Detroit Street in Denver. Toll purchased the property from Mrs. McKenzie, who had obtained title through a constructive fraud that excluded her minor daughters' ownership. A contract ("A") required Mrs. McKenzie and Casey to perfect Toll's title via court proceedings. The court found that while the contract's letter was violated, its spirit was not, and valid probate and guardianship proceedings gave Toll good title. However, because Casey, the encumbrancer, instigated the fraud and failed to comply with "A," the court modified the judgments: Toll must pay the balance due on the encumbrance by June 1, 1931, with Casey paying certain costs and releasing the trust deed upon payment.

Micro E-mini Nasdaq 100 futures are electronically traded contracts, one-tenth the size of E-mini Nasdaq 100 futures, with the Nasdaq 100 Index as the underlying asset. Altermagnetism (AM) is a magnetic phase distinct from ferromagnetism and antiferromagnetism (AF), breaking time-reversal symmetry while preserving it with certain crystallographic symmetries, causing spin-degenerate bands to split. This study uses group theory and density functional theory (DFT) to calculate higher-order atomic multipoles in real space for collinear altermagnets like MnF2 and CrSb, revealing octupoles and dotriacontapoles (32-poles) in the noncollinear spin density (NSD). The NSD exhibits a nodal structure with higher-order multipolar behavior, and spin-orbit coupling (SOC) induces noncollinear multipoles linearly. In perovskite KMnF3, structural octahedral rotations tune the magnetic state from AF to AM, with the 32-pole linearly proportional to the rotation angle. These multipoles are relevant to macroscopic response tensors like piezomagnetism.

A study in *Nature Communications* found that grape-derived compounds, specifically dihydrocaffeic acid and malvidin-3′-O-glucoside, may reduce depression by targeting inflammation and synaptic plasticity, showing efficacy in promoting resilience against stress-induced depression in mice.

Japan's financial regulator conducted surprise checks on Coincheck after hackers stole $530 million, citing prior knowledge of system flaws. The exchange lacked official approval due to security gaps, stored coins in a "hot wallet," and lacked multi-signature security. The FSA ordered all exchanges to report on system risk management and investigated Coincheck's compensation, finances, and consumer protection.

A collection of news articles from May 20, 2001, covers U.S. energy policy, Texas electricity deregulation, and international energy news. The U.S. articles discuss the Bush energy plan's focus on increasing natural gas and nuclear power, modernizing transmission, and the political battles between regions and industries. Texas's pilot deregulation program shows low residential participation due to consumer confusion and California's crisis. International items include Qatar's gas export talks, OPEC's likely output stability, and Enron's termination notice for the Dabhol Power Company in India.

The Henry James Review will move to Creighton University in 2019, with Greg Zacharias as editor. The journal, published by Johns Hopkins University Press, is the only scholarly journal devoted to Henry James. It will complement Creighton's Center for Henry James Studies and provide student opportunities.

Judge Barbara Lynn indicated she is "99 percent sure" she will dismiss mail fraud charges against John Wiley Price, even if a jury convicts him, questioning the validity of the government's bribery conspiracy and mail fraud arguments. She also questioned whether prosecutors proved a quid pro quo existed between Price and political consultant Kathy Nealy.
Due to a lengthy rain delay, the Mariners-Tigers ALDS Game 3 will now air on MLB Network and FS2 instead of the originally scheduled FS1. The game will also stream on the Fox One app and Fubo.

Devon and Cornwall Police has been charged under the Health and Safety Act over the 2012 death of Thomas Orchard, who died in custody after being restrained with an Emergency Response Belt. The force faces one count of exposing a detainee to risk. Criminal proceedings have begun.

Former NFL quarterback Mark Sanchez was arrested in Indianapolis on three misdemeanor charges: battery with injury, unlawful entry of a motor vehicle, and public intoxication, after being stabbed and hospitalized.

The Foothills Audubon Club's first 2017 program is on Jan. 9 at 7:00 p.m. at the Berthoud Community Center. It features the PLANET EARTH segment "Saving Species," with experts discussing global conservation efforts. Refreshments follow; the free event is open to all ages.

Time outdoors reduces children's risk of developing myopia, with about 14 hours per week nearly neutralizing genetic risk from nearsighted parents. Near-work is not a significant factor. Outdoor light exposure, not reduced reading time, is protective, though it does not slow progression in already nearsighted children.

The speaker thanks attendees and acknowledges key individuals and groups involved in passing the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA). The act is described as a historic civil rights law ensuring equality, independence, and access for people with disabilities, covering employment, public accommodations, transportation, and telecommunications. It positions the U.S. as an international leader, with other countries planning similar legislation. The speaker addresses business concerns about costs, emphasizes the potential of disabled workers, and concludes by signing the act to end discrimination.

This paper explores how startups develop Internet-of-Things (IoT) systems in their early stages. It presents a multiple-case study of eight startups, analyzing their team composition, system architecture, work artifacts (Minimum Viable Products or MVPs), and ways of working. The study identifies three MVP types (looks-like, functional works-like, and quality works-like) and common practices like outsourcing, rapid prototyping, reuse-oriented development, and agile development. The findings highlight that IoT startups often lack all needed competencies internally, leading to external dependencies, and that their development processes balance speed and quality, similar to software startups but with added hardware-related challenges.

The passage describes link-cut trees, a data structure for maintaining a forest of trees under edge insertions and deletions, supporting operations like link, cut, find root, and path aggregation in logarithmic time. It explains the use of preferred path decomposition and splay trees to represent the tree, with a focus on the access operation that restructures preferred paths. The analysis uses heavy-light decomposition to bound preferred child changes and the access lemma to achieve amortized O(log n) per operation.
Amazon.com, Inc. filed a Form 8-K on April 18, 2018, attaching its 2017 Letter to Shareholders as Exhibit 99.1.

On Feb. 14, 2013, RCMP Cpl. Marcus Hirschfield was injured in a head-on collision while returning from a rollover call. He broke both legs, was trapped for 1.5 hours, and was airlifted by STARS. After three months in hospital and ongoing physiotherapy, he returned to duty. He now advocates for STARS, which relies on government funding (one-third) and donations. The 2017 STARS Lottery had only 60% of tickets sold with five weeks left.

The passage promotes credit cards with 0% intro APR offers, cash back, and travel rewards from issuers like Discover, Bank of America, Citi, and Capital One, highlighting features such as sign-up bonuses, variable APRs, and balance transfer fees. It notes that CompareCards says issuers provide generous deals for those willing to switch, and that companies thriving in the future will give customers what they want.
The passage describes multiple views of a centrifugal pump design, noting that broken lines indicate unclaimed portions.

All women experience postpartum bleeding after childbirth, regardless of delivery method, due to the placenta's detachment from the uterus. Bleeding is initially heavy, similar to a period, and typically resolves within four weeks. Contact a doctor if bleeding soaks a pad hourly for two hours, involves large clots, or causes symptoms like dizziness or shortness of breath. After a C-section, avoid heavy lifting, strenuous activity, and tampons, and stay hydrated.

Around a third of Scotland's roads need repair, with 30% of A-roads and 35% of B-roads classified as needing work from 2015-2017, far higher than England's 3% and 5%. Scotland spent £657.61 per head on local roads and £621.46 on national roads, above UK averages. Experts blamed bad winter weather, while politicians cited budget cuts. The Scottish Government noted increased maintenance spending and investment projects.

The Dolphins immediately started Lawrence Timmons after his suspension, playing every snap against the Saints. The 31-year-old veteran admitted he wasn't at his best but felt good and expects to improve. He missed two games but was only away from the team for a week, staying in shape with extra running and lifting.
On April 30, 2019, Apple Inc. filed a Form 8-K reporting its financial results for the second fiscal quarter ended March 30, 2019, via a press release attached as Exhibit 99.1.
Charles H. Noski and Helmut Panke will retire from Microsoft's Board of Directors, effective December 4, 2019.

A study by the American Psychological Association found that people may be happier when they feel the emotions they desire, even unpleasant ones like anger. The cross-cultural study of 2,324 university students across eight countries showed that participants who experienced more desired emotions reported greater life satisfaction and fewer depressive symptoms, regardless of whether those emotions were pleasant or unpleasant.

Microsoft Corporation held its 2016 Annual Shareholders Meeting on November 30, 2016. Shareholders elected eleven directors, approved executive compensation on an advisory basis, ratified Deloitte & Touche as auditor, approved an amendment to the Articles of Incorporation, approved the French Sub Plan, and rejected a shareholder proposal to amend proxy access bylaws.

Apple Inc. filed its Annual Report on Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended September 24, 2016, with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission. The report details the company's business, risk factors, financial data, and operations.

The CCI (Commodity Channel Index) is a momentum oscillator that measures a security's current price relative to an average price over a given period, used to identify overbought/oversold conditions. Invented by Donald R. Lambert in 1980 for commodities, it now applies to stocks and ETFs. It works best on stocks and bonds with daily bars and a short lookback period (e.g., 5-9). Advantages include quantifying overbought/oversold levels; disadvantages are it lags and is not a timing tool. A backtest on SPY using a 9-day lookback and -90 buy threshold yielded a profit factor of about 1.8 and average gain of 0.55% per trade.

The Second Circuit reversed a preliminary injunction that barred H. P. Hood & Sons from selling products to Grand Union and Finast for transshipment into Jackson Dairy's exclusive territory, finding Jackson failed to show irreparable harm because money damages would be adequate compensation.

CompareCards states issuers offer generous, virtually irresistible deals for those willing to switch. Banks provide long 0% Intro APR periods, and the site lists several credit card offers with details on APRs, fees, cash back, and bonus rewards. The passage also explains that 0% or low-interest credit cards can save money, with introductory offers typically lasting 6 to 21 months.

Eccentric exercises, involving slow, controlled muscle lengthening, build strength and increase metabolism by creating muscle damage and tension. They improve energy use, preventing fat storage, and do not cause "bulking" in women due to low testosterone levels. Training for strength with eccentric moves, not hypertrophy, and a healthy diet promotes a lean physique.
Subgroup analyses of adherence from Week 24 to Week 48 showed a significant interaction for type of atrial fibrillation and for sex, with varying differences in mean adherence between groups.

Pneumococcal disease, caused by Streptococcus pneumoniae, caused 1.19 million deaths in 2016, disproportionately affecting young children and the elderly. Two pneumococcal vaccines are available in China, but uptake is low (3%-9%) as they are not in the national immunization program. Sinovac developed a preservative-free PPV23, approved in 2020. This phase 4 trial assesses its immunogenicity, tolerability, and safety compared to another PPV23 vaccine in Chinese children, adults, and the elderly, as requested by China's NMPA.
On January 31, 2019, Amazon.com, Inc. filed a Form 8-K announcing its fourth quarter 2018 and full year financial results, with related exhibits incorporated by reference.

KMT Chairwoman Hung Hsiu-chu announced her resignation effective June 30, appointed Lin Cheng-tse as acting chairman, and urged chairman-elect Wu Den-yih to assume office soon for a smooth transition.
The speaker reflects on playoff strategies, anticipation for tonight's game, personal connections to McGill, and emphasizes preparation and earned success over mystique.

HPCaaS enables new business models by allowing enterprises to offer HPC algorithms and insights as a service, with 81% of HPC users intending to implement such models. It reduces upfront costs, with 49% viewing it as full infrastructure outsourcing and 42% as a way to avoid setting up their own HPC. Cloud providers offer modern, continuously developed technologies, with 52% of respondents citing fast access to cutting-edge methods as a core innovation aspect.

The President transmits to the Senate a treaty with Nicaragua for an interoceanic canal, arguing it is necessary for U.S. political and material interests due to the physical impossibility of a domestic water route. The treaty respects Nicaraguan sovereignty, provides for equal use by all nations, and includes provisions for a railway and telegraph. The canal would reduce travel times, boost trade, and strengthen national unity. The President urges ratification and notes the role of private citizens in preliminary efforts.

Inflation is a gradual reduction in purchasing power due to rising prices. Backtests show inflation is bad for stocks short-term, but companies may pass on costs long-term. High inflation causes stock volatility, reduces consumer spending, and can lead to interest rate hikes, potentially causing a stock market decline. Value stocks tend to outperform growth stocks during high inflation.

The speaker discusses uncertainty about being "under the radar," praises players Mike Commodore and Cory Stillman for their contributions and likability, expresses pride in being a U.S.-born coach without making a statement about it, credits parents and various coaches as influences, and notes a player's recovery from injuries and consistent performance as key to the team's success.

In January 2017, foreign investors' net investment on ADX reached Dh406 million. The ADX general index rose 0.03%. The investment & financial services sector grew most (18.07%), while telecommunications fell most (4.79%). Market capitalisation dropped 1.32% to Dh438.383 billion. Traded value rose to Dh7.741 billion, and average daily value grew 87% to Dh352 million. Eshraq Properties was the most active stock.

A Lackawanna County Prison counselor, Kimberly A. Rupp, faces new retail theft charges for allegedly under-ringing $206.77 in merchandise at a Walmart, after being charged in November with a felony for attempting to steal $3,194 from Kohl’s.

Bibliotherapy uses books for psychological assistance, with developmental bibliotherapy in education and therapeutic bibliotherapy in clinical settings. This systematic review of 35 articles found bibliotherapy improved socio-emotional, academic, self-esteem, resilience, hope, and mental health outcomes, though challenges include lack of practitioner training and reader boredom.

Sentencing arguments for Lake Louise ski resort, which pleaded guilty to cutting endangered whitebark pine, were delayed to July due to court scheduling issues, frustrating the judge. The resort faces fines up to $300,000 per tree under the Species At Risk Act and $250,000 under the Canada National Parks Act.

The APC in Ekiti State nominated Chief Adebisi Adegboyega Egbeyemi as its deputy governorship candidate, to run with Dr. Kayode Fayemi. Egbeyemi, born May 8, 1944, is a lawyer and former Executive Chairman of Ado-Ekiti Local Government, with a political career including roles in the UPN, Ondo State House of Assembly, and as Commissioner for Justice.

Huawei aims to become the number one PC vendor globally by 2022, following new device releases. The company has nearly $19 billion in cash, a large global install base of smartphones and servers, and over 40,000 retail outlets across 170 countries. However, it faces challenges in the US due to espionage claims and may struggle to secure key channel partners.

The speaker describes a game where the team had to show resilience and physicality from the start. They stayed focused on their game plan, worked hard despite not getting favorable bounces, and adjusted line combinations to improve team play. They emphasized settling down, controlling the puck, and building confidence, especially on the power play. The win was not seen as a major achievement, but they must stay focused for the next game.

Joseph Percoco was convicted on three counts: two for conspiracy and one for solicitation of bribes. Steven Aiello was found not guilty on bribery charges but guilty on one conspiracy count. Joseph Gerardi was acquitted on all charges. The jury is deadlocked on Peter Galbraith Kelly Jr. Sentencing is set for June 11 (Percoco) and June 14 (Aiello).

Graph neural networks (GNNs) struggle with heterogeneous graphs, which have multiple node/edge types, due to challenges like over-smoothing, capturing long-range information, and high computational complexity from stacking layers. The paper proposes VN-HGCN, which adds type-level and central virtual nodes to shorten distances between nodes, enabling long-range message passing within 4 layers without predefined meta-paths. Experiments on node classification show VN-HGCN outperforms state-of-the-art models, and parameter analysis confirms its robustness.

Cardiac surgery often causes postoperative hyperglycemia, linked to complications. Current glucose management is inadequate, with only 15% of patients achieving control. A new model, GLUCOSE, uses distributional reinforcement learning to personalize insulin dosing. It was trained on 6,148 patients and externally validated on 649, showing improved performance over clinicians. Human evaluations found GLUCOSE’s dosing aligned closely with expert recommendations and was rated as safe and effective.

SimulRAG is a simulator-based retrieval-augmented generation framework for long-form scientific question answering. It uses a generalized simulator retrieval interface to transform between textual and numerical modalities and a claim-level generation method that decomposes answers into atomic claims for verification and updates. Uncertainty estimation scores and simulator boundary assessment (UE+SBA) selectively identify claims for verification. Experiments show SimulRAG outperforms traditional RAG baselines in factuality and informativeness.

The passage discusses post-World War I challenges, including economic readjustment, agricultural distress, transportation issues, labor disputes, and the need for domestic reforms. It emphasizes the importance of supporting farmers through credit and transportation improvements, addressing railway inefficiencies and labor board weaknesses, enforcing prohibition, registering aliens, and expanding education. It also advocates for constitutional amendments on tax-exempt securities and child labor, and highlights U.S. international cooperation without entangling alliances.

The Alaska Department of Fish and Game in Dillingham received reports of a fox behaving aggressively and oddly along Wood River Road, including snarling, snapping, following a car, and foaming at the mouth. Biologist Neil Barten said these signs indicate possible rabies, advising people to avoid approaching such foxes and to keep pets' rabies vaccinations current. Sightings can be reported to ADF&G at 907-842-2334.

Cleveland city worker Khalil Ewais, subject of a federal raid, tried to resign in 2015 over pay and duties, later rescinding after promises of changes. His personnel file shows he denied city business conflicts in 2017. Federal agents seized records related to his side business and city paving contracts.

In 2017, FAANG stocks drove market records but face an uncertain 2018. Morgan Stanley predicts a middle ground, noting these stocks have high valuations and concentration risk. While fundamentally bullish, the bank warns that macro factors and cyclical pressures could moderate returns, making them vulnerable to a decline.

An email forwards an article by Arundhati Roy criticizing the US-led war in Afghanistan, arguing it is an act of terror that kills civilians, is driven by US economic and oil interests, and will create more terrorism.

92.45% of campaign contributions from BigLaw and plaintiffs-side firm lawyers and staff went to Democrats in 2023-2024, up from a 6-1 ratio in 2017-2020. Contributions totaled about $52 million to Democrats and $4 million to Republicans.

The Missouri Court of Appeals affirmed the trial court's order requiring Max Gibson to remove a provision from an insurance trust that allowed him to use cash value, enforcing the parties' property settlement agreement. The court also upheld venue in Platte County based on the parties' contractual agreement, found no adequate legal remedy, and affirmed the award of attorney fees and costs.

USD/CAD remains range-bound between 1.2968 and 1.3211 with neutral intraday bias. A break above 1.3387 would confirm the decline from 1.3598 ended at 1.2968, turning bias upward toward 1.3598. A break below 1.2968 would suggest the rise from 1.2460 is complete, turning outlook bearish. In the bigger picture, price actions from 1.4689 are seen as a correction pattern, with a break of 1.2460 targeting 1.2075.

The lecture discusses TaintDroid, a system for tracking sensitive data flow in Android smartphones to prevent data exfiltration by apps. It explains why traditional Android permissions are insufficient, as they cannot restrict specific data types. TaintDroid uses a 32-bit bitvector to represent taint from sources (e.g., GPS, contacts) and prevents tainted data from reaching sinks (e.g., the network). It propagates taint through Dalvik VM instructions, with special handling for arrays, native methods, and IPC messages. Performance overhead is moderate (3-5% memory, up to 29% CPU). The lecture also covers limitations like implicit flows and compares TaintDroid to other approaches, such as low-level x86 taint tracking and the TightLip system for legacy programs.

In the sole practice session at Suzuka, air temperature was 21°C and track temperature 28°C. Conditions were dry but had damp patches. Fernando Alonso received a 25-place grid penalty after an engine change. Valtteri Bottas damaged his car and stopped running after a red flag. Kimi Raikkonen crashed, causing another red flag. Bottas ended the session quickest, ahead of Lewis Hamilton and Sebastian Vettel.

The passage describes how to attack a "Box & One" defense, focusing on the "Shuffle Cut" offense. It emphasizes simplicity, isolating the star player, and using specific actions like back screens, base screens, and double screens to free the scorer. Key elements include proper execution of screens, offensive rebounding, and defensive recognition. Implementation requires coordination, practice drills, and scouting opponents to anticipate defensive adjustments.

The 52-week high strategy involves buying stocks near their 52-week highs, contrary to "buy low, sell high." The 52-week high is the highest daily closing price over one year, used as a technical analysis tool. Backtests on the S&P 500 did not produce a tradable strategy, but academic research suggests individual stocks near their 52-week highs tend to outperform.

Actress Rose McGowan reached a $100,000 settlement with Harvey Weinstein in 1997 after a hotel room incident during the Sundance Film Festival, according to a New York Times report. The settlement was not an admission of harassment. Ashley Judd also accused Weinstein of inappropriate behavior. Weinstein announced a leave of absence from his company.

The US Department of Energy approved nearly $67 million in grants for 85 nuclear research projects at universities and laboratories to promote safety, efficiency, and energy independence. This includes over $31 million for 32 university-led projects and $6 million for 19 universities researching reactor safety. Since 2009, the Office of Nuclear Energy has awarded about $472 million to 103 US colleges and universities.

The NHS Constitution, or Patient Charter, outlines patients' legal rights, NHS pledges, and patient responsibilities. It guarantees care free at the point of use (with exceptions), equal access, waiting time standards, quality and safety, access to NICE-recommended treatments, patient choice, consent, privacy, and a right to complaints and compensation. Patients are responsible for maintaining their health, respecting staff, and following treatment plans. The Charter is a framework for empowerment, fairness, and shared responsibility.

New diet trends claim fruit is unhealthy, but dietitian Samantha Rigoli states fruit is nutrient-dense and valuable, not comparable to calorie-dense cookies. For weight loss, check glycemic index for slower blood sugar-raising fruits; quality matters more than calorie quantity. Overall, fruit is healthy and should be eaten daily.

The passage discusses biomimicking of natural cellular structures in engineering, including wood-derived silicon carbide ceramics, 3D-printed fiber-reinforced honeycombs, foamed metals for orthopedic implants, tissue engineering scaffolds, sandwich panels, and plant stems with foam cores. It also reviews test material on foam equations and energy absorption, and mentions a future talk on becoming a professor.

Enron's employees' retirement plan was devastated as the stock lost 94% of its value, with workers unable to change investments during a freeze. Dynegy weighed renegotiating its acquisition of Enron, which secured a three-week debt payment extension. Enron's Japan subsidiary reviewed its operations, and its Wessex Water unit faced potential bids. Enron's stock fell 28% to $5.01 amid doubts about the merger and possible bankruptcy.

The launch of California's recreational marijuana market has been problematic due to a complex regulatory scheme, slow implementation, and a large unlicensed industry. Local government bans and high taxes have driven consumers to the black market, with effective tax rates nearing 80 percent. However, experts note that similar issues occurred in Colorado before stabilizing.

Most infected people recover quickly, but some develop long COVID (symptoms lasting ≥4 weeks). Globally, 43% of infected individuals experienced this. Vaccines are highly effective against severe outcomes, but long COVID remains a risk, linked to over 3,500 deaths. Risk factors include female sex, obesity, and comorbidities. Healthcare workers (HCWs) are vulnerable. This study analyzed long COVID risk factors among HCWs in Brazil. It was a case-control study at Hospital Israelita Albert Einstein (March 2020–July 2022), including HCWs with RT-PCR-confirmed COVID-19. Cases had symptoms persisting >4 weeks; controls recovered within 4 weeks.

The Cahokia Creek Watershed Planning project aims to address storm water, flooding, and water quality issues in western Madison County. HeartLands Conservancy is gathering community input through open houses to focus resources on infrastructure and land management issues. The plans will be used to find funding for projects affecting agricultural and residential areas.

A 10-year-old student at Government Primary School near PGI reported an alleged abduction attempt by youths in a black car on Tuesday around 11 am. No complaint was filed, but a DDR was lodged. A similar attempt occurred on February 9. Police found no evidence of an attempt after speaking to locals. The school has requested regular PCR patrols.

A flash flood watch is in effect for much of central Alabama until 7 p.m. due to deep tropical moisture left by Alberto. Heavier storms today could cause flooding on saturated ground. Tomorrow, storms will be more scattered with a marginal risk of severe weather in north Alabama. Friday through the weekend will feature partly sunny skies with scattered afternoon storms and highs near 90 degrees. Drier air is possible early next week, with a front possibly bringing storms late in the week. No tropical storm formation is expected in the Atlantic for the next seven days.

Belgium's 18-10 win over Spain means Romania qualifies for the 2019 Rugby World Cup as Europe 1. Spain will now play Portugal, with the winner facing Samoa; the loser joins Canada in a four-team repechage in November, which also includes the Africa Cup runner-up and the Asia 2 winner.

Bond yields rose and U.S. stocks held near record highs after economic reports showed strengthening growth, potentially prompting the Federal Reserve to raise interest rates sooner. The S&P 500 was nearly flat, the Dow rose 0.2%, and the Nasdaq rose 0.1%. Retail sales and consumer inflation exceeded expectations, with consumer prices up 2.5% year-over-year. Treasury yields increased, and utility stocks fell 1.2% due to reduced demand for dividend-paying stocks. Global markets were mixed, and the dollar strengthened against major currencies.

California state controller Kathleen Connell will release details of long-term power supply contracts, including cost per megawatt-hour, at a news conference. Connell has said the state should stop buying power due to budget impacts. Governor Gray Davis threatened to seize Reliant Energy facilities if prices are not cut. PUC President Loretta Lynch testified that power generators scaled back production unnecessarily, creating artificial shortages. A new poll shows 48% of Californians believe the state is headed in the wrong direction, down from 62% in January. The ISO is studying planned blackouts. Attorney General Bill Lockyer is investigating generators for possible market manipulation.

Coaches must prepare players for varied field conditions, including surface types (artificial turf, natural grass), field anomalies (dirt, uneven surfaces), weather effects (rain, snow, wind), and field size. Pre-match inspection is crucial for safety. Players must adapt play to conditions like wet grounds, wind, and lighting. Referees, perimeter factors, equipment, and ball condition also affect play.

On May 23, 2017, NVIDIA Corporation held its 2017 Annual Meeting. Stockholders voted to elect twelve directors for one-year terms, approved advisory compensation for named executive officers, and ratified PricewaterhouseCoopers LLP as the independent auditor. Based on the advisory vote, the company will hold an annual advisory vote on executive compensation.

The speaker discusses a hockey team's playoff performance, including officiating concerns, injuries to key players (Z and Griz), the need to adjust lineups and strategies, and the importance of winning despite missing players. They emphasize that every player is hurt this time of year and that the team must focus on execution and supporting each other to overcome absences.
The speaker confirms a bruise is fine, praises a young player's potential, and emphasizes keeping play simple despite unpredictable bounces.

First-quarter GDP in China rose 6.9%, above the 6.5% target, but the author speculates this may not be sustainable. Industrial Production (IP) at 7.6% in March 2017 is the highest since January 2015, but the author questions its reliability due to past stability and possible overstatement. Retail sales grew 10.9% in March, and fixed asset investment (FAI) remains subdued, with total FAI growing 9.2% on an accumulated basis. The author suggests China's economy may have stabilized but views the growth as likely temporary, given global trends and past patterns.

The Senate again rejected competing Republican and Democratic funding bills to end the government shutdown, now in its second week. Democrats demand health-care protections, including extended ACA subsidies. Republicans want a short-term funding measure through Nov. 21. Both parties blame each other for the shutdown.

This study compared REM sleep microstructure in patients with isolated REM sleep behavior disorder (iRBD) or RBD with Parkinson’s disease (PD+RBD) to controls. Increased phasic REM sleep proportion was found in iRBD, and reduced sawtooth wave (STW) density and duration in PD+RBD. Both patient groups showed altered STW spectral characteristics with a shift toward higher frequencies. NREM/REM sleep transition duration increased from controls to iRBD, peaking in PD+RBD.

The passage summarizes the derivation of mechanical properties for hexagonal and triangular honeycombs, including in-plane and out-of-plane elastic moduli, compressive strengths (elastic buckling, plastic collapse, brittle crushing), and fracture toughness. It notes that in-plane properties depend on bending (modulus proportional to (t/l)^3), while out-of-plane properties involve axial deformation (modulus proportional to t/l). The discussion also covers Poisson's ratios, shear moduli, and approximate calculations for out-of-plane failure modes.

A player praised Paul's leadership and desire after he returned from a concerning hit to score a crucial goal. The speaker noted the team played well and that Paul's return was a lift. They expressed that this opportunity to win the Stanley Cup makes up for past tough years and is meaningful to share with long-time teammates. The speaker emphasized being ready for the next exciting game.

The Delaware Supreme Court reversed the Superior Court's judgment, holding that Cheryl Tickles' injury was compensable under workers' compensation because she was injured on her employer's premises and within the course of her employment while performing a preparatory act (using an ATM) before her shift.

The Turing GPU architecture introduces a unified L1 cache and shared memory design, increasing hit bandwidth by 2x per TPC. It includes enhanced Tensor Cores with INT8 and INT4 precision for AI inference, and RT Cores for real-time ray tracing. Turing uses GDDR6 memory, delivers up to 50% higher effective bandwidth than Pascal, and supports features like Variable Rate Shading, Mesh Shading, and Texture Space Shading. The Tesla T4 GPU offers up to 40x higher inference performance and over 50x better energy efficiency than CPU-based inferencing.

Moody's states Saudi Arabia's fiscal position is strong, but high oil dependency is a key credit challenge. It expects reform implementation to be challenging, with a stable outlook and balanced risks. Moody's forecasts a 0.2% GDP contraction in 2017, a 10.5% budget deficit in 2017 narrowing to 9.2% in 2018, and oil and gas revenue declining to 54% by 2020. The A1 rating is supported by a strong fiscal position, large reserves, and high external liquidity.

The city of Marquette is not liable for pedestrian injuries from sidewalk obstructions left by occupants, per its charter (Act No. 409, Local Acts 1895, subd. 16, §1, ch. 7). This provision is not repealed by Act No. 423, Local Acts 1899, as both can coexist. It is not invalid as class legislation. The judgment for the defendant was affirmed.

The passage lists 12 reasons to avoid forex trading, including leverage, volatility, zero-sum nature, difficulty in prediction, limited risk management, scams, counterparty risk, 24-hour markets, and lack of backtesting. It argues that stocks offer more robust and profitable trading strategies, while forex is extremely challenging and should be approached with caution.

Lake Havasu City, Arizona, reached 128°F on June 29, 1994, the state's highest recorded temperature, making it the second hottest U.S. location after Death Valley. The Colorado River has little cooling effect; the area's heat is driven by dry desert terrain, lack of monsoon moisture, and minimal agriculture.

The speaker argues that the team must focus on the present game, not past comebacks. He explains he became a coach after being asked repeatedly, finding satisfaction in others' success. He notes coaching involves teaching and molding players, and emphasizes discipline is crucial to avoid penalties against a strong powerplay team.

Brazil is a major financial hub in South America, home to the BOVESPA and BM&F exchanges, and regulated by the CVM. The passage lists various trading strategies, risks, assets, platforms, and tax implications for trading in the country, and includes a backtested swing trading strategy with a 67% win rate and 2.1 profit factor.

Wall Street indexes had their worst week in two years due to rising bond yields and inflation fears, but corporate earnings forecasts are improving due to the U.S. tax overhaul. The S&P 500 fell 3.9 percent, yet profit estimates for 2018 have risen to 18.2 percent from 11.5 percent since December 20. Upcoming earnings reports will influence whether the downturn continues.

The speaker discusses team strategy, focusing on improving forwards and maintaining strong defense and goaltending. They highlight the importance of player development through the Milwaukee Admirals, citing examples like Pekka Rinne and Roman Josi. They credit scouts and staff for successful trades, including acquiring P.K. Subban, and emphasize communication and fit with players. They praise Nashville's game atmosphere and entertainment value.

High-level Trump campaign advisers had frequent communications with Russians known to U.S. intelligence during the campaign, raising concerns among officials. Both Trump and Obama were briefed on these intercepts, which were part of routine collection. Investigators have not determined intent, but post-election Russian communications suggested they believed they had special access to Trump.

Following Pfizer's agreement with the Trump administration to lower drug prices, other major pharmaceutical firms are scrambling to make similar deals, with some hoping to announce agreements as soon as this week.

The court held that transferring a chancery case to the law side did not confer jurisdiction over defendants not served with process in the county, and defendants' appearance in chancery did not waive their right to object to jurisdiction in the law case. The writ of mandamus was granted.

The U.S. Embassy in Nigeria shared photos of Folake, an HIV/AIDS survivor who received antiretroviral treatment through PEPFAR at a CDC/IHVN-supported site in Lagos, to mark World AIDS Day and demonstrate that HIV/AIDS is not a death sentence.

The passage describes an advanced cryptography class focused on the evolution of proofs in computer science, starting with interactive proofs. It introduces the sum-check protocol, an interactive proof for verifying the sum of a multivariate polynomial over a set, detailing its rounds, communication complexity, verifier runtime, and soundness analysis, which shows the probability of cheating is at most m times d over the field size.

SUDEP is the leading cause of death in healthy young epilepsy patients, with major risk factors being nocturnal generalized tonic-clonic seizures and the prone position. The Korus mattress was developed to autonomously reposition patients from prone to a recovery position. In testing with 10 subjects, the device achieved 100% success in repositioning (avg. 21.75 sec) and 96.8% accuracy in detecting the prone position.

NVIDIA Corporation filed its Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended January 31, 2021, with the SEC. The report details the company's business, risk factors, and financial data, including its pending acquisition of Arm Limited.

The passage describes a rotorcraft landing device for drones without image capture. It includes a landing portion, a position recognition portion using infrared cameras, and a remote control portion for landing. The device features an opening/closing mechanism, movable plates for guidance and load centering, and an ascending/descending mechanism for package delivery to a residential space. It is installed above human living areas.

Harvey Weinstein was indicted on rape and criminal sex-act charges by a New York grand jury. Manhattan District Attorney Cyrus Vance stated the indictment moves Weinstein closer to accountability, while defense attorney Ben Brafman called it expected and said Weinstein will plead not guilty. Brafman advised Weinstein not to testify before the grand jury due to insufficient preparation time. The grand jury investigation remains active.

The PGA848 output-stage difference amplifier has a 6.67kΩ feedback resistor. External access to the amplifier's inputs via DA_IN+ and DA_IN– pins allows adding external capacitors for noise filtering or shaping, and implementing custom attenuating gains. The internal resistor network has 0.01% accuracy (80dB CMRR) and ±15% absolute resistance variation. The device has a single functional mode, operating when input-stage supply is >±4.5V and output-stage supply is >±2.25V.

California Governor Gray Davis's reelection prospects have improved due to mild weather, reduced power usage, and no blackouts since May, but he faces challenges including a financial bailout bill for Southern California Edison, litigation delaying bond sales, drought, and low poll numbers showing less than one-third of Californians favor his reelection.

Rabbi Aaron Brafman, longtime principal of Yeshiva of Far Rockaway, died at 73 on August 11, 2017. He was remembered for his dedication to students and community, studied at Yeshivah Torah Vodaath, and became a Maggid Shiur there. In 1970, he became principal of Yeshiva of Far Rockaway. He delivered shiurim, ran a tzedakah fund, and was survived by his wife, brother, sisters, seven daughters, one son, and many grandchildren.

In 2013, the European Space Agency launched the Gaia space observatory to catalog over a billion astronomical objects. Using its initial data and RAVE survey data, a University of Toronto team calculated the Sun's orbital speed around the Milky Way (240 km/s) and derived a refined distance estimate from the Sun to the galactic center of 7.6 to 8.2 kiloparsecs.

The passage promotes the Wells Fargo Active Cash® Card, highlighting unlimited 2% cash rewards, a $200 bonus after $500 spend in 3 months, 0% intro APR for 12 months, and a $0 annual fee. It also mentions other cards and states that Motley Fool Money receives compensation from advertisers, which does not influence product ratings.

Enrique Marquez Jr. agreed to plead guilty to federal charges for purchasing the assault rifles used in the 2015 San Bernardino attack that killed 14 people. He admitted to being a straw buyer for Syed Rizwan Farook and conspiring with him in 2011-2012 to attack Riverside City College and a freeway, though those plans failed. Marquez faces up to 25 years in prison.

Lawyers for Venezuelan TPS holders asked the Supreme Court to uphold a district court order blocking the Trump administration from ending their protected status, arguing the order restored the status quo and that disturbing it would cause harm.

Bitcoin's price fell below $8,000 after Indian Finance Minister Arun Jaitley announced measures to eliminate cryptocurrency use in illegal activities. India's market is small (2-3% of global trade) but growing, and government warnings and bank account suspensions have caused trader concern. A government committee is studying cryptocurrencies before taking action.

The speaker describes a successful season ending in a Stanley Cup finals loss, acknowledging the opposing team was better and deserved to win. Despite disappointment, they express pride in their team's effort, resilience, and support from fans, noting the achievement will feel better in a few days.

Costamare (CMRE) is seen as attractive due to an improving economic backdrop and a stronger balance sheet from debt reduction. Its share price, which fell from 2014-2016 due to global trade concerns, is now forming a bottoming pattern. The company has 71 containerships, $1.2 billion in contracted revenues, and reduced net debt from $1.7 billion to $1 billion. Charter rates have risen, idle fleet is at 1.8%, and management is optimistic about a fundamental upswing.

Amazon.com, Inc. filed its Annual Report on Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2022, with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission. The report details the company's business, risk factors, financial condition, and results of operations.
Tesla, Inc. filed its Annual Report on Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2020, with the SEC. The report details the company's business, risk factors, and financial data.

John Ternus, Apple's 50-year-old senior vice president of hardware engineering, is rumored to succeed Tim Cook as CEO. He joined Apple in 2001, has overseen hardware for major products, and recently gained increased visibility. His promotion follows COO Jeff Williams stepping down. Ternus has an engineering background and was a competitive swimmer at the University of Pennsylvania.

Inclusive education for children with disabilities is a global agenda, with Myanmar enacting laws after ratifying the CRPD. This study examines the practice of inclusive education for visually impaired children in Yangon, where a "limited inclusive education in phase" system exists: primary education in special schools, then secondary education in regular schools. Special schools provide Braille, life skills, and mental support, while regular schools foster social skills. Limitations include poor teacher communication, student isolation, and low awareness of educational opportunities. The study concludes that this system uses existing resources effectively but requires better cooperation and programs to address challenges.

The ADS9803 is an eight-channel, 20-bit, 2MSPS data acquisition system. It uses the SMPL_SYNC signal to simultaneously sample all analog input channels of multiple devices. It features a precision internal voltage reference, supports 2-lane and 4-lane modes with SDR and DDR interfaces, and includes a data output randomizer. The device has two data averaging modes (simple and moving) and test patterns for debugging. It can be powered down via the RESET or PWDN pin. It supports a speed-boost mode for up to 8MSPS on a user-selected channel pair. Register access is via SPI, and multiple devices can be connected in a daisy-chain topology.

No. 11,583,676), which is a continuation of U.S. Patent Application Ser. No. 15/578,776 (now U.S. Pat.
