The speaker believes the time off has been beneficial for focusing on the upcoming game. They emphasize not looking past the next game and wanting to play their best. They acknowledge the opponent is a great shot-blocking team but have no specific adjustments yet.

The passage outlines the structure and content of a volume of diplomatic papers, covering the continuation of World War I, peace efforts, neutral rights, submarine warfare, the U.S. entry into the war, and relations with Latin American countries.

On August 1, 2016, Microsoft Corporation entered an underwriting agreement to issue $19.75 billion aggregate principal amount of notes across seven series (2019-2056), with interest payable semi-annually. The notes are senior unsecured obligations.

This study uses verbal autopsies on a representative sample of 20,453 deaths in India from 2018-2021 to estimate SARS-CoV-2 mortality. The all-cause annual death rate in 2020-2021 was 81.19% higher than in 2018-2019. SARS-CoV-2 was associated with 17.93% of all deaths and 33.15% of excess deaths during the pandemic. Cardiovascular disease accounted for 23.15% of excess deaths. SARS-CoV-2 death rates were highest among those over 80, but most deaths occurred in the 61-80 age group. Death rates were higher in urban areas, but total deaths were greater in rural areas.

The NVIDIA Ampere architecture (GA10x GPUs) improves performance in ray tracing, AI, and shading. The RTX 3080 renders a frame in 6.7 ms (150 FPS) using shader, RT, and Tensor Cores. The second-generation RT Core doubles ray/triangle intersection rates and adds hardware acceleration for ray-traced motion blur, achieving up to 8x faster rendering than Turing. The third-generation Tensor Core supports new data types (TF32, BF16) and structured sparsity, doubling throughput. GDDR6X memory uses PAM4 signaling for up to 936 GB/sec bandwidth. NVIDIA RTX IO enables GPU-based decompression, offloading CPU work. The A40 and A6000 GPUs target data center and workstation applications, offering up to 2x FP32 and 5x AI throughput over previous generations.

The 3-4 defense features 3 down linemen, 4 linebackers, and 4 defensive backs. Since 2005, coaches from its coaching tree have won 9 college national championships and 7 Super Bowls. Its strengths include versatile pressure and blitzing, while weaknesses involve vulnerability to spread offenses and a light 5-man box. Common blitzes include the Weakside Edge Blitz and Crossfire Blitz, and coverages include Cover 4 and Cover 2 Man. Notable coaches using it are Bill Parcells, Bill Belichick, Nick Saban, and Kirby Smart.

The professor discusses quiz statistics, then reviews full factorial experimental design, including contrast estimation, ANOVA for significance, and checking model adequacy with center points. The lecture concludes with an introduction to blocking and confounding to handle nuisance factors.

The Neofoot study in Papua New Guinea assessed newborn foot length as a proxy for low birth weight (LBW) and preterm birth (PTB) in 342 babies. The optimal foot length cut-off for both LBW and PTB was <7.7 cm, with sensitivity of 84.7% for LBW and 88.0% for PTB. The study found foot length measurement feasible in resource-limited settings.

Iran's parliament preliminarily approved a bill to increase funding for its missile program and the Revolutionary Guards in response to new U.S. sanctions. The bill, which allocates over $260 million each to the missile program and the Quds Force, aims to counter U.S. actions. It requires a second vote and final approval to become law.

MSPM0G MCUs have five operating modes: RUN, SLEEP, STOP, STANDBY, and SHUTDOWN. They use two power domains (PD1 and PD0) and include a PMU, CKM, DMA, event manager, flash memory, SRAM, GPIO, IOMUX, ADC, temperature sensor, VREF, COMP, DAC, security features, TRNG, AESADV, Keystore, CRC-P, MATHACL, UART, I2C, SPI, CAN-FD, LFSS, RTC_B, IWDT_B, WWDT, and timers. The device also has an SWD interface and a BSL.

New clock gating allows entire clock trees to shut off quickly, saving dynamic power. Blackwell focuses on memory power management using GDDR7’s fast-wakeup clocking, enabling full memory clock tree gating. A new voltage rail provides separate power to GPU cores and memory, allowing independent voltage control per workload, boosting performance and reducing leakage power. Rail-gated states can be entered at frame granularity, aiding battery gaming and creating.

A Berliner Testament allows spouses to mutually appoint each other as sole heirs, with children as final heirs, providing financial security for the surviving spouse. However, it has a strong binding effect, preventing unilateral changes even after major life changes, and may cause tax issues if allowances are exceeded. Legal advice is recommended.

Delta expects premium cabin revenue to surpass coach cabin sales next year. In the last quarter, premium ticket revenue rose 9% to nearly $5.8 billion, while main-cabin revenue fell 4% to just over $6 billion. Delta noted that in 2024, only 43% of its revenue came from main cabin tickets, down from 60% in 2010, with nearly 60% of 2024 revenue from premium seats and its loyalty program.

This study compared models for forecasting opioid-related fatal overdoses at the census-tract level in Cook County, IL and Massachusetts. It found that a simple historical average baseline performed competitively with more complex models. The study also introduced a new metric, percentage of best possible reach (%BPR), which evaluates models based on their ability to identify high-risk areas for intervention, and showed that this metric can lead to different model rankings than error-based metrics.

The Relative Strength Index (RSI) is a momentum indicator measuring gains/losses over a period, represented on a 0-100 scale. It identifies overbought (above 70) and oversold (below 30) conditions, and can signal trend reversals. A Contract for Difference (CFD) is a financial contract based on the price difference of an underlying asset, allowing speculation without ownership. For day trading, shorter time frames with extreme thresholds (e.g., 15 for oversold, 85 for overbought) are common. Effective RSI trading requires backtesting, combining with other indicators, and risk management.

Science is developing a "memorization pill" by studying individuals with exceptional memory and genetically engineering fruit flies. Researchers are also attempting to identify all genes involved in intelligence for potential genetic enhancement. Additionally, deep brain stimulation devices are being developed to monitor and correct abnormal brain activity.

This chapter details the host environment requirements for implementing the host BIOS interface to access the AGESA software interface. It covers the need for a valid stack, the use of module dispatchers, and the creation of standard headers. The chapter describes the UEFI BIOS execution stages (SEC, PEI, DXE, RTP) and the associated libraries and build tools. It outlines the procedures for various PEIMs and DXE drivers, including processor initialization, memory initialization, and reset coordination. The chapter also provides specifications for configuration options, build methods (binary modules and source integration), and environment variables. It details the procedures for establishing and removing a pre-memory stack, as well as various service procedures like creating structures and obtaining system information. The chapter lists entry procedures in time point order, from AmdInitReset to AmdS3LateRestore, and describes required host environment call-out procedures for memory allocation and deallocation.

Former Langley City mayor and Liberal MLA Peter Fassbender is considering running for mayor again, with a decision expected by early August. He has been approached by many people and will only run if he feels he can contribute. Two incumbent councillors have already declared for the mayoralty.

The speaker expresses profound gratitude for being chosen to serve, acknowledging the solemnity of the current period and the enhanced honor and responsibility. They note the nation's unprecedented prosperity under republican institutions and peace, now contrasted with difficulties not caused by U.S. policy. Despite the U.S. maintaining neutral obligations, belligerent powers have introduced unjust retaliation. The speaker outlines principles of peace, neutrality, union, constitutional support, and fiscal responsibility, and expresses confidence in citizens and divine guidance.

The Supreme Court agreed to hear a case from a Texas man, Hunter, who pleaded guilty to wire fraud. The case concerns his waiver of the right to appeal, after a judge imposed a mandatory-medication condition despite his objection. The 5th Circuit dismissed his appeal due to the waiver, but Hunter argued other circuits would have allowed it. The Court will hear arguments in early 2026.

The court affirmed a judgment for real estate brokers' commission, ruling that a principal cannot defeat a broker's commission by refusing to sign a contract with a procured purchaser, and that any variance in pleading or procedural errors were harmless.

Yankees scout Matt Hyde called Cam Schlittler's eight-inning, 12-strikeout, no-walk, five-hit shutout against Boston in Game 3 of the AL Wild Card series "unbelievable" and "surreal." Schlittler, a 2022 seventh-round draft pick who debuted in July, became the first MLB pitcher to achieve that stat line.

A small Santa Barbara County school district, Montecito Union, settled a sexual abuse lawsuit for $7.5 million with two brothers, now 65 and 68, who alleged a deceased principal molested them in the 1970s. The settlement equals about 40% of the district’s 2025-26 budget. The brothers had sought $35 million. The district admitted no liability.

This study compared Statistical Parametric Mapping (SPM) and a machine learning (ML) approach for detecting outliers in plantar pressure data. The ML approach outperformed SPM, achieving an F1-score of 0.99 and MCC of 0.96 versus SPM's 0.93 and 0.78. In a human evaluation, both approaches were rated positively, with no statistically significant differences, though SPM was perceived as simpler. The ML approach with SHAP explanations was the most preferred (43.48% of expert ratings).

A bear market is commonly defined as a 20% drop from peak to trough in broad market indexes, with similar round-number definitions for corrections (10%), dips (5%), and crashes (30%+). The author argues these percentages have no rational basis or supporting data and are not useful for managing risk or deploying capital, citing examples like the 2015 S&P 500 decline of 15.2% versus the Russell 2000's 27.2% loss. Instead, the author defines a secular bull market as a 10-20 year period driven by economic shifts and increasing investor willingness to pay more for earnings, and a secular bear market as the opposite, with increased volatility and decreasing willingness to pay for earnings. The author notes that three-quarters of the 1982-2000 bull market gains came from rising price-to-earnings ratios, not earnings growth.

Pharma tariffs threatened by Trump did not take effect as planned; the administration will now "begin preparing" tariffs. Pharmaceutical executives receive near-daily calls from White House and HHS staff to strike deals ahead of the 2026 midterms.

Defending the high post split offense involves two phases: a high post split followed by down screens. In phase one, defenders sag off in front of the post to prevent handoffs and drives. In phase two, defenders use "Show & Recover" or "SOS Disruption" techniques, including switching, trapping, and denying passes, to counter down screens and protect the low post.

Deutsche Bank is seeking to sell its 8.8% stake in Dubai-based Abraaj, a private equity firm facing an investor dispute over alleged misuse of funds. The sale, considered non-core, has become more urgent due to Deutsche's restructuring and job cuts. A valuation two years ago was weaker than hoped, and any sale now may be at a discount. Abraaj is also considering selling parts of its business amid cashflow pressures and an investor investigation.

The passage discusses the metaverse's potential in education, including its advantages (e.g., immersive learning, practical application) and limitations (e.g., technical issues, health concerns). A survey of 333 teachers in Türkiye found they have limited metaverse experience but a positive attitude toward its use, citing benefits like engaging materials and practical application, while expressing concerns about technical problems, addiction, and inequality. Teachers identified science and math as suitable subjects and predicted widespread use within 3-5 years, though they noted the education system is not yet ready.

The passage describes the "Box & One - Flash/Back Door" offense, which attacks the Box & One defense by flashing a post player into the middle to create matchup problems. Options include post flash, back cuts, high/low feeds, and Single/Double Screen continuity. Variations include base screens and back door cuts. Success requires execution, coordination, defensive recognition, and scouting.

On February 11, 2015, NVIDIA Corporation filed a Form 8-K reporting its financial results for the quarter and fiscal year ended January 25, 2015, via a press release (Exhibit 99.1) and CFO commentary (Exhibit 99.2).

The passage describes the emotional experience of witnessing a child's birth and the determination to play harder for an injured teammate, referencing a similar hit in a previous series and a hope for league review of a play.

The speaker's MCL has healed and feels strong, but a torn ligament will need surgery after the series. The brace helps, and the speaker is ready to play in the next game after watching from the sidelines.

H. B. Fuller Company VP Traci L. Jensen sold 5,397 shares at $58.40 each on October 2nd. The stock opened at $56.81, with a market cap of $2.87 billion. The company reported Q3 EPS of $0.65, missing estimates by $0.02, and revenue of $562.87 million. A $0.15 quarterly dividend was announced. Analysts have an average "Hold" rating and a $57.40 price target. Institutional investors own 92.37% of the stock.

The Supreme Court will hear on August 17 the bail plea of 2008 Malegaon blast accused Lt Col Prasad Shrikant Purohit and a plea challenging bail to co-accused Sadhvi Pragya Singh Thakur, as both matters involve similar facts. Purohit challenges the Bombay High Court's rejection of his bail, while Nisar Ahmed Haji Sayed Bilal seeks cancellation of Thakur's bail, arguing she could influence witnesses. The High Court granted Thakur bail on April 25 but denied Purohit.

The passage describes LUKB DT, a web tool for identifying disease trajectories from electronic medical records using four steps: disease filtering via Cox regression, disease pair detection via binomial tests, disease pair validation via conditional logistic regression, and trajectory construction. A case study using UK Biobank data on COVID-19 found it primarily led to SARS-CoV-2-related diseases, with limitations noted. The tool's performance was benchmarked at 55 minutes for the case study.

Children with language vulnerabilities need tailored support, and speech-language therapists (SLTs) face challenges in delivering consistent linguistic models. Robot-Assisted Language Learning (RALL) has limitations in adaptability. The authors developed TalBot, a robot application integrating a large language model (LLM) to address these issues. TalBot manages a word retrieval game, handling turn-taking and interpreting mispronunciations. The authors propose expanding TalBot to target morphological learning by generating linguistic material, providing a consistent linguistic model, and acting as a role model for educators. Future plans include lab and field studies to evaluate the intervention's effectiveness.

On May 7, 2015, NVIDIA issued a press release announcing its Q1 fiscal 2016 results. On May 5, 2015, it announced it will wind down its Icera modem operations, with estimated restructuring charges of $100-$125 million.

David Ellison, whose Paramount Skydance owns CBS News, praised the network while saying it needs to build trust. He installed Bari Weiss as editor in chief, raising questions about the network's direction. Ellison avoided specifics on needed improvements and dismissed a plot to align CBS News with Trumpworld. He wants the news operation to appeal to the center-left and center-right.

Officials from two school boards met on Jan. 23 to discuss merging all high school sports in Brantford, Haldimand, and Norfolk into one league by 2019-20. Currently, only football has cross-county play. The goal is to create consistent rules and more opportunities, though travel costs and time are concerns. No final decision has been made.

The passage describes the dependencies, procedures, and build environment for AGESA™ software, including stack setup, call-out routing, UEFI phases (SEC, PEI, DXE, RTP), memory initialization, and platform configuration options. It details specific procedures like AMD_ENABLE_STACK, AmdCreateStruct, and AmdGetApicAddress, along with their parameters and status codes.

Young people in Kildare are choosing college options by February. At 17, declaring a lifelong career is difficult, but not knowing is fine, and choices can change. Technological advancements will alter industries, like petrol engines declining for electric ones. Employees should increase their value to employers, as seen in the pay difference between a burger seller and a surgeon. Most companies aim to minimize reward for work, so workers must ensure their skills are not cheap. Jobs will not always be fun; outside work life matters more.

Type 2A compensation was used with a 10 kHz target crossover frequency. The power stage transconductance was 16.2 A/V. Output capacitance used seven 330-μF polymer tantalum capacitors. The selected component values were RCOMP = 40.2 kΩ, CCOMP = 15 nF, and CHF = 47 pF. A 102 kΩ resistor was connected between RSC and AVSS for slope compensation.

Fees for burying or cremating children under 18 in Scotland will be abolished, with the Scottish government providing £500,000 in funding. Most councils currently do not charge for under-16s, and the change aligns Scotland with England.
On March 30, 2019, Stephen C. Neal was appointed to NVIDIA's Board of Directors and received equity grants and a cash retainer.

Cover 2 is a zone coverage with five underneath players and two deep safeties, designed to cover short routes while protecting against deep throws. Its strengths include defending quick passes and perimeter runs, but it is vulnerable to multiple deep routes, trips formations, and certain run plays. Variations include "Switch" and looks from a 1-high shell.
Emirates Airlines will continue offering a 'Hindu meal' option on its flights after negative customer feedback, reversing an earlier decision to discontinue it.

Sharp, Anderson, and Lang (2025) conducted a co-occurrence analysis of 1,076 articles from the *Information Systems Education Journal* (2003-2024) to identify topic evolution across five eras. Using author-supplied keywords and VOSviewer, they created term maps for five-year groupings and the full dataset. Results showed Era 1 (2003-2007) focused on IS education and curriculum; Era 2 (2008-2012) on pedagogy and student issues; Era 3 (2013-2017) on cybersecurity, big data, and analytics; Era 4 (2018-2022) on COVID-19 impacts; and Era 5 (2023-2024) on artificial intelligence. The full network highlighted pedagogy and curriculum as central themes.

US job growth exceeded expectations in January, with 200,000 non-farm payrolls added, and wages rose 2.9% year-on-year, the fastest since 2009. The unemployment rate held at 4.1%. This strengthens the case for a March rate rise, with the 10-year Treasury yield breaking above 2.8%.

The speaker believes the team learned from the last game, has confidence, and must improve execution, avoid careless turnovers, and not sit back. They note that giving up odd-man rushes is a mistake, but they had chances to win. A timely big hit can fuel the home crowd and shift momentum.

FERC approved an extension of the NYISO's Automated Mitigation Procedures (AMP) until April 30, 2002, instead of the requested October 31, 2002. FERC directed the NYISO to file a comprehensive mitigation proposal by March 1, 2002, addressing concerns with the AMP and how mitigation measures work together. FERC also directed the NYISO to examine barriers to entry for new generation and exemptions for energy-limited resources.

Leicester City manager Craig Shakespeare said the 4-2 loss to Everton, his first defeat since taking over, would not affect the squad's confidence before their Champions League quarter-final against Atletico Madrid. He made five changes with future fixtures in mind and was more concerned about defending set pieces than personal milestones. Captain Wes Morgan will miss the Madrid match due to a back injury.

Dr. Harris L. Rittenberg's practice has provided family dental care for over 50 years, with Dr. Rittenberg practicing for over 25 years. The practice emphasizes quality treatment, patient comfort, and advanced techniques. Dr. Rittenberg was recognized by the American Academy of Cosmetic Dentistry for his work with domestic violence victims. Dr. Brittany Jones has joined the team. The practice has received special recognition from America's Top Dentists.

Laredo Petroleum Holdings Inc (NYSE:LPI) shares rose 0.72%. Analysts project a mean 52-week price target of $13.54 (range $9.50-$17.00) based on 24 opinions. The average brokerage recommendation (ABR) is 2.47 from 15 ratings: 5 Buy, 5 Outperform, 12 Hold, 2 Underperform, 0 Sell. The stock's ATR-14 is 0.45, weekly volatility 3.91%, monthly volatility 3.97%, and RSI is 39.08. Market capitalization is $2.35 billion, with 240.08 million outstanding shares and average volume of 2.93 million.

Jimmie Johnson's departure of sponsor Lowe's creates a "golden opportunity" for a new sponsor of the No. 48 Hendrick Motorsports team, potentially until his career ends. Johnson, a seven-time Cup champion, plans to step down from full-time NASCAR within a "handful of years" but will continue racing, with a bucket list possibly including the 24 Hours of Le Mans, Rolex 24 at Daytona, and the Indianapolis 500 if it adopts F1's halos.

The 5-day low overnight trading strategy involves trading the S&P 500 when it opens at a 5-day low but closes higher than the open, entering at the close and exiting at the next day's open. Overnight trading in the S&P 500 historically yields an average return of 0.04% from close to open. From 2005 forward, the strategy produced an average profit of 15.93% and an average return of 0.26% per trade; excluding the biggest winner of 6% in October 2008, the average profit remains at 0.17%.

An image processing method obtains a video with multiple frames, places a 3D model on a target plane in the first frame, determines 3D and pixel coordinates of model feature points, calculates camera poses for all frames relative to a world coordinate system, and replaces the model with a target model to generate a new video.

New York's Excelsior Scholarship offers free SUNY/CUNY tuition for families earning under $110,000, prompting private colleges to create programs like reduced tuition, four-year graduation guarantees, and scholarships to compete. Students like Gianna Ruffle prioritize cost, while some private schools remain less affected due to reputation. Private college administrators express concerns about sustainability and competitive imbalance.

Text messaging has become a dominant form of communication, with new apps offering alternatives to traditional SMS. Music Messenger lets users send songs. WhatsApp provides free international messaging, media sharing, and emoticons on any smartphone. Facebook Messenger offers HD video chats, group chats, customizable emojis and text colors, and is ad-free.

On April 27, 2017, Amazon.com, Inc. announced its first quarter 2017 financial results via a press release (Exhibit 99.1) and included additional information on non-GAAP financial measures (Exhibit 99.2).
On July 26, 2016, Apple Inc. filed a Form 8-K reporting its financial results for the third fiscal quarter ended June 25, 2016, via a press release (Exhibit 99.1) and a data sheet (Exhibit 99.2).

The Federal Reserve is proposing changes to the Volcker Rule, which restricts banks from risky trading with depositor money, to ease its application for banks that do the most trading. This follows other regulatory rollbacks, including Congress approving legislation to ease Dodd-Frank requirements for smaller banks and the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau curbing its powers under new leadership.

Lotte Group plans to list its Malaysian petrochemical unit, Lotte Chemical Titan Holding, on the Bursa Malaysia stock exchange in the third quarter of 2017. The IPO could raise $1-$1.5 billion, with proceeds used for building plants in Indonesia and Malaysia. The offering includes up to 740.48 million shares, with an over-allotment option.

The offside trap is a defensive maneuver where all defensive backs move upfield in unison before a pass, placing the leading striker in an offside position. If the striker receives the ball, a violation is expected, awarding an indirect free kick to the defense. Introduced in the 1900s, the trap became riskier due to changes in offside law and offensive tactics. Its success requires all back defenders to move as one unit; failure often results from a defender not moving in unison. Coaches must assess team maturity, risks, and opponent style before using it. The trap is called by a designated defender, typically a center-back, using a unique verbal or non-verbal signal. Execution involves a three- to five-yard sprint forward. Overuse increases risk of opponents beating it.

The lecture covers blockchain technology through Bitcoin, focusing on cryptography (hash functions and digital signatures), key design features (timestamped append-only logs, block headers, Merkle trees, asymmetric cryptography, Bitcoin addresses), and the double-spend problem. It also introduces consensus mechanisms and transaction ledgers, with emphasis on hash functions as fingerprints for data and digital signatures for verification.

In December 2006, SunPower CEO Tom Werner considered the company's future as the world's most efficient solar cell producer. The solar industry was driven by environmental concerns, particularly rising CO2 levels and the threat of climate change, which had led to policy support like the Kyoto Protocol and carbon trading. The solar power industry was growing rapidly, with PV demand increasing from 114 MWp in 1997 to 2,500 MWp in 2006. SunPower, founded in 1987, had partnered with Cypress Semiconductor and went public in 2005. The company produced high-efficiency cells with a unique back-contact design, but faced competition from larger firms like Sharp and Q-Cells, as well as thin-film companies. Werner pondered how to turn SunPower's current advantage into an enduring competitive edge.

A weapons expert suggested North Korea's latest failed missile launch, which exploded shortly after liftoff, may have been of a new, untested system. The Pentagon has not identified the missile, and the White House called it a medium-range device. Some observers speculated US hacking caused the failure, but the expert noted North Korean missile technology is too primitive to hack.

The speaker grew up playing for Brick Hockey Club in New Jersey, heard about Jim Dowd's work ethic, and considered a one-time opportunity a "no brainer." They enjoyed the game but preferred an overtime finish over a shootout. They plan to stay as long as needed to achieve their NHL goal, and feel their father's perception of them may have changed. They chose the University of New Hampshire over Michigan for its proximity to home and are excited to play there. Their father, Frans VanRiemsdyk, is with them.

The lecture covers equity basics, including dividends and capital gains, and key characteristics like residual claimant status and limited liability. It introduces the Dividend Discount Model for stock valuation, where price equals the present value of expected future dividends discounted at a risk-adjusted rate. Simplified cases include the perpetuity formula (P = D/r) and the Gordon growth model (P = D/(r-g)), which shows how growth expectations affect stock prices. The lecture also discusses primary vs. secondary markets and the role of short sales.

The device has a resistive input impedance ≥ 1MΩ on analog inputs, independent of sampling or signal frequency. It features internal overvoltage protection (OVP) that withstands up to ±20V when powered on (AVDD = 5V) and up to ±15V when AVDD is floating. The device includes a programmable gain amplifier (PGA), a second-order low-pass filter, an integrated ADC driver, and supports internal or external 4.096V reference. It uses a multiSPI digital interface and supports various data transfer protocols, including daisy-chain topology. The device has alarm features for input and AVDD monitoring, with programmable thresholds and hysteresis. It operates in RESET, ACQ, and CONV states, and offers NAP and power-down modes for power saving.

This protocol describes a systematic review of observational cohort studies on the implementation or redesign of Rapid Response Team (RRT) services. The review will extract data on study characteristics, team characteristics, implementation methods, and outcome measures. Analysis will be primarily narrative, with simple statistics on implementation methods. The review aims to describe how RRT services are implemented or redesigned, why changes occur, the timeframe, and measures of success. Limitations include heterogeneity of eligible studies and a potential lack of relevant studies.

Asia-Pacific equities rose in April due to increased risk appetite from French election results, eased North Korea concerns, and strong Q1 earnings. MSCI's index neared a two-year high. Indian stocks led with over 20% gains; China rose nearly 2.5%. New Zealand and India were most expensive; South Korea and Hong Kong cheapest. Samsung, CITIC Securities, and TSMC reported strong Q1 profits.
Enron replaced CFO Andrew Fastow with Jeff McMahon on October 25, 2001, amid an SEC inquiry into partnerships Fastow ran, following a sharp stock decline and investor confidence loss.

Containerization is an intermodal process where goods are not unloaded between locations, and is used by air for rapid transport by civil and military airlines. The market is driven by demand for fast global transport and lightweight containers, but hindered by global economic slowdown and increased aviation fuel costs. Future growth opportunities exist due to rising commercial airlines and defense demand. The market is segmented by container type (refrigerated/non-refrigerated), end user (commercial/defense), aircraft type, and geography, with key vendors listed.

The passage discusses problems in Chinese family education due to the one-child policy, contrasting Chinese and American educational approaches. It argues for liberating children's individual interests, teaching selflessness, and prioritizing moral behavior over grades. It cites a murder case to highlight the failure of exam-oriented education. The passage advocates for traditional Chinese moral education, outdoor activities, religious faith, and greater maternal involvement to improve the status quo.

A new geoarchaeological study of Egypt's Karnak Temple reveals it originated on an island formed by ancient Nile channels, with earliest occupation likely during the Old Kingdom (2591-2152 BCE). Researchers analyzed 61 sediment cores and ceramic fragments to map the landscape's evolution over 3,000 years, finding the site's placement may mirror the ancient Egyptian creation myth of high ground emerging from primeval waters.

Microsoft's Cortana voice assistant, introduced for Windows Phone 7, is now available on Windows 10 desktops, laptops, and tablets. It works with the Edge browser, helps search files on hard drives and cloud, and some manufacturers add a dedicated button for activation. Cortana is also available on Android and iOS, though less efficient. Features include personal voice recognition, humor, and location-based reminders.

The speaker discusses mental toughness, generating offense, a player's overtime goal and effort, lineup changes due to injury, composure, playing through game bends, a player's charley horse, another player's absence, the team's game-by-game approach, a player returning from missed games, a truthful statement, a player's concussion protocol, special teams performance, and focusing on the current game day.

The passage reviews the Wells Fargo Reflect® Card, highlighting its 0% intro APR for 21 months on purchases and balance transfers, no annual fee, and cell phone protection. It notes the card lacks ongoing rewards and has a 5% balance transfer fee and 3% foreign transaction fee. The author, Ryan Wilcox, is a personal finance writer. The site includes disclosures about advertiser compensation and editorial independence.
Former Ford CEO Mark Fields said US automakers "went full bore" into EV production without considering consumer demand, and the market did not develop as expected.

On March 26, 2020, NVIDIA Corporation entered into an underwriting agreement to issue $5.0 billion in unsecured notes across four series, with net proceeds of approximately $4.97 billion for general corporate purposes. The notes are governed by an indenture with customary covenants and event of default provisions, and are unsecured senior obligations ranking equally with existing and future unsecured debt.

The TPS7H500x-SP series controllers have three switching frequency modes: internal oscillator, external synchronization, and primary-secondary. Output voltage is set via a resistor divider to a 0.613 V reference. Soft-start gradually increases output voltage. Switching frequency is set by an RT resistor (100 kHz to 2 MHz) or an external clock at twice the desired frequency. Primary-secondary mode synchronizes two controllers. The controllers have primary outputs (OUTA/OUTB) and synchronous rectifier outputs (SRA/SRB) with ~150 mA peak current. Dead time and leading edge blank time are programmable via resistors. A pulse skipping mode prevents issues from minimum on-time. Duty cycle is programmable via the DCL pin. Current sensing uses the CS_ILIM pin for PWM generation and overcurrent protection. Hiccup mode provides cycle-by-cycle current limiting and a restart timer. The FAULT pin allows external fault protection. Slope compensation is set via the RSC pin. Frequency compensation uses a transconductance error amplifier. Thermal shutdown occurs at 175°C.

The speaker reflects on having many scoring chances in a recent game but failing to capitalize, viewing it as a positive to build on. They note playoff hockey requires patience and different players stepping up. They did not feel the opposing team used a trap, acknowledging the opponent's speed and work ethic. The speaker assesses their own playoff performance as inconsistent, with their best series against the Islanders, but feels their game is improving. They praise a veteran teammate for adapting his role and leading by example. Finally, they emphasize the need to wear down defensemen by playing below the goal line and cycling the puck, a strategy they plan to improve on.

The passage tests three trend-following and momentum strategies on Bitcoin (BTC-USD) from 2015 to April 2021, using free data. All three strategies beat buy-and-hold (94% CAGR), with the best result (5-day exponential average) achieving 145% CAGR. The strategies also reduced maximum drawdowns compared to holding.

At Microsoft's December 13, 2022 Annual Shareholders Meeting, shareholders elected 12 director nominees, approved executive compensation, and ratified Deloitte & Touche as auditor for fiscal 2023. Six shareholder proposals were not approved.

A week after Karl Anthony-Towns led the Timberwolves to a win over Golden State, Minnesota (40-30) hosts Houston (55-14) on a back-to-back for both teams. Minnesota is sixth in the West, 1.5 games behind Oklahoma City and half a game ahead of New Orleans. Towns is averaging 25.5 points in his last six games. Houston, which has won three 18-point victories over Minnesota this season, is 28-3 since Jan. 6 and 21-1 in its last 22 games.

UC San Diego engineers developed ultrasound-powered nanorobots coated with hybrid platelet/red blood cell membranes. These nanorobots swim through blood to remove bacteria and toxins, reducing both by three times in contaminated samples within five minutes. The work is a proof-of-concept for detoxifying biological fluids.

The speaker is excited about a strong game, noting penalties killed in the first period but emphasizing they are only halfway done. They acknowledge the opponent's strong road record and their own long losing streak in that building, expecting a tough game. Practice is for loosening up, as games are the focus. They highlight success in shutting down top lines, which is key for playoff wins, and stress the importance of back pressure and standing up at the blue line against specific opponent lines.

Brett Veach, the Kansas City Chiefs' general manager, will lead his first draft without a first-round pick but with second and third-round selections to improve a weak defense. He has made several trades involving draft picks to manage the salary cap and acquire players. The Chiefs prioritize defense, especially pass rushers or cornerbacks, but also need to support young quarterback Patrick Mahomes II. Local prospects like Dorance Armstrong and D.J. Reed are potential fits. Recent drafts have produced Pro Bowl players and bargains like Tyreek Hill and Kareem Hunt, but defensive picks have sometimes missed.

In *Oxley et al. v. Oldden*, a motion to strike off a rule of reference was discharged as too late, as the referees had already examined evidence, agreed on a report, and faced no allegations of irregularity or partiality.

Stifel downgraded GrubHub from Buy to Hold, raising the price target from $100 to $110. The analyst cited a balanced risk-reward profile after a 200% return, despite an improved 2019 outlook from a Yum! Brands partnership and expansion into smaller cities. The stock's valuation is considered elevated at 31.5x 2019 EV/EBITDA and 1.7x 2010 EV/GFS.

The Nobel Prize, established by Alfred Nobel, honors narrow scientific fields and limits awards to three people per discovery, often excluding many contributors. Winners are predominantly white men from wealthy regions, with few women or people of color recognized. The selection process aims to avoid bias but is constrained by Nobel's will, leaving fields like ecology or climate science ineligible. Despite limitations, the prize celebrates science and sparks public curiosity.

This application is a continuation of U.S. Application No. 17/874,158, which is a continuation of U.S. Application No. 16/160,984 (now U.S. Patent No. 11,397,889), which claims priority to U.S. Provisional Patent Application Nos. 62/573,125, 62/573,131, 62/573,135, and 62/726,158. The technology disclosed relates to using deep learning-based techniques for training deep convolutional neural networks, specifically for splice site classification and aberrant splicing detection.

A kicker's primary role is kicking extra points and field goals, with expected success rates of 90% and 80% respectively. They also perform kickoffs and situational kicks like onside kicks. The position demands accuracy, lower body power, and consistent technique. Notable kickers include Justin Tucker, Morten Andersen, and Adam Vinatieri. A reliable kicker influences a coach's fourth-down decisions and is crucial in close games.

VentureWire's May 31, 2001 issue reports on venture capital fund closings (Insight Capital IV at $740M, Rho Ventures IV at $435M), a $30M round for Quake Technologies, and Whitney & Co.'s plan to spin off international offices. It also lists numerous smaller financings, M&A activity, and personnel changes.

North Carolina regulators are discussing potential tests to measure industrial compounds in home garden vegetables near a Chemours plant, following a Dutch study that found similar chemicals in food samples near a European factory. No decision has been made on testing, and health effects of GenX in humans are unknown.

High-κ materials are crucial for electronic devices, but current options like SiO2 and perovskite oxides have limitations. HfO₂ offers a balance of properties but has drawbacks. Machine learning (ML) can aid in discovering new high-κ materials, but predicting the ionic dielectric constant (εion) accurately is challenging. This work develops a joint ML model that separately predicts Born effective charges (BECs) and phonon properties to compute εion, achieving higher accuracy than direct models. Using this framework, a virtual screening of 8,717 oxides identified 38 novel high-κ oxides, many containing transition metals with empty d-orbitals and oxygen octahedral networks.

The higher highs and higher lows pattern signals an uptrend but weak future short-term gains. Backtesting across S&P 500, gold, and long-term Treasuries showed poor returns, with the pattern ineffective as a short strategy. Increasing consecutive days did not improve results.

The speaker states they haven't closely analyzed the opposing team's injured player due to focus on their own game. They describe their group as focused and ready, enjoying the moment without being relaxed. Today's practice was simple, to loosen up after travel. They discuss an injured teammate, Marc, who is not present but is honored by having his equipment in the dressing room. After a double elimination in Week 2, 12 celebrity contestants remain for "Dancing with the Stars" Episode 3, which is "TikTok night." Judges score couples out of 30 points, which is converted into a percentage, and audience votes are also converted into a percentage; these two percentages are combined equally. The passage describes the NVIDIA A100 Tensor Core GPU, based on the Ampere architecture, as a data center and cloud GPU designed for AI, HPC, and data analytics. It features third-generation Tensor Cores supporting all DL data types, fine-grained structured sparsity for 2x throughput, and Multi-Instance GPU (MIG) for partitioning into up to seven secure instances. The A100 includes 40 GB of HBM2 memory, a 40 MB L2 cache, third-generation NVLink, and PCIe Gen 4 support. It delivers significant performance improvements over the V100, including up to 2.5x FP64 performance and up to 20x INT8 performance with sparsity.

In January 2015, Medora Brown moved to Kenya to work as a communications fellow at Sanergy, a company providing sanitation facilities in urban slums and converting waste into products like fertilizer. By December 2015, as communications manager, she was developing a social media plan for the company, which had nascent Facebook, Twitter, and blog presences. She needed to allocate limited resources to platforms with the best ROI and create metrics to demonstrate social media’s effectiveness in engaging diverse audiences, including slum dwellers, farmers, and global investors.

A study of over 52,000 men identified 287 genetic signals linked to male pattern baldness, including 40 on the X chromosome inherited from mothers. The genetic pattern is only somewhat predictive; 58% of those with the top 10% of baldness genes had hair loss, while 14% of those with fewer genes were bald. Researchers say accurate individual prediction is still far off.

The GRAD-PRO grant (2023, $2.8 million) expands graduate opportunities for Hispanic and underrepresented students in health sciences, education, and business. Average 30-year fixed-rate mortgage rates dropped to 4.33% from 4.46%, the largest weekly decline since early January. Refinancing applications fell 2.9%, while purchase applications rose 1.2%.

A CORAF report on the largest System of Rice Intensification (SRI) project ever undertaken shows higher rice yields in West Africa. The three-year SRI-WAAPP project involved over 50,000 farmers across 13 countries. It found yield increases of 54%, 65%, and 153% for irrigated, rainfed lowland, and rainfed upland systems, and a 41% average income increase. The report advocates for further SRI scale-up, noting that complete adoption in 2017 would have eliminated rice imports, but stresses adapting practices to local conditions.

Investigators are examining leads including a possible prostitute encounter, his cruises, and a cryptic note, but have found little from typical avenues like politics, finances, or social behavior. Billboards are being posted to seek public help. Paddock meticulously planned the attack, stockpiling 23 guns and scoping out other festivals, but no accomplice has been identified. His girlfriend reported no signs of violence.

A systematic review of 15 articles from 2015-2022 found studies focused on cognitive skills, applications (e.g., Arduino, tablets), and affective variables (interest, motivation). Suggestions include integrating robotic coding across fields, using diverse tools, and conducting large-scale research.

Warren Weaver, in a 1947 letter, described translation as decoding a coded message. The author notes that while machine translation like Google Translate is useful, it lacks understanding, focusing on decoding rather than meaning. Software engineering is a systematic approach to developing and maintaining software efficiently. Requirements are classified as functional (what the software must do) and non-functional (qualities like usability and security). The paper discusses classifiers like K-NN, Naïve Bayes, Decision Tree, and SVM for text classification. Related work includes methods for generating and prioritizing non-functional requirements. The proposed methodology uses clustering of keywords from functional requirements to identify potential NFRs, applying a Decision Tree classifier with an NFR matrix. Results show the proposed method achieves higher accuracy and lower execution time than the existing method.

The NVIDIA Turing GPU architecture introduces a Hybrid Rendering model combining real-time ray tracing, rasterization, AI, and simulation. It includes dedicated RT Cores for accelerating ray tracing and Tensor Cores for AI tasks. Key features include Variable Rate Shading (VRS), Texture Space Shading (TSS), Multi-View Rendering (MVR), and Deep Learning Super-Sampling (DLSS). Turing GPUs support up to four views per pass and enable real-time ray tracing for effects like shadows, ambient occlusion, and reflections. The architecture is implemented in TU102, TU104, and TU106 chips, used in products like GeForce RTX 2080 Ti, RTX 2080, RTX 2070, Quadro RTX 5000, and Tesla T4.

He urged civil society to help government school students, announced a water pump and furniture for the school, and pledged continued support. This study introduces a semi-empirical Bayesian method to improve sex-specific Mendelian randomization (MR) analyses by borrowing information from a larger sex group (males) to calibrate variant effect estimates in a smaller group (females). Simulations showed the adaptive posterior mean (APM) estimator improved causal effect estimation efficiency for the smaller sample. Applied to sleep phenotypes and cardiovascular outcomes, the method identified sex-specific causal associations, including insomnia on chronic kidney disease in females and short sleep on coronary artery disease in males.

A University of Copenhagen study found that passive social media use, like "lurking," can cause envy and worsen mood due to unrealistic social comparisons. A 2015 study linked over two hours of daily social media use to higher mental illness risk in teens. Limiting time or quitting Facebook may improve well-being.

The passage introduces a dynamically-controllable x-ray interferometer for Mössbauer science that overcomes challenges of traditional setups. It uses two 57Fe targets in a polarimetry setup to create a "dark-fringe" mode where transmitted intensity ideally vanishes. The interferometer allows continuous tuning of relative phase between two interfering pathways via target displacement, enabling control of transmitted x-ray intensity and measurement of relative displacements on nanosecond and wavelength scales.

Benchmarks are crucial for measuring progress in language models, but their reliability is often overlooked. Recent work identifies structural issues like redundancy and uneven data distributions that can skew results. The authors introduce HARMONY, a metric that measures how uniformly performance is distributed across a benchmark's subdomains. High HARMONY indicates aggregate scores reflect broad competence, while low HARMONY can obscure strengths and weaknesses. The authors recommend reporting HARMONY alongside accuracy for more reliable evaluation.

The passage discusses the renormalization group equations for the weak Hamiltonian in the context of effective field theory, focusing on the b → c u bar d process. It explains how Wilson coefficients and operators are related through anomalous dimensions, the use of the plus-minus basis to simplify equations, and the method of solving these equations by changing variables from mu to alpha. The solution involves integrating from a high scale (mu w) to a low scale (mu), summing leading logarithms. The passage also covers higher-order corrections, including next-to-leading logarithms, the need for one-loop matching and two-loop anomalous dimensions, and the scheme dependence of these calculations, emphasizing that physical observables are scheme-independent.

Patient advocacy groups have asked the U.K.'s antitrust regulator to investigate several large drugmakers and their U.K. lobbying organization for suspected coordinated efforts to increase medicine prices, amid a dispute over mandatory rebates.

This volume publishes official American records of the 1919 Paris Peace Conference to provide authoritative information for future peacemaking, as no government has yet released a complete record, though extensive unofficial literature exists.

Systems evolved from single-purpose machines to general-purpose programmable ones, then to time-sharing systems and client-server architectures. In the early 2000s, the internet and large datacenters led to distributed systems, which are more reliable and scalable but significantly more complex to design and debug. The growing need for reliable distributed systems has driven the adoption of containers, container images, and orchestrators as foundational building blocks and patterns.

Students in Brandon Nicklas's televideo production class at Lansdowne High School produce live morning announcements streamed to the school. The use of television studios in county schools is increasing, with about 100 of 161 schools having studios. Students learn skills like teamwork and public speaking. Funding for studios comes from school operating budgets, not central funds, with costs ranging from $400 for basic streaming to $15,000-$18,000 for full digital studios. Broadcast production facilitator was added as a paid extra-duty activity this year.

A single dose of psilocybin reduced pain and anxiety-depression behaviors in mice for nearly two weeks by acting on serotonin receptors in the anterior cingulate cortex, bypassing injury sites. Researchers at Penn Medicine suggest it may offer non-addictive relief for chronic pain and mood disorders, though more research is needed on safety and long-term effects.

The eighth annual Regional Theatrical Youth Camp runs June 19-30, 2017, ending with a public ticketed production. It has two age divisions: Level I (ages 5-8) and Level II (ages 9-18), with Level II requiring 50 hours of training and a role in “Bye, Bye Birdie, Jr.” A second show is set for July 2, 2017. Different urinary proteomics profiles were identified among type 1 HAE, type 2 HAE and healthy controls. Several biological processes and pathways were significantly enriched in HAE, including complement and coagulation cascades, cell adhesion molecules, immune response, proteolysis, and bradykinin catabolic process. A urinary biomarker panel (C1-INH, KNG1, and EGF) could be a promising noninvasive diagnostic tool for HAE.

The passage describes an experiment with a levitated ferromagnetic sphere (rotor) in a superconducting trap at 4.2 K. The rotor is driven to spin using synchronous feedback, and its spin-down is measured to determine damping rates, which are used to estimate gas pressure. The rotor achieved a maximum frequency of 2.3 MHz and a damping rate as low as 4.75 × 10⁻⁷ s⁻¹, corresponding to an effective pressure of 4 × 10⁻⁸ mbar. The system is proposed as a cryogenic pressure sensor and for applications in precision measurements and fundamental physics.

Researchers at Columbia University created a chip that turns a single laser into a "frequency comb," producing dozens of powerful light channels. Using a locking mechanism to purify the laser, the team achieved lab-grade precision on a small silicon device, which could improve data center efficiency and fuel innovations in sensing, quantum tech, and LiDAR.

On October 22, 2015, Amazon.com, Inc. announced its third quarter 2015 financial results via a press release (Exhibit 99.1) and included additional information on non-GAAP financial measures (Exhibit 99.2).
