The TPS7H500x-SP controller has three switching frequency modes: internal oscillator, external synchronization, and primary-secondary. Internal oscillator mode uses an RT resistor to set a 100 kHz to 2 MHz switching frequency, with the SYNC pin outputting a clock at twice that frequency. External synchronization mode requires a floating RT pin and a clock on SYNC at twice the desired switching frequency. Primary-secondary mode uses one controller's SYNC output to synchronize a second controller.

Former NFL quarterback Mark Sanchez faces a Level 5 felony battery charge for an altercation with a 69-year-old truck driver in Indianapolis, upgraded from misdemeanors after the driver suffered serious injuries. Sanchez remains hospitalized in stable condition.

The passage examines the MACD indicator and its use in trading strategies. It explains MACD as a momentum, trend-following, and mean reversion indicator, calculated from moving averages. A basic MACD crossover strategy on the S&P 500 from 1993 showed a CAGR of 4.19%, profit factor of 1.65, and max drawdown of 30%. Adding a condition that the slow line is below zero improved the profit factor to 1.72 and reduced drawdown to 25%. A MACD histogram strategy yielded a CAGR of 4.79%, profit factor of 4.22, and drawdown of 16%. Combining the MACD histogram with a two-day RSI produced a CAGR of 6.36%, profit factor of 2.45, and drawdown of 16%. MACD is a lagging indicator, and the histogram is considered reliable, with backtests suggesting profitability about 70% of the time. The best settings depend on the asset and timeframe.

The National Institute of Standards and Technology revised password guidelines, now recommending simple, long, and memorable passwords (like phrases) instead of complex ones with special characters. Passwords no longer need to expire. This approach creates longer passwords that are harder to break, and the industry has responded positively.

Applied Materials, Inc. presented at Semicon West 2025, with a slide deck published by the company. Seeking Alpha's transcripts team, which publishes thousands of quarterly earnings calls, shared this transcript-related development. A chart shows data from October 3 to October 8, 2025, with values ranging from 210.99 to 226.321.

This study presents a radiogenomic analysis of pediatric low-grade gliomas (pLGGs) using data from 545 patients. Three immunological clusters were identified from transcriptomic data, with cluster 2 (high immune infiltration) associated with the worst progression-free survival. A radioimmunomic signature using MRI and ADC features predicted these clusters (AUC up to 0.83). A clinicoradiomic model predicted progression-free survival (concordance index 0.71-0.77) and was associated with treatment resistance. Biological interpretability analysis linked risk scores to specific transcriptomic pathways and germline variants.

The speaker begins with a prayer for guidance and dedication. He states the world is at a midpoint of a challenging century, with good and evil opposed. He describes historical upheavals and America's growth through trials. He questions humanity's progress toward light or darkness. He asserts that domestic problems are dwarfed by the global question of freedom versus tyranny. He proclaims faith in man's dignity under moral law, defining equality and service. He states this faith rejects rule by force and that the conflict is between freedom and slavery. He argues free peoples are linked by need and unity, with America bearing leadership responsibility. He outlines nine fixed principles for foreign policy, including deterring aggression, rejecting appeasement, maintaining strength, respecting other nations, helping allies, fostering economic health, supporting regional groupings, defending all peoples equally, and strengthening the United Nations. He concludes by calling for sacrifice, patriotism, and the practice of faith to achieve peace.

Sheet metal fabricator KMF held its sixth annual Young Engineer of the Year awards, where 22 school teams built and raced electric kit cars. Marcel Konarzewski won the 2018 title. The program has reached over 19,000 students and invested over £600,000 in STEM encouragement.

University of Leeds researchers found that plasma jets from supermassive black holes disintegrate into plumes due to a centrifugal instability linked to their curved shape, which creates a weak point and a "reconfinement point" where the jet breaks down. This instability, previously unconsidered, causes the jet to release heat and become more visible. The study was published in Nature Astronomy.

Gareth Southgate stated England's 13th world ranking is "not good enough" and aims for the top, emphasizing the need to improve "smartly" to bridge the gap, starting with a friendly against Germany on March 22.

The Eleventh Circuit affirmed the district court's dismissal of Mesocap's claim, holding that an unreasonable course deviation by a carrier does not prevent it from invoking COGSA's one-year limitation period for filing suit.

A heatstroke rise in summer has increased loadshedding in Karachi and other areas, causing obstacles, water shortages, and deaths. Four devotees of Lal Shahbaz Qalander died from heatstroke at 50°C, and 12 others are being treated. Devotees at the Sehwan shrine faced 10-11 hours of loadshedding while living in tents for the Urs. One paid a Rs. 50,000 bribe to Hesco for power, unsuccessfully. The loadshedding caused water lack, and a request was made to Hesco to provide power to the devotees.

The investigation into Samsung Galaxy Note 7 fires will likely release results in January, with the state-run Korea Testing Laboratory expected to announce the final outcome. The cause is reportedly not a simple battery malfunction, and findings are crucial for Samsung to regain consumer trust before the Galaxy S8 launch.

The speaker reflects on achieving their childhood dream of winning the Stanley Cup, crediting their team and fans. They acknowledge a bad rebound goal but a key save later, and state the team award is more important than individual honors. They praise home ice advantage and loyal fans, and express gratitude for family support. They note the need for more shots in a previous game and credit a teammate's shot. They feel they improved as a goaltender with team help, and value veteran teammates' long efforts. They mention a lucky hat joke with equipment staff.

The passage is a fantasy football advice email from Joe Bryant, analyzing NFL passing and rushing game matchups for week 11, categorized by favorability to offense or defense, and includes a tribute to veterans for Veterans Day.

The passage is a Form 10-Q filing by Microsoft Corporation for the quarterly period ended December 31, 2021, containing unaudited financial statements and notes. It reports total revenue of $51.7 billion for the three months and $97.0 billion for the six months ended December 31, 2021, with net income of $18.8 billion and $39.3 billion, respectively. The filing includes details on accounting policies, investments, derivatives, business combinations, debt, income taxes, segment information, and a subsequent event regarding an agreement to acquire Activision Blizzard.

This paper formulates AI safety evaluations as a survival bandit problem, showing theoretically and numerically that optimal agents will sandbag (underperform) to avoid exceeding a safety threshold. It proposes a likelihood-ratio test to distinguish sandbagging from genuine incompetence using only reward sequences, finding detection is easier with stricter safety thresholds and shorter post-evaluation periods.

The author made Ina Garten's five-cheese penne pasta, which combines Gorgonzola, fontina, mozzarella, Romano, and ricotta. The dish is rich but not too heavy, suitable for fall and winter. The author substituted Romano for pecorino, used less butter than recommended, and baked the pasta for about 17 minutes. The result was creamy, with a golden-brown crust, and was enjoyed by the author and friends.

The ICE offense is a constant basket attack using back cuts against defensive pressure. Basic continuity involves a "Give & Go" action where players walk defenders to the free throw line, pass, and cut to the basket. Overplay reads include popping out, back cutting, driving, or giving a "Give & Go" cut based on defender positioning.

The passage discusses the EURJPY currency pair, its trading strategies, backtests, and factors affecting it. It notes that EURJPY is a minor pair comparing the euro to the yen, and that forex trading is difficult. It presents backtested strategies with performance metrics, and explores EURJPY as a leading indicator for stocks. It covers drawbacks of overtrading, advantages of trend-following, the role of sentiment analysis, risk management, technical analysis, market volatility, and factors influencing the pair. It states the average daily range and daily pip movement, and addresses suitability for beginners, trading times, and correlation with USDJPY.

A treaty with Hamburg was concluded on January 8, 1848, and an agreement on consular notices followed. A treaty with the Hawaiian Government was signed at San Francisco on October 22, 1849, by Mr. Eames and Mr. Judd. A separate treaty of friendship, commerce, navigation, and extradition was signed in Washington on December 20, 1849, ratified on August 24, 1850, and proclaimed on November 9, 1850. In August 1849, French forces seized Hawaiian fortifications and property after an ultimatum was rejected. The U.S. offered good offices in 1850 to settle the dispute. In March 1851, a deed of cession of Hawaii to the U.S. was delivered to Commissioner Severance due to French threats. Secretary Webster ordered the deed returned in July 1851. In 1854, Secretary Marcy authorized negotiation of an annexation treaty, and a draft acceptable to the King was received on November 11, 1854.

In early 2012, CFA charterholder Harry Markham faced a professional conflict. He believed public pension fund liabilities were undervalued due to GASB rules using an 8% discount rate, while his analysis suggested a 3-4% rate was more appropriate, making liabilities nearly double the reported figures. Neither his clients nor his firm, Investment Consulting Associates, wanted to question the official numbers. Markham struggled with conflicting loyalties to his firm, his clients, and pensioners, as required by the CFA Code of Ethics. He feared raising the issue could cost his firm business, but also felt a responsibility to speak up, drawing a parallel to the 2008 financial crisis.

This study investigated childhood pneumonia assessment and management in primary care in Malawi using semi-structured interviews with staff and caregivers at 10 health facilities. Barriers identified by caregivers included insufficient education, distance to healthcare, and transport costs. Staff barriers included workload, lack of resources, and uncertainty regarding severity markers and antibiotic use. Facilitators included the health passport system and teamwork. The study highlights challenges such as resource shortages, education gaps, and difficulties in accurately identifying severe illness.

The speaker suggests asking someone else about a player's relaxed demeanor, notes the importance of strong series starts, and highlights the value of third-line players contributing goals and effective forechecking.
Toshiba asked creditors to extend a loan covenant waiver until end-March, after failing to deliver audited Q3 earnings and expecting a $6 billion writedown on its U.S. nuclear business.

The passage discusses peace negotiations at Brest-Litovsk, where Central Powers' proposals for territorial conquest led to their breakdown. It questions whom the Central Powers' representatives speak for, contrasts their aims with Allied candor, and presents a 14-point program for world peace, including open diplomacy, freedom of navigation, reduced armaments, colonial adjustments, and a league of nations, based on justice for all peoples.
ITV2 delayed Love Island to 10pm due to England's World Cup match going into extra time, allowing viewers to watch both.

Chargers quarterback Philip Rivers supports re-signing free agent Antonio Gates after tight end Hunter Henry's season-ending knee injury, but says the decision is up to management. Gates holds franchise records and has the most touchdown receptions by an NFL tight end.

An email chain forwards a Texas Monthly article titled "How Enron Blew It," which details Enron's rise and fall, including its aggressive culture, trading strategies, and the resignation of CEO Jeff Skilling.

The passage discusses the Tong Hâk sect as both a religious and political threat in Korea, focusing on government fears of unrest in southern provinces, the King's decree against their doctrines, and placards posted at Protestant missions. The author, Augustine Heard, describes diplomatic responses, including a meeting with the foreign office president, and notes the difficulty of assessing the movement's significance. He declines to request naval assistance but reports excitement in the city.

UVU, now Utah's largest university, is leading sustainability efforts. Scott Williams organized a trash audit at Northridge Elementary, where volunteers sorted nearly 400 students' lunch waste into recyclable bins. Head custodian Shon Frary noted students rush to eat, creating unnecessary waste. Williams and students calculated total waste and will present findings to educate the school on reducing waste through recycling. This was UVU's first audit for Northridge, following a smaller campus audit.
On July 26, 2021, Tesla, Inc. filed a Form 8-K reporting its financial results for the quarter ended June 30, 2021, via a Second Quarter 2021 Update posted on its website.

A visiting Harvard Law professor, Carlos Portugal Gouvêa, was arrested on Oct. 1 for firing a pellet gun near a Jewish temple during Yom Kippur, claiming he was hunting rats. He was charged with illegal discharge, disturbing the peace, disorderly conduct, and property damage. Police and synagogue officials do not believe antisemitism was a factor.

The NVIDIA Turing GPU architecture introduces a new Hybrid Rendering model combining real-time ray tracing, rasterization, AI, and simulation. Key features include RT Cores for hardware-accelerated ray tracing, Tensor Cores for AI-based functions like Deep Learning Super-Sampling (DLSS), and Variable Rate Shading (VRS) for dynamic shading rate control. Turing GPUs support GDDR6 memory, NVLink for SLI, and a new display engine with DisplayPort 1.4a and DSC 1.2. The architecture includes Mesh Shading, Texture Space Shading, and Multi-View Rendering. Turing TU102, TU104, and TU106 GPUs offer varying configurations of CUDA Cores, RT Cores, and Tensor Cores, with the RTX 2080 Ti providing approximately 50% higher effective bandwidth than the previous generation.

The passage discusses market analysis, noting gold's rally and the USD Index's decline, but highlights that mining stocks failed to capitalize on gold's move, confirming bearish signals. The USD Index shows a bullish inverse head-and-shoulders pattern, while stocks consolidate after a decline, with potential for further drops. The situation is compared to 2008.

Colts cornerback Xavien Howard, 32, retired after four games, citing family priorities. He informed the team Wednesday following a poor performance against the Rams, where he was the nearest defender on seven receptions for 112 yards and a touchdown. Howard is a four-time Pro Bowl selection with 29 career interceptions.

The passage reports 149,216,984 confirmed COVID-19 cases and 3,144,028 deaths worldwide. Hospitalized patient management is mainly supportive; dexamethasone and tocilizumab show mortality benefit for those requiring oxygen, while remdesivir has little benefit. Convalescent plasma from recovered donors showed no mortality benefit in a meta-analysis. The authors hypothesized that early administration of high-volume, high-titer convalescent plasma would reduce the proportion of patients progressing to severe disease.

Despite security issues in the north, staple cereal supplies are near average, and export bans and subsidized sales have stabilized prices. Cereal prices remain 15-41% above the five-year average, except in Gorom-Gorom. High prices hinder market access for poor households; goat/cereal terms of trade decreased 26-33% in Zones 8 and 7 but are stable in Zone 5. Income sources include livestock sales and gold panning. Small ruminant supply increased 10%, but demand remains high except in Gorom-Gorom. Insecure border areas see fewer livestock collectors and shorter markets. MAM cases in the Sahel are 4% below 2017 levels. Reduced meals in Zone 8 cause Stressed (IPC Phase 2) conditions, while Zones 7 and 5 remain Minimal (IPC Phase 1).

An analysis of Bitcoin from January 2015 to September 2021 shows that removing the ten best days reduced a $10,000 investment from $2.05 million to $246,000, while removing the ten worst days increased it to $11.6 million. Removing the best day of every month resulted in a loss, with the investment falling to $1,854. The article concludes that market timing in Bitcoin is likely futile for buy and hold investors due to the asset's volatility and price rises.

Jack Dorsey bought 425,998 shares of Twitter stock, increasing his total ownership to 15,468,426 shares. Twitter's stock remains under $17 per share, far below its peak of $69. In 2016, Twitter laid off over 300 employees, discontinued Vine and Fabric, and faced failed acquisition attempts by Google, Salesforce, and Walt Disney. The company's net loss grew to $167.1 million from $90.24 million a year prior.

The speaker analyzes hands from an online poker tournament, focusing on preflop re-raising theory and bet sizing based on board texture. They discuss balancing ranges to avoid predictability, the concept of polarizing, and the importance of adjusting bet sizes on dry versus drawy boards. The speaker reviews specific hands, noting mistakes and strategic decisions, and concludes by summarizing the two main concepts covered.

The TPS7H500x-SP series are radiation-hardened current mode PWM controllers for space-grade DC-DC converters, used with external gate drivers and supporting up to 2 MHz switching frequency. A design example for a synchronous push-pull converter using GaN FETs at 500 kHz is provided, detailing component selection for the TPS7H5001-SP, including a 205 kΩ RT resistor, 10 kΩ and 1.4 kΩ feedback resistors, 20.5 kΩ dead-time resistors, 49.9 kΩ RLEB, 33 nF soft-start capacitor, a transformer with 2.5 turns ratio and 40 μH primary inductance, 170 V primary and 80 V secondary GaN FETs, an RCD clamp, 0.47 μH output inductor, 2.3 mF output capacitance, 7.5 Ω RCS, 3.3 nF hiccup capacitor, 40.2 kΩ, 15 nF, and 47 pF compensation components, and a 102 kΩ slope compensation resistor. Layout guidelines emphasize separating analog and power grounds, minimizing switch node area, and placing bypass capacitors close to the controller.

Billionaire Mark Cuban warns OpenAI's plan to allow erotica in ChatGPT for verified adults starting December could backfire, as parents will abandon the platform if they believe minors might bypass age verification. Cuban argues the issue is not porn but children forming unsupervised emotional relationships with AI. CEO Sam Altman defends the change, saying ChatGPT has been too restrictive. The move comes amid flatlining subscription demand and concerns over AI companionship risks, including lawsuits over teen suicides linked to chatbots.

Hearts of Oak drew 1-1 with Bechem United, while Kotoko won 2-0 against Wa All Stars. Ashanti Gold beat Inter Allies 1-0. Wafa defeated Dwarfs 3-2. Karela United and Elmina Sharks drew 0-0. Eleven Wonders beat Medeama 1-0. Berekum Chelsea vs. Liberty Professionals was postponed due to rain.
The BESE committee voted to close Tallulah Charter School, allowed Northeast Claiborne Charter to complete its five-year term, and deferred a decision on Vision Academy until January.

The Hawk Offense is a derivative of the shuffle offense and a relative of the "UCLA" high post rub offense, introduced to the NBA by Hubie Brown. It is designed to exploit mismatches at the off guard or shooting guard position, featuring wing isolations and post up options. The basic action involves the off guard's rub cut off a high post screen, initiated by the point guard's dribble penetration entry. The offense includes phases for dribble entry, high post shuffle cuts, ball reversal, and continuities like Flex and Triangle Game. Variations include Side Screen, Single/Double, Back Screen, Pin Down, Base Screen, and Post Lob. Success depends on spacing, execution, coordination, and defensive recognition.

Fleas from infected rodents can transmit plague to humans. Fleas carrying Yersinia pestis were found in Taylor, Arizona, prompting health warnings. Plague is rare in the U.S. but occurs in the Southwest. Officials advise avoiding rodent burrows, leashing dogs, and using insect repellent. Symptoms include fever and swollen lymph glands; early antibiotic treatment is effective.

The passage discusses the secretive Grin blockchain, which implements the Mimblewimble privacy protocol derived from Blockstream's Confidential Transactions. Mimblewimble allows deletion of spent transaction outputs while maintaining authentication, compressing blockchain history into signatures for unspent outputs. It reduces functionality to simple transfers but enables "scriptless scripts" for features like atomic swaps and Lightning channels using signature differences. Andrew Poelstra notes that while Mimblewimble would make future verification smaller, real-time size is similar to Bitcoin plus Confidential Transactions, and wallet support is lacking. The Grin blockchain will initially have its own currency, with plans to add Bitcoin later for shared privacy, estimated 18 months from wider ecosystem use.
House Speaker Mike Johnson said hospitals must provide emergency care to all individuals, including immigrants without legal status.

Gamma-ray astrophysics began in the 1950s. Gamma rays are absorbed by Earth's atmosphere, so satellite telescopes like Fermi are used, but they have small effective areas. Ground-based imaging atmospheric Cherenkov telescopes (IACTs) measure Cherenkov light from atmospheric showers, achieving effective areas of ~10⁴ m². Current IACT systems include MAGIC, H.E.S.S., and VERITAS. The future Cherenkov Telescope Array Observatory (CTAO) will improve resolution and energy range (20 GeV to 300 TeV) using three telescope types (LST, MST, SST) in Northern and Southern arrays. CTAO will be open to proposals, with 40% of time for Key Science Projects, including dark matter searches. Simulated observations of the Galactic Center and other targets suggest CTAO can improve limits on WIMP annihilation cross-sections. CTAO will also study axion-like particles and other fundamental physics via AGN observations.

This scoping review identified 13 articles describing 23 candidate genes (6 maternal, 17 fetal/neonatal) potentially contributing to virally induced brain injury after prenatal Zika virus infection, including congenital Zika syndrome.

The passage lists tables, figures, and listings for a statistical analysis plan (SAP) for study ZEA-DNK-02170, version 1.0, dated 16AUG2019, following ICH E3 guidelines. It includes sections on patient disposition, demographics, efficacy (e.g., time to plasma glucose recovery), safety (e.g., adverse events, ECGs, lab results), pharmacokinetics, and pharmacodynamics, with notes on table organization and programming.

Governor Ayodele Fayose accused the federal government of not paying Ekiti's budget support fund for January, stating it was deliberate to weaken the state. He also urged Southwest governors to protect regional interests, citing the 2017 federal budget's lack of favor toward the South-West and the need for a common strategy against herdsmen.

Canada's TSX rose 0.1% to 15,683.06, with energy stocks up 1.2% on higher oil prices, while materials fell 0.4% on weaker metals. TMX Group gained 0.5% after a China deal, and Ritchie Bros dropped 7.7% on a rating cut.

A former New York judge, Louis L. Nock, joined Anderson Kill the same day ethics regulators dropped charges against him in exchange for his resignation from the bench. He had been accused of rude behavior and retaliatory threats. Nock denied the allegations but resigned. Anderson Kill stated Nock disclosed the allegations before hiring and that no wrongdoing was found.

Canada’s main stock market fell due to lower oil prices, while world stocks and Wall Street also declined. The TSX and Dow Jones initially rose but later lost gains. Trade war concerns persist ahead of a U.S. tariff deadline on Chinese goods. The TSX closed at 16,263, down 14 points; the Dow lost 132 points to 24,174. Oil rose to $74.13, gold to $1253.90, and the loonie to 76.09 cents U.S.

A widow administratrix cannot have her letters revoked for failing to give notice to creditors when the estate is under $1,500, as she is entitled to the whole estate under section 1469, making notice unnecessary. Persons not interested cannot petition to revoke letters. The court reversed the order removing the administratrix.

A Finnish study of 5,800 public sector employees found that sleep difficulties, particularly nonrestorative sleep and early morning awakenings, decreased after retirement. Overall, the likelihood of sleep problems dropped 11%, with early awakenings 24% less likely and nonrestorative sleep falling by 53%. Sleep duration increased by about 20 minutes on average.

The SEC launched a preliminary inquiry into whether energy consultants advising California Governor Gray Davis used inside information to trade power company stocks. Davis' spokesman, Steve Maviglio, admitted buying $12,000 in Calpine stock in June and owning Enron stock. Five consultants were fired for potential conflicts of interest. Two political consultants agreed to forgo payment for their work. Separately, India is evaluating Enron's offer to sell its stake in the Dabhol power project, and financial institutions have been asked to work out a completion package.

The passage provides mechanical, packaging, and orderable information for designated devices, including linear dimensions in millimeters, notes on drawing changes, soldering requirements, and status definitions. It also includes disclaimers, RoHS values, lead finish, MSL ratings, part markings, and qualified versions.

Grain growers using deep ripping on summer rainfall have been warned it does not necessarily overcome soil water repellence and can worsen it. Research found soil inversion treatments provided greater gains in moisture content, while deep ripping showed no significant benefit. Options for growers include avoiding dry seeding, using wetting agents, or other soil amelioration.

The lecture discusses how climate risk impacts real estate markets, focusing on whether it affects rental cash flows (numerator) or capitalization rates (denominator) in asset valuation. Empirical studies show price discounts of around 3% for properties with high flood risk, with no change in rents, indicating the discount comes from cap rates rather than net operating income. After Hurricane Sandy, properties in flood zones experienced an 8% persistent price penalty. The role of beliefs is critical, as demonstrated by research showing that communities with higher climate belief have 7% larger price decreases for flood-zone properties compared to denier communities. Information disclosure requirements and social media sentiment analysis are tools to understand belief formation. The lecture also introduces difference-in-differences methodology to isolate climate risk impacts on housing prices.

Digital leaders prioritize data culture, using it to align employee beliefs, values, and actions. Successful firms show consistency between stated values and behavior, while laggards face misalignment due to entrenched habits. Changing mindsets is the hardest part of transformation. Technologically mature firms have stronger data cultures, and organizations typically fall into four patterns: data novice, insight ready, tech enabled, or data reliant, each requiring targeted improvements.

A novel high-impedance microstrip transmission line resonator design for 10.5T MRI was proposed and validated. The design combines high-frequency capability with electromagnetic decoupling. A prototype 2-channel array was tested, showing -21 dB decoupling at 447 MHz with a 10mm gap. Numerical simulations confirmed well-defined B1 distribution and reasonable B1+ values.

Facebook apologized for its search auto-fill suggesting sexual acts involving minors, removed the predictions, and stated they do not allow sexually explicit imagery. The company also admitted a survey mistake about pedophiles requesting pictures, calling such activity unacceptable.

Amazon.com, Inc. filed a Form 8-K on April 30, 2020, announcing its first quarter 2020 financial results via a press release (Exhibit 99.1) and additional information on non-GAAP financial measures (Exhibit 99.2).

School districts facing declining enrollment and budget cuts used AI-optimized master scheduling to rebalance class sizes and workloads, saving $2.2 million in Lubbock and $1.05 million in Edgewood without teacher layoffs, allowing reinvestment into academic priorities.

Speculators' net short positions on the pound hit record highs in March, but sterling has consistently risen an average of 2% in April for the last 12 years, a trend analysts call a "risk to watch" for short-sellers. Potential factors include the end of the UK tax year and dividend payouts by multinationals, though the trend only emerged after 2004.

Active Surfaces, founded in 2022 from MIT research, produces ultra-lightweight, flexible solar panels. The case details 15 fictional transactions for the company's fiscal year ending December 31, 2023, including stock issuance, insurance, a line of credit, equipment purchase, a pilot project, and a customer order. The assignment requires recording these transactions, preparing a balance sheet, and calculating net income and cash flow.

Audi's e-tron prototype achieves a drag coefficient of 0.28, a top SUV segment result, contributing to a WLTP range over 400 km. Each 0.01 reduction adds about 5 km of range. Over 1,000 hours of testing occurred in Ingolstadt's wind tunnel. Aerodynamic measures include virtual exterior mirrors, a fully enclosed underbody with dimples, a controllable cool-air inlet, and adaptive air suspension that lowers the body at high speeds.

Year 6 volunteers at Swallowdale Primary School cleaned a bus to prepare it for renovation into a reading space, with plans to paint a woodland scene featuring book characters and seek an upholsterer for seats.

The passage discusses graph similarity/distance measures, including exact and inexact graph matching methods, topological index-based approaches, and a new method using multiple scaled topological indices to compute graph distance and similarity.

Disney's brand sentiment and awareness for itself and Disney+ fell to two-year lows after temporarily halting Jimmy Kimmel's show and raising Disney+ prices, alienating both Democrats and Republicans, according to a Jefferies analysis of Morning Consult data.

Functional emulsifier blends are mixtures used for emulsification, with North America expected to dominate the market due to major food production centers. Demand is driven by food safety issues, with key players investing in R&D. The food and beverage industry, especially bakery, is the major consumer, though personal care products are projected for higher growth.

The passage describes the American shift from submission to independence, the inadequacy of the Confederation, the resulting crises, and the creation of the Constitution. It expresses strong support for the new government, warns against election corruption, praises the nation's first leader, and outlines principles for preserving the republic.

President Roosevelt addresses the nation, focusing on coal miners, stating the war effort requires uninterrupted coal production. He blames the United Mine Workers' national officers for a strike, which he says obstructs the war. The government has taken over the mines, and he calls on miners to return to work, promising protection and retroactive wage adjustments if approved by the War Labor Board.

Her Highness Sheikha Jawaher Al Qasimi, visiting the 10th Sharjah Children’s Reading Festival, stated that children's learning shapes future values and civilization. She emphasized the festival inspires a thirst for reading and innovation, noting it gathers diverse children and international professionals, reflecting Sharjah's cultural vision. She praised the Sharjah Book Authority for combining fun with science and arts, urging families and institutions to attend.

In March, Google's work with the Pentagon on "Project Maven" to develop AI for analyzing drone footage sparked employee backlash. Over 3,100 employees signed a petition in April, and roughly a dozen resigned in May. Google is now developing ethical guidelines to govern future defense contracts, reportedly precluding the use of AI in weaponry.

The study examines human rights education (HRE) in early childhood education and care (ECEC), focusing on content selection for observing UN Day in Norway. It proposes four dimensions—children’s ages, progression, human rights knowledge anchored in social studies, and children’s own interests—to guide content selection. Analysis of 73 posts from the Idebroen webpage shows three main approaches: human rights, diversity, and fundraising. Findings indicate limited explicit focus on human rights content, with few posts referencing specific rights or legal anchoring, raising concerns about developing children’s judicial consciousness. The dimensions offer structured support for ECEC teachers but reveal challenges in adapting content and ensuring educational value.
Colton Harris-Moore, known as the Barefoot Bandit, committed 67 felonies across three countries, stealing six airplanes, 15 cars, and robbing over 34 homes.

The Nobel Peace Prize was awarded to the International Campaign to Abolish Nuclear Weapons (ICAN), interpreted across Asia as a signal for urgent preventive treaties on the Korean Peninsula. The Nobel committee's language and ICAN's mention of North Korea and the U.S. first were seen as a push for negotiations, with a Nobel historian calling it a signal to both nations. The prize was also viewed as coded support for the Iran nuclear deal, avoiding direct provocation of Trump. ICAN was cited for highlighting nuclear weapons' humanitarian consequences and promoting a treaty-based prohibition. The U.S. stated it will not sign the treaty, which 122 countries adopted but none of the nine nuclear-armed states joined. The backdrop includes North Korea's sixth nuclear test and preparations for a long-range missile test, alongside escalating rhetoric between Trump and Kim Jong Un. Trump's "calm before the storm" comment and threats from both sides underscore tensions. The prize implies the Nobel committee is focusing global attention on Kim and Trump.

Since the last Congress, the nation lost President Harding, who is remembered for his kindness, humanity, and character. The U.S. foreign policy avoids permanent alliances and the League of Nations, but supports a World Court. Relations with Russia are resuming, but the U.S. will not recognize a regime that rejects international obligations. The U.S. opposes canceling foreign debts but will adjust them. The government is reducing expenditures and taxes, opposes war taxes in peacetime, and supports tariff revision only when necessary. The merchant fleet should be transferred to private ownership. Public improvements like waterways and flood control are recommended. Railroad consolidation is needed, and the Labor Board should be left for now. The Justice Department needs more judges and prison reform. Prohibition enforcement requires stronger laws. Lynching should be punished, and civil service extended. The Army and Navy should not be further reduced. The government should promote welfare but not assume personal responsibilities. Immigration should be restricted and selective. Veterans need adequate care, but no bonus. Coal costs must be reduced without government ownership. Government reorganization is needed. Agriculture requires relief through reduced taxes, freight rate reorganization, and cooperative marketing. Muscle Shoals should be sold with conditions for fertilizer production. Reclamation projects need financial relief. Highways and reforestation should continue. The Monroe Doctrine must be maintained, with new responsibilities for global stability.

The TTC will return 67 of its 89 new Bombardier streetcars for preventative repairs of "inferior frame welds," with no safety risk. Bombardier will cover costs, and all repairs will be completed by 2022.

Ohio State researchers discovered that T-cell exhaustion in cancer is driven by a previously unknown stress pathway, TexPSR, which causes a toxic buildup of misfolded proteins. Blocking TexPSR restored T-cell function and improved cancer immunotherapy in preclinical models.

President Buchanan transmits the Lecompton constitution to Congress for Kansas's admission as a state. He describes a rebellion in Kansas by those adhering to the Topeka constitution against the Territorial government established by Congress, which required U.S. troops to suppress. He argues the Lecompton convention was legally constituted and that the slavery question was submitted to a vote, which opponents boycotted. He favors Kansas's admission to end the conflict. Separately, he issues a proclamation against rebellion in Utah, detailing resistance to federal authority and military actions, offering a pardon to those who submit to federal law.

The passage explains flexible working options for employed carers in Britain, covering the right to request it (after 26 weeks of employment), the application process, employer obligations to consider requests within three months, and options if dissatisfied, such as an appeal or employment tribunal.

Veterans in Galesburg and Abingdon, Illinois, have reported missing prescription pills delivered by the Iowa City VA, with some pills apparently removed from bottles. Abingdon Police have two cases under investigation, and the Iowa City VA confirms multiple reports of theft in the area.

NVIDIA Corporation filed a Form 10-Q for the quarterly period ended April 26, 2020. Revenue was $3.08 billion, net income was $917 million, and diluted earnings per share were $1.47. The company reported $15.49 billion in cash and cash equivalents and total assets of $23.25 billion.

The passage details the NVIDIA Turing GPU architecture, including hardware support for USB-C and VirtualLink for VR, the TU102/TU104/TU106 GPU specifications, new SM design with concurrent FP32/INT32 execution, RT Cores for real-time ray tracing, Tensor Cores for AI inference (including DLSS), GDDR6 memory, enhanced video engine, Variable Rate Shading, Texture Space Shading, Multi-View Rendering, and NVLink for multi-GPU connectivity. In 2024, Ferrari pursued a "controlled growth" strategy to protect its luxury performance car market position, nearly doubling shipments and increasing revenues from $3.2 billion (2015) to $7.2 billion. The company planned further growth via new markets, younger customers, and new models, including a 2025 fully-electric vehicle, while maintaining brand exclusivity. Ferrari's success was attributed to balancing tradition and innovation.

First lady Melania Trump, absent from public view for nearly three weeks, tweeted on Wednesday that she is at the White House with her family, feeling great, and working on behalf of children and the American people. Her last public appearance was on May 10, and she had a minor kidney procedure on May 14. Her office dismissed social media theories about her well-being.

The European Commission issued final warnings to Germany, France, Spain, Italy, and Britain for failing to address repeated nitrogen dioxide pollution breaches, posing a serious health risk. If they do not respond within two months, the Commission may take the matter to the EU Court of Justice.

The passage outlines five key principles for early childhood education and care (ECEC) for children aged 1-5: prioritizing early years for holistic development, creating a nurturing environment, focusing on quality in ECEC, engaging families, and ensuring continuous professional development for educators. These principles are based on research and aim to support cognitive, social, emotional, and physical development, with emphasis on brain plasticity, safe environments, quality teacher-child interactions, family partnership, and inclusive practices.

Tyrus Capital S.A.M. purchased 182,400 shares of Reynolds American (NYSE:RAI) in Q2, valued at about $11,863,000, making it 0.9% of its portfolio. Other institutional investors also increased stakes: Vanguard Group by 2.9%, BlackRock by 10.1%, State Street Corp by 0.3%, and FMR LLC by 16.0%. American International Group increased its stake by 1.2% in Q1. Institutional investors own 46.34% of the stock. Analysts have a consensus rating of "Hold" with an average price target of $59.82.

The passage lists Vanguard ETFs and discusses the buy-and-hold strategy, noting that passive investing has historically outperformed active management. It provides details on John Bogle's founding of Vanguard and his advocacy for passive investing. The article backtests ten Vanguard ETFs from their inception, describing each fund's objective and index tracking. It concludes with a FAQ section explaining the buy-and-hold strategy and differences between VOO, VOOV, and VOOG.

Pakistan's national flag, measuring 120x80 feet, was flown at 400 feet at the Attari-Wagah border, the highest in South Asia and eighth highest globally, to mark the country's 70th Independence Day. Army chief Gen Qamar Javed Bajwa hoisted the flag and made a speech referencing the Pakistan resolution, the country's progress, sacrifices, and a warning to enemies.

Ted Hannah, a 1959 Summerland graduate, contrasts his generation's post-Depression and WWII upbringing with the material wealth and technology available to 2018 graduates. He advises them to nurture relationships, volunteer, and improve others' lives regardless of background.

The passage discusses finding minimal trellis representations for linear block codes using a trellis-oriented generator matrix. It explains the state space theorem, which determines state space dimensions at any time, and an algorithm to construct a minimal trellis by reducing the generator matrix to have minimum span. The state dimension profile is read from the number of active generators at each cut time. The passage also covers branch space dimensions, noting they are more fundamental for Viterbi algorithm complexity, and discusses sectionalization to simplify trellis representation. It concludes with average dimension bounds linking trellis complexity to code parameters and notes that good codes require exponentially increasing trellis complexity.

On May 7, 2019, Tesla closed public offerings of 3,549,381 common shares and $1.84 billion in 2.00% Convertible Senior Notes due 2024. The company entered a Fifth Supplemental Indenture for the notes, which have an initial conversion rate of 3.2276 shares per $1,000 principal. Tesla also entered additional note hedge and warrant transactions with hedge counterparties, paying $475.8 million for hedges and receiving $174.4 million from warrant sales.

This document standardizes the Guest-Hypervisor Communication Block (GHCB) for SEV-ES and SEV-SNP guests, defining protocols for Non-Automatic Exits, page state changes, guest requests, AP creation, doorbell pages, IPI, timers, APIC ID lists, VMPL execution, trusted I/O, Secure AVIC, and termination. It details hypervisor feature advertisement, GHCB negotiation, and specific behaviors for host and guest, including support for restricted injection and interrupt handling.
The passage provides an early look at NFL Week 15 matchups, including odds and predictions for each game, highlighting key players and team performances.

A Twitter thread discusses reactions to Mike Pence's St. Patrick's Day parade appearance. Some LGBT activists claim they "ruined" his day by displaying pride flags, while conservative Chad Felix Greene argues Pence appeared happy and unaffected, calling the activists' efforts a waste of time. The exchange includes accusations of misinformation and a debate over Pence's positions.

This cookie policy explains how zeenews.india.com uses cookies and similar technologies to store and access information on user devices, identify users, remember preferences, track usage, control content, and analyze site performance. It describes first and third-party cookies, persistent and session cookies, and categories including essential, analytical, performance, functionality, and advertising cookies. Users can refuse or withdraw consent by adjusting browser settings, though this may affect site functionality.
NVIDIA Corporation's Form 10-Q for the quarter ended May 1, 2016, reports revenue of $1,305 million, net income of $196 million, and earnings per diluted share of $0.33.

The passage is a classroom discussion about reverse logistics and closed-loop supply chains, focusing on case studies of ReCellular and Whirlpool. Students debate the viability of ReCellular's business model, citing factors like shrinking margins and market demand. For Whirlpool, the class evaluates three options: joining an industry-funded organization (IFO), creating a closed-loop system, or opposing regulation. Cost estimates for the IFO model are around $35 million, with a per-unit cost of $47, compared to a forward supply chain cost of $70 per unit. The discussion highlights operational challenges and the potential for Whirlpool to leverage its 48% market share for a closed-loop system.

An SDXC Card with XPC=0 operates at up to 0.36W in Default Speed or SDR12, indicating Class 0 if Speed Class is unsupported. With XPC=1, it operates at up to 0.54W and supports Speed Class; changing XPC requires re-initialization. A UHS-I host sets S18R=1 in ACMD41 to request 1.8V signaling; a UHS-I card responds with S18A=1, then the host issues a voltage switch. After switching, the card sets S18A=0. In UHS-II mode, S18A is always 0. Fast Boot (Bit 29) is reserved for eSD.

The passage discusses a player's resilience and skill, emphasizing his ability to focus after setbacks and make timely saves. It highlights a coaching philosophy encouraging instinctive play with calculated risk, and notes another player's need to balance making plays with simple decisions. The text also addresses playoff trends of fewer penalties, power-play entry struggles, and praises the defensive group's effort and versatility.

In soccer, individual defending involves a defender quickly engaging an opposing ball carrier, either through aggressive defending (cutting off the ball, tackling, interposing) or attack stalling (delaying to allow teammates to recover). Key tactics include staying goalside, maintaining a clean stance, not over-reacting to fakes, denying passes/shots, slowly giving ground, restricting the dribbler’s vision, jockeying, shepherding, and stealing the ball. The defender must eventually stand their ground or tackle, with critical oral communication from teammates using terms like "Contain," "Delay," "Jockey," "Challenge," or "Tackle" to guide action.

On Tuesday morning, all lanes of I-696 were closed after a man threatened suicide. Michigan State Police organized 13 semi trucks under the bridge to shorten a potential fall. After several hours, the situation ended peacefully, and the man was taken to Beaumont Hospital for evaluation.

This disclosure relates to controlling uplink data transmission in wireless communication systems to reduce power consumption when a device is in an enhanced coverage state. A device can refrain from sending uplink data based on conditions such as data type, Quality of Service, device mobility, battery level, or whether it is plugged into a power supply. The application or modem can determine whether to restrict transmission based on radio coverage information. The network can configure transmission restriction parameters via downlink messages.

This study analyzed NHANES data (2007-2010) to examine the association of depression, obesity, and hypertriglyceridemia (HTG) with rheumatoid arthritis (RA). The prevalence of RA was higher in subjects with depression, and this association was synergistically increased when depression coexisted with obesity or HTG. This synergistic effect was dependent on C-reactive protein (CRP) level, being most prominent at medium CRP (1-3 mg/L). The authors conclude that these findings warrant longitudinal studies to evaluate RA risk in subjects with depression and these comorbidities.
On June 26, 2020, Microsoft Corporation filed a Form 8-K announcing a press release about closing Microsoft Store physical locations.

The speaker argues that age is irrelevant in today's game, valuing veteran knowledge over skill. They are proud of their team's selfless play and winning a Cup despite doubts about Brett Hull. The team's focus is on winning one more game, with contributions beyond goals. The speaker had no serious injuries, and their move to Detroit resulted from Dallas's delayed decision and budget issues, leaving them without a team until August.

A player with a leg injury, caused by an opponent falling on him, hopes to play the next night after treatment. He is determined to play in the Stanley Cup Finals, noting the team's need for discipline and best effort. He watched the previous game from the dressing room, feeling a lack of control. He praises the team and the city of Calgary's support.

Brits' average debt grew by £560 in Q1 2017, with single parents adding up to £940 (£10/day). Debt is often for necessities, not extravagance. Average debt is £1,797; highest among 45-54 year-olds (£2,299) and in North East England (£2,664).

The passage discusses a shift in Information Systems (IS) research from a positivist, technical focus to human factors, highlighting complexity theory and User Experience (UX) as key developments. It emphasizes that IS are complex, dynamic systems involving irreversible processes, contrasting with traditional mechanical approaches. The paper aims to improve UX by understanding IS as incorporating humans, not just being used by them, and calls for methodologies that account for nonlinearity and irreversibility.

Ontologies are formal knowledge representations used in the Semantic Web and AI. Ontology Alignment (OA) identifies correspondences between equivalent entities across different ontologies. While large language models are popular for OA, Knowledge Graph Embeddings (KGEs) are underexplored. This work systematically explores KGEs for OA, integrating them into the OntoAligner library. The framework uses a three-stage pipeline (Parser, Encoder, Aligner) to unify triples from two ontologies, learn embeddings via a KGE model, and compute alignments using cosine similarity. It implements 17 KGE models, selected for diversity and performance, and evaluates them on OAEI tracks.

The DAWN-PLASMA study was a randomized, open-label, phase 2 trial evaluating convalescent plasma in hospitalized COVID-19 patients. The primary endpoint was the proportion of patients alive without mechanical ventilation at Day 15. The study found no difference between the convalescent plasma group (83.7%) and the control group (84.1%) for this endpoint (Odds ratio 0.99, p=0.976).

The match-up zone defense combines person-to-person and zone principles, using a series of defensive rules. It prevents offensive alignments from splitting defenders, makes overloads easier to defend, and confuses opponents. Success depends on smart, knowledgeable players and communication. It is a passive defense reacting to offensive movement but can be supplemented with aggressive traps. The passage details specific match-up rules for defenders X1 through X5 against various offensive alignments (2-3, 1-3-1, 1-2-2, 1-4) and describes how to defend cutters, screens, and post rolls through switches and interchanges. Trapping can be applied in quarter court, half court, and full court.

The passage discusses distributed systems, focusing on single-node container patterns, particularly the sidecar pattern. It explains motivations for splitting applications into multiple containers on a single machine, such as resource isolation, team ownership, and separation of concerns. The sidecar pattern involves an application container and a sidecar container that augments it, sharing resources like filesystem and network. Examples include adding HTTPS to a legacy service, managing dynamic configuration, and providing monitoring tools like topz. The passage also covers parameterizing containers, defining APIs, and documenting containers for modularity and reusability. It introduces the ambassador pattern for brokering interactions between application containers and external services, with examples like sharded Redis, service brokering, and request splitting. The adapter pattern is described for modifying application interfaces to conform to standards, with examples in monitoring (Prometheus), logging (Fluentd), and health checks. Multi-node patterns are introduced, including replicated load-balanced services for stateless applications, with discussions on readiness probes, session tracking, caching layers, SSL termination, and rate limiting. Sharded services are covered for stateful systems, focusing on sharded caches, sharding functions, and consistent hashing.

The passage reports that the S&P 500 hit its average annual price return of 9.1%, entering a seasonally weak period. July economic data showed weakness, with only 73K jobs added and prior months revised down by 258K. However, Q2 earnings growth rose from 7.7% to 11.2%, with 94% of mega-cap companies beating expectations. The text notes AI has been carrying the market, but warns of a negative equity risk premium and a real economic slowdown, suggesting potential market weakness in the coming months.

DomeShelter Australia's Container Mounted DomeShelter™ (CMDS) is a weather-resistant, relocatable shelter system with a robust steel frame, designed for various industries. It protects goods from heat, moisture, and UV damage, and is suitable for sectors like oil and gas, agriculture, events, and tourism.

This patent application describes systems and methods for providing user interfaces to confirm actions associated with untrusted emails. A driver monitors process creation, and a user console injects a monitor library into significant processes. The library detects user actions to access untrusted domains, pauses the action, and notifies the user console. The console queries a server to determine if the domain is trusted, sending a client settings hash. If the hash does not match the server's, updated notification settings are returned. The console displays a configurable notification based on local settings, allowing the user to confirm or revert the action. The user's response is recorded and passed to the monitor library to resume or discard the request.

A fluid flow measuring and control device for plumbing includes a main flow channel, a parallel bypass channel with a flowmeter, a valve, two pressure sensors, and a transceiver. The flowmeter uses a wheel and two movement sensors to measure net flow, including backflow. A computer compares flow data to pre-recorded appliance signatures to identify usage, detect abnormal usage or leaks, and can instruct the valve to close.

Analysis of district and school-level data shows a strong correlation between reading and math performance. Among 140 exceptional districts, only 14 excelled in one subject while underperforming in the other. In Mississippi, the correlation between school-level reading and math scores was 0.87, and schools with high growth in one subject also showed high growth in the other.

The passage describes a kinetic Monte Carlo (KMC) simulation technique for predicting crystal morphology using intermolecular interaction parameters, implemented in an open-source Python package (cgkmc). It details the encoding of the system on a colored graph, calculation of interaction energies, identification of surface sites for adsorption and evaporation, and the use of a residence-time algorithm to simulate crystal growth. The technique is applied to PETN, showing agreement with the AE model and experiments.

Soccer teams need a planned corner kick defense, as conceding corners is common. The plan must be understood by all players and implemented immediately. While professional teams may have a low scoring chance against them, this results from years of practice; without a plan, corners are dangerous. Defenses evolve from youth to advanced levels but share common principles: defenders should avoid conceding corners, the goalkeeper remains in charge, players must react quickly and aggressively to win the ball, and clearances should be high and wide. A transition to attack should be planned. Three main defensive strategies exist: zone, man-to-man, and a mixed combination. Zone defense assigns players to cover specific areas; man-to-man assigns each defender to a specific attacker; the mixed approach uses zone for players near the goal and man-to-man for others. Coaches should scout opponents and practice until the response is intuitive.

The Mid Screen offense is used by every NBA and WNBA team. It takes place in the center of the floor, taking away helpside support. The basic option is for the point guard to drive off a high post screen, with options including a drive to the basket, pull-up jumper, drop pass to the post, or kick-out passes. The offense requires reading and countering defensive actions, with specific counters for various defensive reads. It can flow into continuities like motion, single/double, flex, inside triangle, or side screen. Variations include post pop, horns, 1-4 low, post isolation, and two game. Success depends on execution, coordination, and defensive recognition.

The NVIDIA combined L1 data cache and shared memory subsystem, first introduced in Volta V100, improves performance and simplifies programming. It integrates both functions into one memory block, with a combined capacity of 192 KB/SM in A100 versus 128 KB/SM in V100. The L1 cache provides low latency and high bandwidth, and the A100’s larger subsystem boosts performance for applications using the L1 data cache.

The goalie entered the play, the puck came to the speaker, who waited for teammates to clear the zone, saw space behind Zubov, went wide, and got a good shot off. On a two-on-one, he tried to recover a turnover. On a powerplay, he played the pass to give Marty the shot. He feels they have come far but must not drag the series out; they will try to take it to the opponent on Thursday, learning from Philadelphia's letdown. He signed with the Devils knowing he had a chance to reach this point, having been in finals in Finland. He must move on from the one loss, feeling he played well and is getting more comfortable against Dallas. The opponent has more speed, cycles well, and supports each other, making it hard to take away their time. Media attention is similar, but focus is easier this close to the end. The team matches up top lines with defensive pairings, and rolling four lines gives forwards more energy. Group responsibility for changes has become easier with communication. He is not surprised a veteran player has stepped up in the playoffs. He focused on making the finals, as he did in Finland.

Casey Mittelstadt could play for Rochester via an AHL or amateur tryout contract, but signing an NHL entry-level deal would burn a year of his contract and prevent an AHL assignment. The Sabres prefer an amateur tryout now and an entry-level deal starting in 2018-19, which would allow him minor-league experience.

This passage details the design of a synchronous push-pull converter using GaN devices and the TPS7H5001-SP controller, operating at 500 kHz with a 5 V output. Key component selections include a 205 kΩ RT resistor, a feedback divider of 10 kΩ and 1.4 kΩ, a 25 ns dead time, a 49.9 kΩ RLEB, a 33 nF soft-start capacitor, a transformer turns ratio of 2.5 with 40 μH primary inductance, 170 V primary and 80 V secondary GaN FETs, a 0.47 μH output inductor, 2.3 mF output capacitance, a 7.5 Ω current sense resistor, a 3.3 nF hiccup capacitor, and compensation components of 40.2 kΩ, 15 nF, and 47 pF. The design also includes layout guidelines for noise reduction and reliability.

BMW released a video explaining the five SAE levels of self-driving capability. Levels 1 and 2 require full driver attention. BMW expects Level 3, where drivers can temporarily disengage, in its 2021 iNext. Many firms skip Level 3 for Level 4, where the vehicle can stop safely if the driver fails to retake control. BMW expects Level 4 regulations and infrastructure by the mid-2020s. Waymo already has Level 4 cars, limited to certain areas. Level 5, requiring no driver, likely won't be ready until the end of the next decade.

The passage describes a system and method for detecting abnormal cardiac activity using machine learning. It receives cardiac and motion data, determines signal quality indices, extracts cardiovascular features, applies a tensor transform, and uses a deep learning architecture (convolutional neural network, bidirectional recurrent neural network, and attention network) to classify cardiac activity as normal or abnormal. The system can generate a report with the classification.

Among women with hypertensive disorders of pregnancy (HDP) at two academic health systems, 13% developed incident hypertension within 12 months postpartum. Higher systolic blood pressure (BP) at the 15-90 day postpartum visit (HR 1.70 for 140 vs. 120 mmHg), older maternal age (HR 1.46 for 35 vs. 25 years), and severe preeclampsia/eclampsia (HR 1.49 vs. gestational hypertension) were associated with greater risk. 40% of eligible women lacked a 15-90 day BP check.

JPMorgan Chase is deploying AI across its global operations to cut costs and enhance services, having rolled out its generative AI platform to all 200,000 employees. The bank is investing roughly $18 billion in technology, with AI tools automating customer support, payments, and account management in retail banking. In wealth management, AI platforms like "Smart Monitor" cut analysis time by up to 83%, while "Connect Coach" offers real-time product recommendations. On the institutional side, AI spans credit assessments, fraud detection, and risk management, with over 175 active use cases. Challenges include balancing innovation with compliance, ensuring transparency, and integrating AI with legacy infrastructure.

iOS 11 drains iPhone battery more than twice as fast as iOS 10, with battery life dropping from 240 to 96 minutes. Wandera advises against reverting to iOS 10.3.3 due to security risks. Update iOS 11.0.1 improved battery drain to 159 minutes. Older devices experience worse drain. Users can save battery by limiting background app refresh and location services, or using low power mode.

On October 29, 2001, Enron's stock fell to six-year lows after Moody's downgraded its debt to Baa2, two notches above junk. Enron sought $1-2 billion in new credit lines after drawing $3.3 billion the prior week. European energy firms halted trading with Enron due to credit concerns. Multiple shareholder lawsuits were filed over undisclosed partnership transactions.

The CS5535 has several errata: AuxOutputFull bit is incorrectly cleared by Port 60h reads; tACK bits have no effect on UDMA timing; ATAC can hang with WORD-aligned PRD addresses; LPC controller may abort transactions with short SYNC patterns; NEGACK bit in SMB controller behaves incorrectly; GLPCI retry counter counts all PCI retries; GPIO High Bank writes fail after suspend; SMBus hold time is too short; LOWBAT_FLAG is missing after abnormal standby; and Sleep_X/Y are not deasserted if delay is larger than PM_SED delay.

Connaught Public School attempted a world record for most students playing tunnel ball simultaneously, with over 250 students participating, surpassing the previous record of 120. The event also raised $10,000 for the school's yard renewal project.

A survey of 1,079 people found 71% of Washington homeowners worry about a housing bubble, but experts say the market shows no signs of a bubble due to high credit scores and down payments, though a market correction is likely.

Billionaire CEOs like Jeff Bezos and Reid Hoffman reject work-life balance, with some viewing constant work as essential for success. Bezos prefers "work-life harmony," while Hoffman argues seeking balance indicates a lack of commitment to winning. Other executives, such as Cerebras CEO Andrew Feldman and Scale AI cofounder Lucy Guo, also dismiss the concept, stating that extraordinary achievement requires far more than a 40-hour workweek.

American consumer confidence rose to 128.7 in April, up from 127.0 in March, nearing an 18-year high. The index measures current conditions and six-month outlook. Analysts attribute the strength to a strong labor market, tax cuts, reduced stock volatility, and eased trade war fears, though some caution that slow income growth may limit spending.

NEC Corp announced the NEC Satellite Operation Center, fully operational in April, starting with the ASNARO-2 radar satellite launched in January. The center uses NEC's GroundNEXTAR system and a high-security data center, enabling simultaneous multi-satellite operations. NEC plans to market ASNARO-2 images via JEOSS from September.

The TPS7H500x-SP uses a transconductance error amplifier, allowing Type 2A or Type 2B frequency compensation. Type 2A includes an additional capacitor (CHF) for high-frequency noise attenuation. A procedure and equations are provided to select compensation components based on crossover frequency and power stage transconductance. The device features thermal shutdown at 175°C and operates using fixed frequency, peak current mode control. A design example for a synchronous push-pull converter using GaN FETs is detailed, including component selection for output voltage, dead time, blanking, soft-start, transformer, FETs, output filter, and overcurrent protection. Layout guidelines are provided to improve reliability.

For precise halting of a ring buffer, the halt command must be last in the queue; for precise error halting, only one command should be queued at a time due to parallel execution. Software clears interrupt status by writing PM_RBCtl[CLEAR_INTS] to 1, accepted only when no entries remain or PM_Status[PAUSED] is true.
The SN NEXT No. 1 McEachern Indians, both teams 5-0, are playing the Harrison Hoyas in Georgia. The game kicked off at 8 p.m. EST.

Astronomers discovered the most distant and powerful "odd radio circle" (ORC) ever detected, a double-ringed radio structure nearly 10 billion years old. The discovery, made with citizen scientists using LOFAR, challenges theories linking ORCs to black hole mergers, instead suggesting galactic superwinds may be the cause.
Peter Marks, former FDA vaccine regulator, has joined Eli Lilly to lead molecule discovery and infectious diseases, a move criticized as a revolving door between the agency and industry.

The state sued the Banking Department of the Citizens’ Bank for a license. The president of the Citizens’ Bank excepted, arguing no valid service was made because no such corporation exists. The court held the objection to citation should be decided with the Citizens’ Bank, and that the suit was improperly brought against the Banking Department rather than the Citizens’ Bank of Louisiana. The judgment was reversed and the suit dismissed as of nonsuit.

The passage contains a collection of news articles and email summaries from February 2002, covering Enron's bankruptcy, its pipeline and power operations, FERC contacts with Enron, and other energy industry news.

The passage introduces a Bucketized Hysteresis Controller (BHC) for budget pacing in online advertising, which uses error discretization and multiplicative updates to improve stability and accuracy over a legacy variable-step system.

In Windows 10, mouse pointer size and color can be changed via Settings > Ease of Access > Mouse, offering small, medium, or large sizes and white, black, or inverting colors. For shape changes, use Control Panel > Mouse applet > Pointers tab. In Safari on iOS, close all tabs by pressing and holding the Tabs link (or Done link) and selecting "Close xx Tabs."

NASA's Dawn spacecraft captured the closest-ever images of Ceres' Occator Crater, revealing bright salt deposits (faculae) from 22 miles altitude. The photos show Vinalia Faculae and Cerealia Facula, the largest carbonate deposits outside Earth. The mission aims to determine if faculae originated from shallow water or deeper brines. Dawn is nearing fuel depletion and will remain in its final orbit to avoid contaminating Ceres.

The ISDA Press Report for May 16, 2001, includes articles on IRS hedging regulations, OTC derivatives activity slowing, FAS 133 compliance, single-stock futures, credit derivatives, and bandwidth trading.

Canadian Pacific Railway has reduced delivery times for imported goods from Vancouver to Detroit by up to 48 hours compared to Canadian National Railway, cutting costs for shippers and increasing competitive pressure on its rival.

Euro zone stocks hit a one-year high on Monday after manufacturing data showed the fastest growth in over five years, though thin trade due to global holidays caused volatility. The euro fell 0.3% against a resurgent dollar, while Italy's FTSE MIB rose 1.3% and Germany's DAX gained 0.9%. A gun attack in Istanbul had little market impact, and China's manufacturing expanded for a fifth month.

The Horns Offense involves high post screening, similar to the "MidScreen" Offense. Defensive strategies include influencing the ballhandler toward the weakest screener, using "Show & Recover" techniques, and the "All Out SOS Disruption" method, which traps the point guard early to force freelance play. Rotations and match-ups are detailed for each phase.

The new coarse-fishing season on Britain’s rivers has begun. Roger Poole advises that June fishing differs from March, requiring new baits, tactics, and swims. The club seeks young members to enjoy the outdoors. The close season allows fish to spawn, so anglers should offer varied baits. National Fishing Month (July 27 to September 2) features over 250 events for youngsters and adults, backed by the Environment Agency. Children under 16 can get a free fishing licence. The club maintains venues on still waters and the Rother and Arun rivers. Early-season fish include tench, chub, dace, roach, perch, bream, and barbel, with specific tactics recommended for each river.

Nashville police arrested armed white domestic terrorism suspect Travis Reinking without using force, prompting questions about why unarmed Black suspects are not treated similarly. Reinking, who allegedly killed four people, was spotted by a citizen, complied with an officer's order to get on the ground, and was handcuffed; his backpack contained a semi-automatic handgun. The passage contrasts this with police killings of unarmed Black individuals and notes a separate incident where white officers violently arrested an unarmed Black woman at a Waffle House in Alabama.

The Office of Climate Change (OCC) opened a three-day Greenhouse Gas Inventory workshop to prepare for Guyana's Third National Communication (TNC) to the UNFCCC, aiming to build technical and institutional capacity. The workshop targets the Greenhouse Gas Inventory component of the TNC, with other components addressed later. Head of OCC, Janelle Christian, stated the goal is to create a group of national experts for data collection and institutionalizing the inventory process. National Project Coordinator Marlon Velloza said the findings will support Guyana's 'green' agenda and public involvement. Professor Anit Garg conducted sessions via Skype, aiming to prepare national experts for future inventories. The TNC is due in 2019.

Napheesa Collier suffered a Grade 2 tear of three ankle ligaments and a shin muscle during a collision, with a minimum six-week recovery. The Mercury eliminated the Lynx in Game 4. Lynx coach Cheryl Reeve was ejected and suspended for one game.

NEC Display is offering five-year warranties on four P-series pro-grade 24/7 digital signage displays, up from three years, without additional cost. The models covered are P404, P484, P554, and P703, with support starting from first shipment or August 1, 2017.

The Internal Bar Strength (IBS) indicator, calculated as (Close-Low)/(High-Low), has worked well on stocks and stock indices for over 30 years, particularly in bear markets, but not on other asset classes like commodity stocks. It is a mean-reversion strategy where low values signal bullish setups and high values bearish. Backtests on SPY and QQQ show strong compounded returns, with best performance when combined with filters like VIX or a 200-day moving average cap. Execution requires entering near the close, as delaying reduces returns. The indicator's weakness is this execution timing.

A passage promotes a "Functional Food Therapeutic Lifestyle Change Intervention Program" for high cholesterol, claiming it addresses underlying causes unlike conventional statin treatments, which it describes as lifelong and potentially malpracticed. It references CDC data on cholesterol's role in CVD and U.S. healthcare costs, and mentions a book listing 14 high cholesterol types and solutions.

The passage describes the construction of the new Governor Mario M. Cuomo Bridge, replacing the Tappan Zee Bridge. The project director, Jamey Barbas, presented details including the 3.1-mile crossing, a 2,230-foot main span built to last 100 years, eight chamfered towers, and the use of a massive floating crane. The project involved extensive planning, environmental studies, and labor agreements, with over 7,000 people contributing nearly 9 million work hours.

A University of Alabama student, Kelsey Hall, wore a Christmas tree costume to classes after a Twitter promise to do so for 1,000 retweets, which she exceeded with 30,000. She found the resulting attention stressful and said she would reconsider posting future challenges.

The radio show "High School Sports Talk" aired on ESPN Radio 94.1 from 10 AM to Noon, hosted by Matthew Hatfield and Coach Ed Young. Matt flew solo and interviewed guests including Chris Duhon, Jalen Lecque, David Teel, Cam Bacote, Bryan Kersey, Ed Miller, and Keyontae Johnson. A full replay and individual segments are available via Dropbox.

Alpha Theory's analysis of client data reveals investor biases, including failing to cut winners after price moves, slowly scaling into high-conviction positions, lacking discipline without price targets, and over-diversifying. These biases reduce returns, as disciplined sizing and concentration outperform, with optimal sizing potentially improving 2016 returns by 5.1%.

The lecture discusses adaptive experimentation and robust design, comparing one-factor-at-a-time (OFAT) methods to fractional factorial designs. The speaker presents research showing that adaptive OFAT can outperform fractional factorial designs in many scenarios, especially when experimental error is high or interactions are significant. The talk also covers robust parameter design, the history of experimental design (Fisher vs. Russell), and practical considerations for industry, including the use of ensembles and streamlining experiments. The speaker concludes that adaptive methods often yield substantial improvements with fewer experiments, particularly when starting points are informed.

The Showstoppers Theatre production of *Foiled Again!*, directed by founder Radu Azdril, features funny melodramas with songs. The summer program offers children aged 12 or younger free admission, with general tickets at $7. Performances are at La Colina Junior High School on Friday at 7 p.m., Saturday at 10:30 a.m., June 28 at 7 p.m., and June 29 at 10:30 a.m.
NVIDIA Corporation's Form 10-Q for the quarter ended April 26, 2015, reports revenue of $1.151 billion, net income of $134 million, and total assets of $7.291 billion.

The speaker emphasizes focusing on winning the current game to extend the series, noting the opponent's strong defense and goaltender Jonathan Quick. They suggest generating more shots, rebounds, and offensive zone time. Lineup changes are seen as a shake-up. The team has worked hard but needs better puck movement and more pressure on Quick. A teammate cited past comebacks as proof a turnaround is possible, stressing the slim margin for error.

Last week's market was risk-off, with major indexes breaking down from all-time highs in a bearish engulfing pattern. Key catalysts included mixed earnings, stronger-than-expected GDP (3% vs. 2.5%) clouded by tariff distortions, a disappointing jobs report (73,000 vs. 100,000 expected) with record downward revisions, and an FOMC meeting with two dissenting votes. Despite 82% of S&P 500 companies beating EPS estimates, the market sold off, with all sectors except Utilities down. The market now sees over 75% odds of a September rate cut.

The 2-1-2 zone is a compact defense protecting the middle, using an athletic middle player and "Bigs" on the blocks for rebounding. The lecture covers constructing the spacetime of a compact spherical body, beginning with the general static spherically symmetric metric in Schwarzschild coordinates. The exterior vacuum solution is derived, leading to the Schwarzschild metric, with the constant of integration fixed by the Newtonian limit. Birkhoff's theorem is introduced, stating that any spherically symmetric vacuum spacetime is described by the Schwarzschild metric. For the interior, the Einstein equations are equated to a perfect fluid stress-energy tensor, yielding a mass function and the Tolman-Oppenheimer-Volkoff (TOV) equation for relativistic hydrostatic equilibrium.
