Over 640 Ontario schools and daycares failed lead tests in two years, with numbers expected to rise under new sampling rules.

Turing GPUs feature a new display engine supporting higher resolutions, faster refresh rates, and HDR, including DisplayPort 1.4a for 8K at 60 Hz and DSC 1.2. They include an enhanced NVENC encoder for H.265 8K encode at 30 fps and an updated NVDEC decoder. Turing introduces hardware support for USB-C and VirtualLink for VR headsets, using a single connector for power, display, and data. NVLink replaces MIO and PCIe for SLI, providing up to 100 GB/sec bidirectional bandwidth. Turing includes RT Cores for hardware-accelerated real-time ray tracing, enabling hybrid rendering that combines ray tracing and rasterization. NVIDIA NGX uses Tensor Cores for AI-based functions like Deep Learning Super-Sampling (DLSS), which improves performance by rendering at lower input sample counts. Mesh Shading introduces Task and Mesh Shaders for more flexible geometry processing. Variable Rate Shading (VRS) allows dynamic adjustment of shading rate per 16x16 pixel region. Texture Space Shading (TSS) decouples shading from screen-space pixels. Multi-View Rendering (MVR) supports up to four views per pass. Turing's resource model supports bindless Constant Buffer Views and Unordered Access Views. The TU104 GPU contains 48 SMs, 3072 CUDA Cores, 368 Tensor Cores, and 48 RT Cores. The TU106 GPU, used in the GeForce RTX 2070, contains 36 SMs, 2304 CUDA Cores, 288 Tensor Cores, and 36 RT Cores, without NVLink or SLI support. RTX-OPS is a workload-based metric for hybrid rendering, considering Tensor, FP32, RT, and INT32 operations. Ray tracing simulates lighting by casting rays from the camera, using BVH acceleration and denoising. Ray-traced shadows, ambient occlusion, and reflections provide more realistic imagery than traditional techniques.

The passage discusses the Fiat-Shamir paradigm for converting interactive protocols into noninteractive ones, focusing on proving soundness for a specific zero-knowledge protocol (parallel repeated Hamiltonicity) using a hash function. The key idea is to use a fully homomorphic encryption (FHE) scheme with circular security to construct a hash function that avoids "bad" challenges (beta) for each first message (alpha). The proof relies on replacing a dummy circuit in the hash key with a special circuit (g*) that uses a trapdoor to compute and avoid the bad beta, arguing indistinguishability via semantic security of FHE. This technique yields a noninteractive zero-knowledge proof (NIZK) and is generalizable to other protocols like GKR.

The Nova Scotia government is seeking public feedback on a legal marijuana age of 19, sales through a Crown corporation, where use should be allowed, and drug-impaired driving. All sequenced infections were the Omicron BF.7 sublineage. No severe COVID-19 or serious adverse events occurred.

Cisco announced its participation in the Goldman Sachs Technology and Internet Conference 2017 on February 16 and the 2017 Morgan Stanley Technology, Media & Telecom Investor Conference on February 28, with webcasts available on its Investor Relations website.

Ruthless burglars threatened a newborn baby and held knives to women's throats during a home invasion in Birmingham on November 8. A separate gang used screwdrivers and cleaning fluid in another theft. West Midlands Police has formed a 24-hour task force to investigate 28 recent offences, with one arrest so far. Detectives are urging residents, especially those with valuable gold jewellery, to protect their property and report suspicious activity.

Counterterrorism officers are involved due to the nearby poisoning of Sergei Skripal and his daughter in March. The substance is being tested, and public health officials say there is no significant health risk currently.

Autoliv plans to list its electronics business, which makes radars, vision systems, and driver assistance software, with the spin-off expected to be completed in Q3 2018. The passive safety business (airbags and seatbelts) will retain the Autoliv name.

A TB mortality audit at Kitwe Teaching Hospital (Zambia) reviewed 74 patient files from June 2018 to June 2019. Most mortalities were among males (67.6%), HIV-positive patients (81.1%), and those from high-density areas (83.8%). Common symptoms included cough (41.9%) and fever (40.5%). He noted PPP rallies in Sindh exceeded planned durations due to public response. Haider demanded fair elections, citing past rigging, and affirmed PPP's support for democracy.

The study used satellite data and Monte Carlo simulations to detect damage across Brazil and Bolivia.

Dell Technologies will standardize on Salesforce CRM, expanding its use to nearly 40,000 sales staff and giving contact centers access to Service Cloud Einstein. The partnership also includes using Dell Boomi for cloud data sharing. Salesforce CEO Marc Benioff called it a major digital transformation, while Dell CEO Michael Dell noted it will support 200,000 channel partners.

A nanosecond pulsed electric field (nsPEF) generator with a feedback control system is disclosed. The generator includes a controller, a power supply, and a pulse generator. The controller generates control signals for the power supply and pulse generator based on feedback signals representing a characteristic or result of the generated pulses. The power supply generates power voltages based on its control signal. The pulse generator generates pulses based on the power voltages and its control signal. The feedback loop allows adjustment of pulse characteristics such as supply voltage, pulse width, number of pulses, frequency, or duty cycle in response to measured parameters like current, voltage, or temperature.

The TESS mission launched on a SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket from Cape Canaveral on April 18, 2018, to search for planets in our solar neighborhood. The launch was delayed two days for additional analysis. The rocket's first stage booster landed on a drone ship.

Mentalization is a key factor in personality pathology, studied extensively in Borderline Personality Disorder and now extending to other diagnoses. The passage discusses D-branes in string theory, focusing on their mass, interactions, and the effects of multiple coincident D-branes. The mass of a D-brane is defined as the vacuum energy of open strings living on it, proportional to 1/gs. The interaction between two D-branes can be viewed either as closed string exchange (tree-level) or as an open string loop (one-loop), illustrating channel duality. When multiple D-branes coincide, open strings can have endpoints on different branes, leading to a U(N) gauge symmetry and a low-energy effective action of Yang-Mills theory. Separating the branes breaks this symmetry via a Higgs mechanism, giving mass to strings stretched between different branes.

Cascaded inference uses a collection of sub-models of varying complexity, adaptively routing simple queries to lightweight models and complex ones to larger models to balance accuracy, latency, and cost. The paper introduces T-Tamer, a theoretical framework that formulates routing and termination as a costly exploration problem over a directed acyclic graph (DAG). T-Tamer computes a theoretically optimal strategy using a dynamic indexing approach, which is provably optimal for DAG structures like directed lines, their transitive closures, and trees, and can be computed in polynomial time. The framework is model-agnostic and operates as a plug-in component. The paper proves that no-recall strategies cannot achieve a constant-factor approximation to the optimal utility, while recall-based strategies with dynamic indexing are optimal. Experiments on vision and NLP classification tasks show that T-Tamer delivers favorable accuracy–latency trade-offs.

HF-band RFID enables wireless power transfer from reader to transponder. NFC, an application of this, increases battery drain in mobile devices. The judge found the image, analogous to a family photo of a nude child bathing, insufficient to support a finding of lasciviousness under the child pornography statute.

In the binary image build model, all interface call-out functions are funneled through one portal, providing a single point for filtering and dispatching. The host environment must implement a call-out router function and load its address in the standard header. The router translates the function number into an execution address. The UEFI BIOS environment offers four execution stages (SEC, PEI, DXE, RTP) across three execution modes. AGESA software core files are arranged into libraries for these stages. The SEC phase establishes the C environment. The PEI phase uses two PEIM modules: one for processor initialization and one for post-reset duties. The DXE driver performs late initialization and supplies data tables. The AmdInitLate entry point generates tables used by other drivers. The AmdGpuVgaControlDxe driver controls VGA resource decoding for the iGPU. Reference files are in the \Addendum directory. Build control files are in the \UEFI directory. The build environment requires environment variables like AGESA_ROOT and AGESA_OptsDir. There are two primary build methods: Binary Modules and Source Integration. Stack procedures are provided as macros. The AMD_RESET_ENABLEMENT macro provides very early control. The AMD_ENABLE_UEFI_STACK procedure establishes the stack. The AMD_DISABLE_STACK procedure removes the pre-memory stack. AmdCreateStruct creates storage for a parameter block. AmdReleaseStruct releases that storage. Entry procedures are listed in time point order. AmdInitReset performs minimal basic initialization after a system reset. AmdInitEarly establishes the program environment. AmdInitPost initializes system memory. AmdInitEnv transfers artifact data into main memory. AmdInitLate generates informational data tables. AmdInitRtb saves registers for system suspend. AmdInitResume re-initializes for the resume boot path. AmdS3LateRestore restores saved registers. AmdS3FinalRestore prepares for OS restart. Required host environment call-outs include AgesaAllocateBuffer, AgesaDeallocateBuffer, and AgesaReset.

A backtest comparing dollar-cost averaging (DCA) and lump-sum investing in the S&P 500 from 2000 to 2019 shows lump-sum investing generally outperforms. The article concludes lump-sum investing is the best option, as randomness and sequence of returns significantly affect DCA outcomes.

The study was initially observer-blinded for the first two doses, then became open-label. It features RT Cores for real-time ray tracing, Tensor Cores for AI (including DLSS), and supports hybrid rendering combining rasterization, ray tracing, and AI. Turing includes Variable Rate Shading, Mesh Shading, Texture Space Shading, Multi-View Rendering, and NVLink for SLI. The TU102 GPU has 6 MB L2 cache, and the architecture delivers up to 50% higher effective bandwidth than Pascal.

Hurricane Harvey damaged or destroyed up to a dozen critical wildlife habitats in Texas, including nesting sites and marshes for threatened species. Initial assessments are underway, with significant losses reported, such as at Attwater Prairie Chicken National Wildlife Refuge where only about 10 of 60 endangered prairie chickens survived. Scientists attribute increased storm intensity to climate change, and marine species like oysters and dolphins have been affected.

This study introduces a method to analyze public transit modal hierarchy using smart card data, classifying trips into ascending and descending phases based on half the total travel distance. Applied to Seoul metropolitan area data, it found consistent hierarchy within Seoul (walking, community bus, urban bus, light rail, metro) and regional variations when including intercity bus and comparing zones.

A 16-year-old driver drove through a "T" intersection into a bayou, killing two passengers. The trial court found the police jury 20% at fault for inadequate warnings. The appellate court affirmed the factual findings but amended the fault allocation to 35% for the police jury and 65% for the driver. The general damage award was affirmed.

Of 1,897 clinical trial publications from German university medical centers (2010-2020), 54% were openly accessible. Of the 46% closed-access publications, 85% had permission to self-archive in a repository, but only 16% of archivable publications were actually deposited.
Natural gas closed at $3.27/MMBtu, confined in a descending wedge since March. U.S. exports rise due to Europe’s LNG pivot, but domestic surpluses and Canadian supply shocks keep volatility high.

U.S. markets fell sharply Tuesday, with the Dow dropping 424.56 points, as the 10-year Treasury yield hit three per cent, while Canada's TSX fell 75.06 points, mitigated by gains in materials and gold sectors.

Ontario Premier Kathleen Wynne's comment that if young people don't vote, "somebody who looks like me is going to vote, some senior person, older than me, some white person" is criticized as ageist and racist. Critics argue it presumes old white voters' interests oppose those of young people and minorities, and that such identity politics would be unacceptable in a workplace.

Global stock markets rose after Federal Reserve chair Janet Yellen indicated a possible interest rate hike as soon as March, signaling confidence in the U.S. economy. Asian markets mostly finished higher, while U.S. crude oil prices fell.

Gary Gensler, a Senior Lecturer at MIT Sloan, introduces a course on blockchain and money. He surveys the class on cryptocurrency ownership and blockchain project experience. The week's study questions are: what is blockchain, and why might it be a catalyst for change in finance. He discusses the history of the internet, cryptography, and the challenge of moving money online, which Satoshi Nakamoto addressed with a peer-to-peer electronic cash system. Blockchain is described as a time-stamped append log secured by cryptography and consensus. The course will explore blockchain's potential in finance, covering technical, commercial, and public policy hurdles, and will examine both minimalist and maximalist perspectives.

Digital laggards restrict data access, hoard data as power, and favor business judgment over data-driven decisions. Digital leaders encourage data collection, use metrics for goals, and provide transparent data access. Digital leaders align organizations with data-driven objectives, while laggards struggle with goal-setting and misalignment. Data culture is central to digital leaders, but laggards face cultural misalignment. Organizations fall into four patterns: data novice, insight ready, tech enabled, and data reliant.

A pooled analysis of six Phase II trials found 54% of patients no longer met PTSD criteria after MDMA-assisted therapy. The FDA designated it a breakthrough therapy for PTSD. A Phase 3 study confirmed safety and efficacy, showing significant symptom reduction compared to placebo with therapy.

On January 28, 2016, Amazon.com, Inc. announced its fourth quarter 2015 and year ended December 31, 2015 financial results via a press release (Exhibit 99.1) and included information on non-GAAP financial measures (Exhibit 99.2).

Ireland is highly exposed to exchange rates, particularly the dollar and sterling. A low euro-to-dollar rate has boosted US tourism, while a low sterling-to-euro rate deters UK visitors. Brexit raised concerns about the euro-sterling rate. Exchange rates affect importers, exporters, tourism, and holidaymakers, potentially harming SMEs. The euro has strengthened against both sterling (from 76 to 91 pence) and the dollar (from $1.05 to $1.18). The author believes the euro's rise exceeds ECB preferences. The outlook is uncertain, with ECB decisions and Brexit as key influences. Tourism firms have limited hedging options; importers from the UK benefit, while exporters to the UK struggle.
Browns coach Kevin Stefanski is noncommittal on naming rookie Shedeur Sanders as the backup quarterback after trading Joe Flacco, stating he will "let the week play out" and make a decision later.

A University of Michigan study found that 21% of Gen X women and 10% of men in their 50s and early 60s meet criteria for ultra-processed food addiction, far higher than the 12% of women and 4% of men aged 65-80. The addiction was linked to poor health, weight issues, and social isolation. Researchers suggest marketing of "diet" ultra-processed foods to women in the 1980s may be a factor.

The Bank of England will keep the £5 polymer note in circulation and issue the £10 polymer note as planned in September, despite concerns over animal fat traces. It rejected costly alternatives like destroying or delaying notes. Over 134,000 people signed a petition against tallow use. The Bank will consult publicly and decide on plant-based substitutes for the £20 note by summer 2017.

A large, pants-like rock formation called Qarlinngua exists in Canada's Arctic, about 80-90 km southwest of Arctic Bay, Nunavut. It is a sea arch formed by erosion, made of sedimentary rock, and is only reachable by boat during a short summer window. The formation is over 50 meters tall and was confirmed as real by local sources and geologists, despite initial online skepticism.

The passage examines career transitions of lecturers and education personnel in Indonesian state higher education institutions, focusing on adaptation and impact. It reviews literature on career transition theories, including Schlossberg's 4 S model (situation, self, support, strategies), and uses a grounded theory approach with snowball sampling of six key informants. Findings identify eight main categories (situation, self, support, strategies, behavior, role, learning, perception) and propose a career transition adaptation model, noting dual roles and reciprocal 4 S relationships. The study concludes that transitions cause behavioral, role, learning, and perception changes, with limitations including narrow institutional focus and potential researcher bias.
On September 10, 2019, Bob Iger resigned from the Board of Directors of Apple Inc.

The speaker discusses being hit in the head, but is more concerned about being run into the boards from behind. He felt comfortable after his first shift, played well but tired in the third period. He attributes cramping to travel and dehydration, which was resolved. He cannot change his playing style and is focused on contributing to the team. A doctor reviewed his CT scan, stating his current risk is no different from September, as the healing process is mostly complete. He is excited to play at home with a normal routine. He believes the team needs better execution and passion, and expects them to play harder for a chance to win the Stanley Cup at home. He questions the shot clock's accuracy but says it should not dictate the game. The CT scan was arranged after he asked if he could play following Doug's injury. His family and management were supportive of the decision.
The judgment for the plaintiff is affirmed with costs, based on the trial judge's opinion.

Mathematics anxiety is a widespread issue affecting all age groups, causing tension and avoidance of mathematics. This bibliometric analysis of 324 Scopus-indexed articles (2013-2023) examines trends, key journals, authors, and international collaborations. The study found that mathematics anxiety research is growing, with the highest publication count in 2022 (56 documents). The most published journal is *Frontiers in Psychology* (39 documents), the most productive author is Garcia-Santillan (10 publications), the most prolific country is the United States (62 documents), and the most relevant affiliate is the University of Barcelona (23 documents).

North Korea warned the US it is "ready to hit back with nuclear attacks" and displayed new intercontinental and submarine-launched ballistic missiles during a parade marking the 105th anniversary of Kim Il-sung's birth. Official Choe Ryong-hae stated the country is prepared for an all-out war. The parade occurred amid speculation of a new nuclear test. China's Foreign Minister warned conflict could break out at any moment, and no Chinese representatives appeared at the parade.

NVIDIA Corporation filed a Form 10-Q for the quarterly period ended July 26, 2020. The report includes unaudited condensed consolidated financial statements and notes, covering the acquisition of Mellanox Technologies Ltd. on April 27, 2020. Revenue for the three months ended July 26, 2020 was $3,866 million, with net income of $622 million.

This application provides a detection model training method and apparatus, and a terminal device. The method includes: determining an initial training model comprising an initial detection model and an adaptive model; obtaining a training sample comprising source domain data with first images (including a first identifier for target object presence and a second identifier for domain) and target domain data with second images (including a third identifier for domain); obtaining a detection result from the initial detection model and a domain classification result from the adaptive model; calculating a loss function value based on these results and identifiers; and adjusting a parameter value in the initial training model according to the loss function value to obtain a final detection model.

Enron's influence in Washington is highlighted by a conversation between its chairman, Kenneth Lay, and FERC chairman Curtis Hebert, where Lay offered support in exchange for policy changes. The New York Times reports Hebert may be replaced. Enron's Dabhol project in India faces contract cancellation by the Maharashtra State Electricity Board over unpaid bills and performance disputes.

Teams must prepare for three jump ball situations: defensive (opponent advantage), even (equal chance), and offensive (own advantage). Defensive tips involve early rotation, watching the jumper's eyes/hand, and specific alignments (box, diamond, "Y") with rotations. Even jumps require boxing out, coordinated rotations, and watching the jumper. Offensive plays (e.g., Possession, Double Tap, Split, Jumper Fly, Forward Fly, Spread, Tandem, Loop) use height advantage and set plays, maintaining defensive balance.

Apple removed several ICE-tracking apps from its App Store, including ICEBlock and Eyes Up, following claims from US attorney general Pam Bondi that such tools endanger ICE officers. Developers like Joshua Aaron and Mark are fighting the bans, with Mark appealing twice and planning further appeals. The apps remain on Google Play and websites. Apple cited a guideline prohibiting defamatory or discriminatory content, while Google also considers ICE officers a vulnerable group. Legal experts say the apps involve protected speech under the First Amendment. The Trump administration has threatened prosecution, and researchers warn of risks from centralized platform control.

Tropical Depression 02W made landfall in the eastern Philippines on April 15, 2017, with maximum sustained winds near 25 knots. It weakened to a remnant low pressure area over the Philippines and moved into the South China Sea. By April 17, NASA's Terra satellite observed its remnants as an elongated area of clouds. The Joint Typhoon Warning Center stated that wind shear and drier air would prevent re-intensification.

Alberta's education minister indicated the province may allow parents to pay school bus fees despite Bill 1, which eliminated fees for students living 2.4 km or more from their designated school. Rocky View Schools faces a $1 million shortfall due to factors including Bill 1, inflation, and a carbon levy. Trustees are considering options like changing bell times or increasing bus commutes, and may extend their April 12 decision deadline.

The Supreme Court is considering whether double jeopardy bars separate convictions under 18 U.S.C. §§ 924(c) and 924(j) for the same conduct. The parties agree that a clear congressional intent can allow cumulative punishments, but dispute which statutory language provides that intent. Key provisions discussed include § 924(c)(1)(D)(ii) and the "in addition to" language in § 924(c). The government argues § 924(j) lacks such language, so cumulative punishments are not authorized.

The passage provides mechanical, packaging, and orderable information for designated devices, which is subject to change. It includes details on status, material type, RoHS values, lead finish, MSL rating, part marking, and disclaimers regarding liability and warranties.

Schizophrenia spectrum disorder (SSD) affects ~1% of the global population. Developing a classifier for SSD using resting-state functional connectivity MRI faces challenges: accuracy, generalisability, across-session variability, and lack of specificity. The research aimed to develop a clinically viable rs-FC biomarker for SSD using a large harmonized dataset and a LASSO algorithm, and to explore if the diagnostic biomarker could also serve as state and staging markers. The LASSO classifiers achieved 79.6% accuracy in the discovery dataset and 77.3% in the validation dataset. Voting classifiers showed significantly higher sensitivity than LASSO classifiers. Forty-seven important functional connectivities were identified, with a laterality imbalance observed in the involved brain regions.

Amazon's mobile accessory kit allows Alexa integration in devices like Jabra Elite 65t earbuds ($170). Alexa in earbuds lacks native OS support, cannot make calls or play Spotify, and only works with Amazon Music. It supports timers and alarms but not reminders, and cannot send texts or navigate. Sound quality is excellent, but battery life is 5 hours with 10 extra from the case, and no tracker feature exists. Alexa performs poorly compared to smart speakers, requiring phone use for many tasks.

Shohei Ohtani started NLDS Game 1 for the Dodgers against the Phillies. He pitched 14 games in 2025 with a 1-1 record, 2.87 ERA, 62 strikeouts, and 15 earned runs in 47 innings. He pitched over four innings only three times. The Sporting News tracked his live stats.

Following the Las Vegas mass shooting, country musician Charlie Daniels called the event an "anomaly" and a "nut," arguing that fear would let "the bad guys have won." He agreed with NRA support for regulating "bump stocks" but opposed stricter gun laws, citing Chicago's strict laws as a "slaughterhouse" and claiming politicians "don't know what the hell they're talking about."

Digital leaders encourage risk-taking, experimentation, and long-term development, viewing sensible risks and deliberate experimentation as fundamental to competing. They consider themselves learning organizations that adapt through continuous feedback and measurement, valuing the learning from experiments even when goals are unmet. They also invest in individual development, particularly in critical thinking skills, for long-term success.

The passage analyzes solar radiation data from the Mauna Loa Observatory (MLO) to assess atmospheric clarity and the effects of volcanic eruptions. It finds that, aside from volcanic periods, atmospheric clarity at MLO has been unchanged since 1980. After the El Chichon and Pinatubo eruptions, maximum and average solar radiation decreased similarly, with average downwelling solar radiation 24.5 W/m² lower during volcanic periods. However, clouds partially offset this by rearranging to allow more sunlight through, increasing downwelling radiation by about 7 W/m². Despite a 25 W/m² reduction in solar radiation for two years, temperature records from MLO and other Hawaiian stations showed no change. The author offers no definitive explanation for this lack of temperature response.

The speaker praises Winnipeg's passionate hockey fans, the strong organization led by Mr. Chipman, and the MTS Centre arena. They recall a "white out" game and fans chanting "we want the Jets." They note minor differences between Henrik and Daniel Sedin, with Henrik being more talkative. They discuss strategies for playing against goalie Thomas, emphasizing shot selection and giving credit for saves.

Energy sector trading involves gaining exposure to multiple energy stocks for diversification and profit, via ETFs like XLE or a stock portfolio. The S&P 500 energy sector includes oil and gas companies and related businesses. Major ETFs tracking it are VDE and XLE. The sector had a one-year total return of 52.81% as of July 18, 2022, compared to the S&P 500's -9.28%. The five biggest stocks are Exxon Mobil, Chevron, ConocoPhillips, EOG Resources, and Schlumberger. Two XLE trading strategies are described: one with 198 trades, 0.61% average gain, 65% win ratio, 13% max drawdown, and 2.1 profit factor; another with 335 trades, 0.21% average gain, 59% win rate, 8% max drawdown, and 1.75 profit factor. Diversification is emphasized as valuable.

The passage compares Canada's big five banks, which dropped 4.6% to 7.5% from February highs, with five small-cap lenders that saw drops of 1.6% to 28%. Using five criteria (beta, earnings yield, dividend yield, payout ratio, dividend history), MCAN Mortgage Corporation ranked first, Atrium Mortgage Investment Corporation third, and Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce second. Small-cap lenders offer higher dividend yields and lower price swings but have lower liquidity and less diverse business models.

The passage details two defensive strategies against the Hawk Offense: "Basic NBA Show & Recover" and "All Out 'SOS' Disruption." The Hawk Offense involves a wing isolation, high post shuffle cut, and weakside post up. The "Show & Recover" method uses defenders to force cutters wide and recover. The "SOS" method uses a double team trap on the ballhandler, with specific rotations and contact switches to disrupt the offense.

AMD released two new high-end graphics cards, Radeon RX Vega 64 and Vega 56, to compete with Nvidia's GTX 1080 and GTX 1070 respectively. The Vega 64 is not a GTX 1080 Ti competitor. AMD's FreeSync technology and cheaper monitors are an advantage, and Enhanced Sync improves the experience. The Vega 56 is priced $50 lower than the GTX 1070 in the US, but UK pricing varies.

A party may be convicted for malicious mischief for wounding an animal trespassing on his field, as the animal's damage does not justify injuring it. The conviction of the plaintiffs in error for shooting a mare was affirmed.

Old paper £10 notes will cease to be legal tender on 1 March and can be swapped for new polymer notes at banks, building societies, post offices, or the Bank of England, possibly with ID. The new polymer notes, featuring Jane Austen, entered circulation on 14 September, last longer, and have enhanced security and tactile features.

The safety position is a complex defensive role, positioned deepest to stop big plays. It includes free safeties, who roam the field, and strong safeties, who play closer to the line. Safeties must cover passes, stop the run, and communicate effectively. Notable players include Troy Polamalu, Ed Reed, and Ken Houston. A great safety provides confidence, creates turnovers, and limits the quarterback's options.

The Great Barrier Reef has recovered from near-extinction five times in 30,000 years, migrating 20 cm to 1.5 m per year in response to sea-level changes. Researchers note current environmental stresses, including rapid sea surface temperature and acidification changes, may be unprecedented. Past death events occurred 30,000, 22,000, 17,000, 13,000, and 10,000 years ago due to exposure, sea-level rise, or sediment. The reef may die again naturally, but human-induced climate change's impact is uncertain.

Following the 2024 Arab Summit in Bahrain, the "Hope" initiative was launched to address the over 10 million Arab children out of school (UNESCO, 2018). The report focuses on the Syrian conflict, where over two million children are deprived of education due to war, displacement, and school attacks. It uses a triangulation methodology (interviews and surveys) to examine impacts like trauma, resource scarcity, and disrupted learning. Proposed solutions include immediate emotional and academic support, and a long-term "Hope Initiative" for a sustainable educational framework.
Primatologist Jane Goodall died on October 1 at age 91. Her legacy includes not only stories of living chimpanzees but also the enduring study of their skeletons.

The indigenous community of San Andrés Hueyapan, living near the Popocatépetl volcano, finds its eruptions preferable to earthquakes, but a September 19 earthquake followed by renewed volcanic activity has caused constant stress. Authorities advised residents to be prepared for a possible eruption. The earthquake damaged many homes, and residents are scared, though they have a peaceful relationship with the volcano. Ashfall was reported after recent eruptions.

Sean "Diddy" Combs was sentenced to 50 months in prison and a $500,000 fine for transporting sex workers across state lines. He was convicted on two Mann Act counts but acquitted of more serious charges. The judge cited his abuse of power over women. Combs apologized in court, calling his actions "disgusting." Prosecutors had sought 11 years; his defense asked for 14 months. Additional civil lawsuits against Combs are pending.

The passage states that DAX 40 and Euro Stoxx 50 have better performance during the futures expiration week than any random week. The average gain for DAX 40 expiration week is 0.39% with a 57% win ratio, while any random week gains 0.12%. For Euro Stoxx 50, the average gain is 0.3% with a 54% win ratio, compared to 0.18% for any random week. December is the best month for both. The week after DAX 40 futures expiration performs poorly, with an average loss of 0.1% and a 47% win ratio. The backtest for the week after expiration uses a 100% margin strategy, not futures backtesting.

The Second Circuit affirmed the conviction and sentence of Samuel Israel III, finding no abuse of discretion in the district judge's refusal to recuse herself and no procedural or substantive error in the 20-year sentence.

For the UC1825BEVM-CVAL, an RCD clamp uses a resistor and capacitor with a diode to clamp the switch node voltage. Starting values are found via testing. The clamp voltage is calculated using Equation 30, where Kclamp is recommended as 1.5 for about 50% overshoot. Starting resistor and capacitor values can be determined using Equation 31 and 32, based on parasitic inductance and allowed voltage change.

This patent application describes methods for producing an elastomeric composition containing dispersed carbon black particles. The method involves treating hydrophilic carbon black particles with a dispersant that is miscible in a hydrophobic silicone pre-polymer, mixing the treated particles into the pre-polymer, and then curing the mixture. The dispersant has a carbon-black-affinic moiety, such as an amino, acrylate, or epoxy group. The carbon black particles have specific properties, including a volatile matter content of at least 1.5%, a pH of at most 5.0, and an ID/IG ratio of at least 0.8. The resulting composition can be used in articles like intermediate transfer members for printing systems.

The passage details design requirements for an ADS8860 ADC application, including three filters for noise reduction and stability, a PGA848 front end with a nominal 318kHz bandwidth, and a 2.5V reference voltage for the PGA848 REF pin generated via a voltage divider and buffered by an OPA192 op amp. It also provides power supply recommendations (nominal ±15V), layout guidelines for performance, and mentions simulation software (TINA-TI) and support resources.

The Supreme Court reversed the Court of Appeals' decision, holding that the veteran was entitled to seniority status as a journeyman mechanic in North Little Rock as of November 3, 1955, because the District Court found he would have achieved this but for his military service, and the possibility that supply and demand might have prevented his automatic promotion does not defeat his claim under the relevant statutes.

U.S. stocks rose on Monday, led by the S&P 500 and Nasdaq, as gains in technology and semiconductor shares offset energy stock weakness. Investors remained cautious over a potential government shutdown that could delay economic data releases, complicating Federal Reserve decisions. Despite hawkish remarks from a Fed official, markets priced in a modest rate cut. The rally showed resilience amid political and inflation concerns.

A Russian journalist, Arkady Babchenko, appeared alive at a news conference after his murder was staged by Ukrainian authorities to foil an alleged Kremlin hit plot. Ukrainian police had reported he was shot multiple times. The head of the Ukrainian Security Service said a Ukrainian citizen was allegedly paid $40,000 by Russian security services to organize the killing, which was part of a larger alleged plot.

Americans spent over $100 billion on summer vacations last year. Travel reduces stress and health risks but is costly. Tips include: start with a budget using tools like Excel or budgetyourtrip.com; use travel websites like Expedia; avoid foreign transaction fees on credit cards; check cell phone roaming charges; travel in the off-season; sign up for airline newsletters; and search for local deals.

PortMiami's economic impact rose to over $41 billion, up $12.8 billion, according to a study announced by Mayor Carlos Gimenez. The port contributed $288 million in taxes and added 116,000 jobs since 2012, totaling 300,000 jobs. Cargo increased by nearly 1 million tons in 2016, and cruise passengers hit a record 5.1 million. The study's accuracy was questioned by the Miami Herald, but Gimenez defended the numbers. A new $247 million Royal Caribbean terminal is expected to generate $500 million annually.

The ARM Cortex-A8 Subsystem controls the device, handling configuration of subsystems, peripherals, and external memories. It includes the ARMv7 ISA, Thumb2, JazelleX, Media Extensions, and an Interrupt Controller. The processor supports multi-tasking, memory management, and debug, with a Harvard architecture, NEON SIMD engine, VFPv3 coprocessor, separate L1 caches, and a 128-bit interconnect. It connects to an ETM for real-time trace, with a trace port linked to a 32KB ETB buffer.

A National Weather Service zone forecast for extreme southwestern California, issued July 4, 2018, covers multiple zones including coastal, inland, valley, mountain, and desert areas. It includes high surf advisories and excessive heat watches for various regions, with daily temperature and weather condition forecasts from July 4 through July 10, 2018.

The President recommends the third Thursday in August as a day for public humiliation and prayer, due to a Congressional request and the ongoing war. The day is for offering homage to God, acknowledging transgressions, seeking forgiveness, and praying for divine protection, guidance, peace, and the restoration of peace.

The Blue Ridge Poison Control Center warns of increased natural dangers in spring, including poisonous plants, mushrooms, spiders, and snakes. It advises against self-treatment for toxins, as folk remedies often cause harm, and recommends wearing proper clothing, checking boots, and staying aware.

By 2024, ESPN faced major challenges from the streaming era, including declining cable subscribers (from 100 million to an estimated 70 million), rising live sports rights costs, and increased competition. In response, Disney launched ESPN+ in 2018, confirmed a direct-to-consumer "flagship" ESPN service for 2025, and in 2024 announced a joint venture with Warner Bros. Discovery and Fox to create Venu Sports, a bundled sports streaming service. The company was attempting to balance extracting value from its declining linear television business while investing in streaming for long-term growth.

The passage criticizes IEX for having a split identity: IEX One, which uses a speed bump to benefit buy-side traders within the SEC's flawed NMS, and IEX Two, which aims to disrupt the market but is hindered by IEX One's tactics. The author argues the speed bump is an implicit fee and not a true market disruptor, and that IEX must bypass the NMS to achieve market dominance.

The U.S. economy added 200,000 jobs in January, with unemployment at 4.1 percent. Average hourly wages rose 2.9 percent year-over-year. Eighteen states increased minimum wages in January, affecting 4.5 million workers. Job growth under Trump has been similar to under Obama. African-American unemployment rose to 7.7 percent in January from 6.8 percent in December.

IT buyers often compare Oracle Exadata and HPE Vertica, according to IT Central Station. Exadata users praise its "smart scan" feature, while Vertica users value its columnar storage for faster "hot data" access. Users note Exadata needs better patching and Vertica's documentation requires improvement. IT Central Station offers a 68-page report comparing the systems based on user reviews.

The passage discusses Coronation Street's sensitive portrayal of suicide, shares the author's personal experience with a suicide attempt, and recounts Cheryl Fialka's story of her husband's suicide 33 years ago, highlighting the lasting pain and unanswered questions for loved ones.

The Stable Operations TRACC, a product of a partnership between CCi and R&G Global Consultants, uses big data to scale stable manufacturing operations, potentially increasing plant capacity by 15-20% within six months. Cargill facilitated the partnership. The product addresses industry challenges through data analytics, the TRACC methodology, and blended learning modules.

The passage discusses the low female literacy rate in Pakistan (51.9% overall, 40.8% in rural areas) and identifies multiple barriers to women's education, including patriarchal culture, poverty, lack of facilities, early marriages, and illiterate family environments. A quantitative study using surveys of illiterate and literate women in rural Pakistan and Azad Jammu Kashmir found common challenges: management problems, patriarchal culture, motivational issues, financial problems, and lack of educational institutes. The study concludes that despite government efforts, significant challenges remain, and suggests solutions such as monthly seminars and legislation for compulsory women's education.

The Pakistan Super League will allow franchises to draft new players if contracted international stars opt out of the March 5 final in Lahore due to security concerns. A new draft is scheduled for Feb. 22. The Pakistan Cricket Board has promised top-level security, but a recent bombing in Lahore has raised doubts. PSL chairman Najam Sethi stated the final aims to showcase Pakistan and bring international cricket back.

After her 20-year marriage ended, the author, who had been a stay-at-home mom, realized she knew little about their finances. With help from a friend and a financial planner, she compiled documents, set a budget, and made a retirement plan. She also rebuilt her career, finding a job she has held for seven years. She is now confident in her financial future and proud of her professional independence.

Interior Secretary Ryan Zinke is visiting Maine to review the Katahdin Woods and Waters National Monument, a privately donated 87,000-acre site with a $40 million endowment. The author, who moved to Maine 24 years ago, describes the state as a respite with a timeless inland wilderness. The monument is seen as a positive economic driver for rural Maine, but Governor Paul LePage opposes its designation. Zinke will hear from local supporters and experience the area firsthand.

Content-based image retrieval is a promising solution for botanical identification, with smartphone apps enabling low-cost ecological monitoring. The LifeCLEF 2014 plant identification task aimed to measure and boost identification tool performance using a realistic dataset of 60,962 pictures of 500 species from 1,608 contributors. The task evaluated multi-image plant observation queries, with the best results from IBM AU using Fisher Vector encoding and CNN, achieving a score of 0.471.

The TILER includes an additional 4-GByte addressing range, enabled by a 33rd address bit, for accessing the frame buffer in rotated and mirrored views. This range is only accessible to the HDVPSS and ISS subsystems. Other masters can access a single view through the 512-MB TILER region in the base 4-GByte address map.

The CAG 2015/16 report identifies public procurement weaknesses causing government losses, including non-compliance, mismanagement of eight contracts worth Sh63 billion and $1 billion, irregularities in Sh23.98 billion procurement without competitive quotes, delays in Sh23.32 billion projects, Sh2.48 billion procurement without tender board approval, and Sh11.253 billion in contracts without valid agreements. Examples include unvetted contracts by the Ministry of Water and Irrigation and Registrar of Political Parties. Asset management issues were also noted, with 12 embassies having 37 dilapidated buildings and ten undeveloped plots.

In soccer, an offensive switch is an exchange of positions between two attacking teammates to beat defenders. It can be "called" (oral) or "natural" (without a call), and may involve the ball or not. The basic switch forms an "X" pattern with diagonal runs. A vertical switch exchanges positions front-to-back, while a lateral switch exchanges side-to-side. The objective is to confuse defenders. After the switch, players may use "Switch back" to return to original positions.
On September 25, 2022, Tesla appointed Joseph Gebbia to its Board of Directors. He waived cash compensation and, with the rest of the Board, waived equity compensation until July 2023.

The passage introduces MatterMech, a benchmark of 4,800 questions across eight nanomaterial synthesis subdomains, developed from ~17,000 papers using multi-agent validation and human evaluation. It evaluates 14 LLMs via multiple-choice questions (MCQ) and text-infilling (TIF) tasks. Key findings: LLMs excel at logical reasoning but struggle with precise terminology; larger models and principle-guided prompting improve performance; reasoning-specialized models show a gap between MCQ and TIF results. The work also releases MatterDB, a dataset of 31,735 papers with extracted mechanisms.

On May 20, 2015, NVIDIA Corporation held its 2015 Annual Meeting. Stockholders voted to elect twelve directors, approved advisory compensation for named executive officers, and ratified PricewaterhouseCoopers LLP as the independent auditor for fiscal year ending January 31, 2016.

Tropical Storm Nate is strengthening in the western Caribbean, moving north-northwest at 21 mph with 60 mph winds. West Tennessee may get heavy rain between Saturday evening and Sunday morning, though the risk for severe weather is low.

Dr. Edith Mbagwu recommends using the SMART goal-setting method (Specific, Measurable, Attainable, Realistic, Time-based) to help people set and maintain realistic weight loss resolutions, with examples for each component.

A weak EF-0 tornado touched down near the Prince William County line on Friday, August 11, between 6:08 and 6:10 p.m., with 75 mph winds. It caused a mile-long, 100-yard-wide damage path at Broad Run in Fauquier County. No one was injured.

The document is Apple Inc.'s Form 10-Q for the fiscal quarter ended June 29, 2019, containing unaudited condensed consolidated financial statements and notes. It reports net sales of $53.8 billion for the quarter and $196.1 billion for the nine months, with net income of $10.0 billion and $41.6 billion, respectively. The passage discusses the quantization of the Dirac theory, focusing on the use of anticommutators instead of commutators to ensure a positive-definite Hamiltonian and enforce the Pauli principle. A data transfer frame between the device and host controller begins on the falling edge of CONVST/CS and ends on the subsequent rising edge. The frame ends when the host pulls CONVST/CS high. The device treats frames with 32 SCLKs as optimal, fewer as short, and more as long. Data write operations are synchronous to SCLK. The device supports various SPI and source-synchronous protocols for data transfer. It features nine configuration registers for settings like device ID, reset/power control, and data output control.
