A study of 121 future preschool and primary school teachers found most had accurate conceptions of robots, with 22 misconceptions identified, primarily depicting robots as electrical appliances. The most common robot depiction was animal-shaped (47.1%), and the dominant perceived function was educational (52.9%). Most respondents gained real-life experience with robots at their faculty.

The Green Bay Packers signed veteran tackle Byron Bell, who has started 56 games at right tackle and played multiple positions. He joins a line with uncertainty at right tackle, where Bryan Bulaga is recovering from a torn ACL, and other options like Jason Spriggs and Kyle Murphy have injury concerns.

Out of bounds situations are a major part of the game, requiring teams to be prepared to inbound from the baseline, sideline, and full court. The primary objective is to inbound the ball successfully and get it to the best players. Plays should be simple and practiced. Inbounders need fundamental skills and a commitment to team play. Successful plays involve vision, communication, execution, and timing. Players must know rules, such as the five-second count, inbounder restrictions, and that a defender reaching over the vertical plane results in a technical foul.

The passage discusses the impact of the Fourth Industrial Revolution (4IR) on education, emphasizing the need for new pedagogies like digital game-based learning (DGBL) and stealth assessment (SA). It highlights that DGBL can enhance teaching, learning, and assessment by developing cognitive and non-cognitive skills, while SA uses AI and machine learning to assess learners in real-time during gameplay. The integration of DGBL requires a multidisciplinary approach and faces challenges such as cognitive load and validity concerns.

Neutrino sources include supernovae, Big Bang relics, cosmic rays, the sun, accelerators, and nuclear reactors. Experimental parameters (length, energy, mass sensitivity) vary by source: solar neutrinos (~1 MeV, 10⁻¹⁰ Δm²), atmospheric (10²–10⁵ MeV, 10⁴–10⁷ m), reactor (MeV range), and accelerator (10³–10⁴ MeV). Solar neutrino experiments (e.g., Homestake, SNO) observed fewer electron neutrinos than expected, with SNO confirming total flux matches theory via neutral-current scattering, providing evidence for oscillation. Atmospheric neutrinos from cosmic-ray interactions showed muon neutrino disappearance. Accelerator experiments (e.g., T2K) use near and far detectors to study oscillation. Reactor neutrinos from nuclear fission study anti-electron neutrino disappearance via inverse beta decay, with survival probability observed as a function of distance over energy.

The Medina City School District has a 5.2-mill permanent substitute levy on the May 8 ballot, replacing a 5.9-mill levy expiring in December. Kids First Medina held a rally to raise awareness, emphasizing it is not a new tax and a bond issue will decrease tax bills. The levy would maintain programs, add all-day kindergarten, and reinstate high school French. Supporters include school board members, city council members, and Superintendent Aaron Sable.

The speaker describes a long-awaited, exciting experience, recalling past feelings from childhood championships that remain unchanged. They emphasize maintaining normal routines to avoid mental exhaustion.

On Feb. 10, APU students attended The GIG formal dance at the La Cañada Flintridge Country Club. The event had a "La La Land" theme, two dance floors (DJ and live jazz), and activities like cartoon drawings and photography. Tickets cost $20. Students praised the venue, music variety, and ambiance.

A court in Kochi convicted migrant labourer Muhammed Ameerul Islam for the rape and murder of a Dalit law student. He was found guilty under IPC sections 302, 376, and 376(A), but not under section 201 or the SC/ST Act. Sentencing is scheduled for the next day.

The passage discusses the emergence of AI policy as a field, noting its absence from CS curricula. It synthesizes US and EU AI regulatory developments, highlighting US volatility and the EU's structured AI Act. A framework is proposed to integrate AI policy discussions into CS courses, using perspectives (socio-political, translational, technical) and dimensions (scope, power, agency) with guiding questions.

During a penalty kick, the ball is live upon being kicked. Attacking teammates must be positioned behind the penalty mark, at least 10 yards away, outside the penalty area and arc, and cannot enter until the ball is touched and moves forward. They must react to rebounds or saves, while the kicker cannot retouch the ball until another player does. If the goalkeeper secures the ball, the attacking team must switch to defense. Violations result in a retake or indirect free kick.

An Italian man, Luca Traini, shot six African migrants in Macerata in a racially motivated attack. He was captured with an Italian flag and had made a fascist salute. The attack followed the arrest of a Nigerian migrant in connection with an Italian woman's death. Traini had been a candidate for the anti-immigrant Northern League.

Rutgers historian Mark Bray, author of a 2017 book on antifa, is attempting to flee the US for Spain after far-right influencers incited an online campaign resulting in death threats. His first attempt to board a flight was blocked when his reservation was mysteriously canceled. The threats escalated after President Trump's executive order targeting antifa, leading to a petition from conservative student activists and coverage by Fox News. Bray has reported the threats to police and plans to stay in Spain until the end of the academic year.

The device features a programmable gain amplifier (PGA) that converts input signals for the internal SAR ADC and adjusts the common-mode level. The PGA gain is set via RANGE_SEL[3:0] bits. A second-order, low-pass antialiasing filter at the PGA output mitigates noise. An integrated high-bandwidth, low-noise amplifier buffer drives the ADC input. The device operates with an internal (4.096V) or external voltage reference, selected by the INTREF_DIS bit. It supports single-ended and differential inputs with bipolar and unipolar ranges, outputting data in straight-binary format. The device has alarm features for input voltage and AVDD supply, with programmable thresholds and hysteresis. It uses a multiSPI digital interface supporting various data transfer protocols and connection topologies, including daisy-chain. The device has three functional states: RESET, ACQ, and CONV. It features nine configuration registers for programming. The device also includes NAP and power-down modes for power saving.

A multiscale model linking atomistic simulations to macroscopic growth kinetics predicts GaN epitaxy growth rates. The model uses molecular dynamics to show ordered liquid Ga layers at the GaN-Ga melt interface, metadynamics to quantify free energy barriers for N adatom adsorption and migration, and kinetic Monte Carlo simulations to identify a diffusion-controlled growth mode. A parameter-free continuous model based on these free energy profiles predicts facet-dependent growth rates (0.01-0.04 nm/s), which are validated by experimental MBE growth and TEM analysis. The study establishes that for systems with low N solubility in liquid Ga, the free energy profile for adatom adsorption and migration at the solid-melt interface is the decisive factor for crystal growth kinetics.

On May 20, 2016, Amazon.com entered a credit agreement for a $3.0 billion unsecured revolving credit facility, replacing a 2014 agreement. The three-year term may be extended. At its May 17, 2016 annual meeting, shareholders elected ten directors, ratified Ernst & Young as auditor, and did not approve three shareholder proposals.

The passage covers financial market updates, including USD/JPY dropping over 2.0% after a weak NFP report, GBP/USD awaiting the BoE decision, and BTC/USD testing support near 112,000. It also mentions NVIDIA stock with a $7 trillion target, Bitcoin hovering above $123,000, and various investment tools and risk disclosures.
In 2017, Nigerians abroad sent $21.9 billion home, a 12% increase from 2016, the highest in Sub-Saharan Africa.

On April 7, 2015, NVIDIA's Compensation Committee adopted the Fiscal Year 2016 Variable Compensation Plan, offering eligible executives cash bonuses based on achieving corporate revenue targets. The plan sets target variable cash compensation for named executive officers, ranging from $150,000 to $1,000,000, as a percentage of base salary.

Sino Gas & Energy Holdings agreed to a A$530 million takeover offer from U.S. private equity firm Lone Star, with shareholders receiving A$0.25 per share, a 19 percent premium. The board recommended the offer due to risks in China, though some brokers and small investors expressed surprise or opposition. Shareholders will vote in late August or September.

Chinese President Xi Jinping told the NPC that China must not become complacent, stating that only socialism can save it. The NPC lifted the presidential term limit, allowing Xi to remain president for life. Xi reaffirmed his vision to "rejuvenate" China, stressed unity, and vowed to thwart any separatist attempts regarding Taiwan. The NPC confirmed Xi's second term, ratified "Xi Jinping Thought" into the constitution, and established a new anti-corruption agency.
The Treaty of Guadalupe Hidalgo, signed February 2, 1848, was amended by the U.S. Senate, ratified by both parties, and proclaimed by President James K. Polk on July 4, 1848.

Of the $473,151.26 gross award from the United States, $172,962.35 was for interest. The document certifies the ownership and registry of the bark Cape Horn Pigeon, listing its owners, dimensions, and crew.

In 2018, financial markets face multiple potential crises, including concerns over stock valuations, emerging markets, and Italy/euro instability, though current gyrations are less extreme than past crises. The Federal Reserve's interest rate hikes are pressuring Treasury yields and valuations. While past crises like the dot-com bubble and 1997-98 emerging market chaos were more severe, current turmoil in Turkey, Argentina, and Indonesia has not caused similar contagion. China and the U.S. banking system are seen as stable, though bears like George Soros warn of a major crisis. Some analysts advise reducing risk amid uncertainty.

At Mobile World Congress, graphene-based technologies were presented as crucial for 5G development, including flexible ICs for receivers/transmitters, a cryogenic cooling pump, and graphene photonics for high-speed data. Industry involvement is high, but challenges remain in manufacturing, such as yield and material consistency.

In soccer, the second defender provides support by positioning behind and inside the first defender, goalside and far enough back to react if beaten. They maintain distance, announce arrival (e.g., "support"), and adjust position as the play moves. The support defender calls for jockeying or tackling, as they can see the field. If the first defender is beaten, the support defender may take over or perform a defensive switch.

The S&P 500 closed at its lowest since early July, losing 2.36% last week after a 1.5% gain the prior week. It fell 3.33% in two days from a record high. The VIX rose to 21.90. Crude oil dropped 2.79% on Friday and another 2.1% after OPEC+ announced production hikes. The market is set to open about 0.5% higher.

This study compared Auditory Brainstem Response (ABR) and Auditory Steady-State Response (ASSR) thresholds in 64 infants (0-6 months) with normal hearing (NH) or conductive hearing loss (CHL). ABR and ASSR thresholds were poorly correlated. Air-bone gaps (ABGs) were significantly larger for CHL groups in both ABR and ASSR. Minimum normal intensities for ASSR were higher than for ABR. The ABR demonstrated better sensitivity and specificity for detecting mild CHL than the ASSR. The authors conclude the ABR remains the gold standard for infant hearing assessment in EHDI programs.

Enron's Dabhol Power plant in India stopped generating electricity after its sole customer, the Maharashtra State Electricity Board, stopped buying power. Enron stated it remains open to discussions regarding the dispute over overdue payments. The plant is operational but not producing power.

Ethereum is near $4,450 after rebounding from $4,100, within a rising wedge pattern. On-chain data shows $84 million in outflows, indicating accumulation. A break above $4,800 could lead to $5,200, while $4,300 is key support.

RS Components calculated how long it takes the top five Forbes billionaires to earn various salaries, based on their net worth increases over the past year. Jeff Bezos earned the most ($39.2 billion) and takes the shortest time, while Bill Gates earned the least ($4 billion) and takes the longest.

An international journalists' rights organization is urging Russian authorities to investigate threats against Novaya Gazeta, which reported gays being tortured and killed in Chechnya, following official denials and calls for retribution.

Turing GPUs enable real-time ray tracing through dedicated RT Cores, which accelerate BVH traversal and ray-triangle intersection testing, offloading the SM. This is combined with advanced denoising to reduce required rays per pixel. Turing also introduces Variable Rate Shading (VRS) for dynamic shading rate control, Texture Space Shading (TSS) for decoupled shading, and Multi-View Rendering (MVR) for efficient multi-viewpoint rendering. The architecture supports a Hybrid Rendering model combining rasterization, ray tracing, and AI, with features like Deep Learning Super-Sampling (DLSS) and NGX for AI-based image enhancement.

The passage discusses inclusive education, emphasizing the need for legal frameworks at global, regional, and national levels to guide its implementation. It highlights a gap in research on educational leaders' awareness of these frameworks, particularly in Addis Ababa's resource centers. A qualitative study with 15 participants (including principals, teachers, and Ministry experts) found that while global policies (e.g., CRPD, SDGs) and national policies (e.g., Ethiopia's Constitution, Education and Training Policy) exist, awareness varies: Ministry experts and itinerant teachers are more informed than school principals and teachers. The study concludes that increasing leaders' policy awareness is crucial for effective inclusive education.

This is an HTML email newsletter from Energy Central Direct, dated March 5, 2002, sent to khyatt@enron.com. It contains news sections on the gas and electric power industries, including top stories, articles on the Enron debacle, national energy policy, mergers, and other industry topics. It also includes sponsored content and information about the newsletter service.
On October 24, 2018, Microsoft Corporation filed a Form 8-K reporting its financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2018, via a press release attached as Exhibit 99.1.

Surmodics, Inc. VP Charles W. Olson sold 1,201 shares at $26.00 each, totaling $31,226.00, now owning 27,386 shares valued at $712,036. The stock opened at $25.40, with a market cap of $335.46 million, P/E ratio of 33.42, and beta of 1.00. The company reported Q3 EPS of $0.26, beating estimates of $0.09, with revenue of $18.20 million, up 4.6% year-over-year. Several institutional investors adjusted holdings, and analysts issued rating changes.
Oprah Winfrey revealed she experienced depression for six weeks after her 1998 film *Beloved* underperformed at the box office, which she overcame through a gratitude practice.

Amazon's fall Prime Day sale has ended, but some deals remain. WIRED editors selected these deals from products they have tested and approved. The list includes discounts on tech, home, and other items, and was updated on October 9, 2025, to remove expired deals.

The passage discusses the evolution of yoga from a separate practice to one integrated with fitness, outlining various yoga styles (e.g., Ashtanga, Vinyasa, Iyengar, Bikram, Yin, Restorative, Kripalu) and their benefits for athletes. It advises choosing a style based on personal goals and training needs, and ends with an advertisement for a free outdoor yoga event.

Xiaomi launched the Mi Band 3 in Shenzhen, China, as the successor to the popular Mi Band 2. It features a larger 0.78-inch OLED display, waterproofing up to 50m, call and app notifications, motion tracking, and up to 20 days of battery life. It is priced at Yuan 169 (approx. Rs 1,780) and is expected to launch in India.

Dundee & Angus College hairdressing and beauty therapy students won seven golds, eight silvers, and six bronzes at the AHT Scottish finals. Darcie Westland won Student of the Year. Other winners included Amy Gray, Harriett Pitt, and the team bridal event winners Shannon Allen and Dani Kelbie.

The President submits a report on Texas's condition, stating no steps have been taken to acknowledge its independence. He notes Congress's previous resolutions favoring recognition upon proof of a stable civil government. He argues that premature recognition of a state forcibly separated from another is delicate and could be seen as unfriendly. The U.S. policy is to recognize new governments only as a matter of fact after clear evidence, avoiding interference in internal disputes. He suggests Congress should decide on recognition, especially if it might lead to war. He cites past precedents with Spain's colonies, where recognition was delayed until independence was fully established. Given Texas's ties to the U.S. and its desire for annexation, he advises caution, recommending the U.S. maintain its current stance until Texas's sovereignty is indisputable.

The government shutdown prevented the release of the September jobs report. Non-governmental data suggests the labor market plodded along, with anemic employment growth but a stable market overall. The unemployment rate likely held at 4.3%. The market is uneven, with health care thriving while other fields lag. Other indicators, like ADP data and state-level claims, show a similar picture of softening conditions, though spending data from Bank of America and Fiserv showed growth.

On April 28, 2016, Amazon.com, Inc. announced its first quarter 2016 financial results via a press release (Exhibit 99.1). The company began allocating stock-based compensation and "Other operating expense (income), net" to its segment results, combined as "Stock-based compensation and other." Historical segment results for 2015 and 2014 are in Exhibit 99.3.

Modeling light-matter interactions at the nanoscale is crucial for quantum technologies, but classical Maxwell solvers cannot capture quantum features like entanglement. Quantum models are often idealized and incompatible with realistic device simulations. This paper introduces a stochastic differential equation (SDE) approach using a stochastic Bloch vector to bridge quantum dynamics and classical electromagnetic solvers, validated against the Mollow triplet spectrum. The method addresses limitations of symmetric diffusion matrices by allowing complex, non-symmetric noise correlations.

The passage reports on Czech financial market events, including a spike in crown hedging costs, a 14.2% rise in Q1 car registrations, a Russian extradition case, and RWE's potential sale of a Hungarian utility stake. It also includes market snapshots and press digest items on oil pipeline exports, OKD's insolvency bid, and Prague Airport investment plans.

Chefs' Warehouse trades at a 33.3x forward P/E, with a target price of $79.3 by FY 2027 implying 36% upside. EPS is forecasted to grow at a 16.7% CAGR through 2028. The company shows 8.4% revenue growth, margin expansion, and pricing power, with a luxury client base insulating it from economic downturns.

The speaker accepts Chris Pronger's one-game suspension for a hit that resulted in injury, but criticizes the league for not holding a hearing on Chris Neil's hit on Andy McDonald, which they describe as a deliberate elbow to the head. They argue Neil's hit was more dangerous and went unpunished, while Pronger's was a reaction hit. The speaker does not fault the officials for missed calls, noting the league can still impose supplementary discipline. They emphasize their team is physical, not dirty, and stress the importance of preserving body contact in hockey.

The University of New Haven received Saudi government approval to open a branch campus in Riyadh next fall, aiming to enroll 13,000 students within a decade. The campus will support Saudi Arabia’s Vision 2030 economic diversification plan. The university has partnered with the Saudi royal family since the late 1990s. It still needs approval from its U.S. accreditor.

The President transmits departmental reports in response to a Senate resolution. He found a military commandant acting as civil governor in California and did not disturb this arrangement. He sent Thomas Butler King to California and officers to California and New Mexico with specific instructions. He expressed a desire for those territories to form state constitutions if prepared, but did not authorize any government without Congress's assent or allow interference in their domestic institutions. He has no information on laws passed by a supposed California government or a census. He advised early statehood applications to avoid national dissension. He recommends Congress admit California as a state if its constitution complies with the U.S. Constitution. He questions the expediency of establishing a territorial government for New Mexico before its boundary dispute with Texas is adjusted. He asserts that any condition on California's admission affecting its domestic institutions would be seen as an invasion of rights. He believes the slavery question will be settled by causes independent of Congress and recommends awaiting that outcome.

This document standardizes the GHCB memory area for SEV-ES and SEV-SNP guests, defining Non-Automatic Exits, guest state exposure, and specific actions like NMI handling and SMP booting. It introduces version 2 of the GHCB protocol with hypervisor feature advertisement, support for SEV-SNP, and various new NAE events including APIC ID list retrieval, page state changes, SNP guest requests, AP creation, restricted injection, and Secure AVIC. The document also covers guest identification of SEV-ES support, SMP booting challenges, NMI handling, debug register support, and specifies that SMM and nested virtualization are not supported.

NASA Glenn's Venus simulator (GEER) replicates Venus's harsh surface conditions—high pressure, temperature, and a supercritical carbon dioxide atmosphere—to test rock survival and new durable electronics. A computer chip lasted 21 days, a breakthrough for longer missions. Studying Venus, Earth's "evil twin," helps predict Earth's climate and may reveal microbial life in its cooler upper atmosphere.

In the third period of the last game, the team spent minutes in their own end and did not score. The first period was easy for the opposing defense. The opponent is the best backchecking team, with all forwards backchecking hard. The team's forechecking lacked speed and effective dumps. In the second period, a stop on Bondra failed to provide momentum after a bad first period.

The OxyChem deal allows Occidental Petroleum to reduce leverage, sharpen its E&P focus, and position for stronger growth, potentially leading to valuation clarity and expanded P/E multiples. For Berkshire Hathaway, the acquisition is immaterial to its diversified operations and financials.

Work has started on a £252M Viridor resource recovery centre at Avonmouth, operational by 2020, to convert Somerset's non-recyclable household rubbish into energy, powering 44,000 homes and reducing landfill use. The process involves high-temperature treatment, with emissions meeting EU standards and monitored by the Environment Agency.
Andrew Triggs pitched six strong innings, Mark Canha homered, and the Oakland A's beat the Texas Rangers 3-2. Adrian Beltre drove in both Rangers runs but injured his left hamstring.

Martin James Cooper, 66, was convicted of 30 historical child sex offences for abusing eight children aged 11-16 at Warminda Hostel between 1978-1983. He was acquitted of one charge. Testimony described a culture of fear, including violent and sexual acts. His bail request was denied, and he was remanded in custody.

The S&P 500 closed Friday at its lowest since early July, losing 2.36% for the week. The index fell 3.33% over two days from a record high. Friday's drop pushed the VIX to 21.90, its highest since June 23. Crude oil fell 2.79% on Friday and another 2.1% after OPEC+ announced production hikes. The market is expected to open about 0.5% higher Monday.

The passage discusses a player's readiness to play despite a ligament issue, emphasizing his average hands and ability to handle puck-related tasks. It covers team strategies, including replacing Mike Modano's defensive role, Eddie Belfour's emotional challenges and recovery, and a player's back injury rehab. It also addresses goaltender interference concerns, a player's groin injury, team pride, and the importance of a critical game against Buffalo, with penalties and defensive efforts highlighted.

A study found women preferred the body odor of men who ate more fruits and vegetables, while men who ate more carbohydrates smelled less appealing. The research assessed men's skin color and diet, then had women rate the smell of their sweat after exercise. Meat did not affect attractiveness but made odor more intense. The relationship between diet and body odor is indirect, as sweat is metabolized by skin bacteria.

Maya Kodes, a holographic pop star created by Montreal's Neweb Labs, has released a song on iTunes, recorded an EP, performed 30 concerts, and gained 5,500 Facebook followers. Developed over 18 months by Yves St-Gelais, she has performed at the company's Prince Theatre and will launch her EP with a 360-degree livestream on June 13. A Toronto performance is planned, with aspirations for a world tour and simultaneous multi-venue shows.
On January 26, 2017, Microsoft Corporation filed a Form 8-K reporting its financial results for the quarter ended December 31, 2016, via a press release furnished as Exhibit 99.1.

A rumor from Mac Otakara suggests the iPhone 8 may have a polished stainless steel frame like the Apple Watch, sandwiched between glass plates, with an under-display Touch ID sensor and vertically positioned dual cameras for VR or AR shots.

The passage evaluates fine-tuning (FT) and multi-head fine-tuning (MHFT) of universal interatomic potentials (UIPs) for predicting surface properties of unary (Au), binary (RuO2), and ternary (BiVO4) systems. FT models consistently outperformed models trained from scratch (TS) and zero-shot (ZS) models, achieving lower prediction errors with fewer data points. MHFT mitigated catastrophic forgetting, improving accuracy on out-of-domain surfaces (Ag, Cu, Pt, Ir) compared to FT, though with increased computational cost. The study provides guidelines for selecting strategies to extend UIPs beyond bulk materials.

Human rights education (HRE) in higher education often focuses on legal norms and avoids sensitive historical cases, risking retraumatisation of students with lived or intergenerational trauma. Trauma-informed HRE (TIHRE) aims to empower learners by integrating principles of safety, trust, and collaboration into teaching. The article recommends educators develop a self-aware teaching persona, embed trauma-sensitive content design, and use dialogic learning to foster advocacy and healing.

High-performance computing (HPC) is a game changer for product and process innovation in manufacturing, according to 81% of surveyed decision makers. HPC enables complex calculations, increases quality and intensity of use, unlocks new usage scenarios, and boosts innovation and agility. Currently, 26% of enterprises use professional HPC, and 39% plan to. Key challenges include security concerns (72%), high energy consumption (58%), and the high cost of on-premises infrastructure, leading 87% of HPC users to prefer external HPC infrastructures.

This paper investigates whether the textual content of earnings press releases predicts stock returns on announcement days. Using over 138,000 press releases from 2005-2023, the authors find that soft information from press releases is as informative as earnings surprises in explaining stock price reactions. FinBERT provides the most effective extraction of soft information. The market efficiently incorporates this information by market open, preventing profitable trading strategies based on public signals, but if information is available before release, traders can identify high-return stocks with better-than-random accuracy.

The Federal Reserve's fourth interest rate hike in 18 months will increase costs for credit card holders, adjustable-rate mortgage borrowers, and home equity line users, but fixed mortgage and auto loan rates remain largely unaffected. Savers may see slight increases on high-yield CDs and accounts, though average rates stay low. Overseas, higher U.S. rates attract investment, strengthening the dollar and potentially causing capital outflows from developing countries. Consumers with poor credit may face higher costs, especially for used car loans. Retirees with bonds are advised to maintain balanced portfolios.

A UCLA study found that meat-based pet food for U.S. dogs and cats generates about 64 million tons of CO2 equivalent annually, comparable to 13.6 million cars. Pets account for 25-30% of U.S. meat consumption's environmental impact. The study's author noted the numbers are "surprisingly large" but did not advocate vegetarian diets for pets. Some experts argue most pet meat comes from rendered byproducts that would otherwise be waste, while others note vegan diets can be healthy for dogs but risky for cats.

U.S. government bonds fell after a jobs report showed wage gains and the first job losses since 2010. The 10-year Treasury yield rose to 2.370%, and the two-year yield rose to 1.511%, both rising for four consecutive weeks. The economy lost 33,000 jobs, the unemployment rate fell to 4.2%, and average hourly earnings rose 2.9%. Traders focused on wage gains as inflationary, while attributing job losses to hurricanes. Yields pared increases due to potential geopolitical unrest. Fed-funds futures showed an 88% chance of a rate increase by December, up from 73% a week ago.

Steven Kean forwarded an email from Ann Schmidt containing a Wall Street Journal article about three small entrepreneurs who won bids for oil from the Strategic Petroleum Reserve but struggled to secure financing. The email also includes a Washington Post article about Artesia Technologies' $26 million funding round, a Houston Chronicle article analyzing the proposed Houston Rockets arena deal, and an editorial supporting the arena referendum.

The Vegas Golden Knights will build their first roster through the NHL expansion draft, with existing teams submitting protected lists by Saturday. Teams can protect either 11 players (seven forwards, three defencemen, one goalie) or nine players (eight skaters, one goalie), and must expose specific players. The Knights' selections will be announced June 21.

The University of Notre Dame received two gifts totaling $205 million: $150 million from Matthew and Joyce Walsh for the School of Architecture, and an endowment from Francis and Kathleen Rooney for the Rooney Institute for the Study of American Democracy.

Apple Inc. filed a Form 8-K on February 13, 2018, reporting the results of its Annual Meeting of Shareholders. Shareholders elected eight directors, ratified Ernst & Young LLP as auditor, approved executive compensation, and approved the amended Non-Employee Director Stock Plan. Two shareholder proposals, on proxy access and a human rights committee, were not approved.

The passage argues that Apple should allow users to teach Siri new words, pronunciations, and functions, such as "Hey Siri: learn this word, 'ahh’rv,' spelled A R V," to improve its learning and reduce its perceived stupidity. It notes that current features, like address book nicknames, are limited and cannot handle natural verbal requests. The author suggests that user-taught words could filter up through machine learning, enabling Siri to handle tasks like "find all photos with me in it photobombed by Arv."

Students returned to North Park Elementary School a week after a shooting that killed a teacher and a student. The superintendent called the reopening a step toward healing, noting tightened security and available counselors.

Amsterdam's Buiksloterham district is regenerating its docklands experimentally, focusing on localization, sustainability, and new living/working ways. The project, De Ceuvel, is a temporary ten-year co-working hub on renovated houseboats with phytoremedial gardens. It uses composting toilets, wormeries, solar panels, heat exchangers, and a local cryptocurrency (Jouliettes) to reduce waste and energy use. This approach heals polluted land cheaply, aiming for inclusive, circular development rather than luxury apartments.

Kilauea's eruption continues after 27 days, with fast-moving lava threatening Leilani Estates and Lanipuna Gardens at 600 yards per hour, and volcanic haze reaching Guam, where residents with respiratory issues are advised to stay indoors. The eruption has produced phenomena including lava fountains, "Pele's hair" glass fibers, and high volcanic gas emissions, with at least 40 homes destroyed and 2,000 acres covered by lava.

Peel police believe three suspects in the March 13 assault of an autistic man at Square One are originally from British Columbia's lower mainland and recently traveled to the GTA. The video has over 300,000 views, and police are asking West Coast residents for tips. Suspects are described as South Asian men, 5-foot-10, with varying builds and clothing.

The RSI indicator works on Bitcoin and cryptocurrencies as a momentum indicator, but mean reversion strategies (buying low and selling high RSI readings) are ineffective. Momentum tests on Bitcoin, Ethereum, and Dogecoin showed positive results, with a sample RSI(5) strategy on Bitcoin achieving a 122% CAGR versus 101% for buy and hold, with lower drawdowns.

The U.S. Supreme Court is considering an appeal regarding an Arkansas inmate's execution. Don Davis had his last meal as courts decide his fate. The Arkansas Supreme Court stayed two executions; the state's attorney general seeks to overturn this for Davis. The 8th Circuit overturned a federal judge's halt on all eight executions, ruling the lethal injection method, including midazolam, does not cause undue severe pain.

This manuscript illustrates the value of critical approaches to quantitative research in education, intended for scholars, students, and educators. It argues quantitative research is not objective, presents author positionalities, and defines quantitative criticalism as combining methods with epistemologies to advocate for social justice. It outlines tensions, including white supremacist roots of statistics and unclear thresholds of criticality, and provides examples using critical race theory, queer theory, and intersectionality. Implications encourage epistemological reflection and coalition-building.

The passage introduces SpinGPT, an LLM-based agent for Spin & Go poker, using supervised fine-tuning on 320,000 professional decisions and reinforcement learning with 270,000 solver-generated hands. SpinGPT-SFT achieved 80% exact accuracy on professional data and a 13.4 BB/100 win rate against Slumbot. The final SpinGPT model improved bet sizing (MAE 0.30 BB) and beat SpinGPT-SFT by 13.2 BB/100, though it showed lower accuracy on solver data (72% exact). Limitations include format mismatch and numerical errors.

A global learning crisis, worsened by pandemic closures, climate change, conflict, and economic slowdown, costs an estimated US$129 billion annually. Youth unemployment nears 30% in lower-income countries, and 20% of youth globally are NEET. A skills gap is deepening, with 39% of current job skills expected to become obsolete by 2030. Educational mismatch affects two-thirds of young adult workers in lower-income countries, driven by undereducation. The Global Partnership for Education (GPE) supports partner countries to improve learning and equip youth with 21st-century skills through policy, financing, and partnerships.

The passage discusses effective field theory with fine tuning, focusing on two-nucleon non-relativistic scattering. It explains that a naive dimensional power counting can incorrectly label an operator as irrelevant when it is actually relevant, indicating a need for a more complex power counting, often involving expansion around an interacting fixed point. The theory uses contact interactions and is simple enough to calculate all loops. The effective range expansion is derived, showing that the amplitude can be expressed as a geometric series of bubble diagrams. The scattering length is found to be unnaturally large, indicating fine tuning. To address this, a renormalization scheme (off-shell momentum subtraction or power divergence subtraction) is used to treat the leading operator as relevant, allowing a power counting where the scattering length is handled to all orders. This approach propagates the fine tuning to other operators via renormalization group equations, enabling predictive power for the theory.

Over 10 lakh students in Karnataka's government and aided schools (Classes 4-9) require remedial classes, based on a state-conducted Students Achievement Survey of over 36 lakh students from 50,000 schools. About 4.5 lakh need help in Math and Science. Marks cards with star ratings will be issued.

A NASA satellite captured an infrared image of the northern lights over northern Canada on Dec. 22. The aurora occurs when solar wind particles interact with Earth's magnetic field, energizing atmospheric gases that release photons of specific wavelengths, creating different colors. The most magnificent displays occur roughly every 11 years, with the last cycle peak in 2013.

In soccer, a defender's stance against a ball carrier involves one foot forward and one back, with the dominant leg usually behind, feet about 18 inches apart on a 30-degree angle, body balanced on the balls of both feet, knees bent, and arms out with elbows bent. The stance is modified by field location: on the right side, the left foot leads; on the left side, the right foot leads; in the center, it is optional. This positioning aims to block the opponent from moving inside and force them toward the sideline.

The Iso play is a downhill running scheme using a Fullback as a lead blocker on a linebacker, designed to overpower a defense and get the ball vertical quickly. Its strengths are getting the ball downhill fast and simplicity. Its weakness is dependence on personnel, requiring large, powerful linemen and a rugged fullback. The passage details blocking assignments for Iso against 3-4 Odd and 4-3 Even fronts, and mentions variations like Shotgun Iso and Weakside Iso.

GBPJPY is the forex quote for the exchange rate between the British Pound and Japanese Yen, formed as a cross pair of GBPUSD and USDJPY. It is considered a minor pair. The best time for intraday trading is during the Asian session (23:00-06:00 GMT) and London session (08:00-16:00 GMT). Methods improve user experience by processing binaural sound to a location behind a sound source, such as an image on a display, so the listener perceives the sound as originating from the source. This addresses challenges with near-field sound localization, where convolving sound to the source's exact location is difficult. Sound can switch between binaural and mono/stereo based on device actions like rotation or face detection.

The passage discusses orthonormal expansions in infinite-dimensional spaces, the use of prolate spheroidal functions for time-frequency energy concentration, and the basics of Pulse Amplitude Modulation (PAM) for data transmission. It explains the separation of source coding and modulation, the choice of signal constellations, and the Nyquist criterion for avoiding intersymbol interference by designing filters with band-edge symmetry, such as raised cosine filters.

Rutile RuO₂ has been investigated as an altermagnetic candidate, but debate persists over whether it intrinsically hosts altermagnetism. This study uses multiple techniques to examine exchange bias (EB) in RuO₂/Fe heterostructures. Neutron diffraction found no magnetic ordering in RuO₂ films. Polarized neutron reflectometry revealed canted moments at the RuO₂/Fe interface sensitive to field history. Atom probe tomography and electron microscopy identified an iron oxide interlayer containing Fe₃O₄ at the interface. EB was absent in RuO₂/Ni heterostructures but present in TiO₂/Fe/Ru bilayers without RuO₂. The authors conclude that EB in these heterostructures arises from interfacial chemical interactions and oxide formation, not from intrinsic altermagnetism in RuO₂.

This paper explores applying a Bayesian probabilistic approach to relevance-theoretic pragmatics, focusing on implicature comprehension. It discusses the relevance-theoretic comprehension heuristic, which involves accessing interpretive hypotheses in order of accessibility until relevance expectations are met. The authors propose a probabilistic computational model in ProbLog that captures this heuristic as an optimization model, evaluating interpretive hypotheses based on Kullback-Leibler divergence and Herbrand base size. The model focuses on the audience's comprehension process, assuming hypothesis generation is not amenable to explanatory study.
Strange Brigade will launch on August 28 for PS4, Xbox One, and PC. Pre-orders include the Secret Service Weapons Pack. A Deluxe Edition with a season pass is also available.

BioSafe Systems has hired Carleton Birk as Operations Manager and Tenaya Becker, Ester Mastronardi, Patrick Clark, and Kyle Pickles as Technical Sales Representatives for regions in the USA and Canada.

They address a blindside hit on a player (Horty) who went to the hospital, criticizing the hit but deferring to the league. The power play and penalty kill are evaluated, with the latter praised for its performance. Cybersecurity researchers simulated a ransomware attack on a water treatment plant to highlight vulnerabilities in industrial control systems. The attack could shut valves, increase chlorine, and show false readings. No real attacks on such systems have been reported, but ransomware is a growing problem elsewhere. Weak security in these systems makes them potential targets.

Global internet usage growth slowed to 7% from 12%, with 3.6 billion users. Smartphone sales stalled. Voice computing improved, with Google's accuracy at 95%. Amazon Echo is in over 30 million homes. E-commerce rose 16% to 13% of retail sales; 49% of shoppers start on Amazon. Netflix leads subscriptions at 117 million. Uber has 31 million drivers; Airbnb 600,000 hosts. The Sansa c200's record button is on the front panel. To record, press and hold it for 2 seconds, then press the middle silver button to stop. The device requires a USB 2.0 port. Photos are transferred using Sansa Media Converter, which supports JPEG, TIFF, PNG, BMP, and GIF. Files can be dragged and dropped in MTP or MSC mode. The device supports MP3, WAV, WMA, and secure WMA formats. It has a 1-year limited warranty.

A deep neural network trained on a hyper-scale dataset of 4.5 million images achieved 96% classification accuracy in identifying medical imaging modalities (CT, MRI, PET, X-ray). The best performing model was a ResNet-18, which also achieved a balanced accuracy of 86%.

The Chinese sent 2,000 troops to Korea to prevent rebels from reaching the capital, but Korean forces suppressed the rebellion before Chinese troops engaged. Japan also sent troops, leading to a standoff where neither side would withdraw. The U.S. instructed its minister to work for peace.

The passage argues that mass formal schooling systems cause widespread, often unnoticed harm to students, which is morally unjust because it treats innocent children as means to ends. It categorizes this harm as structural, objective, and symbolic, and contrasts it with Montessori education, which rejects coercion and aims for positive peace. The author contends that contemporary Montessorians should adopt an educational pacifist stance, rejecting harmful practices and providing a nonharmful alternative.

The DAX index is Germany's main equity index, offering high liquidity and popularity. A DAX Trading Strategy provides diversification due to different trading hours and unique movements compared to US markets. The DAX 40, formerly DAX 30, comprises the 40 biggest or most liquid blue-chip stocks. Trading the DAX index provides access to a highly liquid market with low costs, and DAX trading strategies offer diversification into a market that moves differently than US equities.

The lecture introduces underactuated robotics, defined as systems where control inputs cannot accelerate the system in every direction, contrasting with fully actuated systems. Examples like ASIMO (conservative, high-energy walking) and passive dynamic walkers (efficient, dynamics-driven) illustrate the importance of leveraging natural dynamics. The course will cover nonlinear dynamics, optimal control, and computational methods (e.g., dynamic programming, reinforcement learning) to control underactuated systems like pendulums, walking robots, and flying machines.
The passage details the 2025 ALDS schedule between the Blue Jays and Yankees, including TV channels, live streams, and that Toronto won the season series 8-5.

Nick Mathewson, a Tor developer, presented on the Tor anonymity network, which has about 6,000 volunteer-operated servers and serves hundreds of thousands to millions of users. He discussed anonymity definitions, Tor's design using circuits and encryption, the importance of a large user base for anonymity, and challenges like traffic correlation and abuse. He covered hidden services, attacks and defenses, censorship resistance, and future work including key blinding and scaling improvements.

Seven months after deep cuts at the U.S. Department of Education, researchers are cautiously optimistic due to plans to reinstate 20 of over 100 terminated research contracts, a lawsuit reprieve for 10 federally funded centers, and a public request for guidance on modernizing the Institute of Education Sciences (IES). The American Educational Research Association rates IES at 3 or 4 on a 10-point scale, up from 1 a month ago, but cites severe staff shortages. The department hired Amber Northern to advise on IES reform, and has begun posting high-level assessment jobs. However, experts note limited resources, with NCES staff cut from 100 to three, and concerns about data quality and long-term impacts.

Saving a penalty kick is a stressful task for goalkeepers, with a success rate under 15% as approximately 80% of kicks are scored. Goalkeepers must follow Law 14, which requires them to stay on the goal-line until the ball is kicked. Coaches should support goalkeepers and train them using "read and react" techniques, focusing on cues like ball placement, run-up, and plant foot. Mental preparation includes visualization, positive self-talk, and breathing exercises. Physical training and research on opponents' tendencies are essential. After the kick, goalkeepers must remain calm and ready for rebounds, as the ball is live.

The passage discusses the importance of scoring first, gaining confidence from a power-play goal, and the team's reliance on young leaders like Jarome Iginla. It highlights the need for defensive discipline, limiting space for skilled players like St. Louis, and the mental toughness shown by goalie Kiprusoff after a rough game. Genomic sequences are analyzed using metagenomic binning, which clusters DNA fragments to reconstruct genomes. Traditional methods use deterministic embeddings from k-mer profiles, but these cannot handle sequences shared between genomes or those with similar profiles. The authors propose probabilistic embeddings that map fragments to distributions, capturing uncertainty. They introduce UNCERTAINGEN, a scalable framework with theoretical guarantees, showing improvements over deterministic methods on real datasets.

Jeff Davis Parish begins its first full school week after opening last Friday. Preparations included streamlining processes, campus preparation, bus driver training, and staff meetings to tailor teaching to student needs while meeting state requirements. The parish has a 92.5% on-time graduation rate, ranking fourth in the state, a three-point increase from last year.

A scoping review of 9 articles on graduate health professions education found that barriers and facilitators to belonging fall into three themes: environment, relationships, and personal factors. The study aimed to gather foundational knowledge on belonging for occupational therapy education.

The Supreme Court declined to hear appeals in several cases, including a defamation case against Alex Jones by Sandy Hook families and a Colorado case on parental rights regarding children's gender identity. The court also denied review in cases involving Section 230 immunity for Grindr, a death penalty juror misconduct claim, and a Seventh Amendment jury trial challenge. Justice Alito expressed concern about the gender identity issue, and Justice Sotomayor dissented in the death penalty case.

A study tested a world model-based reinforcement learning (RL) approach for autonomous mechanical thrombectomy (MT) navigation. Using TD-MPC2, a model-based RL algorithm, across ten patient vasculatures and five navigation tasks, the agent achieved a mean success rate of 65%, significantly higher than the 37% achieved by the current state-of-the-art SAC algorithm (p < 0.001). TD-MPC2 also showed significant improvements in path ratio for several tasks, though procedure times increased. The study concludes that this approach demonstrates feasibility for multi-task generalization in autonomous MT.

Actress Allison Mack was released on $5 million bail to await trial for recruiting women as sex slaves for Keith Raniere's secret society. Police continue to search for the stolen bike, a white recumbent three-wheeler with red "Top End Force RX" lettering.

Strength training requires correct technique, warm-ups, and cool-downs to prevent injuries like rotator cuff issues, hamstring strains, herniated discs, tendonitis, and tennis elbow. Warming up increases blood flow and reduces injury risk; cooling down regulates blood flow. Tips include using proper form, not overexerting, seeking help, and consulting a doctor or trainer for persistent pain or new routines.

Over 3,400 UNT students are expected to receive degrees at fall 2017 commencement ceremonies on Dec. 15 and 16 at the UNT Coliseum and Murchison Performing Arts Center. A special ceremony for graduates attending the New Orleans Bowl will be held Dec. 15 at the Hilton New Orleans Riverside.

The petitioner argued the case was never reviewed by the Supreme Court on merits, citing new evidence against British Secret Service Force 136.

A sequence of graphs converges if the sequence of homomorphism densities converges for every graph H. The cut distance between two graphons is defined as the infimum over measure-preserving bijections of the cut norm of their difference. Theorem 1 states that a sequence of graphs converges in the sense of homomorphism densities if and only if it is a Cauchy sequence with respect to the cut distance. Theorem 2 states that every convergent sequence of graphs has a limit graphon. Theorem 3 states that the space of graphons, with graphons of distance zero identified, is compact.

An email from Steven Kean to Maureen McVicker forwards a Wall Street Journal article about three small entrepreneurs who won bids for oil from the Strategic Petroleum Reserve but struggled to secure financing. The email also includes articles about Artesia Technologies' funding, and a Houston Chronicle piece analyzing the proposed downtown arena deal.

A five-year-old girl with the rare CLOVES syndrome, causing severely swollen feet, will undergo a free double amputation in Melbourne by Professor Tony Pennington's team. Brought from Pakistan 18 months ago by Moira Kelly, she suffered malnutrition and bullying, and now seeks relief to walk and wear shoes.

The Centre has taken sole power to verify transitional GST credits claimed by taxpayers, potentially straining state relations. The CBEC justified this as only the tax authority with past records can verify. Of Rs 1.6 lakh crore claimed, only 5-7% are invalid. Attorney General Patrick Morrisey renewed a contract with the U.S. Consumer Product Safety Commission to help protect West Virginians from dangerous products. The program lets state investigators monitor stores for recalled items, such as appliances, clothing, and electronics, and ensure recall notices are posted. Since 2015, over 40 compliance checks have been conducted, with 25 more planned between February and September.

The CCAT Collaboration is building the Fred Young Submillimeter Telescope (FYST) and testing two instruments, Mod-Cam and Prime-Cam. Mod-Cam uses six flexible circuits ("stripline") to connect detectors to readout electronics. Prime-Cam will use 18 striplines. The paper characterizes the stripline's thermal conductivity and crosstalk. Thermal measurements found a Residual Resistance Ratio (RRR) of about 120 and thermal conductivity consistent with OFHC copper. Thermal loading estimates for Prime-Cam are lower than for Mod-Cam despite having more striplines. Elevated crosstalk was traced to the SMP-SMA transition PCBs, not the stripline itself. A redesigned PCB is predicted to reduce crosstalk by about 20 dB.

The passage describes three options strategies to participate in a potential upward movement of AMD stock without full capital risk: buying a $10 call option for $0.60, a call spread (buy $10 call, sell $12 call) for a net $0.50, and selling a cash-covered $10 put for $0.56, which can be combined with the call spread for a net credit of $0.06. A felon with a slungshot forced entry into a southeast Portland apartment. Police responded at 9:46 p.m. Thursday to the Stark Street Villa Apartments. They found a frightened woman and arrested suspect Jason A. Clifford, 37, on multiple charges. Two others with outstanding warrants were also arrested but are not believed to be involved.

The passage reviews various white-noise machines, including the LectroFan Classic, Snooz, Hatch 3, Hatch Rest, Babelio mini, Yogasleep Dohm, Momcozy portable, ErgoPouch, and others, detailing their features, sounds, timers, and pros/cons. The Inverted Hammer is a bullish reversal candlestick pattern that forms at the bottom of a downtrend, characterized by a small body at the lower end and a long upper shadow. It indicates buyers are gaining momentum. The pattern is not a standalone signal and should be confirmed with other tools like trendlines, support levels, and momentum oscillators. Backtests on the S&P 500 show a win rate of 53-65% over 1-10 days and an average gain of 0.36% per trade. It is the 11th most frequent pattern and is considered reliable, though it is ranked 39th in accuracy among 75 patterns. The pattern is mostly a buy signal.

President Trump will order an investigation into Chinese trade practices involving forced intellectual property transfers, potentially leading to tariffs. The move is separate from diplomacy on North Korea, though Trump has linked trade leniency to China's cooperation on North Korea. The investigation could take up to a year and may result in negotiated agreements or unilateral trade actions under Section 301 of the Trade Act of 1974.

Violet Brown, a 117-year-old Jamaican woman, is believed to have become the world's oldest living person after Emma Morano's death. She has credible birth documentation, according to the Gerontology Research Group, but Guinness World Records has not yet confirmed the title. Brown attributes her long life to hard work and her Christian faith.

A University of California, Davis study of 50,921 firearm deaths in California from 2000 to 2015 found a decline in gun homicides, driven by reduced gang violence and a 32% drop in black male homicides. The homicide rate fell from 4.19 to 3.13 per 100,000 by 2014. Researchers hope the study serves as a template, as federal funding for gun research has been restricted.

Digital laggards set aspirational, data-ungrounded goals that employees see as unachievable, leading to a "best effort" approach and a focus on process adherence over measurement. Digital leaders use data-driven, transparent objectives to align teams vertically and horizontally, though they risk over-reliance on data. Organizations fall into four patterns (data novice, insight ready, tech enabled, data reliant) and can target improvements to build a strong data culture.

The passage examines optimal pricing for a monopolist selling a single expiring item to strategic buyers with stochastic arrivals. The seller faces time pressure as the item becomes worthless at expiration, while buyers may delay purchases for lower prices. The authors model this as a Stackelberg game, introducing Value-Based Threshold strategies to analyze buyer equilibrium. They derive near-optimal pricing schedules: constant pricing for thin markets (low arrival rates) and linear discounting for thick markets (high arrival rates). Numerical simulations validate these policies and show a transition based on seller time sensitivity. The work extends prior research by formally proving equilibrium existence in continuous valuation settings and assigning time-dependent disutility solely to the seller.

USB-C and USB-A refer to physical connector shapes, not speeds. USB versions (e.g., USB4, USB 3.2) determine data transfer and power delivery, with the slowest link in the chain limiting performance. USB4 (up to 40 Gbps) is the latest version, built exclusively for USB-C. USB-PD enables charging up to 240 watts, and DP Alt Mode allows video over USB-C. Thunderbolt 4 (based on USB4) enforces stricter requirements, guaranteeing up to 40 Gbps and 100 watts. Thunderbolt 5 doubles bandwidth to 80 Gbps (up to 120 Gbps unidirectional) and supports 240-watt power delivery. Cable speeds must match device capabilities; using the included cable or checking listed speeds is recommended.

A literature review on diagnosing student learning problems and designing teaching activities is presented. An effective teacher diagnoses student responses to develop solutions (Darling-Hammond & Bransford, 2005). This diagnosis, a key teaching competency (Kukla-Acevedo, 2009), involves assessing learning performance characteristics (Artelt & Rausch, 2014; Deng et al., 2020). Student learning problems are observed through external behaviors reflecting internal cognitive processing (Deng et al., 2020). Instructional activities, as stimuli for cognitive processes (Gagné, 1985), include material presentation, discussions, and review. Classroom observers document student behaviors to deduce instructional effectiveness and diagnose learning challenges. The definition of diagnosing student learning problems involves teachers observing student performances during teaching activities to identify reasons for a lack of learning effectiveness. Observers record student performance in specific activities to explore cognitive processing, evaluating comprehension via worksheets and responses. When challenges are discerned, observers offer findings to teachers for evaluating instructional design. Studies show that teacher education students (TESs) can be trained to observe and diagnose learning performances, enhancing their pedagogical knowledge (Sims & Walsh, 2009; Murata & Pothen, 2011; Myers, 2012; Kramer et al., 2021), though they initially lack diagnostic observational skills (Bjuland & Mosvold, 2015). Further investigation is needed on the impact of diagnosing student learning problems on TESs' instructional design capabilities.

Amazon received a patent for a drone fragmentation system that would release components in a controlled sequence during malfunctions, using terrain data to direct parts to safer locations like water or forests, based on factors such as component cost and weather conditions.

The passage is a presidential address to Congress, reviewing the state of the Union in 1849. It covers peaceful foreign relations, including trade agreements with Britain, resolved diplomatic issues with France, and neutrality in European conflicts. Domestic matters include suppressing a military expedition to Cuba, financial deficits from the Mexican War, and recommendations for a tariff revision, agricultural bureau, and a transcontinental railroad survey. The address also discusses territorial governance for California and New Mexico, the need for a branch mint, and postal reforms, concluding with a defense of constitutional separation of powers and the Union's preservation.

Social media platforms are strengthening policies and using AI to moderate inappropriate content, but AI has limitations: it can recognize text and images but struggles with intent, is biased due to human training data, and cannot determine context. Human moderators remain essential, though AI helps prioritize and speed up their work. The rapid pace of technology outpaces ethical considerations, increasing the need for staff with humanities backgrounds.

Lobbyists for Connecticut towns asked the governor to ease administrative burdens and allow local cost-control reforms. They also seek changes to the municipal retirement system, easier arbitration for collective bargaining, and a higher percentage of land-transfer fees. Governor Malloy called the meeting productive, noting the budget stalemate creates uncertainty. Senate leader Looney disputed a claim that towns are not seeking to be "held harmless" on aid.

To obtain warranty service, contact SanDisk. You must return the product in tamper-resistant packaging, freight prepaid, as instructed. SanDisk will repair, replace, or refund the product. SanDisk disclaims all other warranties and is not liable for lost data or damages exceeding the product's purchase price. The Software is licensed for personal use with a SanDisk product only, with restrictions on modification and reverse engineering. The Software is provided "AS IS" with no warranties. Liability is limited to the amount paid for the Software.

A method and system for manufacturing an orthodontic appliance are disclosed. The method involves measuring tooth positions, receiving movement constraints, measuring malocclusion elements, generating multiple treatment plans, generating interim and final tooth positions for each plan, selecting a plan, generating an appliance model for each stage, and outputting fabrication instructions. The system includes a processor and memory configured to perform these steps.

Tesla, Inc. filed a Form 10-Q for the quarterly period ended September 30, 2018, reporting total revenues of $6.82 billion for the three months and $14.24 billion for the nine months. Net income attributable to common stockholders was $311.5 million for the quarter, while a net loss of $1.12 billion was reported for the nine months. Total assets were $29.26 billion as of September 30, 2018.

Patients with hematological malignancies and COVID-19 have high mortality. A study of 112 such patients receiving COVID-19 convalescent plasma (CCP) found 90-day overall survival of 64.9%. In a propensity score analysis of B-cell neoplasm patients, CCP was associated with a 63% decrease in death risk.

The passage lists 40 known silicon issues for the AMD Geode™ CS5535 Companion Device Revision A3, including problems with PIT operation, debug port hangs, PIC interrupt handling, DMA rotation, thermal alarm recovery, and clock control dependencies. Issue numbers are non-sequential as resolved issues are omitted.

On September 12, 2017, Apple Inc. issued and sold $5 billion in aggregate principal amount of Notes across four series: $1 billion of 1.500% Notes due 2019, $1 billion of 2.100% Notes due 2022, $2 billion of 2.900% Notes due 2027, and $1 billion of 3.750% Notes due 2047, under an underwriting agreement dated September 5, 2017.

Diana Containerships Inc. reported Q4 earnings of ($0.66) per share, beating estimates of ($0.77), with revenue of $5.40 million versus $7.50 million expected. Revenue fell 63.8% year-over-year. The company had negative return on equity of 11.99% and net margin of -350.33%. Its stock opened at $2.71, with a market cap of $24.82 million. Renaissance Technologies LLC increased its stake by 94.4%, owning 2.53% of shares. Zacks Investment Research upgraded the stock from “sell” to “hold.”

Enron Chairman Kenneth Lay received a $7 million bonus for 2000, a 79% increase from 1999, due to the company's "extremely strong" performance. Enron CEO Jeffrey Skilling projected 2001 revenue of $160-$170 billion. Enron presented plans for a power plant in Japan and is entering India's wind power market. The company also holds a stake in a project to supply gas to Dubai.

The passage discusses the Tampa Bay Lightning's approach to team building, emphasizing patience, home-grown talent development, and the importance of leadership. Key points include: no set timeline for success; reliance on drafting and player development over free agency; the evolution of players like Steven Stamkos and Victor Hedman as leaders; the role of coaching staff in developing young players; and the team's ability to overcome adversity in playoffs. The general manager and coach highlight the value of character, a strong program, and the support of ownership.

The Bittle tree, planted by Roanoke's first president, stood for over 100 years but was removed due to damage. Its wood was used to create the Bittle Tree of Life Cross for Antrim Chapel, inspired by Reverend Chris Bowen and built by George Arthur. The cross, 4'8" wide by 7'6" tall, symbolizes the College's roots and future.

Two women, May Baxter-Thornton and Emma Lewis, both survivors of child sexual abuse, have been appointed to the victims and survivors panel of the Independent Inquiry into Child Sexual Abuse (IICSA) to advise on reaching and listening to Welsh victims.
The Supreme Court of Louisiana granted a writ of review in the case of Robert Daniel Chappuis v. Sears Roebuck & Co., ordering the Court of Appeal to send up the record and notify counsel.

Electric Resistance Welding (ERW) is used for transporting vapor and liquid objects like petroleum and gas. ERW tubes are high-frequency resistance welded steel pipes with high production efficiency and low cost. ERW steel pipe quality is key, with inner and outer burrs removed to about 0.2 mm~0.5 mm. It uses hot-rolled coil raw material with wall thickness controlled by ±0.2mm, and is widely used in urban pipe networks.

A playback device can receive digital audio data, send a portion to an identification system, receive associated information, send that information to a control device, and play the audio. A control device can command the playback device to retrieve such information, receive it, and display a representation of the received information or metadata from a network location.

Rep. Ken Buck stated health care is a commodity, not a right, but the author argues it is integral to life and should be a right, advocating for Medicare for all. A second letter criticizes a headline about Denver paying a settlement to a teen killed by police, arguing the teen was committing a crime and the police acted in self-defense.

A directional illumination apparatus includes a backlight with plural light sources and a directional waveguide. The waveguide has an input end, opposed first and second guide surfaces, and deflects input light to exit through the first guide surface. A transmissive spatial light modulator receives output light. An input polariser is between the backlight and modulator, and an output polariser is on the output side. At least one additional polariser is on the input or output side, with at least one retarder between the additional polariser and the input or output polariser. This arrangement reduces off-axis luminance for privacy, while maintaining head-on luminance. The retarder may include correcting passive retarders and switchable liquid crystal retarders. The waveguide can image light sources into optical windows. A control system can switch between wide and narrow viewing modes.

A Deloitte study shows consumer confidence in autonomous vehicles is rising, with 49% now believing they are unsafe (down from 73% last year). Trust in brands developing the tech (53%) and traditional car manufacturers (51%) is key. However, 73% still prefer engine-powered cars over electric, citing range, price, and charging infrastructure.

The presidential election cycle theory, based on historical data, suggests the stock market performs better in the first two years of a U.S. president's term than in the last two. Midterm election years show weak performance until the 4th quarter. Yale Hirsch first quantified this effect, finding the Pre-Election Year is the best and Election Year second best. The theory is a strong seasonal pattern for market timing or dollar-cost averaging.

Intel includes a microcontroller (Management Engine) in its CPUs, connected to storage and network, always on, and partly designed at NSA request. Researchers presented a local exploit for arbitrary code execution on the Intel ME. The ME runs Minix and is closed-source. Mitigation options include firmware updates from System76 and Dell, detection tools, and the me_cleaner tool to disable it, though a computer without valid ME firmware shuts down after 30 minutes. The current exploit requires physical access; a network-based exploit does not yet exist.

New Jersey Governor Chris Christie signed a law strengthening legal protections for people with developmental disabilities and increasing family involvement in their care, prompted by the 2007 death of Stephen Komninos in a group home. The law allows unannounced state inspections twice a year, requires notification of parents or guardians within two to eight hours of a patient's injury, and mandates family meetings at least twice annually.

Mortimer J. Adler, a philosopher in education, focused on curriculum building and learners' capabilities, envisioning wholeness in educational management from a Christian perspective. His philosophy of perennialism upholds eternal values, arguing that opinion equals philosophy in learning. The passage discusses posthumanist education, humanism, and the deconstruction of anthropocentric supremacy. It examines Christian education management through family meals, spirituality, and multi-country comparisons. The study uses primary and secondary sources to analyze Adler's perennialism, emphasizing docility, obedience, and democracy in education. The conclusion argues for justice in education, rejecting scapegoating children, and highlights the importance of skepticism and intellectual enlightenment in obedience.

The Cleveland Browns may select Oklahoma quarterback Baker Mayfield with the No. 1 pick in the NFL draft, per ESPN. Browns GM John Dorsey remains open to all options, and head coach Hue Jackson says four top quarterbacks are in play. Mayfield, the 2017 Heisman winner, threw for 4,627 yards and 43 touchdowns in his senior season.

Jefferies Group LLC raised Ferguson Plc's price target from GBX 5,170 to GBX 5,240, maintaining a hold rating. Other analysts issued varied ratings and targets. The stock has an average Buy rating and a GBX 5,265.71 average price target. Shares traded at GBX 5,200.00, up 0.68%.
The VentureWire newsletter from May 30, 2001, lists executive changes at numerous high-tech companies, including new CEOs, CFOs, and VPs, along with several open executive search positions.

Nicola Sturgeon stated the Conservatives will use a snap election to "move the UK to the right, force through a hard Brexit and impose deeper cuts." She called the announcement a "huge political miscalculation" and accused Theresa May of putting party interests ahead of the country. Sturgeon said the move capitalises on "utter disarray" in the Labour Party and makes it more important to protect Scotland from a "right-wing, austerity-obsessed Tory government."

The MSPM0 MCU features an Arm Cortex-M0+ CPU with pre-fetch logic and I-cache, five operating modes (RUN, SLEEP, STOP, STANDBY, SHUTDOWN), two power domains (PD1, PD0), a power management unit with BOR and POR, a clock module with multiple oscillators and clocks, a DMA controller with 3 channels, an event manager, flash memory, SRAM, GPIO, IOMUX, a 12-bit ADC, temperature sensor, LFSS, VREF, comparator, security features, CRC, UART, I2C, SPI, IWDT, WWDT, RTC, timers, SWD interface, and a debug subsystem.

Lawyers for Venezuelan TPS holders asked the Supreme Court to uphold a district court order blocking the Trump administration from ending their protected status, arguing the order restored the status quo and that disturbing it would cause massive injuries.

Ed Sachse, 56, began his career as a teen with a window-washing business in Detroit, later becoming president of property services for Kennedy Wilson. He studied accounting at Michigan State, worked at Arthur Andersen, then moved to Los Angeles for a job at Douglas Emmett. He became a broker at Coldwell Banker, sold a school to the Simon Wiesenthal Center, and started his own property management company in 1993. Diagnosed with stage 4 non-Hodgkin lymphoma in 2001, he battled it for six years while running his business. The Great Recession led him to sell his company to Kennedy Wilson in 2009. He lives in Pacific Palisades with his wife, has two children, and plays guitar in a garage band.

President Rutherford B. Hayes, citing the Constitution and laws of the United States, issued a proclamation on July 18, 1877, regarding domestic violence and obstruction of laws in West Virginia, particularly at Martinsburg and along the Baltimore and Ohio Railroad. He admonished citizens against participating in these unlawful proceedings and ordered all persons involved to disperse by noon on July 19, 1877.

The invention enhances the field of view of a waveguide optical display by coating external surfaces of the waveguide, where guided light reflects internally, with a material having a refractive index of 1.0 or less. This reduces the critical angle for total internal reflection, allowing light from outside the original field of view to be retained and guided. The apparatus includes a first diffractive part to receive and diffract display light for guided propagation, and a second diffractive part to output the light. The coating material may be a meta-material.
