The passage discusses renewal processes and countable-state Markov chains. It reviews three major renewal theorems: the strong law for renewals, the elementary renewal theorem, and Blackwell's theorem. It then examines age and duration in renewal processes, deriving joint probabilities and marginal distributions. The discussion transitions to countable-state Markov chains, contrasting them with finite-state chains, and introduces concepts like recurrence, transient states, and first passage times.

In 2015, the author developed sepsis from a scratch, was in a coma for three months, and took a year to recover. Sepsis affects over 30 million people yearly, killing 6 million, and 40% of survivors suffer lasting symptoms. It begins with an infection, but the body’s uncontrolled immune response causes organ failure. Symptoms include pale skin, breathlessness, shivering, and nausea. There is no cure, but metformin and gene therapy show promise. Awareness is low globally; only 40% in Australia and 14% in Brazil know of sepsis. The best defence is public and medical awareness, including asking, “Could it be sepsis?”

The passage describes a face anonymization system for intelligent education, built on an enhanced YOLOv8 model (MSFF-YOLOv8) with a Contour-Adaptive Occlusion Refinement (CAOR) module. It achieves 96.02% accuracy and 22.67 fps processing speed, balancing privacy protection with preserving experimental details.

La-Z-Boy beats Stanley Furniture on 12 of 14 compared factors. La-Z-Boy has higher revenue, earnings, net margins, return on equity, and return on assets. It pays a dividend, while Stanley Furniture does not. Analysts favor La-Z-Boy, which has a consensus target price of $30.33. Stanley Furniture has a lower price-to-earnings ratio and is less volatile.

Sam Altman stated that intellectual property is more complex for AI video than images because video feels "more real and lifelike," prompting rights holders to seek different approaches and more restrictions. He noted most are excited to include their content but want granular control, predicting they will eventually want more AI-generated content for fan connection.

Scientific research on the human brain has advanced understanding of memories, with progress in identifying face cells and the protein CREB. Studies show that activating specific neurons before learning can pinpoint memory storage. Research by Dr. Susumu Tonegawa's team at MIT demonstrated the ability to create and reverse artificial emotional associations, approaching memory implantation and erasure.

The speaker states they are unconcerned with outside opinions and are excited to have earned their place in the Stanley Cup final. They assert Mike Peca is the best all-around player. They credit their team's success to physical play from big, fast forwards. They found it easy to relax during the layoff and believe their recent playoff experience, including facing adversity, prepares them for the next series.

A trade deficit reduces U.S. demand and can increase unemployment, offset by budget deficits or bubbles. The dollar's reserve currency status does not force trade deficits; countries like China hold dollars deliberately to gain trade advantages. China's technology transfer policies are described as "high-technology extortion," but U.S. companies like Boeing and Apple chose to invest in China voluntarily.

The passage describes an RSI(2) mean reversion trading strategy on QQQ. A basic RSI(2) strategy (buy when RSI < x) returned 10.01% vs. 6.39% buy-and-hold. Adding a second indicator (with RSI(2) below 10) improved performance to a 12.7% CAGR, 75% winners, a profit factor of 3, and a Sharpe Ratio of 2.85. The strategy performed well in four bear markets.

The SD Memory Card is designed for audio/video devices, featuring content protection, mutual authentication, and a cipher algorithm. It also supports a second security system for e-commerce. The SDIO Card, compatible with SD Memory cards, provides high-speed I/O with low power, and is ignored by non-SDIO hosts. SD communication uses a 9-pin interface at up to 208 MHz.

The Irish Times reports JD Wetherspoon's will open a 1,600sq metre gastropub in Dublin city centre, using two buildings on Lower Abbey Street connected by a glazed link, after a court granted a full license. The company has six other pubs in the area, with the new one set to open between 2019 and 2022. Prices have increased, with draught ales starting at €2.75 and Heineken at €4.50.

In this lecture, the speaker discusses auctions, focusing on the independent private values model. Key auction types covered include second-price sealed-bid, oral ascending (button), and first-price sealed-bid auctions. The second-price auction has a weakly dominant strategy of bidding true value, while in the first-price auction, bidders shade their bids. The revenue equivalence theorem states that under certain conditions (e.g., risk neutrality, independent values), different auction mechanisms yield the same expected revenue. The lecture also covers reserve prices, common value auctions and the winner's curse, and concludes with an empirical study by Hendricks and Porter on offshore oil lease auctions, which tests predictions about asymmetric information and bidding behavior.

In HS mode, the ADS7828 reads codes one at a time and stretches the clock after the read-addressing byte until conversion completes. To stay in HS mode after reading, use a repeated START instead of a STOP, which returns the part to F/S mode.

An Alberta Education survey of nearly 10,000 people found support for more emphasis on practical skills and basics, but also confusion over draft curriculum plans. Social studies drew the most "strongly held views," with concerns about political correctness, civic literacy, and fostering a particular worldview. Most respondents felt the drafts fostered literacy, numeracy, and critical thinking.

The BGF China Flexible Equity Fund allows investors to access both onshore (A-shares) and offshore Chinese equities via a single strategy, investing flexibly across market capitalizations, sectors, and factors. It is a long-only, fundamentals-driven portfolio of 20-50 stocks, managed by Helen Zhu and a team of 10 analysts. The fund aims to exploit valuation differences and sector opportunities in Chinese markets.

The passage examines the perceptions of Turkish tour guiding students regarding Emergency Distance Education (EDE) implemented during the Covid-19 pandemic. Students found EDE insufficient for tour guiding education due to inadequate vocational courses, lack of effective communication, and motivation problems. While they acknowledged advantages like time management and flexibility, they preferred face-to-face education for its efficiency, socialization, and practical training opportunities. The study concludes that students face a dilemma, recognizing benefits of distance education but ultimately favoring in-person learning for this practice-based profession.

The passage describes the ebook edition of the Foreign Relations of the United States series, including its features, citation guidance, and the statutory and editorial standards governing the series' preparation and publication.

Data culture aligns organizations vertically (via metrics linking individual/group goals to company objectives) and horizontally (via shared data models enabling cross-team collaboration). Digital leaders prioritize data culture as central, using it to align beliefs, values, and actions. Digital laggards struggle with misalignment between espoused values and behavior due to entrenched habits. Organizations fall into four patterns—data novice, insight ready, tech enabled, data reliant—each requiring targeted improvements to build a strong data culture.

Brad Vis has been selected as the Conservative candidate for Mission-Matsqui-Fraser Canyon in the next federal election, after losing to Liberal Jati Sidhu by over 1,000 votes in 2015. Conservative leader Andrew Scheer and riding president Vella praised Vis, who criticized Liberal spending and expressed concern for seniors and young families.

The speaker felt good about their own performance but acknowledged the opposing team played better. They praised specific plays by Friesen and Jeff, noted the second period was the opponent's best, and emphasized the need to improve speed, shooting, and creating traffic. They respected Patrick's decision to move on, dismissed the time off as a factor, and stressed the next game is crucial, with no excuses for not showing up.

This study examines the relationship between multilingualism and cultural awareness in Indonesian higher education. Using an embedded mixed-methods design with 388 students, it found significant positive correlations between multilingual learning variables (competency, learning process, psychological factors, social interaction) and cultural awareness variables (cultural knowledge, practices, sociocultural context, capacity/attitude). The research highlights Indonesia's linguistic diversity and recommends integrating multilingual approaches and cultural awareness into educational strategies and policies.

Amazon.com, Inc. filed its 2015 Form 10-K, reporting net sales of $107.0 billion, operating income of $2.2 billion, and net income of $596 million. The company operates in three segments: North America, International, and Amazon Web Services.

A McKinsey email forwards a memo summarizing global electric power sector restructuring from June to November 2000, covering Europe, Asia-Pacific, Latin America, and the Middle East/Africa, noting trends like privatization, unbundling, and market opening.

Jeong-Suk Cha, 77, provides round-the-clock care for her 48-year-old son Alex, who has cerebral palsy and spinal cord damage, often working alone despite her small stature. Alex is on a wait list for residential care, which advocates call a 50-year wait. A $100-million class-action lawsuit has been launched against Ontario, alleging the government denies services through inconsistent wait lists. The South West LHIN lacks data on medically complex adults needing care. Alex’s sister Jin organizes his care, while their mother handles daily tasks, suffering from arthritis. Alex would rather die than enter a nursing home, and his family is pushing for more housing for disabled adults.

The passage proposes a methodology for a trusting agent in a digital business ecosystem to determine the probability of not achieving the full benefit of its invested resources when interacting with a trusted agent. This involves analyzing the trusted agent's FailureLevel (probability and consequences of failure) across time slots, calculating an Amount Invested Curve (AIC) for resources, and convolving it with the FailureLevel to produce a Factual Amount Invested Curve (FAIC). The Loss of Resource Benefit (LORB) index, derived from the FAIC, quantifies this probability, aiding the agent's decision-making.

The passage describes the content and editorial features of a 1917 U.S. diplomatic documents ebook, noting its arrangement, inclusion of papers beyond April 6, 1917, for specific reasons, and editorial conventions for brackets and parentheses.

GA10x GPUs feature PCIe Gen 4, doubling bandwidth to 64 GB/sec. The GA102 GPU contains seven GPCs, 42 TPCs, and 84 SMs. Each SM has 128 CUDA Cores, four third-generation Tensor Cores, and one second-generation Ray Tracing Core. The memory subsystem has twelve 32-bit controllers (384-bit total) and 6144 KB of L2 cache. ROPs are now part of the GPC, with 112 total ROPs. The SM doubles FP32 throughput and has a 33% larger L1 cache. Second-generation RT Cores double ray/triangle intersection rates. Third-generation Tensor Cores support new data types and sparsity for up to 2x throughput. GDDR6X memory uses PAM4 signaling for up to 936 GB/sec bandwidth. RTX IO enables GPU-based decompression for faster I/O.

The Shuffle offense, a predecessor of several other offenses, uses constant player movement and teamwork to create high-percentage shots, eliminating defensive help and drawing big players away from the basket. Originating with Bruce Drake at Oklahoma, it is a sequential series of options where all five players rotate through each position, requiring minimal dribbling and strong fundamentals in passing, screening, and rebounding. The offense includes specific schematic sequences, rub cut reads and counters, flash cut options, and defensive overplay counters.

At its final 2017 meeting, the Brunswick school board approved the first step to place a 10-year, $4.67 million emergency levy renewal on the May ballot with no tax increase. It also approved issuing up to $10 million in notes for a new middle school and other improvements, and modified FY2018 appropriations, including grant increases. The board recognized departing member Lisa Durichko and acknowledged four donations.

The study assessed apixaban adherence at 24 weeks (primary) and 12/48 weeks (secondary) using an EMD. 1162 subjects were randomized to Primary SOC or Additional Education. Mean adherence at 24 weeks was 91.64% (SOC) and 91.88% (Education), with no significant difference. Adherence declined over time in both groups. Safety endpoints were similar between groups. The study concluded high adherence was sustained up to 48 weeks, with no additional benefit from the educational program.

The speaker praises the building for its atmosphere, noting it can favor a team like Philadelphia when they play well. They describe a player as calm, quiet, and unfazed by opponents' attempts to disrupt him, crediting his consistent play and big saves as crucial to the team.

SD Memory Cards have two areas: User Area and Protected Area. Card capacity is the sum of both. Three capacity types exist: Standard Capacity (SDSC, up to 2 GB), High Capacity (SDHC, over 2 GB to 32 GB), and Extended Capacity (SDXC, over 32 GB to 2 TB). Five Speed Classes define minimum performance: Class 0 (unspecified), Class 2 (≥2 MB/s), Class 4 (≥4 MB/s), Class 6 (≥6 MB/s), and Class 10 (≥10 MB/s). Communication uses commands, responses, and data blocks with CRC protection. Cards have registers like CID, RCA, CSD, and OCR. UHS-I provides up to 104 MB/s, and UHS-II up to 624 MB/s. Card initialization involves voltage validation and identification. Data transfer uses block read/write commands, with support for erase, discard, and write protection.

On November 6, 2017, NVIDIA Land exercised an option to terminate a lease and purchase its new Santa Clara campus property from Wachovia for approximately $350 million. The purchase is expected to close in Q4 of fiscal year 2018. On November 9, 2017, NVIDIA issued a press release and CFO commentary on its Q3 and first nine months of fiscal year 2018 results.

The player scored in the finals after many chances, delayed his move to the NHL for experience, felt his best game was with the team, advocated for more shooting, focused on effort over results, and chose the Sharks due to their early interest and strong organization.

TDSAT issued an interim order preventing penalties for non-compliance with tariff reporting requirements to Trai, though Trai can still request details of discounts for retaining customers. The order stayed clauses on reporting and significant market power. Trai's new norms require tariff reporting within seven days, with penalties for delays, and allow examination of predatory pricing by operators with at least 30% market share.

Scientists discovered that the Phoenix cluster's black hole recycles hot gas into cold, star-making fuel. Hot jets and bubbles from the black hole, which normally quench star formation, instead produce cold gas that fuels starbursts. Observations from ALMA and Chandra revealed cold gas filaments extending 20,000 light years, spatially matching hot gas bubbles. This explains the cluster's extreme star production of 1,000 stars per year.

This study analyzed data from 2,192 nulliparous participants to examine relationships between first- and second-trimester placental biomarkers and a composite outcome of retained placenta or postpartum hemorrhage requiring transfusion (RP/PPH). Of the sample, 3.1% experienced RP/PPH. Second-trimester levels of sEng, β-hCG, INHA, PAPP-A, and sFlt-1 were significantly higher in the RP/PPH group. Among participants without preeclampsia, second-trimester β-hCG, INHA, PAPP-A, and sFlt-1 remained significantly elevated in the RP/PPH group. The study concludes that these biomarkers are associated with RP/PPH and warrant further investigation for PPH risk screening.

Five Gor Mahia players lead the 2017 Kenyan Premier League MVP shortlist, including holder Kenneth Muguna. The Sports Journalists Association of Kenya (SJAK) is holding its own awards, sponsored by LG, after KPL postponed theirs. Patrick Matasi leads the goalkeeper shortlist. The awards ceremony is on December 18 with eight categories.

Patterns provide a shared vocabulary for distributed system developers, enabling quick understanding and knowledge sharing. This prevents wasted time on naming disagreements, allowing focus on core concepts and implementation details.

Former firefighter Luis Garcia spent $40,000 of his own savings to buy 800 doses of Narcan, a medication that blocks opioids to reverse overdoses. He distributes the drug for free and trains residents, business owners, and law enforcement on its use, having revived five of six overdose victims he assisted. Garcia’s efforts focus on providing Narcan to businesses and agencies lacking it, as opioid-related deaths rose on the Treasure Coast from 2014 to 2016.

National home prices rose 0.9% quarterly and 6.1% annually. Regional growth varied: Midwest slowed to 0.8%, Northeast increased to 0.7%, South and West held at 1.0%. San Jose, CA and Hartford, CT saw negative quarterly growth. Portland, OR was the fastest-growing market. Sixteen of the top 50 metro areas reached all-time price highs. National annual growth is projected to moderate to 2-3% in 2017.

The Pittsburgh Steelers have won eight straight games, including a 39-38 win over the Baltimore Ravens, but face a tough test against the New England Patriots in Week 15. Shannon Sharpe believes Patriots quarterback Tom Brady is "licking his chops" due to the Steelers' recent narrow wins and the absence of linebacker Ryan Shazier.

This study assessed the first year (April 2021-March 2022) of COVID-19 vaccination in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). By March 2022, 5.7% had received one dose and 1.03% were fully vaccinated. Only 16 of 26 provinces started vaccination. The DRC had the lowest vaccination coverage among nine Central African countries, with 2% of its population receiving at least one dose. Challenges included vaccine hesitancy, logistical issues, and competing health emergencies.

When stock markets are oversold, strong short-term returns are expected, but long-term returns gravitate toward averages. Oversold means a significant drop over a defined period, measured by indicators like the 3-day RSI. A backtest on the S&P 500 from 1985 shows 484 trades, average gain 0.64%, win rate 75%, CAGR 7.7%, max drawdown 26%, and profit factor 2.5, indicating a consistent short-term rebound. However, this strategy did not work well before 1990.

The idea of social capital, first appearing in a West Virginia education report a century ago, gained academic traction in the late 1980s through sociologist James Coleman. Robert Putnam, initially an expert on Italian politics, adopted the concept in the early 1990s to explain northern Italy's superior economic and social performance over the south, attributing it to civic engagement versus the mafia's dominance. Putnam's 1990s book *Bowling Alone* popularized social capital, defining it as civic group membership, and sparked a fad among academics and policymakers. Two competing definitions emerged: civic engagement and generalized trust, with an econometric study finding positive effects only from trust. Another distinction is between "bridging" (cross-group trust) and "bonding" (in-group solidarity) social capital. Putnam's research also indicates that ethnic fragmentation does not increase social capital, a finding used by nationalists.

Generative models offer a promising alternative to molecular dynamics (MD) and Monte Carlo (MC) simulations for generating equilibrium ensembles by learning a direct mapping to the equilibrium distribution, enabling statistically independent samples in 'one shot'. Gap trading strategies have been popular for decades, but profitability has diminished due to increased computer power and trader numbers. A gap can be faded (buying a gap down) or followed (selling a gap down). In the S&P 500, smaller gaps (0.1%) fill about 60% of the time on the same day, while larger gaps (1%) fill less frequently (28-33%). Backtesting simple gap strategies on futures data from 2011 to 2021 showed negative or marginal returns, indicating finding profitable strategies is difficult.

Some embodiments provide a packet processing pipeline for reconfigurable hardware switches. The switch includes an ingress and egress pipeline, each with a parser, a match-action unit (MAU), and a deparser. The parser separates packet header fields into a primary packet header vector (PPHV) for fields processed by the MAU, and a secondary packet header vector (SPHV) for fields not processed. The SPHV bypasses the MAU and goes directly to the deparser, which reassembles the packet using the processed PPHV, unprocessed SPHV, and payload. This separation improves efficiency by avoiding MAU processing of unused fields and allows deeper packet parsing. A compiler generates configuration data for the parser and MAU based on a parse graph and flow graphs.

The goalie played well despite a layoff, but the team's frustration led to poor play, and they hope to rebound.

This study of 67,060 Chinese adults found a bidirectional association between arterial stiffness and chronic kidney disease (CKD), with cross-lagged analysis showing that kidney function decline preceded increased arterial stiffness. Higher baseline arterial stiffness was a predictor of incident CKD (HR 2.17 for highest tertile), and lower eGFR predicted higher arterial stiffness risk (HR 1.21).

This case study of one participant with a transtibial amputation found that after multiple weeks of using spinal cord stimulation (SCS) for sensory feedback during walking, there was a reduction in co-contractions of knee antagonist muscles and an increase in tensor fasciae latae (TFL) muscle activity, which corresponded to increased pelvic obliquity range-of-motion and pelvic drop.

Adventurer Bear Grylls criticized schools for inadequately preparing children for adult life, stating success often stems from determination rather than exam scores. He emphasized schools should empower kids for life's long-term challenges, not league tables. Grylls, a former SAS member, attributed his achievements to persistence, not school performance, and praised his school Eton. He also expressed doubt about Donald Trump joining his show, noting Trump prefers being "king" while survival requires humility.

Thunderstorms produced hail in North Texas, but severe weather season has been slow. Few tornadoes have been reported statewide, with four in North Texas (average seven in April). Oklahoma has recorded zero tornadoes in 2018, the latest since 1962, and Kansas also has zero. However, tornado season may intensify in May.

This study introduces SCIseg, a deep learning method for automatically segmenting the spinal cord and T2-weighted hyperintense lesions in traumatic spinal cord injury (SCI) patients. Trained on 191 patients from three sites, it is the first open-source method for 3D segmentation of both structures, generalizing to non-traumatic SCI. The model's performance was evaluated against other methods, and its automatically derived lesion biomarkers showed no statistically significant difference from manual ground truth in correlation with clinical scores.

Prime Minister Dmitry Medvedev stated on April 17 that the Russian economy is on a positive development path, with industrial output growth of 1.3 percent and agricultural growth of 5 percent in the last year. He noted a 60 percent rise in agricultural machinery production.

While Exchange shopping privileges are limited to Soldiers, Airmen, and their families, anyone can dine in Exchange restaurants or buy grab-and-go food from Express locations for on-installation consumption, per Army Regulation 215-8/Air Force Instruction 34-211 (I).

The opponent's goaltender was impressive, but the team will stay aggressive and use their experience to perform well at home.

Athletes Unlimited (AU) launched in 2020 as a women's professional sports startup with a player-led model, featuring no team owners, a new competition format, and a leaderboard ranking individual performance. It launched leagues in softball, volleyball, lacrosse, and basketball, securing broadcast deals with ESPN and CBS. AU is a public benefit corporation with a "Mission Equity" capital structure capping investor returns and directing surplus to players. By 2023, it had raised $30 million and was named one of the world's 10 most innovative sports companies by Fast Company.

A method for a first AP in a multiple BSSID set allocates random access resources using AID values based on a group AID mapping in a TIM element's partial virtual bitmap, and transmits a trigger frame containing those AID values to stations in the set. The AID values can identify a group of stations, a specific BSSID, a group of BSSIDs, or all stations. When the trigger frame is from a Tx BSSID, its TA is the Tx BSSID's MAC address. Random RUs can be allocated to a non-Tx BSSID by setting an AID to that BSSID's index, to the Tx BSSID by setting an AID to zero, or to all unassociated stations by setting an AID to 2045. When from a non-Tx BSSID, the TA is set to that BSSID's index, and random RUs can be allocated to that non-Tx BSSID by setting an AID to zero or to all unassociated stations by setting an AID to 2045.

Grupo Supervielle S.A. presented at Latin Securities Argentina in London, with a related slide deck published. Seeking Alpha's transcripts team manages transcript projects, publishing thousands of quarterly earnings calls. The passage also lists article titles and chart data.

He notes disparities in wealth and education, urging graduates to contribute their talents to society. He praises Frost as an artist and American who questioned power and upheld truth, arguing that art strengthens national life. He envisions an America that values culture, beauty, and moral restraint alongside strength.

The CAT offense is a 2-1-2 spread alignment used against traps and zone presses, with a skilled post player as the key. Rules include baseline back cuts when the ball goes to the middle, post roll to the basket on corner passes, passing to the opposite corner when trapped, and using dribble penetration sparingly.

Tight ends remain a crucial part of football due to their unique blend of size and athleticism, creating matchup problems for defenses. They split time between running short-to-medium routes and blocking, making them versatile in both the passing and running game. The position name originates from lining up "tight" to the formation on the line of scrimmage. Elite tight ends require strong hands, athleticism, speed, blocking ability, route running, and physicality, typically standing 6'3"-6'8" and weighing 240-270 pounds. Notable players include Tony Gonzalez, Rob Gronkowski, Antonio Gates, and Shannon Sharpe. Their versatility allows offenses to diversify plays and schemes, providing a reliable weapon for coordinators.

Guangdong Province, China, is experiencing its largest recorded chikungunya outbreak, with over 4,000 confirmed cases since late July. The disease is transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes and causes fever and joint pain. Local authorities are encouraging residents to eliminate standing water to reduce mosquito breeding. The World Health Organization has issued new guidelines and strengthened its Global Arbovirus Initiative to address the growing threat.

On World No Tobacco Day, CTC-Pak officials urged prioritizing health over business, stating tobacco causes 16% of NCD deaths, mainly cardiovascular, which account for 19% of total deaths in Pakistan. WHO reports tobacco disproportionately harms vulnerable populations, with over 80% of smokers in low- and middle-income countries, costing $1.4 trillion annually and killing over seven million people globally, including 108,800 in Pakistan. Officials called for enforcing 85% Pictorial Health Warnings, increasing taxes, and implementing stronger tobacco control policies, noting Pakistan ratified FCTC in 2004 but has not fulfilled obligations.

The passage describes a method using the MM algorithm for multivariate variance components linear mixed models to estimate genetic heritability and correlation, applied to isoform expression in the PsychENCODE dataset. It finds cis-SNPs have sparse, large effects, while trans-SNPs have small, collective effects, with isoform-level analyses revealing more genetic signals than gene-level analyses, some linked to psychiatric disorders.

The passage introduces SoDaDE, a new data-driven fingerprint for solvents created by training a transformer model on a small solvent property dataset via data augmentation. It outperforms previous representations on the Catechol Benchmark for solvent selection, demonstrating effective solvent feature capture without reliance on fine-tuning.

The lecture introduces causality and stability as additional constraints for discrete-time linear shift-invariant (LSI) systems, where stability requires the unit sample response to be absolutely summable, and causality requires it to be zero for n < 0. It then discusses LSI systems described by linear constant coefficient difference equations, noting that such equations require boundary conditions to define a unique system, which can be causal or non-causal. Finally, it presents the frequency response H(e^jω) as an alternative representation of LSI systems, derived from the convolution sum, showing that complex exponentials are eigenfunctions and that the frequency response is periodic with period 2π.

The lecture introduces radiation from plasmas as a diagnostic tool, covering radiation transport, the radiation transport equation, optical depth, and Kirchhoff's law. It contrasts optically thin and thick limits, distinguishes absorption from cut-off, and outlines deriving radiation from accelerated charges, focusing on the far-field term.

The speaker praised their first-period transition game and puck movement, but noted a defensive mistake led to a goal. After a second goal, they played on their heels and lost. It uses Alteryx for data workflows and Tableau for dashboards, integrating data from over 2,000 individuals. The platform supports cohort characterization, clinical trial eligibility, genotype-phenotype mapping, medication trends, and risk factor analysis, improving data accessibility for clinicians and researchers.

A White House official said the administration will now "begin preparing" tariffs on companies that do not build in the U.S. or agree to a drug pricing deal, without providing a new timeline.

The passage discusses the head and shoulders chart pattern, a bearish reversal signal formed by three rallies (left shoulder, higher head, right shoulder) and two pullbacks, with confirmation when price breaks below the neckline. This study used DFT and molecular dynamics to compare the interaction of chlorothalonil (CLT) with carbon nanotubes (CNTs) and boron nitride nanotubes (BNNTs) of varying radii. Both nanotubes physically adsorbed CLT, with adsorption energy increasing with radius. BNNTs showed shorter recovery times and significant band gap changes upon adsorption, making them suitable for CLT detection, while CNTs did not. Both nanotubes were effective for CLT removal.

Pneumonia and tuberculosis (TB) cause significant global mortality and misdiagnosis. Current AI models for chest X-ray analysis often neglect non-X-ray cases. This study proposes a multi-class classification system (normal, pneumonia, TB, non-X-ray) using a pretrained CNN to address this gap, enhancing robustness for clinical settings.

Hounds of the Bay is a stock-picking strategy for selecting the highest dividend-paying stocks in the S&P/TSX 60 index, named after Bay Street. It tends to involve global commodities and is skewed towards energy. The strategy underperformed in 2014 due to the severe oil decline. It is based on the premise that blue-chip companies do not alter dividends to reflect trading conditions, so high dividend yields indicate a company near the bottom of its business cycle.

It involves corner and hitch routes, with quarterback progression focusing on high-low reading of the cornerback. Variations include adjustments for 3x1 sets and sprint-out designs.

The ISM Manufacturing Index (PMI) is a monthly indicator of US manufacturing sector health, based on a survey of purchasing managers. It measures factors like production, new orders, employment, and supplier deliveries. A reading above 50 indicates expansion, below 50 contraction. The index is published on the first business day of each month. It is considered a backward-looking indicator, reflecting past activity, but can provide early insight due to its survey nature. The PMI can be used with other indicators like GDP and employment data for a comprehensive economic view. Backtests show that holding stocks when PMI is above 50 yields positive returns, but the index is not a strong contrarian indicator.

Psychometrics is integrating NLP technologies to complement traditional questionnaire-based methods, using LLMs for tasks like item creation and synthetic data generation. However, obtaining large human rater samples is costly and prone to issues like fatigue. The authors propose "Survey and Questionnaire Item Embeddings Differentials" (SQuID), a method using semantic embeddings from LLMs to recover latent dimensions of questionnaires, demonstrated with the PVQ-RR on value orientations. Their approach achieves performance on par with human rater judgments, is flexible, cheap, and scalable, overcoming the problem of missing negative correlations in embeddings.

The A100 GPU uses 2:4 structured sparsity to prune weights, compressing data 2x and doubling Tensor Core math throughput. This method, involving dense training, pruning, and fine-tuning, yields virtually no accuracy loss across various networks. The A100 also features a 192 KB combined L1 data cache and shared memory, simultaneous FP32 and INT32 execution, 40 GB of HBM2 memory with 1555 GB/sec bandwidth, SECDED ECC protection, and a 40 MB L2 cache. Multi-Instance GPU (MIG) partitions the A100 into up to seven isolated GPU Instances. Third-generation NVLink provides 600 GB/sec total bandwidth. The A100 supports PCIe Gen 4 with SR-IOV, hardware JPEG decode, an optical flow accelerator, and improved atomics.

The A100 Tensor Core GPU, based on the NVIDIA Ampere architecture, features third-generation Tensor Cores that support multiple data types (FP16, BF16, TF32, INT8, INT4, Binary, and FP64). Each A100 SM delivers 1024 FP16 FMA operations per clock, double that of a V100 SM. The full A100 GPU with 108 SMs provides up to 312 TFLOPS of dense mixed-precision FP16/FP32 performance, 2.5x that of the V100. It includes 40 GB of HBM2 memory with 1555 GB/sec bandwidth, a 40 MB L2 cache (6.7x larger than V100), and supports Multi-Instance GPU (MIG) partitioning into up to seven isolated GPU Instances. New features include Fine-Grained Structured Sparsity for 2x compute throughput, third-generation NVLink with 600 GB/sec total bandwidth, PCIe Gen 4, hardware JPEG decode, and an Optical Flow Accelerator.

The Rate of Change (ROC) is a momentum-based technical indicator that compares a security's current price to its price "n" periods ago, plotted as an oscillator above or below a zero line. It has oversold/overbought levels and can produce divergence signals. Common trading strategies include using oversold/overbought conditions, breakouts, zero line crosses, and divergences. Backtested ROC strategies on the S&P 500 showed mixed results, with some performing poorly. The indicator is best used in trending markets and is prone to whipsaws in volatile markets. It differs from RSI by directly measuring price momentum.

This procedure is a stackless native assembler source file using a register passing model. It initializes the processor and cache system to create a viable stack region before main memory is available, dividing the pre-memory stack among processor cores and mapping them to global address space. It must run on all cores. If protected mode is enabled, it does not modify SS; otherwise, in Real Mode, SS:ESP is set to a 16-bit Segment:Offset format. The procedure creates a UEFI_SEC_PEI_HAND_OFF instance. AARCH64 APUs with PSP will not use the stack, as PSP initializes DRAM. Registers destroyed: EAX, ECX, EDX, EDI, ESI.

Graham died at age 99. He is the fourth private person to lie in honor since 1998. A funeral is scheduled for Friday in Charlotte, North Carolina.

The Infinium Global Research report analyzes the global aerosol valves market (2017-2023), covering applications (automotive, household, personal care, foods, paints, medical) and regions (North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific, RoW). It profiles key players like Aptar Group and Lindal Group. The market is expected to grow at a 6% CAGR.
Budget Blinds Serving Bothell offers high-quality custom window coverings, including blinds, shades, shutters, and drapes, with professional installation and budget-friendly options.

A study of pregnant women attending first antenatal care visits in four Zambian districts from September 2021 to September 2022 found that 63.8% of 8,304 participants were SARS-CoV-2 seropositive. Seroprevalence peaked near 100% in three districts by August 2022. Most antibodies were infection-induced, and COVID-19 vaccination was associated with higher seropositivity. The study estimated 2,911,393 people had evidence of SARS-CoV-2 exposure, compared to 90,150 reported cases.

A child in Coventry was accidentally jabbed by a syringe in a wooded area known for drug use. His family fears infection and faces a wait for blood test results. The aunt has called for the council to clear the area.

The passage describes a rotation strategy between the S&P 500 and gold based on their ratio relative to a 20-month moving average. When the ratio is above the average, the strategy is long the S&P 500; when below, it switches to gold. Backtested from 1985 to July 2020, the strategy achieved a 9.9% CAGR with a 22% max drawdown, outperforming the S&P 500's 55% drawdown. The strategy underperformed until the 2008/09 financial crisis but then improved due to a lower drawdown. Dividends were not included.

Active Alumina is used in oil & gas, plastic, and healthcare industries. The global market spans Europe, North America, Latin America, Asia Pacific, and the Middle East & Africa. Asia Pacific leads due to industrialization in Japan, China, and India, driven by water needs and oil & gas growth. North America dominates due to developed end-use industries and shale gas activities. Europe grows steadily, propelled by healthcare use in Germany, the U.K., and France. The market is segmented by application (catalysts, desiccants, fluoride adsorbents, bioceramics) and end-user industry (oil & gas, water treatment, plastic, healthcare). Key players include BASF SE, Honeywell International Inc, and Sumitomo Chemical Co.

Ten years ago, Saks Fifth Avenue launched its 10022-SHOE shoe salon, which revolutionized the footwear industry by making shoes a destination. The retailer will celebrate the milestone on Aug. 17 with over 75 exclusive styles. The flagship shoe floor now holds 200,000 pairs across 30,000 square feet, and the concept has expanded to 25 other locations, including a stand-alone store in Greenwich, Conn.

PointState Capital LP purchased 6,057,459 shares of Peabody Energy Corporation in Q2, valued at about $148,105,000, making it 1.6% of its portfolio. Other hedge funds also bought new positions. Major shareholder Discovery Capital Management sold 12,800,000 shares at $27.10 each. Analysts have an average "Buy" rating with a $35.00 target price. Peabody reported Q2 EPS of ($0.18), missing estimates of $0.89, and revenue of $1.26 billion.

Metastatic colorectal cancer (mCRC) has a 14% 5-year survival rate, highlighting the need for biomarkers. This study evaluated the clinical relevance of circulating tumor cell (CTC) genomic diversity in 29 mCRC patients using whole-exome sequencing. Higher CTC-pool MATH scores and non-silent BCL9L mutations were significantly associated with poorer overall survival in multivariate analysis. A 55-gene panel derived MATH scores also predicted survival, offering a cost-effective alternative.

Mr. Otori requested a council for proposals, which was delayed. The Japanese minister demanded appointment within three days. The Korean government, on advice, rejected the proposals due to military occupation. The King appointed a reform council. Neutrality for Chemulpo was discussed but Japanese conditions prevented it. Mr. Waeber returned. The U.S.S. Monocacy arrived. C. T. Gardner reported being assaulted by Japanese soldiers. K. Otori investigated, and General Oshima denied the assault claims, stating no soldiers struck foreigners or blocked a lady.

Kerala has directed universities to reserve two seats for transgender students in undergraduate and postgraduate courses, and to prevent discrimination. The state also launched a continuing education programme and will provide shelter homes in four districts to reduce drop-outs, which a survey found affect nearly 40% of transgender students between classes 7 and 10.

The BerkeleyGW software package achieved over 1.0 ExaFLOP/s in double-precision throughput for quantum many-body materials simulations on exascale supercomputers, demonstrating performance portability across AMD, Intel, and NVIDIA GPU architectures. It enables predictive modeling of complex materials with up to 17,574 atoms, including GW perturbation theory for electron-phonon coupling.

Wall Street and global stock markets hit record highs on Thursday, driven by optimism over U.S. tax reforms and economic growth. The Dow, S&P 500, and Nasdaq set record closes for a fourth consecutive day. The dollar gained on solid U.S. economic data, while oil prices rose despite record U.S. exports.

The ASP process for SFS involves six steps: checking DRAM address protection, verifying customer and AMD signatures, loading and running an executable patch, updating patch level information, and returning status. The GET_SFS_VERSION_INFO command checks firmware versions using a two-page buffer. SFS packages are binary objects named with family, AGESA release, and a counting number. Update packages must match specific firmware versions, run in parallel with x86/DMA traffic, and aim for minimal performance impact. SEV/SNP VMs can continue operation during SEV firmware updates.

A federal judge ordered Alabama to release information about its lethal injection procedure, citing public access rights, though the state can withhold some security-related details like low-level employee names. The order follows a motion by news organizations after a halted execution.

A federal judge temporarily halted deportation proceedings for Indonesian Christians in the U.S. illegally seeking legal status, including a man honored for rebuilding homes after Superstorm Sandy. The order applies to about 50 people in New Jersey with pre-2009 removal orders.

Toronto police reported that 26-year-old Nnamdi Ogba was fatally shot while walking to his car in a Toronto Community Housing complex on Friday. Two men approached from behind and fled in an SUV. Police believe the attack was meant to instill fear in the community, and that Ogba, an innocent man with no criminal record, was targeted due to his presence at that time and place. Video clips of the suspects and a newer model Nissan Rogue have been released.

The speaker confirms a player is fine and will play tomorrow. They critique their team's powerplay and passing, noting the powerplay was key to reaching the finals. They emphasize discipline and composure as reasons for success, and state they learned from the first two games against the Devils. They admit they did not play well enough in the previous game, citing lost focus and poor passing under pressure. They reject using Forsberg's absence as an excuse. They note both teams have strong defense, limiting scoring chances, and that mental mistakes and discipline will be key. They explain that referees missed high-sticking calls due to the game's speed. They end by looking forward positively to the next game.

The passage introduces ABXLAB, a framework for studying AI agent decision-making by manipulating real web content. It evaluates 17 LLM agents across 80,000 trials, finding they exhibit strong, systematic biases toward ratings, prices, order effects, and nudges, often exceeding human susceptibility by 3–10×. Agents show near-deterministic responses to user preference profiles, acting as categorical switches. The study highlights risks of delegating decisions to AI agents without rigorous behavioral testing.

The President's message reviews the past year, noting a financial crisis, improved foreign relations, and the capture of the Virginius, now being resolved. It discusses the Vienna Exposition, Chinese coolie trade, Geneva arbitration payments, boundary commissions, and claims against the U.S. and Britain. It recommends legislation on expatriation, Cuban slavery, and constitutional amendments. The Treasury reports a surplus but warns of future deficits, urging economy and currency elasticity. The War and Navy Departments request funding for armament and shipbuilding. The Post-Office shows increased revenue and expenditures. The Justice Department addresses Utah jury issues and bankruptcy law. The Interior reports on Indian policy, land sales, pensions, and education. It supports D.C. improvements, civil-service reform, Colorado statehood, amnesty, and civil rights.

In 2011, First Solar faced a net operating loss of $39 million, its first in seven years, due to slowed revenue growth, increased competition from Chinese manufacturers, and weakened market demand. The company’s cost advantage was eroding, and its senior vice president, Tymen deJong, was considering how to respond to these challenges.

For the Dawn-plasma study, viral swab residual material should be stored in a fridge (4°C) for up to 24 hours, then at -80°C (preferred) or -20°C until transport to the central laboratory in Leuven for later quantitative PCR analysis.

Week 6 featured UCLA's 42-37 upset of Penn State, the biggest top-10 upset by a winless team in 40 years, and Florida's 29-21 win over Texas, damaging both preseason top-two teams' playoff odds. Other key developments included Alabama's win over Vanderbilt, Cincinnati's upset of Iowa State, and Florida State's loss to Miami.

The passage demonstrates sampling, aliasing, and digital filter properties using a programmable digital filter. It explains that sampling a band-limited signal creates periodic spectrum replications; aliasing occurs when the signal bandwidth exceeds half the sampling frequency, causing frequency overlap. A sinusoidal input example shows that as input frequency increases past half the sampling frequency, the output frequency decreases due to aliasing. The digital filter's frequency response is rescaled to continuous time by replacing the digital frequency with the analog frequency times the sampling period, making the cutoff frequency proportional to the sampling rate. Demonstrations show the filter's impulse response, frequency response, and the effect of changing the sampling rate on the cutoff frequency.
Deepak Ahuja intends to retire as Tesla's CFO, with Zachary Kirkhorn to replace him upon retirement.

A Derby takeaway, Sun Waa, received a food hygiene score of one ("major improvement necessary") after inspectors found rice left at room temperature for six hours, a wok obstructing a wash basin, and food debris on surfaces. The business has since improved hygiene practices and expects a re-score in March.

A Sarnia judge imposed three months of house arrest and a year's probation on Tarren Joseph Titus, 23, who pleaded guilty to drug possession and probation violations, after calling his efforts to end drug abuse "outstanding."

The passage contains quotes from Jonathan Toews, Brad Richards, and Kris Versteeg discussing their team's mindset before a potential Stanley Cup-clinching game. They emphasize focusing on the game, the quickness of the playoff journey, the importance of preparation and recovery, and the team's experience and chemistry. They also comment on opponents, coaching, and staying ready for opportunities.

Research shows that understanding how marginalized young adults perceive their mental health conditions—their "mental health narratives"—is crucial for improving treatment engagement. Studies by NYU's Michelle Munson and colleagues focus on young adults facing poverty, discrimination, and system involvement. They argue that providers must collaboratively explore each individual's beliefs about causes and management, as these narratives strongly influence treatment participation. The researchers advocate training providers in cultural humility and developing interventions to help shape these narratives, noting that many marginalized young adults feel unheard by the current system.

Murad Rahimov, a 16-year-old aspiring astronaut and recent U.S. citizen from Uzbekistan, received a private tour of NASA's Goddard Space Flight Center after an NPR listener connected him with his brother, astrophysicist Jeremy Schnittman. Murad, who has dreamed of working for NASA since age three, toured facilities including the clean room, cryo-vac chamber, and acoustic chamber, and discussed black holes and time travel with Schnittman. He plans to attend Cal Tech and lead a Mars mission.

BBC presenter Anita Anand was temporarily removed from hosting Radio 4's *Any Answers* after publicly criticizing the gender pay gap. The episode, which discussed the BBC pay dispute, was instead presented by a man. The BBC cited impartiality rules, as Anand had tweeted in support of equal pay. A BBC spokesman stated that editors decide case-by-case if campaigning presenters can interview on that subject to ensure impartiality.

The NRA sent a letter claiming YETI cut ties with them. YETI responded, stating it eliminated outdated discount programs and offered an alternative customization program, contradicting the NRA's statement. Some NRA supporters planned a boycott, and one man destroyed a YETI cooler with explosives, sparking the #YetiCoolerChallenge. This dispute follows other businesses distancing themselves from the NRA after shootings. YETI affirmed its support for the Second Amendment.

This study benchmarked 15 Mendelian randomization (MR) methods using real-world genetic datasets, evaluating type I error control, accuracy of causal effect estimates, and replicability. MR-APSS, Egger, and Weighted-mode consistently controlled type I error across confounding scenarios. MR-APSS also produced the most accurate causal effect estimates. Most methods were sensitive to the choice of instrumental variable (IV) threshold, with looser thresholds increasing bias and type I error. The study recommends using negative controls, multiple IV selection standards, and data from multiple independent sources to improve MR analysis reliability.

Asparagus, broccoli, citrus fruits, legumes, avocado, lady's finger, nuts and seeds, cauliflower, beetroot, carrots, and corn are all sources of folate (vitamin B9), with specific amounts provided for each.

Zita Kovács faced early career prejudice as a female winemaker but now feels respected. Zsófi Laposa notes the profession has become more open and accepting of women, who bring gentleness and uniqueness. Krisztina Csetvei balances winemaking with raising her daughter, who attends wine events with her. Andi Gere co-manages the family winery with her father, believing feminine elegance balances masculine wines.

This application is a continuation of U.S. Application No. 17/176,057, which is a continuation of U.S. Application No. 16/648,887 (now U.S. Pat. No. 10,955,587), which is a national stage of PCT/US2018/053529, claiming priority to U.S. Provisional Applications No. 62/633,666, 62/565,313, 62/565,310, 62/565,306, and 62/565,299. The disclosure relates to articles exhibiting structural color via optical elements, which produce color through physical light interaction rather than dyes or pigments. The optical element can be used alone or with a textured surface or primer layer. The article can be footwear, apparel, or sporting equipment. The optical element can include a multilayer reflector or filter. The structural color can be single-hued or multihued (iridescent). The optical element can be disposed on a component surface, such as a shoe upper or sole.

A flurry of new deals on Monday suggests mergers among junior mining companies, especially in gold, may be increasing after slow months. Hecla Mining proposed a US$462 million acquisition of Klondex Mines, and Alio Gold proposed a $128 million acquisition of Rye Patch Gold. In 2018, there have been six mergers in Canada’s metals and mining sector, compared to 19 in 2017. Hecla’s CEO stated the deal was unrelated to short-term gold prices. If approved, Hecla would acquire three Klondex gold mines, raising its annual gold production to 370,000 ounces. Klondex shares rose 61 percent. Alio Gold’s offer for Rye Patch includes a 35 percent premium. A third deal combined Anaconda Mining and Maritime Resources.

The speaker considers Detroit the strongest team faced, with top goaltending and firepower. They emphasize playing cleanly to avoid penalties, as officials are calling infractions strictly, and note the need for better decision-making on the power play. They acknowledge Detroit's top line, led by Kris Draper, and stress winning faceoffs against a puck-possession team. The speaker also comments on the opponent's best defenseman's positional smarts, their arena's loud atmosphere, and the need to focus on the game despite distractions.

MSPM0C1105/6 MCUs are ultra-low-power 32-bit devices based on the Arm Cortex-M0+ core, operating at up to 32MHz. They offer up to 64KB flash, 8KB SRAM, analog peripherals including a 12-bit ADC, and digital peripherals like timers and communication interfaces (UART, SPI, I2C). The MCUs are supported by a hardware and software ecosystem including LaunchPad kits and a free SDK.

Pusa, 63, died, survived by his wife, two sons and a daughter. He was a Congress member, served as Nagaland Minister (1998-2003), and was an MLA from 2003-2013. He first won as an independent in 1993. His funeral was held at his residence, with burial in Viswema. Several officials condoled his death.

India's state-run banks reported a combined loss of 853.7 billion rupees ($12.65 billion) for the fiscal year ending March 2018, the highest ever, due to a surge in bad loan provisions after stricter central bank rules. All but two of 21 majority-owned banks posted losses in the March quarter, with total fourth-quarter losses at 626.81 billion rupees. Gross non-performing loans rose 15% to 8.96 trillion rupees, with IDBI Bank having the highest bad-loan ratio at 27.95%.

A Zillow analysis found homes with air conditioning sold for a 2.5% premium ($5,486) nationally, with the highest premiums in San Antonio (5.8%) and Cincinnati (5.7%). Air conditioning was a required feature for 62% of buyers, and 66.1% of homes sold in the past year had it. Renters paid a 2.8% premium ($40/month) for central air conditioning.

Options trading in IWM involves buying and selling call and put options contracts. Call options grant the right to buy shares at an agreed-upon price, while put options grant the right to sell shares. Traders use options to profit from price movements and hedge against risks.

Gov. Kay Ivey announced the voluntary Alabama Sentry Program, which trains administrators in schools without a school resource officer to store a firearm in a safe for active shooter response. Participants need training and approval from the local superintendent, school board, and county sheriff. The program aims to provide security until more SROs are added.

A method for tracing cryptocurrency transactions includes receiving blockchain data and intelligence labels, selecting a transaction flow, applying labels to addresses, using an AI graph search algorithm to determine an auto-traced path, and generating a report with suspicious addresses. If a suspicious address is found, the method generates an action such as alerting a user or suspending transactions.

The Bank of England (BoE) warned that AI-related stock rallies may be unsustainable, mirroring the dot-com bubble, and that gains concentrated in U.S. tech giants could amplify systemic vulnerabilities. The BoE cited potential bottlenecks in power, semiconductors, and data infrastructure, and cautioned that an AI-driven sell-off could trigger cross-border volatility, with Britain exposed to U.S. equity shocks.

Plum School District officials will begin preliminary 2018-19 budget discussions Tuesday, hoping to avoid a third straight tax increase. The district starts the school year over $4 million in debt. Other discussion items include recruiting Chinese students, elementary construction, consolidation, redistricting, and beginning the process to close Regency Park Elementary School.

More than 80% of bankers expect commercial blockchain adoption by 2020, with over half of financial institutions investing or planning to invest this year. Average investment is about $1 million, and half of banks work with fintech firms. Top use cases include cross-border payments and digital identity. Private blockchains are preferred by 69% of banks.

Pump and dump schemes are bad because they are mostly illegal and immoral, benefiting only a few fraudsters while leaving latecomers exposed to losses. They involve artificially inflating a stock's price through false information, then selling shares to naive investors, causing a price drop. These schemes are common in the OTC and crypto markets, with evidence showing average losses of -28% for investors.

This application claims priority to a series of patent applications and relates to a method, apparatus, and system for transmitting paging information in wireless communications. It addresses the challenge of implementing a discontinuous reception (DRX) mechanism for paging in high-frequency beamforming systems, where a user equipment (UE) in an idle state cannot predict beam scheduling. The solution involves a first communication node calculating a time domain position of a paging occasion (PO) for a second communication node, where the PO includes a group of paging resources for transmitting paging information on preset beams or ports. The paging information may include paging downlink control information or a paging message.

Argus Research upgraded Orbital ATK to buy with a $120 price target after the company reported Q2 2017 earnings, showing sales of $1.12 billion and pro forma earnings of $1.56 per share, though GAAP profits fell 3% to $1.51 per share and free cash flow turned negative at -$55.8 million. Management raised full-year sales guidance to $4.6-$4.65 billion and earnings to $5.95-$6.25 per share, citing a strong book-to-bill ratio of 1.45 and 10% backlog growth. However, the stock trades at 22 times trailing earnings and an EV/FCF ratio over 40, considered too expensive given expected 10% annual profit growth.

In February 2009, street artist Shepard Fairey was arrested at his ICA exhibition opening, but the show still drew 130,000 visitors. The incident highlighted the ICA's transformation under Director Jill Medvedow, who arrived in 1998 when the museum had no money, few members, and 25,000 yearly visitors. Medvedow led a risky turnaround, securing a waterfront parcel for a new $51 million building that opened in 2006. By 2009, the ICA had achieved high attendance, contrasting sharply with its earlier status as an "insider's art club."
Appeal docketed and dismissed on motion of appellee and consent of appellant.

This study proposes "whole human pedagogy," a framework with four tenets (embodiment, emotions, belonging, becoming) for holistic education abroad. Based on interviews with 17 practitioners, findings show participants understood these tenets as central to their work, with subthemes including place-based learning, emotional reflection, communal relationships, and transformation. The framework offers a decolonial approach to program development and professional development.

Sean "Diddy" Combs was sentenced to four years and two months in prison and fined half a million dollars for transporting people across state lines for sexual encounters. He was acquitted of sex trafficking and racketeering. He has served a year in jail, meaning he would be released in about three years.

At a New York event, Amazon announced new Echo devices with Alexa+, Kindle Scribe tablets (including a color model), Fire TVs with the Vega OS, Ring cameras with Retinal 2K/4K processing, and Blink cameras with 2K resolution and a new Arc accessory.

The passage describes the sidecar pattern, where a separate container (sidecar) augments a main application container to add functionality without modifying the original application. Examples include adding HTTPS to a legacy HTTP service, synchronizing dynamic configuration from an API, and providing monitoring tools like a `topz` interface. The pattern promotes modularity and reusability, with sidecars parameterized via environment variables, a defined API surface, and proper documentation. The text also introduces the ambassador pattern for brokering external communication (e.g., sharded services, service brokering, request splitting) and the adapter pattern for normalizing interfaces (e.g., monitoring, logging, health checks). Multi-node patterns are then discussed, including replicated load-balanced services for stateless applications, sharded services for stateful data scaling, and the scatter/gather pattern for parallelizing request processing across multiple nodes.

Mr. Stevens reported in March 1892 that revolutionary plans were restrained only by a U.S. naval vessel, with widespread hostility to the "half English" heir and growing support for annexation. Dispatches throughout 1892 described dissatisfaction with the Queen's influence, arrogance, and political deadlock, culminating in a peaceful revolution and dethronement on January 28, 1893. U.S. policy from 1820 to 1893 was one of friendship and protection, opposing foreign intervention and occasionally considering annexation.

Seven months after major cuts at the U.S. Department of Education, researchers express cautious optimism. The department plans to reinstate 20 of over 100 terminated research contracts and is seeking public input to modernize the Institute of Education Sciences (IES). Hiring and a new advisor for IES reform have raised hopes. However, severe staff shortages and the impact of cuts on data quality remain concerns.

Theratechnologies Inc. announced a US$50,000,000 offering of 5.75% convertible unsecured senior notes due 2023, with an over-allotment option of up to US$7,500,000. The notes are convertible at US$14.85 per share and are not redeemable before June 30, 2021. Proceeds will fund payments under the EMD Serono Termination Agreement, Trogarzo™ commercialization, and general corporate purposes. The offering is subject to regulatory approvals and is not registered in the U.S.

The NASA/ESA Hubble Space Telescope image shows dwarf galaxy NGC 5949, located 44 million light-years from Earth. Its mass is about one-hundredth of the Milky Way's, and it is a barred spiral galaxy. Discovered by William Herschel in 1801, its proximity allows observation with small telescopes. Dwarf galaxies like NGC 5949 present cosmological puzzles, including the "cuspy halo" dark matter problem and the "missing satellites" problem.

The ultimate oscillator (UO) is a momentum indicator measuring price momentum across three timeframes (7, 14, and 28) using a weighted average. It was developed by Larry Williams in 1976. The calculation involves buying pressure, true range, and averages combined in a 4:2:1 ratio, scaled to 0-100. Levels below 30 are oversold, above 70 overbought. Trading signals require divergence between price and indicator. Backtests show the indicator performs well, with profit factors often above 2.5, high win rates, and manageable drawdowns, making it a reliable mean reversion strategy.
The Supreme Court dismissed a plea to cancel the interim bail of the Ryan International School owners, the Pinto family, in connection with the murder of student Pradyuman.

The passage discusses the threat of automation to American truck drivers and other workers, and explores human augmentation—through neural laces, exosuits, and skill development—as a potential safeguard. It notes that while AI and robotics are advancing, many jobs still require human decision-making, and experts advise workers to develop new skills to remain employable.
President Trump denied watching four to eight hours of TV daily, as reported by The New York Times, which stood by its article sourced from 60 interviews.

A fast-moving lava flow from Hawaii's Kilauea volcano crossed Highway 132, destroying power lines and bringing the total number of destroyed homes to 71, with more expected. The flow knocked out power to neighborhoods, and authorities warned residents to evacuate due to risk of isolation. The eruption has destroyed over 400 utility poles, and a new fissure has opened, bringing the total to 24 since May 3.

Meb Faber’s Tactical Asset Allocation strategy is an active trend-following approach using market timing across stocks, bonds, REITs, and commodities, divided into five categories. It uses five index ETFs, allocates 20% to each position, and holds cash if no signal is given. Backtests over 16 years show a maximum drawdown of -13.24%, lower than passive portfolios.

The Minnesota Court of Appeals remanded a child support modification case, finding the trial court's findings inadequate under *Moylan v. Moylan* to justify increasing support from $145 to $258 per child per month based on the father's income increase.

Amazon.com, Inc. filed a Form 10-Q for the quarterly period ended September 30, 2017, reporting net sales of $43.7 billion for the quarter and $117.4 billion for the nine months, with net income of $256 million and $1.2 billion, respectively. The company acquired Whole Foods Market on August 28, 2017, for approximately $13.2 billion.

BidaskClub upgraded Rapid7, Inc. (NASDAQ:RPD) from "hold" to "buy." Other analysts issued varied ratings, with an average "Buy" rating and a consensus price target of $20.19. The company reported quarterly earnings of ($0.26) per share on revenue of $47.44 million. Insiders sold 93,770 shares over 90 days. Institutional investors own 71.01% of the stock.

The Canadian dollar was little changed against the U.S. dollar on Monday, trading at C$1.2857, as investors focused on a Federal Reserve interest rate decision and a speech by Bank of Canada Governor Stephen Poloz later in the week. The currency lost 1.3% last week after the central bank left its benchmark rate steady at 1%. Speculators trimmed bullish bets on the Canadian dollar, with net long positions slipping to 42,466 contracts. Canadian government bond prices were slightly higher across the yield curve.

A senior Iranian Revolutionary Guards commander stated the Guards are ready to prevent regional oil exports if U.S. bans on Iranian oil sales proceed, following President Rouhani's threat to disrupt neighboring oil shipments.

The University of Agriculture Faisalabad approved a non-development statement of accounts worth Rs3.28 billion for 2015-16. The VC reported 48 new degree programs, student enrolment exceeding 25,000, financial assistance of Rs700 million, and a research portfolio of Rs2.5 billion. He noted Pakistan spends 0.1% of GDP on agriculture research, recommended reducing wheat irrigation from five to three methods, and stated 40% of the population faces malnutrition and post-harvest losses.

Photographer Richard Mosse's project *Heat Maps* uses a military-grade thermal camera to depict the refugee crisis, stripping individuals of identity to challenge Western perceptions. The work, displayed at Jack Shainman Gallery, combines surveillance, aesthetic ambiguity, and deliberate discomfort to force viewers to confront their complicity in the dehumanization of refugees.

India demanded the UN secretariat disclose information on staff misconduct cases and immunity waivers, criticizing the UN for reluctance to waive immunity for serious crimes. The legal advisor requested data on registered misconduct cases, refused immunity waivers, host country requests for prosecution, and consultations with member states. The UN publishes data on peacekeeper sexual misconduct since 2015 but lacks a full roster of serious misconduct cases.

President Donald Trump announced a 100% tariff on Chinese imports and export controls on critical software, effective Nov. 1, in retaliation for China's new export controls on rare earths minerals, which supply 70% of the global market and are essential for high-tech industries.

The double bottom chart pattern is a bullish reversal formation with two swing lows at a similar level and a swing high between them, seen in a downtrend. It completes when price breaks above the neckline. Traders estimate profit targets by projecting the pattern's size upward and may place stop losses in the pattern's middle or below it. Bulkowski's research on 500 stocks over five years found 68% of formations reach their target, but the study relies on manual pattern detection and may have survivorship bias.

The International Union for Conservation of Nature classifies Emperor penguins as "near-threatened." A 2014 study indicated their population could fall by 19 percent by 2100 due to rising global temperatures. A new monitoring system uses a time-lapse camera and weather data to track foraging behavior. The system revealed penguins huddling in warmer conditions, suggesting less body fat and potential food scarcity. While one researcher links this to global warming, another cites commercial fishing as a possible cause. The system is praised as cost-effective for research in Antarctica's extreme environment.
Mark Palmer forwarded a class action lawsuit filed against electricity generators, alleging market manipulation and inflated prices in California.

The court fined defendant Pomeroy $6,000 and the railroad company $108,000 for six offenses each. The passage criticizes criminal law for overturning judgments on technicalities, suggesting a law to prevent reversals unless a miscarriage of justice is shown. It discusses injunctions, opposing their total abolition in labor cases but advocating against their abuse, noting that improper use can cause irreparable harm and threaten the injunction's existence. Judges should be bold against disorder but not oppressive, and public criticism of judicial actions is permissible.

A UDMA write CRC corruption occurs after a device termination, caused by a corrupted state from a prior UDMA read with a host termination. The ATAC passes the correct CRC for the first device termination but continues from the last CRC for the next portion, causing an error. A host termination after a device termination restarts the CRC, but this is unreliable. UDMA writes cannot be used due to CRC errors. The resolution is to use the UDMA I/O blocking feature of bit 8 of the ATAC Error MSR.

The Ninth Circuit affirmed the district court's dismissal of an antitrust suit against Mitsubishi and Exportadora de Sal (ESSA), a Mexican government-owned corporation, under the act of state doctrine. The court held that the suit challenged Mexico's sovereign decision to exploit its natural resources (salt) exclusively through Mitsubishi, which is an official act performed within Mexico. Granting relief would require a U.S. court to invalidate that sovereign act, and the Sabbatino factors supported applying the doctrine. The court did not decide on a commercial exception to the doctrine, as it would not apply here.

Interferometric second-harmonic generation (SHG) polarimetry can optically resolve antiparallel domains and their boundaries in CVD-grown hexagonal boron nitride (hBN). SHG intensity varies by up to three orders of magnitude among samples, unlike Raman scattering. A mixed-domain model shows SHG intensity is a sensitive metric of crystalline order, with reductions caused by destructive interference from antiparallel domains. The methodology provides a scalable approach for structural imaging and quality assessment of non-centrosymmetric 2D crystals.

This study used untargeted metabolomics on blood samples from 22 patients undergoing TIPS placement to identify metabolites associated with post-procedure hepatic encephalopathy (HE). The TPS7H500x-SP controller has three oscillator modes: internal oscillator mode, external synchronization mode, and primary-secondary mode. In external synchronization mode, RT is left floating and a clock (200 kHz to 4 MHz, 40-60% duty cycle) is applied to SYNC at twice the desired switching frequency. In primary-secondary mode, a primary controller's SYNC output drives a secondary controller's SYNC input, allowing two independent converters to synchronize or a single interleaved converter to be designed.

The passage discusses collective Thomson scattering, where the scattering wavelength is larger than the Debye length, sampling coherent plasma motion. The scattered power spectrum is proportional to a spectral density function, S(k, ω), which depends on density fluctuations. These fluctuations are calculated using a test particle treatment and the Klimontovich distribution, leading to a formula for S(k, ω) involving electron and ion susceptibilities and distribution functions. The permittivity ε = 1 + χₑ + χᵢ determines the plasma's normal modes (e.g., ion acoustic and electron plasma waves), where peaks in S(k, ω) occur when ε = 0. For a Maxwellian plasma, the susceptibilities are expressed using the plasma dispersion function.

The lecture discusses paternalism in policy with behavioral agents. It contrasts neoclassical reasons for government intervention (externalities, equity, market failures) with behavioral reasons (internalities, where consumers harm their future selves). Paternalism is defined as influencing conduct for one's own good, not for externalities. Hard paternalism forces choices (taxes, bans), while soft paternalism (libertarian, asymmetric) preserves choice. Arguments against paternalism include government fallibility, heterogeneity, and freedom of choice; arguments for include helping people who make mistakes and the low cost of soft policies. Examples of popular paternalism include Social Security and cigarette taxes; unpopular examples include helmet laws. The Save More Tomorrow plan is highlighted as a successful libertarian paternalism using present bias and loss aversion. Market solutions are limited because firms exploit naive consumers. Nudges can improve welfare but may backfire or be disliked; reducing "sludges" (harmful nudges) is also important.

Montreal has been named the best city for students in the QS Best Student Cities ranking, displacing Paris after four years. The ranking considers university quality, affordability, desirability, and safety. Canada also has Vancouver in 10th and Toronto in 11th place. London rose to third, while Paris fell to second due to cost and safety concerns. Seoul is fourth. The US remains the largest market for international students, worth almost $36bn to its economy.

South Korean prosecutors raided Korean Air Lines headquarters over suspected embezzlement and breach of trust by its owning family, with investigations also covering tax evasion and suspicious money flows involving Chairman Cho Yang-ho and his family.

The TPS7H500x-SP controllers use a transconductance error amplifier. Output voltage is set via a resistor divider to a 0.613-V reference. Soft-start is controlled by a capacitor on the SS pin. Switching frequency is set by internal oscillator, external synchronization, or primary-secondary mode. The controllers have primary switching outputs (OUTA/OUTB) and synchronous rectifier outputs (SRA/SRB). Dead time and leading edge blank time are programmable. Duty cycle is configurable via the DCL pin. Current sensing and PWM generation use the CS_ILIM pin. Hiccup mode overcurrent protection uses the HICC pin. External fault protection is provided via the FAULT pin. Slope compensation is set via the RSC pin. Thermal shutdown occurs at 175°C.

He found a burnt note indicating an extramarital affair, but no instrument for standing to hang herself. Head coach John Harbaugh must rally the team to halt the slide, or they risk not winning the division or making the playoffs. He described the non-penalty collision with teammate Mark Andre, resulting in his knee and elbow injury. Frustrated by the timing, he noted MCL strains are common in the NHL. The passage describes a study on SARS-CoV-2 genomes from Rio Grande do Sul (RS), Brazil. Twelve samples from Esteio, collected in 2021, were sequenced, all belonging to the Gamma variant. Analysis of 4,706 RS genomes from March 2020 to May 2022 showed lineage shifts: B.1.1.33 in 2020, Zeta in late 2020, Gamma in early 2021, Delta in mid-2021, and Omicron from December 2021. Molecular evolution tests on structural proteins found no positive selection in E, two sites in M, and fourteen in N. Stability predictions for positively selected sites in M and N showed both stabilizing and destabilizing effects.

This study protocol describes a three-arm randomized controlled trial (RCT) testing the effectiveness of a digital mindfulness psychoeducation programme (Digital-MindCAN) on psychological symptoms among cancer survivors in Singapore. Primary outcomes are objective and subjective stress; secondary outcomes include psychological well-being, relaxation, mindfulness, resilience, depression, and anxiety. Results identified three themes: importance of sensory education, its relationship with the preschool program, and challenges/limitations. Teachers found sensory education important but noted it is insufficiently included in the program. They reported inadequate materials, unfavorable physical conditions, and a need for training on sensory integration.

The technique, called biofilm lithography, is faster, simpler, and higher-resolution than existing methods. This study examines four higher education projects (HEPs) relocated from Russia after the 2022 invasion of Ukraine, exploring how they conceptualize themselves in relation to their homeland.
